title: COBIL00C online bill payment (CB00)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CB00` → `COBIL00C`, mapset `COBIL00`, map `COBIL0A`. Online, `DFHCOMMAREA` = `CARDDEMO-COMMAREA` + `CDEMO-CB00-INFO` (`CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED X(16)` etc.).

##### Inputs
Map: `ACTIDINI` account id (11), `CONFIRMI` (`Y`/`y`/`N`/`n`/blank). Files: `ACCTDAT` (account KSDS, `CVACT01Y` 300 bytes, key `ACCT-ID 9(11)`), `CXACAIX` (xref AIX path by account, `CVACT03Y` 50 bytes), `TRANSACT` (transaction KSDS, `CVTRA05Y` 350 bytes, key `TRAN-ID X(16)`).

##### Processing flow
1. `MAIN-PARA`: `EIBCALEN = 0` → `XCTL COSGN00C`. Else copy COMMAREA; if not re-enter → set re-enter, clear map, if `CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED` not blank move it to account input and `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`; `SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN`. Re-enter: `RECEIVE-BILLPAY-SCREEN`, `EVALUATE EIBAID`: ENTER → `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`; PF3 → `RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN` (to `CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM` or `COMEN01C` when blank); PF4 → `CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN`; other → `CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY`.
2. End: `RETURN TRANSID('CB00') COMMAREA`.
3. `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`: account blank → `Acct ID can NOT be empty...`. Else account → `ACCT-ID` and `XREF-ACCT-ID`; `EVALUATE CONFIRMI`: Y/y → `CONF-PAY-YES` + `READ-ACCTDAT-FILE`; N/n → `CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN`, error flag; blank/low → `READ-ACCTDAT-FILE` only; other → `Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...`.
4. After read, `ACCT-CURR-BAL` → `CURBALI` (shown). If `ACCT-CURR-BAL <= 0` and no error → `You have nothing to pay...`. If no error: if `CONF-PAY-YES` → `READ-CXACAIX-FILE`; `STARTBR-TRANSACT-FILE` with `TRAN-ID = HIGH-VALUES`; `READPREV-TRANSACT-FILE`; `ENDBR-TRANSACT-FILE`; `WS-TRAN-ID-NUM = TRAN-ID + 1`; INITIALIZE `TRAN-RECORD`; set id, type `02`, cat `2`, source `POS TERM`, desc `BILL PAYMENT - ONLINE`, amount = `ACCT-CURR-BAL`, card = `XREF-CARD-NUM`, merchant id `999999999`, name `BILL PAYMENT`, city/zip `N/A`; `GET-CURRENT-TIMESTAMP` (ASKTIME, FORMATTIME YYYYMMDD with '-' / TIME ':' → `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.000000`) to orig/proc ts; `WRITE-TRANSACT-FILE`; then `COMPUTE ACCT-CURR-BAL = ACCT-CURR-BAL - TRAN-AMT`; `UPDATE-ACCTDAT-FILE` (REWRITE). Otherwise (blank confirm) → `Confirm to make a bill payment...`, cursor confirm.
5. File responses: ACCTDAT READ UPDATE NOTFND → `Account ID NOT found...`, other → `Unable to lookup Account...`; CXACAIX NOTFND / other similar; STARTBR/READPREV NOTFND (empty file) → `Transaction ID NOT found...` (READPREV ENDFILE → TRAN-ID zero); REWRITE NOTFND/other → `Unable to Update Account...`; WRITE NORMAL → `INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS`, green `Payment successful.  Your Transaction ID is <id>.`; DUPKEY/DUPREC → `Tran ID already exist...`; other → `Unable to Add Bill pay Transaction...`.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  T[CB00 COBIL00C MAIN-PARA] -->|EIBCALEN 0| SG[XCTL COSGN00C]
  T --> K{EIBAID}
  K -->|PF3| PR[RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN XCTL]
  K -->|PF4| CL[CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN]
  K -->|ENTER| P[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY]
  P --> C{CONFIRMI}
  C -->|Y| RA[READ-ACCTDAT-FILE UPDATE]
  C -->|blank| RA
  C -->|N| CL
  C -->|other| ER[error msg]
  RA --> B{ACCT-CURR-BAL <= 0}
  B -->|yes| NP[nothing to pay]
  B -->|no, confirmed| X[READ-CXACAIX-FILE]
  B -->|no, blank| AS[ask to confirm]
  X --> SB[STARTBR TRANSACT HIGH-VALUES READPREV ENDBR]
  SB --> N[new TRAN-ID = last + 1, build TRAN-RECORD]
  N --> WT[WRITE-TRANSACT-FILE]
  WT --> UA[UPDATE-ACCTDAT-FILE REWRITE bal - amt]
  UA --> SC[SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN RETURN CB00]
```

##### Data
Read/updated `ACCTDAT` (READ UPDATE + REWRITE), read `CXACAIX` (RIDFLD `XREF-ACCT-ID`, KEYLENGTH 11), browse+write `TRANSACT` (RIDFLD `TRAN-ID`, KEYLENGTH 16). Written transaction layout `CVTRA05Y`.

##### Outputs & side effects
New bill-payment transaction; account balance reduced by the full balance (to zero). Screen messages as listed.

##### External calls
`XCTL COSGN00C` (no commarea), `XCTL` to previous program/`COMEN01C` with `CARDDEMO-COMMAREA`; CICS `ASKTIME`/`FORMATTIME`.

##### Migration notes
- Payment amount is always the entire current balance; no partial payments.
- Transaction ID = highest existing `TRAN-ID` (numeric interpretation) + 1: non-atomic; concurrent payments can collide (DUPKEY path). Non-numeric keys in the file break the arithmetic.
- The transaction WRITE happens **before** the account REWRITE, and the REWRITE is performed even if the WRITE failed (error flag only sets a message). A failed WRITE (e.g. DUPKEY) still zeroes the balance; a failed REWRITE leaves a written payment without a balance change. No explicit SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK; the success message from the WRITE can be overwritten by a later REWRITE error message.
- Cycle credit/debit and `TCATBALF` are not updated by online payment (unlike batch posting).
- Error flags do not always stop later steps (e.g. balance is displayed after lookup errors); preserve message precedence.
- Timestamp microseconds always `000000`.
recommendation: Decide on atomicity of transaction write + account rewrite and on transaction ID generation (max+1).
note: Duplicate of sfind-5a9fd71c03ca476780cf6a7998c54416 (COBIL00C online bill payment (TRANSID CB00)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CBACT03C card cross-reference listing (READXREF)
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `READXREF` (`app/jcl/READXREF.jcl`), `EXEC PGM=CBACT03C`, STEPLIB `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB`. `PROGRAM-ID. CBACT03C`, batch, no linkage.

##### Inputs
`XREFFILE-FILE` DD `XREFFILE` = `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS`, indexed, SEQUENTIAL, OPEN INPUT, key `FD-XREF-CARD-NUM X(16)`; read INTO `CARD-XREF-RECORD` (`CVACT03Y`, 50 bytes: `XREF-CARD-NUM X(16)`, `XREF-CUST-ID 9(9)`, `XREF-ACCT-ID 9(11)`, `FILLER X(14)`).

##### Processing flow
1. DISPLAY `START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT03C`; `0000-XREFFILE-OPEN` (non-'00' → display status, `9999-ABEND-PROGRAM`).
2. `PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'`: `1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT` READ; '00' → DISPLAY `CARD-XREF-RECORD`; '10' → EOF; other → display I/O status, abend. Back in the loop, if not EOF the record is DISPLAYed again.
3. `9000-XREFFILE-CLOSE`, DISPLAY `END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT03C`, GOBACK.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[READXREF CBACT03C] --> O[0000-XREFFILE-OPEN]
  O -->|error| AB[9999-ABEND-PROGRAM CEE3ABD]
  O --> R[1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT]
  R -->|00| D1[DISPLAY CARD-XREF-RECORD] --> D2[DISPLAY again in main loop] --> R
  R -->|10| C[9000-XREFFILE-CLOSE GOBACK]
  R -->|other| AB
```

##### Data
Read-only sequential scan of the card xref KSDS. Nothing written.

##### Outputs & side effects
SYSOUT listing: each xref record printed twice (50-byte raw image). `9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS` formats non-numeric/VSAM status as `FILE STATUS IS: NNNN`.

##### External calls
`CEE3ABD` (ABCODE 999, TIMING 0) on open/read/close failure.

##### Migration notes
Diagnostic/report utility only. Duplicate display per record is real behavior (paragraph and main loop both DISPLAY). Status '10' is the only non-error end condition.
recommendation: Fully documented; diagnostic utility.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/CBACT03C.cbl, app/jcl/READXREF.jcl; merged duplicates: sfind-7000f46d6eb048a88c0b6fd931de71f0.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- 
Diff vs CBACT02C: each record is DISPLAYed twice (once in 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT, once in main loop).

End-to-end: READXREF is a job in the CA-7 file-read chain. Upstream findings: sfind-768eeaac8ac240da839e576915f7309d.

title: CBIMPORT branch-migration import split by record type
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `CBIMPORT` (`app/jcl/CBIMPORT.jcl`), `EXEC PGM=CBIMPORT`. `PROGRAM-ID. CBIMPORT`, batch, no linkage. Main: `1000-INITIALIZE`, `2000-PROCESS-EXPORT-FILE`, `3000-VALIDATE-IMPORT`, `4000-FINALIZE`, GOBACK.

##### Inputs
`EXPORT-INPUT` DD EXPFILE = `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.EXPORT.DATA`, indexed, SEQUENTIAL, OPEN INPUT, key `EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM`; 500-byte `CVEXPORT` envelope (see CBEXPORT flow).

##### Processing flow
1. `1000-INITIALIZE`: timestamp, `1100-OPEN-FILES` (EXPFILE input; CUSTOUT, ACCTOUT, XREFOUT, TRNXOUT, CARDOUT, ERROUT output; each non-'00' → abend).
2. `2000-PROCESS-EXPORT-FILE`: READ loop until status '10'; `ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-RECORDS-READ`; `EVALUATE EXPORT-REC-TYPE`: `C` → `2300-PROCESS-CUSTOMER-RECORD` (INITIALIZE `CUSTOMER-RECORD`, move `EXP-CUST-*` fields, WRITE CUSTOUT); `A` → `2400` account; `X` → `2500` xref; `T` → `2600` transaction; `D` → `2650` card; OTHER → `2700-PROCESS-UNKNOWN-RECORD` (`ADD 1 TO WS-UNKNOWN-RECORD-TYPE-COUNT`, build error record, `2750-WRITE-ERROR` → WRITE ERROUT, `ADD 1 TO WS-ERROR-RECORDS-WRITTEN`). Write failures on the data outputs → abend; read errors other than 00/10 → abend.
3. `3000-VALIDATE-IMPORT`: only DISPLAYs completion / no-error text — performs no checks.
4. `4000-FINALIZE`: CLOSE all, DISPLAY counters.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S[CBIMPORT] --> I[1000-INITIALIZE 1100-OPEN-FILES]
  I --> R[2000-PROCESS-EXPORT-FILE read EXPFILE]
  R -->|10| V[3000-VALIDATE-IMPORT display only]
  R --> E{EXPORT-REC-TYPE}
  E -->|C| C[2300 CUSTOUT]
  E -->|A| A[2400 ACCTOUT]
  E -->|X| X[2500 XREFOUT]
  E -->|T| T[2600 TRNXOUT]
  E -->|D| D[2650 CARDOUT]
  E -->|other| U[2700-PROCESS-UNKNOWN-RECORD 2750-WRITE-ERROR ERROUT]
  C & A & X & T & D & U --> R
  V --> F[4000-FINALIZE]
```

##### Data
Outputs (sequential, OPEN OUTPUT): `CUSTOUT` → `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CUSTDATA.IMPORT` (`CVCUS01Y` 500), `ACCTOUT` → `.ACCTDATA.IMPORT` (`CVACT01Y` 300), `XREFOUT` → `.CARDXREF.IMPORT` (`CVACT03Y` 50), `TRNXOUT` → `.TRANSACT.IMPORT` FB 350 (`CVTRA05Y`), `CARDOUT` (`CVACT02Y` 150) – **no DD in JCL**, `ERROUT` → `.IMPORT.ERRORS` FB 132. Error record: `ERR-TIMESTAMP X(26)`, filler, `ERR-RECORD-TYPE X(1)`, filler, `ERR-SEQUENCE 9(7)`, filler, `ERR-MESSAGE X(50)` (`Unknown record type encountered`), trailing filler to 132.

##### Outputs & side effects
New sequential datasets per entity (NEW,CATLG,DELETE), error file for unknown types; no VSAM masters are loaded by this program.

##### External calls
`CEE3ABD` on I/O errors.

##### Migration notes
- `CBIMPORT.jcl` defines no `CARDOUT` DD while the program opens `CARD-OUTPUT` for OUTPUT; on z/OS this open fails (status ≠ 00) and the program abends at initialization unless the DD is supplied — the job as shipped cannot complete. Confirm intended DSN with the customer.
- Unknown record types never abend; they are counted and logged. `ERR-SEQUENCE 9(7)` truncates the 9-digit sequence (high-order digits lost).
- Validation paragraph is a no-op; there is no referential check (e.g. account exists for card).
- Output order equals export sequence order; numeric representation conversions between `CVEXPORT` and target copybooks are done by COBOL MOVE (sign/packing must be reproduced).
recommendation: Supply the missing CARDOUT DD/target dataset; confirm whether 3000-VALIDATE-IMPORT should perform real validation.
note: Duplicate of sfind-5749e63024e546c398ee8c10b5d64b29 (CBIMPORT export-file split into master-layout files); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CLOSEFIL close CICS files via SDSF/CEMT
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `CLOSEFIL` (`app/jcl/CLOSEFIL.jcl`), step `CLCIFIL EXEC PGM=SDSF`.

##### Inputs
In-stream ISFIN commands:
`/F CICSAWSA,'CEMT SET FIL(TRANSACT ) CLO'`, `... FIL(CCXREF ) CLO`, `... FIL(ACCTDAT ) CLO`, `... FIL(CXACAIX ) CLO`, `... FIL(USRSEC ) CLO`.

##### Processing flow
SDSF issues MVS MODIFY commands to the CICS region `CICSAWSA`, which executes CEMT to close each file in order. Used before batch jobs need exclusive dataset access (counterpart open job outside this batch).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J[CLOSEFIL CLCIFIL SDSF] --> C1[CEMT SET FIL TRANSACT CLO]
  C1 --> C2[CCXREF] --> C3[ACCTDAT] --> C4[CXACAIX] --> C5[USRSEC]
```

##### Data
No data read/written; CICS file state changed to CLOSED.

##### Outputs & side effects
Five CICS files closed (online transactions using them fail until reopened).

##### External calls
`SDSF` batch, MVS `MODIFY` to `CICSAWSA`, `CEMT`.

##### Migration notes
- Region name hard-coded. `CARDDAT`, `CARDAIX`, `CUSTDAT` are NOT closed though batch jobs update/read them.
- No RC checking: the job succeeds even if CEMT fails.
recommendation: Confirm whether CARDDAT/CARDAIX/CUSTDAT should also be closed.
note:
End-to-end: CLOSEFIL opens every scripted cycle (run_posting, run_interest_calc, run_full_batch, remote_refresh), heads the Control-M folders and is the CA-7 trigger job for all chains. Upstream findings: sfind-7feddedd36284cb9bb70506492952d56, sfind-b70e9c924f394cb2a5965f7bce2166ce, sfind-574c7fefe140460688d7131108eb4d55, sfind-89eccdc975c54f8c8f058e029a06ca5f, sfind-c0001c8086c54798b228ce1ea65e05ab, sfind-768eeaac8ac240da839e576915f7309d.

title: CBACT01C account extract to PS/array/VB files (READACCT)
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `READACCT` (`app/jcl/READACCT.jcl`): `PREDEL` step `IEFBR14` deletes `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.PSCOMP`, `.ARRYPS`, `.VBPS` (DD01-DD03, DISP=(MOD,DELETE)); then `EXEC PGM=CBACT01C` (no PARM). `PROGRAM-ID. CBACT01C`, batch, no linkage.

##### Inputs
`ACCTFILE-FILE` DD `ACCTFILE` = `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS`, indexed SEQUENTIAL, OPEN INPUT, FD `FD-ACCT-ID 9(11)` + `FD-ACCT-DATA X(289)` read INTO `ACCOUNT-RECORD` (`CVACT01Y`, 300 bytes; fields listed in CBTRN02C flow).

##### Processing flow
1. Open ACCTFILE (INPUT), OUTFILE, ARRYFILE, VBRCFILE (OUTPUT); non-'00' → display + `9999-ABEND-PROGRAM`.
2. Loop until EOF: `1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT` READ. Status '00': `INITIALIZE ARR-ARRAY-REC`; `1100-DISPLAY-ACCT-RECORD` (DISPLAY every field); `1300-POPUL-ACCT-RECORD`; `1350-WRITE-ACCT-RECORD`; `1400-POPUL-ARRAY-RECORD`; `1450-WRITE-ARRY-RECORD`; `INITIALIZE VBRC-REC1`; `1500-POPUL-VBRC-RECORD`; `1550-WRITE-VB1-RECORD`; `1575-WRITE-VB2-RECORD`. Status '10' → EOF; other → display status, abend.
3. `1300-POPUL-ACCT-RECORD`: move id, status, curr bal, credit limit, cash limit, open date, expiry date; `ACCT-REISSUE-DATE` → `CODATECN-INP-DATE` and `WS-REISSUE-DATE`; `CODATECN-TYPE='2'`, `CODATECN-OUTTYPE='2'`; `CALL 'COBDATFT' USING CODATECN-REC`; `CODATECN-0UT-DATE` → `OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE`; cyc credit moved; **if `ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT = 0` move 2525.00 to `OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT`** (no ELSE – the real debit is never moved); group id moved.
4. `1400-POPUL-ARRAY-RECORD`: `ARR-ACCT-ID`; occurrence 1 = (curr bal, 1005.00); 2 = (curr bal, 1525.00); 3 = (-1025.00, -2500.00); 4-5 zero from INITIALIZE.
5. `1500-POPUL-VBRC-RECORD`: VB1 = acct id + status (12 bytes); VB2 = acct id, curr bal, credit limit, reissue year `WS-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY` (39 bytes). `1550` sets `WS-RECD-LEN=12`, `1575` sets 39; WRITE `VBR-REC` (RECORD VARYING 10-80 DEPENDING ON `WS-RECD-LEN`).
6. Any write status not '00' → display + abend. At EOF: `9000-ACCTFILE-CLOSE` only, GOBACK.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J[READACCT PREDEL IEFBR14 delete 3 outputs] --> P[CBACT01C open ACCTFILE OUTFILE ARRYFILE VBRCFILE]
  P --> R[1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT]
  R -->|10| C[9000-ACCTFILE-CLOSE GOBACK]
  R -->|other| AB[9999-ABEND-PROGRAM CEE3ABD]
  R -->|00| D[1100-DISPLAY-ACCT-RECORD]
  D --> M[1300-POPUL-ACCT-RECORD CALL COBDATFT]
  M --> Q{ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT = 0}
  Q -->|yes| K[debit out = 2525.00]
  Q -->|no| N[debit out not set]
  K & N --> W1[1350-WRITE-ACCT-RECORD OUTFILE]
  W1 --> A[1400-POPUL-ARRAY-RECORD constants] --> W2[1450-WRITE-ARRY-RECORD ARRYFILE]
  W2 --> V[1500-POPUL-VBRC-RECORD] --> W3[1550 VB1 len 12] --> W4[1575 VB2 len 39] --> R
```

##### Data
- `OUTFILE` → `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.PSCOMP` FB LRECL 107: `OUT-ACCT-ID 9(11)`, `OUT-ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS X`, `OUT-ACCT-CURR-BAL S9(10)V99`, `OUT-ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99`, `OUT-ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99`, `OUT-ACCT-OPEN-DATE X(10)`, `OUT-ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE X(10)`, `OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE X(10)`, `OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT S9(10)V99`, `OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT S9(10)V99 COMP-3` (7 bytes), `OUT-ACCT-GROUP-ID X(10)`.
- `ARRYFILE` → `.ARRYPS` FB LRECL 110: `ARR-ACCT-ID 9(11)`, `ARR-ACCT-BAL OCCURS 5` of (`ARR-ACCT-CURR-BAL S9(10)V99` zoned 12 bytes, `ARR-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT S9(10)V99 COMP-3` 7 bytes), `ARR-FILLER X(4)`.
- `VBRCFILE` → `.VBPS` VB LRECL 84: VB1 (12 bytes: `VB1-ACCT-ID 9(11)`, `VB1-ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS X`), VB2 (39 bytes: `VB2-ACCT-ID 9(11)`, `VB2-ACCT-CURR-BAL S9(10)V99`, `VB2-ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99`, `VB2-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY X(4)`).
- `CODATECN-REC` (`CODATECN.cpy`): `CODATECN-TYPE X`, `CODATECN-INP-DATE X(20)`, `CODATECN-OUTTYPE X`, `CODATECN-0UT-DATE X(20)`, `CODATECN-ERROR-MSG X(38)`.

##### Outputs & side effects
Three new sequential datasets (one record in PSCOMP and ARRYPS, two in VBPS per account); verbose SYSOUT display of every account. Source file untouched.

##### External calls
`COBDATFT` (assembler, `app/asm/COBDATFT.asm`) with `CODATECN-REC`: type '2' input `YYYY-MM-DD` → writes 8-byte `YYYYMMDD` into the output area (remaining output bytes are not cleared by the routine); invalid type sets `INVALID INPUT` in the error message; RC 0. `CEE3ABD` on I/O errors.

##### Migration notes
- `OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT` is populated only when the source debit is zero (with 2525.00); non-zero debits leave whatever value remained from the previous record (first record: initial storage). Treat as a test-data generator, not a faithful copy.
- Reissue date in PSCOMP is `YYYYMMDD` followed by 2 residual bytes, despite the 10-byte field.
- Array file contains hard-coded constants; occurrences 4–5 are zero.
- Mixed zoned/COMP-3 fields: byte layouts must be preserved for any consumer.
- Output files are never closed explicitly (relies on run-unit termination).
recommendation: Confirm whether the 2525.00 debit fallback and constant array values are test scaffolding to drop.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/CBACT01C.cbl, app/jcl/READACCT.jcl; merged duplicates: sfind-e4f55bd0596b44f3b1052610fa5005f1, sfind-19ddfe07f4244d1bad7065c53f8c5a20.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- OUTFILE write accepts status '10' as success (asymmetry with other writes).
- WS-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY derived by REDEFINES of the raw date (first 4 chars), independent of COBDATFT.

- OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT is only set when the source is zero (to 2525.00)**; otherwise it retains whatever is in the FD buffer (previous record/undefined). Test-data generator behavior, not a faithful copy.
- Array values are hardcoded test constants.
- UNIT=SYSAD is a site esoteric.

End-to-end: READACCT is a job in the CA-7 file-read chain triggered after CLOSEFIL. Upstream findings: sfind-768eeaac8ac240da839e576915f7309d.

title: CSUTLDPY shared date validation paragraphs
description:
##### Entry point
Procedure-division copybook `CSUTLDPY` (paragraph library, working storage in `CSUTLDWY`), COPYed into online programs (e.g. `COACTUPC`) and entered via `PERFORM EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD THRU EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD-EXIT` and `PERFORM EDIT-DATE-OF-BIRTH THRU ...-EXIT`.

##### Inputs
`WS-EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD` (`WS-EDIT-DATE-CCYY` 4 = century 2 + year 2, `WS-EDIT-DATE-MM` 2, `WS-EDIT-DATE-DD` 2, each with numeric redefinitions), `WS-EDIT-VARIABLE-NAME` (field label for messages), `WS-RETURN-MSG` / `WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF` flag of the host program.

##### Processing flow
1. `EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD`: set invalid flags, `EDIT-YEAR-CCYY` → `EDIT-MONTH` → `EDIT-DAY` → `EDIT-DAY-MONTH-YEAR` → `EDIT-DATE-LE` (each exits early on error via GO TO).
2. `EDIT-YEAR-CCYY`: blank → `<name> : Year must be supplied.`; non-numeric → `<name> must be 4 digit number.`; century not 19/20 → `<name> : Century is not valid.`.
3. `EDIT-MONTH`: blank → `Month must be supplied.`; not 1-12 or `TEST-NUMVAL` fails → `: Month must be a number between 1 and 12.`.
4. `EDIT-DAY`: blank → day must be supplied; not 1-31 → `:day must be a number between 1 and 31.`.
5. `EDIT-DAY-MONTH-YEAR`: day 31 in a 30-day month → `:Cannot have 31 days in this month.`; Feb 30 → `:Cannot have 30 days in this month.`; Feb 29 → divisor 400 when year-of-century = 00 else 4; remainder ≠ 0 → `:Not a leap year.Cannot have 29 days in this month.`.
6. `EDIT-DATE-LE`: `CALL 'CSUTLDTC' USING WS-EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD, WS-DATE-FORMAT ('YYYYMMDD'), WS-DATE-VALIDATION-RESULT`; severity `0000` → valid, else `<name> validation error Sev code: <sev> Message code: <msg>`.
7. `EDIT-DATE-OF-BIRTH`: compare `FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE` of the date with current date; not in the past → `<name>:cannot be in the future `.
All messages are only stored when `WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF` (first error wins); the corresponding field flag is always set.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD] --> Y[EDIT-YEAR-CCYY]
  Y -->|ok| M[EDIT-MONTH]
  M -->|ok| D[EDIT-DAY]
  D -->|ok| DMY[EDIT-DAY-MONTH-YEAR leap rules]
  DMY -->|ok| LE[EDIT-DATE-LE CALL CSUTLDTC]
  Y & M & D & DMY & LE -->|error| X[EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD-EXIT flags + message]
  LE --> X
  B[EDIT-DATE-OF-BIRTH] --> F{date < today}
  F -->|no| ERR[cannot be in the future]
```

##### Data
No files; flags and messages in host working storage.

##### Outputs & side effects
Sets `WS-EDIT-DATE-FLGS` (year/month/day valid/blank/not-ok), `INPUT-ERROR`, and `WS-RETURN-MSG`.

##### External calls
`CSUTLDTC` (`app/cbl/CSUTLDTC.cbl`, outside this batch; wraps LE `CEEDAYS`) — receives date, format mask; returns `WS-DATE-VALIDATION-RESULT` with severity and message code. Not traced further here.

##### Migration notes
- Only centuries 19 and 20 are accepted.
- Leap-year rule uses year-of-century only (YY = 00 → divisible by 400 check on the 2-digit value, i.e. 0 → always leap for 1900 and 2000); 1900-02-29 passes the COBOL check and is caught only if `CSUTLDTC` rejects it.
- Day 31 check precedes February checks; message wording (including odd spacing) is user-visible.
recommendation: CSUTLDTC (CEEDAYS wrapper) lies outside this batch; confirm its severity/message codes.

title: CBTRN02C daily transaction posting (POSTTRAN)
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `POSTTRAN` (`app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl`), step `STEP15 EXEC PGM=CBTRN02C` (no PARM), load library `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB`. `PROGRAM-ID. CBTRN02C`, batch (no CICS, no linkage section). Main line starts at PROCEDURE DIVISION (line 193).

##### Inputs
| Logical file (SELECT) | DD | Dataset | Organization / access / open mode |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DALYTRAN-FILE` | `DALYTRAN` | `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYTRAN.PS` | sequential, INPUT, 350-byte records |
| `XREF-FILE` | `XREFFILE` | `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS` | indexed, RANDOM, INPUT, key card number X(16) |
| `ACCOUNT-FILE` | `ACCTFILE` | `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS` | indexed, RANDOM, I-O, key account id 9(11) |
| `TCATBAL-FILE` | `TCATBALF` | `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.VSAM.KSDS` | indexed, RANDOM, I-O, key acct 9(11)+type X(2)+cat 9(4) |

Daily transaction record (`CVTRA06Y`, 350 bytes): `DALYTRAN-ID X(16)`, `DALYTRAN-TYPE-CD X(2)`, `DALYTRAN-CAT-CD 9(4)`, `DALYTRAN-SOURCE X(10)`, `DALYTRAN-DESC X(100)`, `DALYTRAN-AMT S9(9)V99` (zoned, signed), `DALYTRAN-MERCHANT-ID 9(9)`, `DALYTRAN-MERCHANT-NAME X(50)`, `DALYTRAN-MERCHANT-CITY X(50)`, `DALYTRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP X(10)`, `DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM X(16)`, `DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS X(26)`, `DALYTRAN-PROC-TS X(26)`, `FILLER X(20)`.

Cross-reference (`CVACT03Y`, 50 bytes): `XREF-CARD-NUM X(16)`, `XREF-CUST-ID 9(9)`, `XREF-ACCT-ID 9(11)`, `FILLER X(14)`.
Account (`CVACT01Y`, 300 bytes): `ACCT-ID 9(11)`, `ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS X`, `ACCT-CURR-BAL S9(10)V99`, `ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99`, `ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99`, `ACCT-OPEN-DATE X(10)`, `ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE X(10)`, `ACCT-REISSUE-DATE X(10)`, `ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT S9(10)V99`, `ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT S9(10)V99`, `ACCT-ADDR-ZIP X(10)`, `ACCT-GROUP-ID X(10)`, `FILLER X(178)`.
Category balance (`CVTRA01Y`, 50 bytes): `TRANCAT-ACCT-ID 9(11)`, `TRANCAT-TYPE-CD X(2)`, `TRANCAT-CD 9(4)`, `TRAN-CAT-BAL S9(9)V99`, `FILLER X(22)`.

##### Processing flow
1. Open files in order `0000-DALYTRAN-OPEN`, `0100-TRANFILE-OPEN`, `0200-XREFFILE-OPEN`, `0300-DALYREJS-OPEN`, `0400-ACCTFILE-OPEN`, `0500-TCATBALF-OPEN`; any non-'00' status displays the status and calls `9999-ABEND-PROGRAM` (`CEE3ABD`).
2. Loop until `END-OF-FILE = 'Y'`: `1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT` (status '10' sets EOF; other non-'00' abends). For each record: `ADD 1 TO WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT`, reset `WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON` to 0 and description to spaces, `1500-VALIDATE-TRAN`.
3. `1500-VALIDATE-TRAN` → `1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF`: READ `XREF-FILE` by `DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM`; INVALID KEY → reason 100 `INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND`. Only if reason still 0 → `1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT`: READ `ACCOUNT-FILE` by `XREF-ACCT-ID`; INVALID KEY → 101 `ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND`; else `COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT + DALYTRAN-AMT`; if `ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL` continue else 102 `OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION`; then independently if `ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS(1:10)` continue else 103 `TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION`.
4. Reason 0 → `2000-POST-TRANSACTION`; else `ADD 1 TO WS-REJECT-COUNT`, `2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC` (WRITE 430-byte reject = 350-byte daily record + 80-byte trailer `WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON 9(4)` + `WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC X(76)`; non-'00' abends).
5. `2000-POST-TRANSACTION`: move every DALYTRAN field to `TRAN-RECORD` (`CVTRA05Y`), `Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP` (FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE reformatted `YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.hh0000`) → `TRAN-PROC-TS`; then in order:
   - `2700-UPDATE-TCATBAL`: key = `XREF-ACCT-ID`+`DALYTRAN-TYPE-CD`+`DALYTRAN-CAT-CD`; READ; INVALID KEY (status 23) → `2700-A-CREATE-TCATBAL-REC` (INITIALIZE, set key, `ADD DALYTRAN-AMT TO TRAN-CAT-BAL`, WRITE); found → `2700-B-UPDATE-TCATBAL-REC` (ADD amount, REWRITE). Status other than 00/23 on read, or non-00 on write/rewrite → abend.
   - `2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC`: `ADD DALYTRAN-AMT TO ACCT-CURR-BAL`; if amount >= 0 add to `ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT` else add to `ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT`; REWRITE; INVALID KEY only sets reason 109 (no abend, no reject).
   - `2900-WRITE-TRANSACTION-FILE`: WRITE `TRAN-RECORD` to TRANFILE; non-'00' (incl. duplicate key 22) → abend.
6. EOF: close all six files (`9000`..`9500`, abend on error), DISPLAY processed/rejected counts; if `WS-REJECT-COUNT > 0` `MOVE 4 TO RETURN-CODE`. GOBACK.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[POSTTRAN STEP15 CBTRN02C] --> B[0000..0500 open DALYTRAN TRANFILE XREFFILE DALYREJS ACCTFILE TCATBALF]
  B --> C[1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT]
  C -->|status 10| Z[close files, display counts]
  C -->|record| V[1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF read XREFFILE]
  V -->|invalid key| R100[reason 100]
  V -->|found| AC[1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT read ACCTFILE]
  AC -->|invalid key| R101[reason 101]
  AC -->|found| L{credit limit >= cyc credit - cyc debit + amt}
  L -->|no| R102[reason 102]
  L --> E{expiry >= ORIG-TS 1:10}
  R102 --> E
  E -->|no| R103[reason 103]
  E -->|reason 0| P[2000-POST-TRANSACTION]
  R100 & R101 & R103 --> REJ[2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC DALYREJS]
  E -->|reason 102 only| REJ
  P --> T[2700-UPDATE-TCATBAL create or rewrite TCATBALF]
  T --> U[2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC rewrite ACCTFILE]
  U --> W[2900-WRITE-TRANSACTION-FILE TRANFILE]
  W --> C
  REJ --> C
  Z --> RC{rejects > 0}
  RC -->|yes| RC4[RETURN-CODE 4]
  RC -->|no| END[GOBACK RC 0]
```

##### Data
- Read: DALYTRAN (sequential), XREFFILE, ACCTFILE, TCATBALF (random).
- Written: TRANFILE `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS` (indexed, RANDOM, OUTPUT; 350-byte `TRAN-RECORD`: `TRAN-ID X(16)` key, `TRAN-TYPE-CD X(2)`, `TRAN-CAT-CD 9(4)`, `TRAN-SOURCE X(10)`, `TRAN-DESC X(100)`, `TRAN-AMT S9(9)V99`, `TRAN-MERCHANT-ID 9(9)`, `TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME X(50)`, `TRAN-MERCHANT-CITY X(50)`, `TRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP X(10)`, `TRAN-CARD-NUM X(16)`, `TRAN-ORIG-TS X(26)`, `TRAN-PROC-TS X(26)`, `FILLER X(20)`); DALYREJS `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYREJS(+1)` new GDG generation, 430-byte records; TCATBALF (WRITE/REWRITE); ACCTFILE (REWRITE).

##### Outputs & side effects
Posted transactions, updated account balances and cycle totals, created/updated category balances, reject GDG generation; SYSOUT counts `TRANSACTIONS PROCESSED`/`TRANSACTIONS REJECTED`; RC 4 when rejects exist, abend (CEE3ABD, code 999) on I/O failures.

##### External calls
`CEE3ABD` via `9999-ABEND-PROGRAM` (`ABCODE` 999, `TIMING` 0) – Language Environment abend, no return. `FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE` for timestamps.

##### Migration notes
- Opening TRANFILE as OUTPUT on a KSDS with existing records: the program WRITEs new keys; duplicate `TRAN-ID` abends the whole run (no reject).
- Over-limit test uses only current-cycle credit minus debit plus amount, not `ACCT-CURR-BAL`; `WS-TEMP-BAL` is `S9(09)V99` so cycle sums above 999,999,999.99 truncate high-order digits silently.
- Reason 103 overwrites 102 when both apply; only one reason is recorded.
- Expiry compare is alphanumeric `X(10)` vs first 10 chars of the origin timestamp; works only for `YYYY-MM-DD` formats.
- Ordering: TCATBAL updated and account rewritten before the transaction write; there is no commit/rollback — an abend mid-record leaves partial updates.
- Account REWRITE failure (reason 109) is not routed to rejects; the transaction is still written and counted as posted.
- Debit/credit split by sign: amount 0 adds to cycle credit. No ROUNDED; all arithmetic exact at 2 decimals.
- Return code 4 (not 0) when any reject exists—downstream scheduling (`Control-M`) may depend on it.
recommendation: Fully documented. Customer decision: whether to preserve partial-update ordering (TCATBAL/account before transaction write) and reason-103-overwrites-102 behavior.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl, app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl; merged duplicates: sfind-c0cb63235d834c219161f6a33b058d90, sfind-fda88b0a58c74c73849fd0e184915482, sfind-0e987d082b5344b4a08519931171c6dc.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- TRANFILE opened OUTPUT although it is the master KSDS; on z/OS this requires an empty or REUSE cluster - otherwise open fails/data replaced. Re-implementation must decide append vs. replace semantics with the customer.
- Expiry check is a lexical compare of 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings; blank expiry date fails (spaces < digits) -> 103.
- WS-TEMP-BAL S9(9)V99 vs account S9(10)V99 fields: silent high-order truncation possible.
- Amounts are zoned decimal signed (overpunch) in files; use BigDecimal scale 2.
- DALYREJS DCB RECFM=F (not FB).


End-to-end: POSTTRAN is submitted by run_posting.sh (after CLOSEFIL/ACCTFILE/TCATBALF/TRANBKP) and run_full_batch.sh, and in CA-7 is triggered in the CLOSEFIL-started chain; together they form the daily transaction posting cycle. title: CARDDEMO CSD resource definitions (transactions, programs, files, TDQ)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS CSD definition file `app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD` (DFHCSDUP input) defining group `CARDDEMO`. Installed resources drive every online flow: transaction → program, program/mapset load modules, files → VSAM datasets, TD queue.

##### Inputs
DEFINE statements (LIBRARY, MAPSET, PROGRAM, TRANSACTION, FILE, TDQUEUE).

##### Processing flow
Resource mappings observed:
- TRANSACTION → PROGRAM: `CAUP`→`COACTUPC`, `CAVW`→`COACTVWC`, `CA00`→`COADM01C`, `CB00`→`COBIL00C`, `CCDL`→`COCRDSLC`, `CCLI`→`COCRDLIC`, `CCUP`→`COCRDUPC`, `CC00`→`COSGN00C`, `CDV1`→`COCRDSEC`, `CM00`→`COMEN01C`, `CR00`→`CORPT00C`, `CT00`→`COTRN00C`, `CT01`→`COTRN01C`, `CT02`→`COTRN02C`, `CU00`→`COUSR00C`, `CU01`→`COUSR01C`, `CU02`→`COUSR02C`, `CU03`→`COUSR03C`.
- FILE → DSN: `ACCTDAT`→`AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS`, `CARDAIX`→`...CARDDATA.VSAM.AIX.PATH`, `CARDDAT`→`...CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS`, `CCXREF`→`...CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS`, `CUSTDAT`→`...CUSTDATA.VSAM.KSDS`, `CXACAIX`→`...CARDXREF.VSAM.AIX.PATH`, `TRANSACT`→`...TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS`, `USRSEC`→`...USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS`; all `LSRPOOLNUM(1) STRINGS(1) OPENTIME(FIRSTREF) DISPOSITION(SHARE) RECORDFORMAT(V)`, ADD/BROWSE/DELETE/READ/UPDATE YES, `UPDATEMODEL(LOCKING)`, `READINTEG(UNCOMMITTED)`, no journaling.
- MAPSETs `COACTUP COACTVW COADM01 COBIL00 COCRDLI COCRDSL COCRDUP COMEN01 CORPT00 COSGN00 COTRN00 COTRN01 COTRN02 COUSR00 COUSR01 COUSR02 COUSR03`.
- LIBRARY `CARDDLIB` and `COM2DOLL` → `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB`.
- TDQUEUE `JOBS` `TYPE(EXTRA) DDNAME(INREADER)` output, 80-byte records (internal reader; used to submit JCL from CICS, e.g. by `CORPT00C`).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CSD[CARDDEMO.CSD group CARDDEMO] --> TR[TRANSACTION CC00 CM00 CA00 CB00 CCLI CCUP CAUP CT01 CU00 CU02 ...]
  TR --> PG[PROGRAM COSGN00C COMEN01C COADM01C COBIL00C COCRDLIC COCRDUPC COACTUPC COTRN01C COUSR00C COUSR02C ...]
  PG --> MS[MAPSET COSGN00 COBIL00 COCRDLI COCRDUP COACTUP ...]
  PG --> FL[FILE ACCTDAT CARDDAT CARDAIX CCXREF CXACAIX CUSTDAT TRANSACT USRSEC]
  FL --> DS[AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.*.VSAM.KSDS / AIX.PATH]
  CSD --> TD[TDQUEUE JOBS INREADER]
  CSD --> LB[LIBRARY CARDDLIB COM2DOLL LOADLIB]
```

##### Data
VSAM datasets as mapped above.

##### Outputs & side effects
Defines the runtime resource namespace used by `EXEC CICS READ DATASET('...')` in programs.

##### External calls
None (consumed by `DFHCSDUP`/CICS).

##### Migration notes
- `CDV1`→`COCRDSEC`: no `COCRDSEC` source exists in the repo — dangling definition.
- `READINTEG(UNCOMMITTED)` + `UPDATEMODEL(LOCKING)`: reads see uncommitted data; record locks are held until syncpoint.
- `CARDAIX` and `CXACAIX` are AIX paths (non-unique keys); programs read the first match.
- This file and `CBADMCDJ.jcl` disagree (see that flow); this file matches program literals.
recommendation: COCRDSEC program for CDV1 has no source; confirm whether it is retired.

title: CBEXPORT branch-migration export of all master files
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `CBEXPORT` (`app/jcl/CBEXPORT.jcl`): STEP 1 `IDCAMS` (`DELETE AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.EXPORT.DATA CLUSTER PURGE`, `SET MAXCC = 0`, `DEFINE CLUSTER ... INDEXED KEYS(4 28) RECORDSIZE(500 500) CYLINDERS(10 5) FREESPACE(10 10) SHAREOPTIONS(2 3)`); STEP 2 `EXEC PGM=CBEXPORT`. `PROGRAM-ID. CBEXPORT`, batch, no linkage. Main: `1000-INITIALIZE`, `2000-EXPORT-CUSTOMERS`, `3000-EXPORT-ACCOUNTS`, `4000-EXPORT-XREFS`, `5000-EXPORT-TRANSACTIONS`, `5500-EXPORT-CARDS`, `6000-FINALIZE`, GOBACK.

##### Inputs
All indexed, ACCESS SEQUENTIAL, OPEN INPUT:
| SELECT | DD | Dataset | Key | Copybook |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CUSTOMER-INPUT` | CUSTFILE | `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CUSTDATA.VSAM.KSDS` | `CUST-ID` | `CVCUS01Y` (500 bytes) |
| `ACCOUNT-INPUT` | ACCTFILE | `...ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS` | `ACCT-ID` | `CVACT01Y` (300) |
| `XREF-INPUT` | XREFFILE | `...CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS` | `XREF-CARD-NUM` | `CVACT03Y` (50) |
| `TRANSACTION-INPUT` | TRANSACT | `...TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS` | `TRAN-ID` | `CVTRA05Y` (350) |
| `CARD-INPUT` | CARDFILE | `...CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS` | `CARD-NUM` | `CVACT02Y` (150: `CARD-NUM X(16)`, `CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11)`, `CARD-CVV-CD 9(3)`, `CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME X(50)`, `CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X(10)`, `CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS X`, filler X(59)) |

##### Processing flow
1. `1000-INITIALIZE`: build `WS-EXPORT-TIMESTAMP` from `FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE` (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.hh0000` style 26 chars), `1100-OPEN-FILES` (each OPEN checked; non-'00' → display + `9999-ABEND-PROGRAM`).
2. For each source in fixed order (customers → accounts → xrefs → transactions → cards): priming READ, loop until status '10'; per record `INITIALIZE EXPORT-RECORD`, set `EXPORT-REC-TYPE` (`C`,`A`,`X`,`T`,`D`), `EXPORT-TIMESTAMP`, `ADD 1 TO WS-SEQUENCE-COUNTER` → `EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM`, `EXPORT-BRANCH-ID='0001'`, `EXPORT-REGION-CODE='NORTH'`, move every source field into the matching `EXP-*` redefinition of `EXPORT-RECORD-DATA`, WRITE `EXPORT-OUTPUT-RECORD`; non-'00' write → abend; increment type counter and `WS-TOTAL-RECORDS-EXPORTED`. Read errors other than 00/10 → abend.
3. `6000-FINALIZE`: CLOSE all, DISPLAY per-type counts and total.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J1[CBEXPORT STEP1 IDCAMS delete/define EXPORT.DATA] --> J2[STEP2 CBEXPORT]
  J2 --> I[1000-INITIALIZE timestamp 1100-OPEN-FILES]
  I --> C[2000-EXPORT-CUSTOMERS type C]
  C --> A[3000-EXPORT-ACCOUNTS type A]
  A --> X[4000-EXPORT-XREFS type X]
  X --> T[5000-EXPORT-TRANSACTIONS type T]
  T --> D[5500-EXPORT-CARDS type D]
  D --> F[6000-FINALIZE close + counts]
  C & A & X & T & D -->|I/O error| AB[9999-ABEND-PROGRAM CEE3ABD]
```

##### Data
Output `EXPORT-OUTPUT` DD EXPFILE = `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.EXPORT.DATA`, indexed, SEQUENTIAL, OPEN OUTPUT, RECORD KEY `EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM`. `CVEXPORT` 500-byte envelope: `EXPORT-REC-TYPE X(1)`, `EXPORT-TIMESTAMP X(26)`, `EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM 9(9) COMP` (4 bytes binary), `EXPORT-BRANCH-ID X(4)`, `EXPORT-REGION-CODE X(5)`, `EXPORT-RECORD-DATA X(460)` redefined per type (`EXP-CUST-*`, `EXP-ACCT-*`, `EXP-XREF-*`, `EXP-TRAN-*`, `EXP-CARD-*` — field-for-field copies of the source copybooks; some numeric fields re-declared COMP/COMP-3 in `CVEXPORT`, so representation changes on export).

##### Outputs & side effects
Full re-creation of the export KSDS (prior contents purged by STEP1); SYSOUT counts.

##### External calls
`IDCAMS` (JCL), `CEE3ABD` on any error.

##### Migration notes
- The COBOL key `EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM` begins at byte offset 27 (after 1+26 bytes), but the cluster is defined `KEYS(4 28)` (length 4, offset 28). The defined key straddles the sequence number and branch id; whether the program's key description matches the cluster could only be confirmed at run time — record this discrepancy rather than "fix" it silently.
- Sequence is a single counter across all record types in the fixed order above; import relies on it for ordering. Binary 4-byte sequence; >999,999,999 overflow not handled.
- Branch `0001` and region `NORTH` are hard-coded; one timestamp for the whole run.
- No filtering: every record of every file is exported.
recommendation: Reconcile EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM offset (27) with cluster KEYS(4 28) before re-implementing the export file.
note: Duplicate of sfind-f06fac9d5d98466b878ffde08f4dc3fc (CBEXPORT multi-record master-file export); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: COUSR00C user list and paging (CU00)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CU00` → `COUSR00C`, mapset `COUSR00`, map `COUSR0A` (admin "List Users"). Online; commarea = `CARDDEMO-COMMAREA` + `CDEMO-CU00-INFO` (`CDEMO-CU00-USRID-FIRST X(8)`, `CDEMO-CU00-USRID-LAST X(8)`, `CDEMO-CU00-PAGE-NUM 9(8)`, `CDEMO-CU00-NEXT-PAGE-FLG X` (88 `NEXT-PAGE-YES 'Y'`), `CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG X`, `CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED X(8)`).

##### Inputs
Map: search `USRIDINI`, ten selection fields `SEL0001I`..`SEL0010I`. File `USRSEC` (`CSUSR01Y` 80 bytes, key `SEC-USR-ID`).

##### Processing flow
1. `MAIN-PARA`: no commarea → `XCTL COSGN00C`. First entry → set re-enter, clear map, `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`, send. Re-entry: receive; ENTER → `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`; PF3 → `XCTL COADM01C`; PF7 → `PROCESS-PF7-KEY`; PF8 → `PROCESS-PF8-KEY`; other → invalid-key message. `RETURN TRANSID('CU00')`.
2. `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`: scan SEL0001..SEL0010 in order; first non-blank sets `CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG` and `CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED` (row's user id). If selection: `U`/`u` → `CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM='COUSR02C'`, from tran/program set, context 0, `XCTL`; `D`/`d` → `XCTL COUSR03C`; other → `Invalid selection. Valid values are U and D`. Then `SEC-USR-ID` = search field (or LOW-VALUES if blank), page 0, `PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD`.
3. `PROCESS-PF7-KEY`: key = `CDEMO-CU00-USRID-FIRST` (LOW-VALUES if blank); if page > 1 → `PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD` else `You are already at the top of the page...`.
4. `PROCESS-PF8-KEY`: key = `CDEMO-CU00-USRID-LAST` (HIGH-VALUES if blank); if `NEXT-PAGE-YES` → `PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD` else `You are already at the bottom of the page...`.
5. `PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD`: `STARTBR DATASET('USRSEC') RIDFLD(SEC-USR-ID) KEYLENGTH(8)` (GTEQ); if not ENTER key, one `READNEXT` to skip the current boundary record; clear rows; `READNEXT` up to 10 records → `POPULATE-USER-DATA` (row id, first name, last name, type), first row id → `USRID-FIRST`, last → `USRID-LAST`; page +1; peek one more `READNEXT`: found → `NEXT-PAGE-YES` else `NEXT-PAGE-NO`; ENDFILE → `You have reached the bottom of the page...`; `ENDBR`; send.
6. `PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD`: STARTBR at first id, skip one `READPREV` (when not ENTER), fill rows 10 → 1 with `READPREV`, extra `READPREV` to decide page decrement, `ENDBR`, send. NOTFND on STARTBR / ENDFILE → top-of-file message.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  T[CU00 COUSR00C] -->|no commarea| S[XCTL COSGN00C]
  T --> K{EIBAID}
  K -->|ENTER| E[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY scan SEL0001-SEL0010]
  E -->|U| U2[XCTL COUSR02C]
  E -->|D| U3[XCTL COUSR03C]
  E -->|none/invalid| PF[PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD]
  K -->|PF8 next page| PF
  K -->|PF7 page > 1| PB[PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD]
  K -->|PF3| A[XCTL COADM01C]
  PF --> B1[STARTBR READNEXT x10 peek ENDBR USRSEC]
  PB --> B2[STARTBR READPREV x10 ENDBR USRSEC]
  B1 & B2 --> SC[SEND-USRLST-SCREEN RETURN CU00]
```

##### Data
Read-only browse of `USRSEC`.

##### Outputs & side effects
User list screen (10 rows: id, first, last, type). Navigation to update/delete programs with selected user id in commarea.

##### External calls
XCTL `COSGN00C`, `COADM01C`, `COUSR02C`, `COUSR03C` with `CARDDEMO-COMMAREA` + `CDEMO-CU00-INFO`.

##### Migration notes
- First non-blank selection wins; later selections are ignored silently.
- Invalid selection message is set but the page is still re-read and redisplayed.
- Paging is key-based (first/last ids in commarea), not offset based; records inserted/deleted between screens shift pages.
- Backward paging leaves rows not refilled when fewer than 10 earlier records exist (rows are only overwritten for records read).
- Passwords are never displayed here.
recommendation: Fully documented.

title: COCRDLIC credit card list with filters and paging (CCLI)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CCLI` → `COCRDLIC`, mapset `COCRDLI`, map `CCRDLIA` (credit card list). Online; commarea = `CARDDEMO-COMMAREA` + `WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA` (`WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM`, `WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-ACCT-ID`, `WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM`, `WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID`, `WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM`, next-page / last-page-shown flags). Returned with `RETURN TRANSID('CCLI') COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)` (both parts concatenated).

##### Inputs
Map: account filter `CC-ACCT-ID` (11), card filter `CC-CARD-NUM` (16), 7 row selection codes (`S` view, `U` update). File `CARDDAT` = `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS`, `CVACT02Y` 150-byte card record (`CARD-NUM X(16)` key, `CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11)`, `CARD-CVV-CD 9(3)`, `CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME X(50)`, `CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X(10)`, `CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS X`, filler X(59)). `CARDAIX` literal declared but not used for I/O.

##### Processing flow
1. `0000-MAIN`: INITIALIZE work areas. `EIBCALEN = 0` → initialize commareas, user type `U`, `CDEMO-PGM-ENTER`, first page, last-page-not-shown. Else split DFHCOMMAREA into both areas; if entering from another program → reset program area and first page.
2. `YYYY-STORE-PFKEY` (`CSSTRPFY`) maps EIBAID. If coming from itself → `2000-RECEIVE-MAP` (RECEIVE + `2200-EDIT-INPUTS`). Only ENTER/PF3/PF7/PF8 are valid; others treated as ENTER.
3. PF3 from itself → user type `U`, `PGM-ENTER`, exit message, `XCTL COMEN01C` with `CARDDEMO-COMMAREA`.
4. `2200-EDIT-INPUTS`: `2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT` (blank/zero → filter off; non-numeric → `ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER`), `2220-EDIT-CARD` (non-numeric → `CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER`), `2250-EDIT-ARRAY` (skipped on prior error; count of `S`+`U` > 1 → error, offending rows flagged; each row: valid → `I-SELECTED`, blank ok, other → invalid-action error).
5. `EVALUATE TRUE`: INPUT-ERROR → message, read forward (only if filters are not in error) and send; PF7 on first page → forward from first card; PF3 or re-entry from another program → reset, forward from first card; PF8 with next page → start at last card, `WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM + 1`, forward; PF7 not first page → `WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM - 1`, `9100-READ-BACKWARDS` from first card; ENTER + `S` → `XCTL COCRDSLC` with `CDEMO-ACCT-ID`/`CDEMO-CARD-NUM` of the row; ENTER + `U` → `XCTL COCRDUPC` likewise; OTHER → forward from first card. Then `1000-SEND-MAP` (`1100-SCREEN-INIT`, `1200-SCREEN-ARRAY-INIT`, `1250-SETUP-ARRAY-ATTRIBS`, `1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS`, `1400-SETUP-MESSAGE`, `1500-SEND-SCREEN`) and `COMMON-RETURN`.
6. `9000-READ-FORWARD`: `STARTBR DATASET('CARDDAT') RIDFLD(WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) GTEQ`; loop `READNEXT`: NORMAL/DUPREC → `9500-FILTER-RECORDS` (exclude when account filter valid and `CARD-ACCT-ID ≠ CC-ACCT-ID`, or card filter valid and `CARD-NUM ≠ CC-CARD-NUM-N`); included rows fill `WS-ROW-CARD-NUM`, `WS-ROW-ACCTNO`, `WS-ROW-CARD-STATUS`; row 1 sets first-card keys (screen 0 → 1); at `WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES` (7) stop and peek one `READNEXT` → next page exists, else ENDFILE → no next page + `NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW`; ENDFILE in loop → same message, `WS-NO-RECORDS-FOUND` when screen 1 and 0 rows; other RESP → `File Error: READ on CARDDAT ...`. `ENDBR`.
7. `9100-READ-BACKWARDS`: mirror with `READPREV` from the first card key, filling rows bottom-up.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  T[CCLI COCRDLIC 0000-MAIN] --> R{from itself}
  R -->|yes| RM[2000-RECEIVE-MAP 2200-EDIT-INPUTS]
  R -->|no| EV
  RM --> EV{EVALUATE}
  EV -->|PF3| M[XCTL COMEN01C]
  EV -->|ENTER + S| V[XCTL COCRDSLC]
  EV -->|ENTER + U| U[XCTL COCRDUPC]
  EV -->|PF8 next page| F[9000-READ-FORWARD]
  EV -->|PF7 not first| B[9100-READ-BACKWARDS]
  EV -->|error / other / first page| F
  F --> FI[STARTBR READNEXT 9500-FILTER-RECORDS ENDBR CARDDAT]
  B --> BI[STARTBR READPREV 9500-FILTER-RECORDS ENDBR CARDDAT]
  FI & BI --> S[1000-SEND-MAP] --> CR[COMMON-RETURN RETURN CCLI]
```

##### Data
Read-only browse of `CARDDAT`.

##### Outputs & side effects
Card list screen (7 rows: card number, account, active status) and paging state in commarea.

##### External calls
XCTL `COMEN01C`, `COCRDSLC`, `COCRDUPC` with `CARDDEMO-COMMAREA` (`CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM='COCRDLIC'`, `CDEMO-FROM-TRANID='CCLI'`, last map/mapset set).

##### Migration notes
- Filters are applied by scanning the whole card file in card-number order (the `CARDAIX` account path is not used) — O(n) per page.
- Every XCTL forces `CDEMO-USRTYP-USER` and `CDEMO-PGM-ENTER`, so admin status is not propagated.
- Invalid PF keys silently behave as ENTER.
- Only first error message wins (`WS-ERROR-MSG-OFF` checks).
- Header comments describe admin-sees-all vs user-sees-own-account behavior; no such role-based filter was found in the executed paragraphs (filtering depends only on the screen filters).
recommendation: Confirm intended role-based filtering (header comments) vs observed screen-filter-only behavior.
note: Duplicate of sfind-8518f237530e474290d2db29136a9ff4 (CCLI / COCRDLIC); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CBACT04C monthly interest calculation (INTCALC)
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `INTCALC` (`app/jcl/INTCALC.jcl`), `STEP15 EXEC PGM=CBACT04C,PARM='2022071800'`. `PROGRAM-ID. CBACT04C`, batch. `PROCEDURE DIVISION USING EXTERNAL-PARMS` where `EXTERNAL-PARMS` = `PARM-LENGTH S9(4) COMP` + `PARM-DATE X(10)` (the JCL PARM text).

##### Inputs
| SELECT | DD | Dataset | Org / access / mode |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TCATBAL-FILE` | `TCATBALF` | `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.VSAM.KSDS` | indexed, SEQUENTIAL, INPUT |
| `XREF-FILE` | `XREFFILE` (+`XREFFIL1` AIX path `CARDXREF.VSAM.AIX.PATH`) | `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS` | indexed, RANDOM, INPUT, primary key card X(16), ALTERNATE KEY `FD-XREF-ACCT-ID` 9(11) |
| `DISCGRP-FILE` | `DISCGRP` | `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DISCGRP.VSAM.KSDS` | indexed, RANDOM, INPUT, key group X(10)+type X(2)+cat 9(4) |
| `ACCOUNT-FILE` | `ACCTFILE` | `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS` | indexed, RANDOM, I-O |

Layouts: `TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD` (`CVTRA01Y`, 50 bytes: acct 9(11), type X(2), cat 9(4), `TRAN-CAT-BAL S9(9)V99`, filler X(22)); `DIS-GROUP-RECORD` (`CVTRA02Y`, 50 bytes: `DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID X(10)`, `DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD X(2)`, `DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD 9(4)`, `DIS-INT-RATE S9(4)V99`, filler X(28)); account `CVACT01Y` (300 bytes) and xref `CVACT03Y` (50 bytes) as in CBTRN02C.

##### Processing flow
1. Open TCATBALF, XREFFILE, DISCGRP, ACCTFILE, TRANSACT (`0000`..`0400`), abend via `CEE3ABD` on any non-'00'.
2. Loop `PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'`: `1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT` (status 10 → EOF). Per record: `ADD 1 TO WS-RECORD-COUNT`, `DISPLAY TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD`.
3. Control break on `TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT = WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM`: if not first record → `1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT` for the previous account; set `WS-FIRST-TIME='N'`; `WS-TOTAL-INT = 0`; `1100-GET-ACCT-DATA` (READ ACCOUNT-FILE by acct; INVALID KEY displays `ACCOUNT NOT FOUND` – status then checked, non-00 abends); `1110-GET-XREF-DATA` (READ XREF-FILE KEY IS `FD-XREF-ACCT-ID` alternate key; non-00 abends).
4. For every record: DISCGRP key = `ACCT-GROUP-ID`+`TRANCAT-TYPE-CD`+`TRANCAT-CD`; `1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE`: READ; status '23' → display `TRY WITH DEFAULT GROUP CODE`, set group `DEFAULT`, `1200-A-GET-DEFAULT-INT-RATE` (non-00 abends); other non-00/23 abends.
5. If `DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0`: `1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST`: `COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-INT = (TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200`; `ADD WS-MONTHLY-INT TO WS-TOTAL-INT`; `1300-B-WRITE-TX`: `ADD 1 TO WS-TRANID-SUFFIX`; `TRAN-ID = PARM-DATE ‖ WS-TRANID-SUFFIX(6 digits)`; type `01`, cat `05`, source `System`, desc `Int. for a/c ` ‖ `ACCT-ID`, amount `WS-MONTHLY-INT`, merchant id 0, merchant name/city/zip spaces, card `XREF-CARD-NUM`, orig/proc ts = `Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP`; WRITE to TRANSACT (non-00 abends). `1400-COMPUTE-FEES` is an empty paragraph (only `EXIT`).
6. `1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT`: `ADD WS-TOTAL-INT TO ACCT-CURR-BAL`; `ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT = 0`; `ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT = 0`; REWRITE (non-00 abends).
7. Close all files, display `END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT04C`, GOBACK.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[INTCALC STEP15 CBACT04C PARM date] --> O[open TCATBALF XREFFILE DISCGRP ACCTFILE TRANSACT]
  O --> R[1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT]
  R -->|EOF| X[close files GOBACK]
  R --> BRK{TRANCAT-ACCT-ID changed}
  BRK -->|yes, not first| U[1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT rewrite ACCTFILE]
  BRK -->|yes| G[1100-GET-ACCT-DATA + 1110-GET-XREF-DATA alt key]
  U --> G
  BRK -->|no| I
  G --> I[1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE DISCGRP]
  I -->|status 23| D[1200-A-GET-DEFAULT-INT-RATE group DEFAULT]
  I --> Q{DIS-INT-RATE = 0}
  D --> Q
  Q -->|no| C[1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST bal*rate/1200]
  C --> W[1300-B-WRITE-TX TRANSACT]
  W --> F[1400-COMPUTE-FEES empty]
  F --> R
  Q -->|yes| R
  R -.ELSE branch unreachable.-> U2[1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT last account]
```

##### Data
- Read: TCATBALF (sequential), XREFFILE (alternate key), DISCGRP, ACCTFILE.
- Written: ACCTFILE REWRITE; TRANSACT = `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.SYSTRAN(+1)` new GDG generation, sequential OUTPUT, 350-byte `TRAN-RECORD` (`CVTRA05Y`).
- TCATBALF balances are NOT reset or modified.

##### Outputs & side effects
New interest transactions in SYSTRAN(+1) (later merged into the transaction master by other jobs, not in this batch), account current balance increased by summed interest and cycle credit/debit zeroed, DISPLAY of every category-balance record.

##### External calls
`CEE3ABD` (abend 999) from `9999-ABEND-PROGRAM`; `FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE`.

##### Migration notes
- **Last account is never updated**: the `ELSE PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT` sits under `IF END-OF-FILE = 'N'`, but the `PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'` test exits the loop as soon as EOF is set inside the previous iteration, so the ELSE is unreachable; the final account's interest transactions are written but its balance is not incremented nor cycle totals zeroed. Decide explicitly whether to replicate.
- Accounts with no TCATBALF rows are untouched. Empty input → no updates.
- `WS-MONTHLY-INT` arithmetic has no ROUNDED: truncation to 2 decimals; rate is annual percent (`/1200`). Negative category balances yield negative interest.
- Rate lookup uses the account group per category; missing group falls back to `DEFAULT`; missing default abends.
- Transaction ID = 10-char PARM date + 6-digit counter; rerunning with the same PARM produces the same IDs (duplicates when merged). Counter wraps after 999,999.
- The xref is read by account alternate key: with multiple cards per account the first card on the AIX is used.
- Fees are a stub; nothing is charged.
recommendation: Confirm with customer whether the final account in TCATBALF is intentionally left un-updated (unreachable ELSE) and whether fee computation (empty 1400-COMPUTE-FEES) should be implemented.
note: Duplicate of sfind-d232d1a1035546fe9e6bed2a7c05caab (INTCALC / CBACT04C); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: COUSR02C user update (CU02)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CU02` → `COUSR02C`, mapset `COUSR02`, map `COUSR2A` (admin "Update User"). Online; commarea = `CARDDEMO-COMMAREA` + `CDEMO-CU02-INFO` (same shape as CU00 info, incl. `CDEMO-CU02-USR-SELECTED X(8)`; populated from `COUSR00C` selection).

##### Inputs
Map: `USRIDINI` (8), `FNAMEI` (20), `LNAMEI` (20), `PASSWDI` (8), `USRTYPEI` (1). File `USRSEC` (`CSUSR01Y`).

##### Processing flow
1. `MAIN-PARA`: no commarea → `XCTL COSGN00C`. First entry: set re-enter, clear map, if selected user present → `USRIDINI`, `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`; send. Re-entry: receive; ENTER → `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`; PF3 → `UPDATE-USER-INFO` then return to `CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM` or `COADM01C`; PF4 → `CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN`; PF5 → `UPDATE-USER-INFO`; PF12 → `XCTL COADM01C` (no save); other → invalid-key message. `RETURN TRANSID('CU02')`.
2. `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`: blank id → `User ID can NOT be empty...`; else `READ-USER-SEC-FILE` (`EXEC CICS READ DATASET('USRSEC') INTO(SEC-USER-DATA) RIDFLD(SEC-USR-ID) KEYLENGTH(8) UPDATE`): NORMAL → `Press PF5 key to save your updates ...` and show first/last name, password, type; NOTFND → `User ID NOT found...`; other → `Unable to lookup User...`.
3. `UPDATE-USER-INFO`: validate in order id, first name, last name, password, user type (each blank → `<field> can NOT be empty...`, stop). Then `READ-USER-SEC-FILE` again; compare each of first name, last name, password, type with screen; any difference → move new value, set `USR-MODIFIED-YES`. If modified → `UPDATE-USER-SEC-FILE` (`EXEC CICS REWRITE DATASET('USRSEC') FROM(SEC-USER-DATA)`): NORMAL → green `User <id> has been updated ...`; NOTFND → `User ID NOT found...`; other → `Unable to Update User...`. Not modified → red `Please modify to update ...`.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  T[CU02 COUSR02C] -->|no commarea| S[XCTL COSGN00C]
  T --> K{EIBAID}
  K -->|ENTER| E[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY READ USRSEC UPDATE]
  K -->|PF5| U[UPDATE-USER-INFO]
  K -->|PF3| U3[UPDATE-USER-INFO then XCTL from-program or COADM01C]
  K -->|PF12| A[XCTL COADM01C]
  K -->|PF4| C[CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN]
  U --> V{fields non-blank}
  V -->|no| M[error msg]
  V -->|yes| R[READ-USER-SEC-FILE UPDATE]
  R --> D{any field changed}
  D -->|yes| W[UPDATE-USER-SEC-FILE REWRITE]
  D -->|no| N[Please modify to update]
  E & W & N & M --> SC[SEND-USRUPD-SCREEN RETURN CU02]
```

##### Data
`USRSEC` READ UPDATE + REWRITE of the 80-byte user record (id unchanged; fname, lname, pwd, type replaced).

##### Outputs & side effects
Updated user security record; screen messages.

##### External calls
XCTL `COSGN00C`, `COADM01C`, previous program, with commarea.

##### Migration notes
- User type only checked non-blank: any character (not just A/U) is stored; sign-on treats non-'A' as regular user.
- Password stored/displayed in plaintext; input is NOT uppercased here although sign-on uppercases input — a lowercase password set here can never sign on.
- If the second READ in `UPDATE-USER-INFO` fails (error flag set), the compare/rewrite logic still runs on stale `SEC-USER-DATA`; REWRITE then fails without a held lock or rewrites with old data — preserve or explicitly fix.
- PF3 saves before exiting (and exits even if validation fails).
recommendation: Decide case-handling of passwords vs sign-on uppercasing and user-type validation.
note: Duplicate of sfind-daa894451ea649bea29ff3486ced948e (CU02 / COUSR02C user update screen (USRSEC)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: COACTUPC account and customer update (CAUP)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CAUP` → `COACTUPC`, mapset `COACTUP`, map `CACTUPA` (account + customer update). Online; commarea = `CARDDEMO-COMMAREA` + program area (`ACUP-*` state flags analogous to COCRDUPC, `ACUP-OLD-DETAILS`, `ACUP-NEW-DETAILS` covering all account and customer fields). Entered from `COMEN01C`.

##### Inputs
Map: account id (11) for search; editable account fields (status, open/expiry/reissue date parts, credit limit, cash credit limit, current balance, cycle credit, cycle debit, group id) and customer fields (first/middle/last name, address lines 1-3, state, country, zip, phone 1/2 as area/prefix/line, SSN 3+2+4, government id, DOB parts, EFT account id, primary card holder Y/N, FICO score). Files: `CXACAIX` (xref by account), `ACCTDAT` (`CVACT01Y`), `CUSTDAT` (`CVCUS01Y` 500 bytes, key `CUST-ID 9(9)`).

##### Processing flow
1. `0000-MAIN`: HANDLE ABEND; fresh start if `EIBCALEN = 0` or from `COMEN01C` and not re-enter; PF key validation (ENTER, PF3, PF5 when OK-not-confirmed, PF12 when fetched; else ENTER). PF3 → from tran/program or `CM00`/`COMEN01C`, user type U, `SYNCPOINT`, XCTL. Not fetched & enter or from menu → blank search screen. Done/failed → reset and blank. OTHER → `1000-PROCESS-INPUTS` → `2000-DECIDE-ACTION` → `3000-SEND-MAP`; `RETURN TRANSID('CAUP')`.
2. `1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS`: no details yet → `1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT` only. Else `1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW` (no change → `NO-CHANGES-DETECTED`) then field edits in this order: Account Status `1220-EDIT-YESNO`; Open Date (`EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD` from `CSUTLDPY`); Credit Limit `1250-EDIT-SIGNED-9V2`; Expiry Date; Cash Credit Limit; Reissue Date; Current Balance; Current Cycle Credit; Current Cycle Debit (all signed 9V2 via `FUNCTION TEST-NUMVAL-C`); SSN `1265-EDIT-US-SSN` (part1 not 000/666/900-999); Date of Birth (date edit + `EDIT-DATE-OF-BIRTH` not in future); FICO `1245-EDIT-NUM-REQD` + `1275-EDIT-FICO-SCORE` (300-850); First Name `1225-EDIT-ALPHA-REQD`; Middle Name `1235-EDIT-ALPHA-OPT`; Last Name; Address Line 1 `1215-EDIT-MANDATORY`; State alpha + `1270-EDIT-US-STATE-CD` (valid US state table); Zip numeric; City alpha; Country alpha; Phone 1/2 `1260-EDIT-US-PHONE-NUM` (area code valid per table `EDIT-AREA-CODE`, prefix/line numeric non-zero, optional when all blank); EFT Account Id numeric; Primary Card Holder Y/N; finally `1280-EDIT-US-STATE-ZIP-CD` (state + first 2 zip digits combination table) when state and zip valid.
3. `2000-DECIDE-ACTION` (same state machine as COCRDUPC): not fetched/PF12 → `9000-READ-ACCT` → show when `FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER`; show-details → error/no-change stay else OK-NOT-CONFIRMED; PF5 → `9600-WRITE-PROCESSING` → lock error / failed / changed (re-show) / done; OTHER → abend `0001` `UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO`.
4. `9000-READ-ACCT`: `9200-GETCARDXREF-BYACCT` (`READ DATASET('CXACAIX') RIDFLD(acct X(11))` → `CDEMO-CUST-ID`, `CDEMO-CARD-NUM`; NOTFND → account-not-in-xref message), `9300-GETACCTDATA-BYACCT` (`READ ACCTDAT`), `9400-GETCUSTDATA-BYCUST` (`READ CUSTDAT RIDFLD(cust id X(9))`), `9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA` (old snapshot).
5. `9600-WRITE-PROCESSING`: `READ ACCTDAT UPDATE` (fail → `COULD-NOT-LOCK-ACCT-FOR-UPDATE`), `READ CUSTDAT UPDATE` (fail → `COULD-NOT-LOCK-CUST-FOR-UPDATE`), `9700-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC` (changed → exit). Build `ACCT-UPDATE-RECORD` (id, status, balances/limits, cycle credit/debit, open/expiry/reissue dates `YYYY-MM-DD`, group id) and `CUST-UPDATE-RECORD` (names, addresses, state, country, zip, phones `(AAA)BBB-CCCC`, SSN, govt id, DOB `YYYY-MM-DD`, EFT id, primary holder, FICO). `REWRITE ACCTDAT` (fail → `LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED`); `REWRITE CUSTDAT` (fail → `LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED` + `SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK`).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  T[CAUP COACTUPC 0000-MAIN] --> E{EVALUATE}
  E -->|PF3| X[SYNCPOINT XCTL COMEN01C]
  E -->|fresh| BL[3000-SEND-MAP search]
  E -->|other| PI[1000-PROCESS-INPUTS 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS + CSUTLDPY]
  PI --> DA[2000-DECIDE-ACTION]
  DA -->|search| RA[9000-READ-ACCT CXACAIX ACCTDAT CUSTDAT]
  DA -->|valid changes| CF[ask PF5]
  DA -->|PF5| WP[9600-WRITE-PROCESSING READ UPDATE x2]
  WP --> CK[9700-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC]
  CK -->|same| RA2[REWRITE ACCTDAT]
  RA2 -->|ok| RC[REWRITE CUSTDAT]
  RC -->|fail| RB[SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK]
  DA -->|unexpected| AB[ABEND-ROUTINE]
  RA & CF & CK & RC & RB & BL --> SM[3000-SEND-MAP RETURN CAUP]
```

##### Data
Reads `CXACAIX`, `ACCTDAT`, `CUSTDAT`; READ UPDATE + REWRITE of `ACCTDAT` (300 bytes) and `CUSTDAT` (500 bytes).

##### Outputs & side effects
Account and customer master records rewritten together; rollback if the customer rewrite fails.

##### External calls
`CSUTLDTC` (via `CSUTLDPY` `EDIT-DATE-LE`) for date validity; XCTL to menu/from-program; `SYNCPOINT`, `SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK`, `ABEND`.

##### Migration notes
- Balance, credit limits and cycle totals are directly editable here (no posting/audit transaction is created).
- Customer is located via the first xref of the account (`CXACAIX`); multi-customer accounts are not handled.
- Validation order defines which single error message is shown; replicate the order.
- Phones are re-formatted to `(AAA)BBB-CCCC`; dates rebuilt as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- Lock failures on the customer READ UPDATE leave the account lock held until task end.
- The program is ~4,200 lines; screen attribute paragraphs (`3300`..`3390`) were reviewed at paragraph level only (protect/unprotect and colour handling), so confidence is medium.
recommendation: Screen-attribute paragraphs reviewed at paragraph level only; CSUTLDTC behaviour not traced in this batch.
note: Duplicate of sfind-ea9f460e24fc4aafaa64553e6a0577e2 (COACTUPC account + customer update (TRANSID CAUP)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.
