title: COSGN00C sign-on (CC00) and role-based menu routing
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CC00` → program `COSGN00C` (CSD group `CARDDEMO`), BMS mapset `COSGN00`, map `COSGN0A`. Online pseudo-conversational program; uses `DFHCOMMAREA` mapped to `CARDDEMO-COMMAREA` (`COCOM01Y`).

##### Inputs
- `EIBCALEN`, `EIBAID` (`DFHENTER`, `DFHPF3`, other).
- Map fields `USERIDI` (8) and `PASSWDI` (8).
- `USRSEC` CICS file (dataset `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS`), 80-byte `SEC-USER-DATA` (`CSUSR01Y`): `SEC-USR-ID X(8)` key, `SEC-USR-FNAME X(20)`, `SEC-USR-LNAME X(20)`, `SEC-USR-PWD X(8)`, `SEC-USR-TYPE X(1)` ('A' admin / 'U' user), `SEC-USR-FILLER X(23)`.

##### Processing flow
1. `MAIN-PARA`: clear error flag/message. If `EIBCALEN = 0` → `MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COSGN0AO`, cursor on user id, `SEND-SIGNON-SCREEN`.
2. Else `EVALUATE EIBAID`: ENTER → `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`; PF3 → `SEND-PLAIN-TEXT` with thank-you message (`CCDA-MSG-THANK-YOU`) and `EXEC CICS RETURN` (no TRANSID – conversation ends); OTHER → error flag, `CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY`, resend screen.
3. Every path not ending in XCTL/plain-text ends with `EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CC00') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)`.
4. `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`: `RECEIVE MAP('COSGN0A') MAPSET('COSGN00')`; user id blank/low → `Please enter User ID ...`; password blank/low → `Please enter Password ...` (resend screen each time). Else `FUNCTION UPPER-CASE` of both into `WS-USER-ID`, `WS-USER-PWD`, `CDEMO-USER-ID`; `READ-USER-SEC-FILE`.
5. `READ-USER-SEC-FILE`: `EXEC CICS READ DATASET('USRSEC') INTO(SEC-USER-DATA) RIDFLD(WS-USER-ID) KEYLENGTH(8) RESP RESP2`. RESP 0: if `SEC-USR-PWD = WS-USER-PWD` → set `CDEMO-FROM-TRANID='CC00'`, `CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM='COSGN00C'`, `CDEMO-USER-ID`, `CDEMO-USER-TYPE = SEC-USR-TYPE`, `CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT=0`; if admin → `XCTL PROGRAM('COADM01C') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)` else `XCTL PROGRAM('COMEN01C')`. Wrong password → `Wrong Password. Try again ...` (cursor password). RESP 13 → `User not found. Try again ...`. Other → `Unable to verify the User ...`.
6. `SEND-SIGNON-SCREEN` populates header (`POPULATE-HEADER-INFO`: titles `CCDA-TITLE01/02`, tran/program name, current date MM/DD/YY and time HH:MM:SS from `FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE`, `ASSIGN APPLID` and `SYSID`), `SEND MAP ERASE CURSOR`.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  T[CC00 COSGN00C MAIN-PARA] --> Q{EIBCALEN = 0}
  Q -->|yes| S[SEND-SIGNON-SCREEN]
  Q -->|no| K{EIBAID}
  K -->|PF3| PT[SEND-PLAIN-TEXT thank you RETURN]
  K -->|other| S
  K -->|ENTER| P[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY RECEIVE COSGN0A]
  P -->|blank id/pwd| S
  P --> R[READ-USER-SEC-FILE READ USRSEC]
  R -->|RESP 13 / other / wrong pwd| S
  R -->|pwd ok, type A| A[XCTL COADM01C]
  R -->|pwd ok, other type| M[XCTL COMEN01C]
  S --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CC00 COMMAREA]
```

##### Data
Read-only `USRSEC` keyed read (CSD FILE `USRSEC`, `READ(YES)`, locking update model not used here).

##### Outputs & side effects
Screen `COSGN0A`; on success transfers control with populated COMMAREA (user id, type, from-tran/program, context 0). No file updates.

##### External calls
`EXEC CICS XCTL` to `COADM01C` (admin menu) or `COMEN01C` (main menu) passing `CARDDEMO-COMMAREA` (no return). `ASSIGN APPLID/SYSID`.

##### Migration notes
- Credentials are uppercased before lookup and compare; stored IDs/passwords must be uppercase to match. Plaintext 8-char password compare.
- Any user type other than 'A' (including blank) is routed to the regular menu.
- PF3 ends the pseudo-conversation (RETURN without TRANSID).
- Messages and cursor positioning are part of the UX contract.
recommendation: Fully documented. Decide on credential storage (plaintext, uppercased) in target stack.
note: Duplicate of sfind-392f2c38beae46788ed4fa8bf2032a83 (COSGN00C sign-on screen (TRANSID CC00)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CBSTM03A account statement generation (CREASTMT) with CBSTM03B I/O
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `CREASTMT` (`app/jcl/CREASTMT.JCL`). Steps in order: (1) `IDCAMS` delete/define `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS`; (2) `SORT` of `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS` by card number (pos 263, len 16) then transaction id (pos 1, len 16), `OUTREC` placing card number at 1-16, transaction payload at 17-278 and card/key area at 279-328; (3) `IDCAMS REPRO` sorted output into `TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS`; (4) `IEFBR14` deletes old statement PS and HTML datasets; (5) `EXEC PGM=CBSTM03A`. `PROGRAM-ID. CBSTM03A`, batch; calls subprogram `CBSTM03B` for all master-file I/O.

##### Inputs
Via `CBSTM03B` (DD names): `TRNXFILE` = sorted transaction KSDS (`COSTM01.CPY` `TRNX-RECORD`: key `TRNX-CARD-NUM X(16)` + `TRNX-ID X(16)`, then `TRNX-REST` = type X(2), cat 9(4), source X(10), desc X(100), `TRNX-AMT S9(9)V99`, merchant id 9(9), name X(50), city X(50), zip X(10), orig ts X(26), proc ts X(26), filler); `XREFFILE` = card xref KSDS (`CVACT03Y`), read sequentially; `CUSTFILE` = customer KSDS (`CUSTREC.cpy`/`CVCUS01Y`), keyed read by `XREF-CUST-ID`; `ACCTFILE` = account KSDS (`CVACT01Y`), keyed read by `XREF-ACCT-ID`.
Interface area `WS-M03B-AREA`: `WS-M03B-DD X(8)`, `WS-M03B-OPER X(1)` (`O` open, `C` close, `R` read-next, `K` keyed read, `W` write, `Z` rewrite), `WS-M03B-RC X(2)` (file status), `WS-M03B-KEY X(25)`, `WS-M03B-KEY-LN S9(4)`, `WS-M03B-FLDT X(1000)` (record buffer).

##### Processing flow
1. Diagnostic preamble: walks PSA → TCB → TIOT control blocks and DISPLAYs job name, step name and every DD name allocated (no business effect).
2. Opens `STMTFILE` and `HTMLFILE` (OUTPUT) and, via `CBSTM03B` oper `O`, TRNXFILE, XREFFILE, CUSTFILE, ACCTFILE (status ≠ '00' → display + abend via `9999-ABEND-PROGRAM` / `CEE3ABD`). The open sequence is driven by an ALTER/GO TO dispatch (`0000-START` → `8100-FILE-OPEN` → `8200-XREFFILE-OPEN` → `8300-CUSTFILE-OPEN` → `8400-ACCTFILE-OPEN`).
3. `8500-READTRNX-READ`: reads ALL transaction records into memory: `WS-CARD-TBL OCCURS 51` (card number + count `WS-TRCT`) each with `WS-TRAN-TBL OCCURS 10` (`WS-TRAN-NUM X(16)`, `WS-TRAN-REST`); a new card slot starts whenever `TRNX-CARD-NUM` changes (input must be sorted, which the SORT step guarantees).
4. Main loop over XREFFILE (`1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT`, oper `R`, '10' → end): per xref, `2000-CUSTFILE-GET` (oper `K`, key `XREF-CUST-ID`, length 9), `3000-ACCTFILE-GET` (oper `K`, key `XREF-ACCT-ID`, length 11), `5000-CREATE-STATEMENT`, `MOVE 1 TO CR-JMP`, `MOVE ZERO TO WS-TOTAL-AMT`, `4000-TRNXFILE-GET`.
5. `5000-CREATE-STATEMENT`: INITIALIZE statement lines; WRITE text lines `ST-LINE0` .. header; name = `CUST-FIRST-NAME`+' '+`CUST-MIDDLE-NAME`+' '+`CUST-LAST-NAME` (STRING DELIMITED BY ' '); address lines 1-2; line 3 = addr line 3 + state + country + zip; account id, `ACCT-CURR-BAL`, `CUST-FICO-CREDIT-SCORE`; `5100-WRITE-HTML-HEADER` and `5200-WRITE-HTML-NMADBS` write HTML table lines.
6. `4000-TRNXFILE-GET`: scan card table `CR-JMP` from 1 until `> CR-CNT` or table card `> XREF-CARD-NUM`; on equal card, for each of its `WS-TRCT` transactions `6000-WRITE-TRANS` (statement line `ST-LINE14`: tran id, description, amount; HTML row) and `ADD TRNX-AMT TO WS-TOTAL-AMT`. Then write total line `ST-LINE14A` and trailer lines; HTML closing lines.
7. End of xref: close all (oper `C` for the four VSAM files), GOBACK.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J1[CREASTMT IDCAMS define TRXFL] --> J2[SORT TRANSACT by card+tranid] --> J3[REPRO into TRXFL] --> J4[IEFBR14 delete STMT/HTML] --> P[CBSTM03A]
  P --> DG[PSA/TCB/TIOT DD display]
  DG --> O[8100..8400 open via CALL CBSTM03B oper O]
  O --> L[8500-READTRNX-READ load WS-CARD-TBL 51 x WS-TRAN-TBL 10]
  L --> X[1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT CBSTM03B R]
  X -->|status 10| CL[close via CBSTM03B C GOBACK]
  X --> CU[2000-CUSTFILE-GET K]
  CU --> AC[3000-ACCTFILE-GET K]
  AC --> ST[5000-CREATE-STATEMENT STMTFILE + HTMLFILE]
  ST --> TR[4000-TRNXFILE-GET scan table]
  TR --> W[6000-WRITE-TRANS per tran, sum WS-TOTAL-AMT]
  W --> TOT[write ST-LINE14A total] --> X
```

##### Data
Written: `STMTFILE` FB 80 (text statement) and `HTMLFILE` FB 100 (HTML statement), new datasets; work KSDS `TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS` recreated by the JCL. Masters only read.

##### Outputs & side effects
One plain-text and one HTML statement section per card cross-reference (including cards with no transactions, which get header + zero total). SYSOUT diagnostics of the job's DDs.

##### External calls
- `CBSTM03B` (`app/cbl/CBSTM03B.CBL`) `USING WS-M03B-AREA`: EVALUATE on DD name; TRNXFILE/XREFFILE support O/R/C, CUSTFILE/ACCTFILE support O/K/C; returns file status in `WS-M03B-RC` and record in `WS-M03B-FLDT`. Unknown DD → immediate GOBACK (RC unchanged). Opers `W`/`Z` have no implementation branch (no-op).
- `CEE3ABD` on errors; `SORT`, `IDCAMS`, `IEFBR14` in JCL.

##### Migration notes
- In-memory tables have fixed bounds (51 cards, 10 transactions per card) and no bounds checks: more data overwrites adjacent storage / is unpredictable. A re-implementation must decide on limits explicitly.
- Matching relies on both the transaction table and XREFFILE being in ascending card order; the early-exit condition (`table card > xref card`) skips data otherwise.
- Customer name STRING uses `DELIMITED BY ' '`, so multi-word names are truncated at the first space.
- Customer/account keyed-read failures abend the run; there is no "skip" path.
- Uses ALTER / GO TO control flow and low-level MVS control-block access (not portable); diagnostics only.
- Amounts totalled without ROUNDED; total field is edited numeric for print.
recommendation: Decide limits for the 51-card / 10-transaction in-memory tables; CBSTM03B W/Z operations are unimplemented.
note: Duplicate of sfind-c61aa7aa8ce745ec820239c5975bbf26 (CREASTMT / CBSTM03A + CBSTM03B); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CBADMCDJ DFHCSDUP CSD install job (divergent names)
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `CBADMCDJ` (`app/jcl/CBADMCDJ.jcl`), `STEP1 EXEC PGM=DFHCSDUP,PARM='CSD(READWRITE),PAGESIZE(60),NOCOMPAT'`, STEPLIB `OEM.CICSTS.V05R06M0.CICS.SDFHLOAD`, DFHCSD `OEM.CICSTS.DFHCSD`, symbolic `HLQ=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO`.

##### Inputs
In-stream SYSIN DEFINE commands.

##### Processing flow
DFHCSDUP processes SYSIN sequentially: DEFINE LIBRARY (load lib `&HLQ..LOADLIB`), DEFINE MAPSET/PROGRAM entries (several defined twice with different descriptions — later DEFINE fails/replaces per DFHCSDUP rules), DEFINE TRANSACTIONs, all in GROUP `CARDDEMO`; then LIST of the group.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J[CBADMCDJ STEP1 DFHCSDUP] --> L[DEFINE LIBRARY]
  L --> M[DEFINE MAPSET / PROGRAM duplicates]
  M --> T[DEFINE TRANSACTION incl CCDM->COADM00C]
  T --> G[group CARDDEMO in OEM.CICSTS.DFHCSD]
```

##### Data
Writes CSD dataset `OEM.CICSTS.DFHCSD`.

##### Outputs & side effects
CSD updated; SYSPRINT listing.

##### External calls
`DFHCSDUP` (IBM CICS utility).

##### Migration notes
- Names diverge from `CARDDEMO.CSD` and program literals: defines `COADM00C` (code uses `COADM01C`), transaction `CCDM`→`COADM00C` while the program definition references `TRANSID(CCAD)`; other names do not match existing sources. Treat `CARDDEMO.CSD` as the authoritative mapping; this job reflects an older naming set.
- Duplicate DEFINEs produce warnings/RC>0 in DFHCSDUP; no FILE definitions are included here.
recommendation: Confirm this job is obsolete in favor of CARDDEMO.CSD.
note: Duplicate of sfind-b613c4a2000a4e8099caa63603b38fad (CBADMCDJ); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: COCRDUPC card detail update with optimistic locking (CCUP)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CCUP` → `COCRDUPC`, mapset `COCRDUP`, map `CCRDUPA` (card update). Online; commarea = `CARDDEMO-COMMAREA` + program area holding state flag (`CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED`, `CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS`, `CCUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK`, `CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED`, `CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE`, `CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-LOCK-ERROR`, `CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-BUT-FAILED`/`CCUP-CHANGES-FAILED`) plus `CCUP-OLD-DETAILS` and `CCUP-NEW-DETAILS` (acct id, card id, CVV, embossed name, expiry year/month/day, status). Entered from `COCRDLIC` (`U` action) or `COMEN01C`.

##### Inputs
Map: account id (11), card number (16), embossed name, active status (Y/N), expiry month, expiry year. File `CARDDAT` (`CVACT02Y`).

##### Processing flow
1. `0000-MAIN`: `HANDLE ABEND LABEL(ABEND-ROUTINE)`. Fresh start if `EIBCALEN = 0` or from `COMEN01C` and not re-enter. `YYYY-STORE-PFKEY`; valid keys ENTER, PF3, PF5 only when `CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED`, PF12 only when details fetched; otherwise ENTER.
2. `EVALUATE`: PF3 (or done/failed when last mapset is the list) → `CDEMO-TO-TRANID/PROGRAM` = from values (defaults menu `CM00`/`COMEN01C`), zero acct/card if from list, user type `U`, `EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT`, `XCTL`. Entered from `COCRDLIC` (PGM-ENTER) or PF12 from list → filters valid, `9000-READ-DATA`, `CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS`, send. Not fetched / from menu → blank search screen. Done or failed → reset areas, blank screen. OTHER → `1000-PROCESS-INPUTS` (`1100-RECEIVE-MAP`, `1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS`), `2000-DECIDE-ACTION`, `3000-SEND-MAP`. `COMMON-RETURN`: `RETURN TRANSID('CCUP')`.
3. `1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS`: when no details yet → `1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT` (11-digit numeric) and `1220-EDIT-CARD` (16-digit numeric). With details: compare new vs old (no change → `NO-CHANGES-DETECTED`), `1230-EDIT-NAME` (required; only letters/spaces), `1240-EDIT-CARDSTATUS` (Y/N), `1250-EDIT-EXPIRY-MON` (1-12), `1260-EDIT-EXPIRY-YEAR` (1950-2099). First error message wins.
4. `2000-DECIDE-ACTION`: not fetched / PF12 → read if filters valid → show details; `CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS` → if error or no change stay, else `CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED` (prompt PF5); `CCUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK` stay; OK-not-confirmed + PF5 → `9200-WRITE-PROCESSING` → lock error / update failed / data changed (re-show) / done; done → show details (clear keys if no from-tran); OTHER → abend code `0001` `UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO`.
5. `9000-READ-DATA` → `9100-GETCARD-BYACCTCARD`: `READ FILE('CARDDAT') RIDFLD(card number)`; NORMAL → found; NOTFND → `DID-NOT-FIND-ACCTCARD-COMBO`; other → file error message. Save old CVV, name (uppercased), expiry parts (`(1:4)`,`(6:2)`,`(9:2)`), status.
6. `9200-WRITE-PROCESSING`: `READ ... UPDATE`; failure → `COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE`. `9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC`: uppercase current name, compare CVV, name, expiry parts, status to old snapshot; different → `DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE`, refresh old snapshot, exit. Build `CARD-UPDATE-RECORD`: card number, `CC-ACCT-ID-N`, CVV, new name, expiry `YYYY-MM-DD` (day = old day carried in new details), status; `REWRITE FILE('CARDDAT')`; non-NORMAL → `LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED`.
7. `ABEND-ROUTINE`: SEND abend message text, `HANDLE ABEND CANCEL`, `EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999')`.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  T[CCUP COCRDUPC 0000-MAIN] --> E{EVALUATE}
  E -->|PF3| X[SYNCPOINT XCTL from-program or COMEN01C]
  E -->|from COCRDLIC| RD[9000-READ-DATA 9100-GETCARD-BYACCTCARD READ CARDDAT]
  E -->|fresh| BL[3000-SEND-MAP blank]
  E -->|other| PI[1000-PROCESS-INPUTS 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS]
  PI --> DA[2000-DECIDE-ACTION]
  DA -->|changes valid| CF[OK-NOT-CONFIRMED ask PF5]
  DA -->|PF5 confirmed| WP[9200-WRITE-PROCESSING READ UPDATE]
  WP --> CK[9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC]
  CK -->|changed by others| SD[show details]
  CK -->|same| RW[REWRITE CARDDAT]
  RW -->|fail| FL[OKAYED-BUT-FAILED]
  RW -->|ok| DN[OKAYED-AND-DONE]
  DA -->|unexpected| AB[ABEND-ROUTINE ABEND 9999]
  RD & CF & SD & FL & DN & BL --> SM[3000-SEND-MAP RETURN CCUP]
```

##### Data
`CARDDAT` READ, READ UPDATE, REWRITE of the 150-byte card record (`CARD-UPDATE-RECORD` same layout as `CVACT02Y`).

##### Outputs & side effects
Updated card name/status/expiry (and account id field re-stamped from screen account). Screen state messages.

##### External calls
XCTL to `CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM` / `COMEN01C` / `COCRDLIC` with `CARDDEMO-COMMAREA`; `SYNCPOINT` before exit; `ABEND`.

##### Migration notes
- Optimistic concurrency: snapshot compare before REWRITE; name compare is case-insensitive via uppercase conversion.
- The read is by card number only; the account number entered is not verified against `CARD-ACCT-ID` but is written into the record on update — account linkage can be changed through this screen.
- Embossed name is stored as entered (case preserved) but compared uppercased.
- Expiry day is not editable; CVV is carried through unchanged.
- PF5/PF12 are only valid in specific states; otherwise treated as ENTER.
recommendation: Confirm whether changing the card account linkage via this screen is intended.
note: Duplicate of sfind-307e554868944198aa3149a3c7e2729c (CCUP / COCRDUPC credit card update screen); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: COTRN01C transaction detail inquiry (CT01)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CT01` → `COTRN01C`, mapset `COTRN01`, map `COTRN1A`. Online; `DFHCOMMAREA` = `CARDDEMO-COMMAREA` + `CDEMO-CT01-INFO` (first/last tran id X(16), page num, next-page flag, `CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SEL-FLG X`, `CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED X(16)`). Normally entered from `COTRN00C` (transaction list).

##### Inputs
Map `TRNIDINI` (16). File `TRANSACT` (`AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS`, `CVTRA05Y` 350 bytes, key `TRAN-ID X(16)`).

##### Processing flow
1. `MAIN-PARA`: `EIBCALEN = 0` → `XCTL COSGN00C`. First entry (not re-enter): set re-enter, clear map, if `CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED` not blank/low → move to `TRNIDINI` and `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`; `SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN`.
2. Re-entry: `RECEIVE-TRNVIEW-SCREEN`; ENTER → `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`; PF3 → `RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN` (`CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM`, default `COMEN01C`); PF4 → `CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN`; PF5 → `CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM = 'COTRN00C'`, return-to-prev; other → invalid-key message.
3. `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`: blank id → `Tran ID can NOT be empty...`; else clear output fields, `READ-TRANSACT-FILE` (`EXEC CICS READ DATASET('TRANSACT') INTO(TRAN-RECORD) RIDFLD(TRAN-ID) KEYLENGTH(16) UPDATE`). NORMAL → move `TRAN-AMT` to edited `WS-TRAN-AMT` and display id, card, type, category, source, amount, description, orig/proc timestamps, merchant id/name/city/zip. NOTFND → `Transaction ID NOT found...`; other → DISPLAY RESP/REAS, `Unable to lookup Transaction...`.
4. `RETURN TRANSID('CT01') COMMAREA`.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  T[CT01 COTRN01C MAIN-PARA] -->|EIBCALEN 0| S[XCTL COSGN00C]
  T -->|first entry| F{CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED set}
  F -->|yes| P[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY]
  F -->|no| SS[SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN]
  T -->|reenter| K{EIBAID}
  K -->|ENTER| P
  K -->|PF3| R[RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN XCTL from-program or COMEN01C]
  K -->|PF4| C[CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN]
  K -->|PF5| L[XCTL COTRN00C]
  P --> RD[READ-TRANSACT-FILE READ UPDATE]
  RD --> SS
  SS --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CT01]
```

##### Data
Read-only use of `TRANSACT` (read with UPDATE option, never rewritten).

##### Outputs & side effects
Transaction detail screen. The UPDATE read holds an exclusive record lock until task end (RETURN).

##### External calls
XCTL to `COSGN00C`, previous program / `COMEN01C`, or `COTRN00C` with `CARDDEMO-COMMAREA` (`CDEMO-FROM-TRANID='CT01'`, `CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM='COTRN01C'`, context 0).

##### Migration notes
- `READ ... UPDATE` for a view-only screen: a re-implementation need not lock, but contention behavior differs.
- `WS-TRAN-AMT PIC +99999999.99` shows only 8 integer digits of an `S9(9)V99` amount: the leading digit is silently truncated for amounts ≥ 100,000,000.
recommendation: Fully documented.
note: Duplicate of sfind-345a28a78e9542ce8c1e9e6aad86e5eb (CT01 / COTRN01C transaction view screen); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: COADM01C admin menu (TRANSID CA00) - option dispatch via COADM02Y with PGMIDERR handler
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `COADM01C`, TRANSID `CA00`; reached by XCTL from COSGN00C when SEC-USR-TYPE='A', and on PF3 from admin functions (e.g. COUSR01C).

##### Inputs
- Commarea CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (COCOM01Y).
- Map `COADM1A`/mapset `COADM01`: OPTIONI.
- Table COADM02Y: count=6; entries NUM 9(2), NAME X35, PGMNAME X8 (OCCURS 9 redefinition): 1 User List (Security) COUSR00C; 2 User Add (Security) COUSR01C; 3 User Update (Security) COUSR02C; 4 User Delete (Security) COUSR03C; 5 Transaction Type List/Update (Db2) COTRTLIC; 6 Transaction Type Maintenance (Db2) COTRTUPC.

##### Processing flow
1. `EXEC CICS HANDLE CONDITION PGMIDERR(PGMIDERR-ERR-PARA)`.
2. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C. Else copy commarea; first time -> set REENTER, SEND menu.
3. Re-entry: RECEIVE; ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL COSGN00C; other -> invalid key.
4. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: same right-trim/zero-fill parse as COMEN01C; invalid if non-numeric, >6 or 0.
5. If valid and PGMNAME(1:5) != 'DUMMY': FROM-TRANID=CA00, FROM-PROGRAM=COADM01C, context 0, XCTL program with commarea. If XCTL returns (not possible on success) or DUMMY: green 'This option is not installed ...', SEND menu.
6. PGMIDERR-ERR-PARA (program not defined): green 'This option is not installed ...', SEND menu, RETURN TRANSID CA00.
7. RETURN TRANSID CA00 COMMAREA.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CA00 COADM01C] --> H[HANDLE PGMIDERR]
  H --> B{EIBCALEN=0}
  B -- yes --> SG[XCTL COSGN00C]
  B -- no --> C{REENTER?}
  C -- no --> SM[SEND COADM1A]
  C -- yes --> K{EIBAID}
  K -- PF3 --> SG
  K -- other --> SM
  K -- ENTER --> V{1..6?}
  V -- no --> SM
  V -- yes --> X[XCTL COADM02Y program]
  X -- PGMIDERR --> E[PGMIDERR-ERR-PARA: not installed msg, SEND, RETURN CA00]
  SM --> RT[RETURN CA00]
```

##### Data
No file I/O.

##### Outputs & side effects
Menu lines OPTN001O..OPTN010O ('NN. name'); header; message.

##### External calls
XCTL COUSR00C/COUSR01C/COUSR02C/COUSR03C/COTRTLIC/COTRTUPC with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; XCTL COSGN00C (no commarea).

##### Migration notes
- No check that the caller is actually an admin: the program trusts that it was reached from sign-on; any task with a commarea can drive it.
- PGMIDERR handler covers missing optional Db2 programs; message omits the option name (name concatenation is commented out).
- Error branches SEND then continue; invalid option leads to the IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON block being skipped (single send).
recommendation: Fully documented. Target programs COTRTLIC/COTRTUPC (Db2 options) live in optional modules; confirm whether they are in migration scope.

title: COACTUPC account + customer update (TRANSID CAUP) - full field edits, PF5 confirm, optimistic lock, REWRITE ACCTDAT then CUSTDAT with ROLLBACK
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `COACTUPC`, TRANSID `CAUP`, map `CACTUPA`/mapset `COACTUP`. It is main menu option 2. It returns with RETURN TRANSID CAUP COMMAREA (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA + WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA). The program commarea holds the ACUP state flags (DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, SHOW-DETAILS, CHANGES-NOT-OK, CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED, CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE, OKAYED-LOCK-ERROR, OKAYED-BUT-FAILED, CHANGES-FAILED) and the ACUP-OLD-* / ACUP-NEW-* images of the account and customer fields.

##### Inputs
- Map CACTUPA. Account fields: account ID, status, open/expiry/reissue dates (year, month, day), credit limit (ACRDLIMI), cash limit (ACSHLIMI), current balance (ACURBALI), cycle credit (ACRCYCRI), cycle debit (ACRCYDBI), group. Customer fields: ID, first/middle/last name, address lines 1-3 (line 3 is labelled City), state, country, ZIP, phone 1 and 2 (3+3+4 parts), SSN (3+2+4), government ID, DOB, EFT account, primary-cardholder flag, FICO.
- AIDs: ENTER and PF3 are always valid. PF5 is valid only in CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED. PF12 is valid only after details are fetched. Any other key is treated as ENTER.

##### Processing flow
1. HANDLE ABEND. If EIBCALEN=0, or the program is entered from COMEN01C and is not re-entered, INITIALIZE the commareas and set ENTER and DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED. Otherwise split DFHCOMMAREA into the two commareas.
2. EVALUATE:
   - PF3: TO-TRANID/PROGRAM = FROM values (default CM00/COMEN01C). User type is forced to 'U', context to ENTER. Then SYNCPOINT and XCTL.
   - DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED with ENTER, or first entry from the menu: send an empty map, set REENTER and return.
   - DONE or FAILED: reset the program commarea and CDEMO-ACCT-ID, then send a fresh search screen.
   - OTHER: 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS (1100-RECEIVE-MAP + 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS), then 2000-DECIDE-ACTION, then 3000-SEND-MAP.
3. 1100-RECEIVE-MAP:
   - A field containing '*' or spaces is stored as LOW-VALUES.
   - For each money field (credit limit, cash limit, balance, cycle credit, cycle debit): if FUNCTION TEST-NUMVAL-C(text)=0, then COMPUTE ACUP-NEW-*-N = FUNCTION NUMVAL-C(text). The numeric is packed into the signed S9(10)V99 image. Otherwise only the text is kept.
4. 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS:
   - Search phase: 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT. The account must be a nonzero 11-digit number.
   - Update phase: 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW first. If nothing changed, set NO-CHANGES-DETECTED and skip the edits.
   - Edits run in this order (first message wins; WS-EDIT-VARIABLE-NAME is used as the message prefix):
     - Account Status: Y/N (1220).
     - Open Date: EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD.
     - Credit Limit: 1250-EDIT-SIGNED-9V2 (blank gives '<name> must be supplied.'; TEST-NUMVAL-C failure gives '<name> is not valid').
     - Expiry Date: date edit.
     - Cash Credit Limit: 9V2.
     - Reissue Date: date edit.
     - Current Balance: 9V2.
     - 'Current Cycle Credit Limit' and 'Current Cycle Debit Limit': 9V2.
     - SSN (1265): part 1 must not be 000, 666 or 900-999; parts 2 and 4 must be numeric and nonzero.
     - Date of Birth: date edit.
     - FICO: numeric, 300-850 (1275).
     - First and Last Name: alpha required. Middle Name: alpha optional.
     - Address Line 1: mandatory.
     - State: alpha required plus 1270 valid US state code.
     - Zip: numeric required.
     - City (addr line 3): alpha required.
     - Country: alpha required.
     - Phone 1 and 2 (1260): area code, prefix and line number must be supplied, numeric and nonzero. The area code must also be a valid North American general-purpose code ('Not valid North America general purpose area code').
     - EFT Account Id: numeric required.
     - Primary Card Holder: Y/N.
     - Finally 1280-EDIT-US-STATE-ZIP-CD: the state and the first 2 ZIP digits must be a valid combination ('Invalid zip code for state').
5. 2000-DECIDE-ACTION:
   - NOT-FETCHED or PF12: if the account filter is valid, run 9000-READ-ACCT, which reads in this order:
     1. 9200 READ CXACAIX by account to get the customer ID and card number.
     2. 9300 READ ACCTDAT.
     3. 9400 READ CUSTDAT.
     4. 9500 stores the old images.
     Set SHOW-DETAILS if the customer is found.
   - SHOW-DETAILS: on an error or no change, stay. Otherwise move to CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED and prompt for PF5.
   - CHANGES-NOT-OK: continue.
   - CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED with PF5: run 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING. The outcome sets the state to LOCK-ERROR, OKAYED-BUT-FAILED, SHOW-DETAILS (data changed) or OKAYED-AND-DONE.
   - CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED without PF5: continue.
   - DONE: set SHOW-DETAILS. If FROM-TRANID is blank, zero ACCT-ID/CARD-NUM and set ACCT-STATUS to low-values.
   - OTHER: abend '0001' 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO'.
6. 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING:
   1. READ ACCTDAT UPDATE (RIDFLD account X(11)). If that fails, set COULD-NOT-LOCK-ACCT-FOR-UPDATE and exit.
   2. READ CUSTDAT UPDATE (RIDFLD CDEMO-CUST-ID X(9)). If that fails, set COULD-NOT-LOCK-CUST-FOR-UPDATE and exit. The account lock is still held until the task ends or SYNCPOINT.
   3. 9700-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC compares the current records with the old images. If they differ, set DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE, refresh the images and exit.
   4. Build ACCT-UPDATE-RECORD: new status, limits, balance, cycle credit/debit, group. Dates are built with STRING year '-' mon '-' day into X(10) for open, expiry and reissue. ACCT-REISSUE-DATE is moved first and then overwritten by the STRING.
   5. Build CUST-UPDATE-RECORD: ID, names, addresses, state, country, ZIP. Phones are stored as '(' AAA ')' BBB '-' CCCC (13 chars in X(15)). Also SSN, government ID, DOB 'YYYY-MM-DD', EFT account, primary-cardholder indicator and FICO.
   6. REWRITE ACCTDAT. If that fails, set LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED and exit.
   7. REWRITE CUSTDAT. If that fails, set LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED and issue EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK, which undoes the account rewrite.
7. ABEND-ROUTINE: send the abend message, then ABEND '9999'.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CAUP COACTUPC] --> K{EVALUATE}
  K -- PF3 --> X[SYNCPOINT + XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C]
  K -- first entry --> S[3000-SEND-MAP]
  K -- other --> R[1100-RECEIVE-MAP NUMVAL-C money fields] --> E[1200 edits / 1205 compare]
  E --> D{2000-DECIDE-ACTION}
  D -- not fetched --> RA[9200 CXACAIX -> 9300 ACCTDAT -> 9400 CUSTDAT]
  RA --> S
  D -- changes ok --> C[ask PF5] --> S
  D -- PF5 --> L[READ UPDATE ACCTDAT, CUSTDAT]
  L -- lock fail --> S
  L --> CH{9700 changed?}
  CH -- yes --> S
  CH -- no --> RW1[REWRITE ACCTDAT]
  RW1 -- fail --> S
  RW1 --> RW2[REWRITE CUSTDAT]
  RW2 -- fail --> RB[SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK] --> S
  RW2 --> S
  S --> RT[RETURN CAUP]
```

##### Data
- CXACAIX (xref by account, CVACT03Y): READ.
- ACCTDAT (ACCOUNT-RECORD, CVACT01Y, 300 bytes; money fields are S9(10)V99 zoned signed): READ, READ UPDATE, REWRITE.
- CUSTDAT (CUSTOMER-RECORD, CVCUS01Y, 500 bytes): READ, READ UPDATE, REWRITE.
- Work fields: WS-EDIT-ALPHANUM-LENGTH S9(4) COMP-3 holds a field length. WS-DIV-BY, WS-DIVIDEND and WS-REMAINDER are S9(4) COMP-3 scratch fields, declared but used only in the date/edit helpers.

##### Outputs & side effects
Rewrites both the account and the customer master records. Explicit SYNCPOINT on exit and SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK on a customer rewrite failure.

##### External calls
- XCTL to the caller or COMEN01C.
- EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD comes from an included copybook procedure (CSUTLDPY). It is not fully traced here; it is assumed to call CSUTLDTC as the other date paths do. This is unverified.
- ABEND 9999.

##### Migration notes
- Money fields are converted with NUMVAL-C, so commas, currency signs and leading/trailing signs are accepted. The result is stored in S9(10)V99, so precision beyond 2 decimals and magnitude beyond 10 integer digits are silently truncated.
- The current balance and cycle credit/debit can be edited directly on screen. This is a direct ledger override with no audit transaction.
- The write order is account first, then customer. Only the customer-failure path rolls back. An account rewrite failure exits with nothing written. A lock failure on the customer leaves the account locked until syncpoint.
- Optimistic concurrency uses before-images held in the commarea.
- The phone and date formats are rebuilt on every update, regardless of the stored format.
- Validation runs only when 1205 detects a change.
- The edit labels say 'Current Cycle Credit Limit' but the field updated is the cycle credit amount.
recommendation: Main state machine, the money-field conversion, the edit sequence and the write path are documented. The field-by-field screen attribute logic (3300, 3310, 3320) and the exact old/new compare in 1205/9700 are summarized.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-b3936e38c2124be0a381a0604e81d108, sfind-53d713b2f75a497aa43987eba31be18c, sfind-6a6f6a7558c04c16a8ae4b0e8b786caf, sfind-30f7345e20b34b3f98e5c5b97ccae0c0.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- LOW confidence: only the CICS I/O skeleton (line numbers above) and literals were read. All field edits (formats, ranges, phone/SSN/ZIP/state validations, date checks), the state machine, confirmation logic, error messages, and the program COMMAREA layout remain UNTRACED and must be documented from COACTUPC.cbl.
- Two-phase interaction: fetch -> edit -> confirm with PF5; state is entirely in commarea byte ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION.
- Lock failures: the code continues to the change check / rewrite even after a failed READ UPDATE (only flags are set) - REWRITE then fails with INVALREQ.
- Admin-editable financial fields (current balance, cycle credit/debit, limits) are directly overwritten - no audit trail, no transaction posting.
- Comparison for "no change" is case-insensitive; uppercase/lowercase-only edits are ignored.
- Optimistic locking: compares the freshly locked record to the values captured at display time; any difference aborts the save.
- 1250-EDIT-SIGNED-9V2 ends with `SET FLG-SIGNED-NUMBER-ISVALID` unconditionally, so field-level highlight flags show valid even when INPUT-ERROR was raised.
- CSD defines ACCTDAT/CUSTDAT with RECOVERY(NONE): the SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK cannot back out the ACCTDAT REWRITE in that configuration.
- Balances and cycle totals are directly editable online (no posting audit trail).
- Validation order determines which single error message is shown.
- Literal names for transaction/map/files are LIT-* constants in WORKING-STORAGE (values follow the COACTVWC convention ACCTDAT/CUSTDAT/CXACAIX; transaction CAUP per CSD); a ~4,200-line program — screen attribute logic (3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS via CSSETATY) is summarised here, not enumerated field by field.

- Balance, credit limits and cycle totals are directly editable here (no posting/audit transaction is created).
- Validation order defines which single error message is shown; replicate the order.
- Phones are re-formatted to `(AAA)BBB-CCCC`; dates rebuilt as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

title: COCRDUPC credit card update (TRANSID CCUP) - edit name/status/expiry, PF5 confirm, optimistic-lock REWRITE of CARDDAT
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `COCRDUPC`, TRANSID `CCUP`, map `CCRDUPA`/mapset `COCRDUP`. You reach it from main menu option 5 or from COCRDLIC when a row is marked 'U'. It returns with RETURN TRANSID CCUP COMMAREA (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA + WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA). The program commarea holds the state flag (CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, SHOW-DETAILS, CHANGES-NOT-OK, CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED, CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE, CHANGES-OKAYED-LOCK-ERROR, CHANGES-OKAYED-BUT-FAILED, CHANGES-FAILED) plus the CCUP-OLD-* and CCUP-NEW-* card values (CVV, name, expiry year/month/day, status).

##### Inputs
- Map fields: account (11), card (16), embossed name, status (Y/N), expiry month, expiry year.
- AIDs: ENTER and PF3 are always valid. PF5 is valid only when the state is CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED. PF12 is valid only after the details have been fetched. Any other key is treated as ENTER (CSSTRPFY maps PF13-24 to PF1-12).

##### Processing flow
1. HANDLE ABEND, then initialize or copy the commarea (same pattern as COACTVWC).
2. EVALUATE:
   - PF3, or a finished/failed update when LAST-MAPSET='COCRDLI': TO-TRANID/PROGRAM = FROM values (default CM00/COMEN01C). If the user came from the list, ACCT-ID/CARD-NUM are set to zero. User type is forced to 'U', context to ENTER, then `EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT` and XCTL to the target.
   - First entry from COCRDLIC, or PF12 from COCRDLIC: take the account/card from the commarea, run 9000-READ-DATA, set SHOW-DETAILS and send the map.
   - First entry from the menu (or DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED with ENTER context): reset the program commarea, set REENTER and DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, then return. This shows the search prompt.
   - A finished or failed update (not from the list): reset the program commarea and the commarea ACCT-ID/CARD-NUM, set DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED and return.
   - Otherwise: 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS (RECEIVE plus 1200 edits), then 2000-DECIDE-ACTION, then 3000-SEND-MAP.
3. Edits (first error message wins):
   - 1210 account: blank gives a prompt. Non-numeric gives 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER'.
   - 1220 card: blank gives a prompt. Non-numeric gives 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER'.
   - 1230 name: required. After INSPECT converts the letters to spaces, the TRIM length must be 0, so the name may contain only letters and spaces.
   - 1240 status: must be 'Y' or 'N'.
   - 1250 month: 1-12.
   - 1260 year: 1950-2099.
4. 2000-DECIDE-ACTION:
   - DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED or PF12: if the account and card filters are valid, 9000-READ-DATA, and set SHOW-DETAILS if the card is found.
   - SHOW-DETAILS: on an input error or when no changes are detected, stay in this state. Otherwise move to CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED (the user is asked to press PF5).
   - CHANGES-NOT-OK: continue.
   - CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED with PF5: run 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING. The outcome sets the state to LOCK-ERROR, OKAYED-BUT-FAILED, SHOW-DETAILS (the record changed underneath), or OKAYED-AND-DONE.
   - CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED without PF5: continue.
   - OKAYED-AND-DONE: set SHOW-DETAILS and reset the FROM tranid.
   - OTHER: abend code '0001' 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO'.
5. 9100-GETCARD-BYACCTCARD: READ CARDDAT by card number and save the old values.
6. 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING:
   - READ CARDDAT UPDATE by card number. If that fails, set COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE.
   - 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC: upper-case CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME, then compare CVV, name, expiry YYYY / MM (pos 6) / DD (pos 9) and status with the CCUP-OLD values. On any difference, set DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE, refresh the old values and stop without writing.
   - Otherwise build CARD-UPDATE-RECORD: number = CCUP-NEW-CARDID, acct = CC-ACCT-ID-N, CVV = new CVV, name = new name, expiry = 'YYYY-MM-DD' from new year, month and day, status = new status. Then REWRITE CARDDAT. If the REWRITE fails, set LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED.
7. ABEND-ROUTINE: SEND ABEND-DATA, HANDLE ABEND CANCEL, ABEND '9999'.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CCUP COCRDUPC] --> K{EVALUATE state/AID}
  K -- PF3 / done from list --> SP[SYNCPOINT + XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C]
  K -- from COCRDLIC / PF12 --> RD[9100 READ CARDDAT] --> S[3000-SEND-MAP]
  K -- from menu first --> RT
  K -- other --> E[1200 edits] --> D{2000-DECIDE-ACTION}
  D -- not fetched --> RD
  D -- show details + changes ok --> C[CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED ask PF5] --> S
  D -- PF5 confirmed --> W[READ UPDATE CARDDAT]
  W -- lock fail --> S
  W --> CHK{9300 record changed?}
  CHK -- yes --> S
  CHK -- no --> RW[REWRITE CARDDAT] --> S
  S --> RT[RETURN CCUP]
```

##### Data
`CARDDAT` (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS): READ, READ UPDATE, REWRITE. The record is CARD-RECORD from CVACT02Y (150 bytes): NUM X16, ACCT-ID 9(11), CVV 9(3), EMBOSSED-NAME X50, EXPIRAION-DATE X10, ACTIVE-STATUS X1, FILLER X59. CARD-UPDATE-RECORD has the same layout and is local to the program.

##### Outputs & side effects
Updates the card name, status and expiry date. The program also rewrites the account ID from the screen filter, the CVV and the card number. An explicit SYNCPOINT is issued on exit.

##### External calls
XCTL to the caller or COMEN01C. CICS SYNCPOINT. ABEND 9999.

##### Migration notes
- This is an optimistic concurrency check: the record is re-read with UPDATE and compared with the before-image saved in the commarea. If they differ, the user sees the refreshed data and no write happens.
- The before-image name is compared after the stored name is upper-cased, so names are effectively stored and compared in upper case. Check 1200 for whether the new name is also upper-cased.
- The expiry day is never edited on screen; it is carried over from the old record (CCUP-NEW-EXPDAY).
- The REWRITE writes CC-ACCT-ID-N from the screen into CARD-ACCT-ID. The edits only check that the account is numeric; nothing verifies that it belongs to the card, so a card can be re-pointed to another account.
- Confirmation uses PF5, not a Y/N field (unlike COBIL00C and COTRN02C).
recommendation: Main state machine, edits, and the write/compare paragraphs are documented. The screen-attribute paragraphs (3200-3300) and the exact change-detection compare between new and old values in 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS are summarized, not listed field by field.
note: Duplicate of sfind-307e554868944198aa3149a3c7e2729c (CCUP / COCRDUPC credit card update screen); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: COUSR01C admin add user (TRANSID CU01) - writes new USRSEC security record
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `COUSR01C`, TRANSID `CU01`, map `COUSR1A`/mapset `COUSR01`; admin menu option 2 (COADM01C). RETURN TRANSID CU01 COMMAREA.

##### Inputs
Map fields FNAMEI (first name), LNAMEI (last name), USERIDI (8), PASSWDI (8), USRTYPEI (1). AIDs ENTER, PF3 (XCTL COADM01C), PF4 (clear), other (invalid key). Commarea CARDDEMO-COMMAREA.

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C. First entry -> REENTER, cursor on first name, SEND.
2. ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: EVALUATE in order: first name empty 'First Name can NOT be empty...'; last name 'Last Name can NOT be empty...'; user id 'User ID can NOT be empty...'; password 'Password can NOT be empty...'; user type 'User Type can NOT be empty...'; each sets error, cursor, SEND.
3. No error -> SEC-USR-ID=USERIDI, FNAME, LNAME, PWD, TYPE from screen; WRITE-USER-SEC-FILE: `EXEC CICS WRITE DATASET('USRSEC') FROM(SEC-USER-DATA) RIDFLD(SEC-USR-ID) KEYLENGTH(8)`.
4. RESP NORMAL -> clear fields, green 'User <id> has been added ...'; DUPKEY/DUPREC -> 'User ID already exist...' cursor userid; other -> 'Unable to Add User...'.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CU01 COUSR01C] --> B{EIBCALEN=0} -- yes --> SG[XCTL COSGN00C]
  B -- no --> K{EIBAID}
  K -- PF3 --> AD[XCTL COADM01C]
  K -- PF4 --> CL[clear] --> S
  K -- ENTER --> V{required fields present?}
  V -- no --> S[SEND COUSR1A]
  V -- yes --> W[WRITE USRSEC]
  W --> R{RESP}
  R -- NORMAL/DUP/other --> S
  S --> RT[RETURN CU01]
```

##### Data
Write `USRSEC`: SEC-USER-DATA (CSUSR01Y, 80 bytes): ID X8, FNAME X20, LNAME X20, PWD X8, TYPE X1, FILLER X23.

##### Outputs & side effects
New user security record; message.

##### External calls
XCTL COADM01C / COSGN00C.

##### Migration notes
- Password stored exactly as typed (not upper-cased), but COSGN00C upper-cases the entered password before comparing: users created with lowercase passwords can never sign in.
- User id not upper-cased either, while sign-on upper-cases the lookup key.
- User type accepts any non-blank character; only 'A' gets admin menu at sign-on.
- No authorization check that caller is admin.
recommendation: Fully documented. User type is not validated to 'A'/'U'.
note: Duplicate of sfind-73daf516b5c34afe949a425714b04770 (CU01 / COUSR01C); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: COACTVWC account view (TRANSID CAVW) - reads CXACAIX, ACCTDAT, CUSTDAT and displays account + customer
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `COACTVWC`, TRANSID `CAVW` (LIT-THISTRANID), map `CACTVWA`/mapset `COACTVW`; main menu option 1 (XCTL from COMEN01C). Returns via `RETURN TRANSID('CAVW') COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA) LENGTH(LENGTH OF WS-COMMAREA)` (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA followed by WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA).

##### Inputs
- DFHCOMMAREA: bytes 1..len(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) -> CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (COCOM01Y), following bytes -> WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA (CA-CALL-CONTEXT, program-local).
- Map input ACCTSIDI (account id, 11). EIBAID normalized by CSSTRPFY YYYY-STORE-PFKEY (PF13-24 map to PF1-12; ENTER, CLEAR, PA1, PA2).

##### Processing flow
1. HANDLE ABEND LABEL(ABEND-ROUTINE); INITIALIZE work areas.
2. If EIBCALEN=0 or (FROM-PROGRAM='COMEN01C' and not REENTER) -> INITIALIZE commareas; else copy both parts from DFHCOMMAREA.
3. Only ENTER and PF3 valid; any other key is treated as ENTER.
4. PF3: TO-TRANID = FROM-TRANID or 'CM00'; TO-PROGRAM = FROM-PROGRAM or 'COMEN01C'; FROM = CAVW/COACTVWC; USER-TYPE forced 'U'; PGM-ENTER; LAST-MAPSET/MAP set; XCTL TO-PROGRAM with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA.
5. PGM-ENTER (first time): 1000-SEND-MAP (prompt 'Enter or update id of account to display'), COMMON-RETURN.
6. PGM-REENTER: 2000-PROCESS-INPUTS: RECEIVE map; ACCTSIDI '*' or spaces -> CC-ACCT-ID LOW-VALUES; 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT: blank -> INPUT-ERROR, 'Account number not provided' (ACCT-ID 0); not numeric or zero -> 'Account Filter must  be a non-zero 11 digit number'; else CDEMO-ACCT-ID = input. Error -> send map; else 9000-READ-ACCT then send map.
7. 9000-READ-ACCT: 9200 READ `CXACAIX` RIDFLD account (X11) -> CDEMO-CUST-ID, CDEMO-CARD-NUM; NOTFND -> 'Account:<id> not found in Cross ref file.  Resp:<r> Reas:<r2>'; other -> 'File Error: READ on CXACAIX ...'. On error exit. 9300 READ `ACCTDAT` by account -> FOUND-ACCT-IN-MASTER; NOTFND 'Account:<id> not found in Acct Master file.Resp:..'; exit on not found. 9400 READ `CUSTDAT` by CDEMO-CUST-ID (X9) -> FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER; NOTFND 'CustId:<id> not found in customer master.Resp: ..'.
8. WHEN OTHER (context not 0/1) -> abend info 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO', SEND-PLAIN-TEXT and RETURN.
9. 1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS: account fields shown if account or customer found: status, curr bal, credit limit, cash limit, cyc credit, cyc debit, open/expiry/reissue dates, group id; customer fields if found: cust id, SSN as `SSN(1:3)-SSN(4:2)-SSN(6:4)`, FICO, DOB, names, address lines 1-2, line 3 into city field, state, zip, country, phones 1-2, govt id, EFT account, primary card holder flag. 1300 attributes: account field red if filter not ok; '*' red when blank on re-entry. 1400 SEND MAP ERASE CURSOR FREEKB; set REENTER.
10. ABEND-ROUTINE: SEND ABEND-DATA (default 'UNEXPECTED ABEND OCCURRED.'), HANDLE ABEND CANCEL, ABEND ABCODE('9999').

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CAVW COACTVWC 0000-MAIN] --> B{EIBCALEN=0 or from COMEN01C first}
  B -- yes --> I[INITIALIZE commarea]
  B -- no --> CP[copy commarea + local]
  I --> K{AID}
  CP --> K
  K -- PF3 --> X[XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C]
  K -- ENTER first --> S[1000-SEND-MAP]
  K -- ENTER reenter --> E[2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT]
  E -- error --> S
  E -- ok --> R1[READ CXACAIX by acct]
  R1 -- found --> R2[READ ACCTDAT] -- found --> R3[READ CUSTDAT by cust id] --> S
  R1 -- notfnd/err --> S
  R2 -- notfnd --> S
  S --> RT[RETURN CAVW WS-COMMAREA]
```

##### Data
- `CXACAIX` (card xref alternate index by account, CARD-XREF-RECORD 50 bytes: CARD-NUM X16, CUST-ID 9(9), ACCT-ID 9(11), FILLER X14) - READ.
- `ACCTDAT` ACCOUNT-RECORD (300 bytes, CVACT01Y) - READ.
- `CUSTDAT` CUSTOMER-RECORD (500 bytes, CVCUS01Y: CUST-ID 9(9), FIRST/MIDDLE/LAST X25, ADDR-LINE-1..3 X50, STATE X2, COUNTRY X3, ZIP X10, PHONE-1/2 X15, SSN 9(9), GOVT-ID X20, DOB X10, EFT-ACCOUNT-ID X10, PRI-CARD-HOLDER-IND X1, FICO 9(3), FILLER X168) - READ.
- CARDDAT/CARDAIX names defined but unused.

##### Outputs & side effects
Read-only display. Commarea updated with CDEMO-ACCT-ID, CUST-ID, CARD-NUM (first xref record for the account).

##### External calls
XCTL to FROM-PROGRAM (default COMEN01C). CICS ABEND 9999 on unexpected abends.

##### Migration notes
- Only the first xref record for the account (AIX non-unique) determines customer and card.
- Signed amounts moved to edited BMS output fields (map PICOUT governs format).
- PF3 forces CDEMO-USER-TYPE to 'U' even for admins.
- Invalid PF keys silently act as ENTER.
- Messages use the first error only (WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF guards).
recommendation: Fully documented. Note the SSN is shown unmasked (formatted NNN-NN-NNNN).

Consolidated document for app/cbl/COACTVWC.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-fbc28d12d498425ba3f7464f2572bdb6, sfind-d975eb12d20946e69a271d29d961e490.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- PF3 forcibly sets user type to 'U' in commarea (admin users lose admin flag when returning).
- SSN displayed unmasked; CYC-CREDIT also shown.

title: COTRN02C add transaction (TRANSID CT02) - validates keys/fields/dates via CSUTLDTC and writes TRANSACT
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `COTRN02C`, TRANSID `CT02`, map `COTRN2A`/mapset `COTRN02`; main menu option 8. RETURN TRANSID CT02 COMMAREA.

##### Inputs
- CARDDEMO-COMMAREA + CDEMO-CT02-INFO (TRNID-FIRST/LAST X16, PAGE-NUM 9(8), NEXT-PAGE-FLG, TRN-SEL-FLG, TRN-SELECTED X16).
- Map fields: ACTIDINI (acct 11), CARDNINI (card 16), TTYPCDI (type 2), TCATCDI (category 4), TRNSRCI (source), TDESCI (desc), TRNAMTI (amount, format -99999999.99), TORIGDTI/TPROCDTI (YYYY-MM-DD), MIDI (merchant id), MNAMEI, MCITYI, MZIPI, CONFIRMI.
- AIDs: ENTER, PF3 (back to FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C), PF4 (clear), PF5 (copy last transaction), other (invalid key).

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C. First entry: REENTER; if CT02-TRN-SELECTED non-blank, put it into CARDNINI and PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; SEND.
2. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY = VALIDATE-INPUT-KEY-FIELDS, VALIDATE-INPUT-DATA-FIELDS, then CONFIRMI: 'Y'/'y' -> ADD-TRANSACTION; 'N'/'n'/blank/low -> 'Confirm to add this transaction...'; other -> 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...'.
3. VALIDATE-INPUT-KEY-FIELDS (EVALUATE, account takes precedence): account non-blank -> must be NUMERIC ('Account ID must be Numeric...'); NUMVAL -> XREF-ACCT-ID and redisplay; READ `CXACAIX` by account; fill CARDNINI from XREF-CARD-NUM. Else card non-blank -> NUMERIC ('Card Number must be Numeric...'); NUMVAL -> XREF-CARD-NUM; READ `CCXREF`; fill ACTIDINI. Else 'Account or Card Number must be entered...'.
4. VALIDATE-INPUT-DATA-FIELDS: if an error already exists, clear all data fields. Then sequential required checks (message '<field> can NOT be empty...') for Type CD, Category CD, Source, Description, Amount, Orig Date, Proc Date, Merchant ID, Merchant Name, Merchant City, Merchant Zip. Then Type/Category NUMERIC; amount must have char1 in '-'/'+', chars 2-9 numeric, char 10 '.', chars 11-12 numeric ('Amount should be in format -99999999.99'); dates must be YYYY numeric, '-' at 5 and 8, MM and DD numeric ('... should be in format YYYY-MM-DD'). Amount normalized: NUMVAL-C -> WS-TRAN-AMT-N -> edited WS-TRAN-AMT-E redisplayed. Each date: CALL CSUTLDTC(date, 'YYYY-MM-DD', result); OK if result severity '0000', or if message number = '2513'; else 'Orig/Proc Date - Not a valid date...'. Merchant ID must be NUMERIC.
5. ADD-TRANSACTION: TRAN-ID=HIGH-VALUES, STARTBR/READPREV/ENDBR TRANSACT, WS-TRAN-ID-N = last id + 1; INITIALIZE TRAN-RECORD; move type, category, source, desc, NUMVAL-C(amount), card, merchant id/name/city/zip, TORIGDTI -> TRAN-ORIG-TS, TPROCDTI -> TRAN-PROC-TS; WRITE TRANSACT.
6. WRITE RESP NORMAL -> INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS, green 'Transaction added successfully.  Your Tran ID is <id>.'; DUPKEY/DUPREC 'Tran ID already exist...'; other 'Unable to Add Transaction...'.
7. PF5 COPY-LAST-TRAN-DATA: validate key fields, read the highest TRANSACT record, and if no error copy its type, category, source, amount, desc, orig/proc ts, merchant fields to the screen, then PROCESS-ENTER-KEY (so if CONFIRM was Y, the copy is immediately added).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CT02 COTRN02C] --> B{EIBCALEN=0} -- yes --> SG[XCTL COSGN00C]
  B -- no --> K{first / EIBAID}
  K -- PF3 --> BK[XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C]
  K -- PF4 --> CL[clear] --> S
  K -- PF5 --> CP[COPY-LAST-TRAN-DATA] --> P
  K -- ENTER --> P[VALIDATE-INPUT-KEY-FIELDS]
  P --> X{acct / card}
  X -- acct --> AX[READ CXACAIX]
  X -- card --> CX[READ CCXREF]
  X -- none --> S[SEND COTRN2A]
  AX --> D[VALIDATE-INPUT-DATA-FIELDS + CSUTLDTC x2]
  CX --> D
  D --> C{CONFIRM}
  C -- Y --> AD[STARTBR/READPREV TRANSACT, id+1, WRITE TRANSACT] --> S
  C -- other --> S
  S --> RT[RETURN CT02]
```

##### Data
- `CXACAIX` (xref AIX by account) and `CCXREF` (xref KSDS by card) READ; CARD-XREF-RECORD (CVACT03Y, 50 bytes).
- `TRANSACT` browse + WRITE; TRAN-RECORD (CVTRA05Y, 350 bytes).
- `ACCTDAT` file name defined but not accessed.
- Xref read errors: NOTFND 'Account ID NOT found...' / 'Card Number NOT found...'; other 'Unable to lookup Acct in XREF AIX file...' / 'Unable to lookup Card # in XREF file...'.

##### Outputs & side effects
One TRANSACT record; screen messages. No account balance update (unlike bill payment) - balances are posted later by batch.

##### External calls
- CALL 'CSUTLDTC' USING CSUTLDTC-DATE X10, CSUTLDTC-DATE-FORMAT X10, CSUTLDTC-RESULT X80 (result: SEV-CD X4, filler 11, MSG-NUM X4, ...). See CSUTLDTC finding.
- XCTL COSGN00C / previous program.

##### Migration notes
- Error branches each SEND the screen but do not stop: validation keeps running and later messages overwrite earlier ones; multiple SENDs per turn are possible; final message shown is the last one set before the last SEND.
- When key validation fails, all data fields are blanked before data validation, so the user loses input.
- Dates are not converted: TRAN-ORIG-TS/PROC-TS receive the 10-char date left-justified in a 26-char field (rest spaces), unlike batch/bill-pay timestamps.
- Account/card typed values are normalized through NUMVAL (leading zeros padded on redisplay).
- CEEDAYS message 2513 (likely Lilian range warning) is treated as valid.
- No check that the card belongs to an active account or that the type/category exist in reference files.
- Concurrent adds can collide on max+1 id.
recommendation: Fully documented. Preserve validation order, the '2513' CEEDAYS message exemption, and the max-ID+1 transaction key generation.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/COTRN02C.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-d4fe7c495bfc4e0caa808922ef13aef0, sfind-d235a73fdc9a4aa9a4d6dba51ced18c7.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- TRAN-ORIG-TS/PROC-TS receive only 'YYYY-MM-DD' + spaces, unlike batch DB2-format timestamps; CBTRN03C/SORT use bytes 1-10 so still match.
- No balance, credit-limit or account-status checks online; TCATBAL and ACCTDAT not updated.
- PF5 copies the globally last transaction, not the last for the selected card.
- Amount NUMVAL-C into S9(9)V99: values > 999,999,999.99 impossible due to format check (8 integer digits).
- SEND-TRNADD-SCREEN issues `EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(CT02)` immediately after SEND, so the **first error message ends the task** — validations are effectively short-circuit.
- CEEDAYS message 2513 is tolerated (treated as valid); exact semantics depend on LE (unresolved locally — LE service).
- Amount must be exactly sign+8 digits+'.'+2 digits.
- Timestamps stored as dates only (no time part).

title: COCRDLIC credit card list (TRANSID CCLI) - filtered paged CARDDAT browse (7 rows), S->COCRDSLC, U->COCRDUPC
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `COCRDLIC`, TRANSID `CCLI`, map `CCRDLIA`/mapset `COCRDLI`; main menu option 3. RETURN TRANSID CCLI COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA + WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA).

##### Inputs
- Commarea; program commarea holds WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM/ACCT-ID, WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM/ACCT-ID, WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM, CA-FIRST-PAGE, CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS, CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN flags.
- Map: account filter (11), card filter (16), 7 row selection fields (WS-EDIT-SELECT-FLAGS; 'S' view, 'U' update).
- AIDs: ENTER, PF3, PF7, PF8 valid; others treated as ENTER (CSSTRPFY maps PF13-24 -> PF1-12).

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> INITIALIZE commareas, FROM=CCLI/COCRDLIC, user type 'U', ENTER context, first page. Else copy commarea; if PGM-ENTER and FROM-PROGRAM != COCRDLIC -> reset program commarea, first page.
2. If re-entered from itself, 2000-RECEIVE-MAP: RECEIVE, 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT (blank/zero -> no filter; non-numeric -> error 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER', protect rows), 2220-EDIT-CARD (same, 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER'), 2250-EDIT-ARRAY (skipped on earlier error): count 'S'+'U' across 7 rows; >1 -> error (more than one action) and mark rows; then per row: S/U sets I-SELECTED (only if exactly one), blank ok, other -> invalid action code error.
3. PF3 from itself -> XCTL COMEN01C (FROM=CCLI, user type 'U', ENTER context).
4. EVALUATE: INPUT-ERROR -> re-read forward only if both filters ok, send map; PF7 on first page -> read forward from first card; PF3 / re-entry from another program -> reset and read forward from start; PF8 with next page -> start at last card key, screen+1, read forward; PF7 not first page -> start at first key, screen-1, 9100-READ-BACKWARDS; ENTER with row 'S' -> CDEMO-ACCT-ID/CARD-NUM from selected row, XCTL COCRDSLC; ENTER with 'U' -> XCTL COCRDUPC; OTHER -> read forward from first card key.
5. 9000-READ-FORWARD: STARTBR CARDDAT GTEQ RIDFLD card number; READNEXT loop: 9500-FILTER-RECORDS excludes records whose CARD-ACCT-ID != account filter (if valid) or CARD-NUM != card filter (if valid); included rows store card num, acct id, active status; row 1 sets first keys (screen num 1 if 0); at 7 rows: save last keys, one extra READNEXT -> NORMAL/DUPREC next page exists, ENDFILE -> no next page + 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW'; ENDFILE during loop -> no next page, message; no rows on screen 1 -> WS-NO-RECORDS-FOUND; other RESP -> 'File Error: READ on CARDDAT...'. ENDBR.
6. 9100-READ-BACKWARDS: STARTBR at first key, READPREV filling rows from slot 8 downwards (counter starts at max+1) applying the same filter, ENDBR.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CCLI COCRDLIC] --> I{EIBCALEN=0 / from other pgm}
  I --> E[2000-RECEIVE-MAP edits if from self]
  E --> K{EVALUATE}
  K -- PF3 --> M[XCTL COMEN01C]
  K -- input error --> S[1000-SEND-MAP]
  K -- PF8 next --> F[9000-READ-FORWARD STARTBR/READNEXT + 9500 filter]
  K -- PF7 --> B[9100-READ-BACKWARDS READPREV]
  K -- ENTER S --> V[XCTL COCRDSLC acct/card]
  K -- ENTER U --> U[XCTL COCRDUPC acct/card]
  K -- other --> F
  F --> S
  B --> S
  S --> RT[RETURN CCLI]
```

##### Data
`CARDDAT` (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS) browse; CARD-RECORD (CVACT02Y, 150 bytes). CARDAIX literal defined but browse uses CARDDAT.

##### Outputs & side effects
Read-only list; commarea passes selected ACCT-ID/CARD-NUM to COCRDSLC/COCRDUPC.

##### External calls
XCTL COCRDSLC, COCRDUPC, COMEN01C.

##### Migration notes
- Account filter is applied by full scan of CARDDAT in card-number order (no AIX use); filtered pages may read many records.
- Page size is WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES = 7 (COMP).
- Blank/zero filters exit the edit paragraph (GO TO ...-EXIT) and mean 'no filter'; only non-numeric input is an error.
- WHEN PF7 AND CA-FIRST-PAGE appears twice (first WHEN falls through to the second).
- Rows count only 'S'/'U' uppercase.
recommendation: Documented from main control logic, edits, browse and filter paragraphs; screen-attribute paragraphs (1200-1400) and 9100 backward-loop details summarized. Note that there is no per-user/account authorization: the list shows all cards unless filtered.
note: Duplicate of sfind-8518f237530e474290d2db29136a9ff4 (CCLI / COCRDLIC); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: COTRN00C transaction list (TRANSID CT00) - paged TRANSACT browse, 10 rows, selection to COTRN01C
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `COTRN00C`, TRANSID `CT00`, map `COTRN0A`/mapset `COTRN00`; main menu option 6. RETURN TRANSID CT00 with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA.

##### Inputs
- Commarea + CDEMO-CT00-INFO: TRNID-FIRST X16, TRNID-LAST X16, PAGE-NUM 9(8), NEXT-PAGE-FLG X1 (88 NEXT-PAGE-YES 'Y'), TRN-SEL-FLG X1, TRN-SELECTED X16.
- Map: TRNIDINI (search start transaction id), SEL0001I..SEL0010I selection flags; TRNID01I..10I etc. on output.
- AIDs: ENTER, PF3, PF7 (page up), PF8 (page down).

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C. First entry -> REENTER, LOW-VALUES map, PROCESS-ENTER-KEY (initial page), SEND.
2. Re-entry: RECEIVE; ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL COMEN01C; PF7 -> PROCESS-PF7-KEY; PF8 -> PROCESS-PF8-KEY; other -> invalid key + SEND.
3. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: scan SEL0001I..SEL0010I in order; first non-blank sets TRN-SEL-FLG and TRN-SELECTED = corresponding TRNIDnnI. If a selection exists: flag 'S'/'s' -> FROM-TRANID CT00, FROM-PROGRAM COTRN00C, TO-PROGRAM COTRN01C, context 0, XCTL COTRN01C with commarea; other -> 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S'.
   - TRNIDINI blank -> TRAN-ID=LOW-VALUES; numeric -> TRAN-ID=TRNIDINI; non-numeric -> 'Tran ID must be Numeric ...'.
   - PAGE-NUM=0, PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD.
4. PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD: STARTBR TRANSACT RIDFLD(TRAN-ID) GTEQ; if EIBAID not ENTER/PF7/PF3 do an extra READNEXT (skip the current last key); INITIALIZE rows 1..10; READNEXT up to 10 records populating rows (TRNID, date from TRAN-ORIG-TS as MM/DD/YY, TRAN-DESC, TRAN-AMT edited +99999999.99); record first/last ids; then READNEXT once more to detect next page (NEXT-PAGE-YES/NO); ADD 1 to PAGE-NUM if rows found; ENDBR; SEND.
5. PF8: if NEXT-PAGE-YES -> TRAN-ID=TRNID-LAST, page forward; else 'You are already at the bottom of the page...'.
6. PF7: if PAGE-NUM > 1 -> TRAN-ID=TRNID-FIRST, PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD (STARTBR, extra READPREV when EIBAID not ENTER/PF8, READPREV up to 10 rows filling slots 10 down to 1, PAGE-NUM - 1); else 'You are already at the top of the page...'.
7. STARTBR/READ errors: NOTFND/ENDFILE -> 'You are at the top/bottom of the page...'; other -> 'Unable to lookup transaction...'.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CT00 COTRN00C] --> B{EIBCALEN=0} -- yes --> SG[XCTL COSGN00C]
  B -- no --> C{REENTER?} -- no --> E[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY]
  C -- yes --> K{EIBAID}
  K -- PF3 --> M[XCTL COMEN01C]
  K -- PF7 --> P7{PAGE-NUM>1} -- yes --> BW[PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD READPREV x10]
  K -- PF8 --> P8{NEXT-PAGE-YES} -- yes --> FW[PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD READNEXT x10]
  K -- ENTER --> E
  E --> SEL{selection?}
  SEL -- S/s --> X[XCTL COTRN01C TRN-SELECTED]
  SEL -- invalid --> SND
  SEL -- none --> FW
  FW --> SND[SEND COTRN0A]
  BW --> SND
  P7 -- no --> SND
  P8 -- no --> SND
  SND --> RT[RETURN CT00]
```

##### Data
`TRANSACT` browse only (STARTBR/READNEXT/READPREV/ENDBR), TRAN-RECORD per CVTRA05Y (350 bytes; see COBIL00C finding).

##### Outputs & side effects
Map rows: TRNID01..10 (X16), TDATE (MM/DD/YY from TRAN-ORIG-TS positions YYYY-MM-DD), TDESC (TRAN-DESC moved into the map field, truncated to the BMS field length), TAMT (+99999999.99). PAGENUMI. No updates.

##### External calls
XCTL COTRN01C (commarea with CT00-INFO.TRN-SELECTED), COMEN01C, COSGN00C.

##### Migration notes
- `IF EIBAID NOT = DFHENTER AND DFHPF7 AND DFHPF3` is COBOL abbreviated condition = not ENTER and not PF7 and not PF3; controls the skip-one READNEXT so PF8 paging does not repeat the last row. Backward has the analogous NOT ENTER AND NOT PF8 test.
- Only the first non-blank selection among 10 rows is honored.
- TRAN-ID is X16 but validated NUMERIC on input only.
- SEND uses ERASE unless WS-SEND-ERASE-FLG is set off (used on some error redisplays).
recommendation: Fully documented; preserve paging semantics (first/last key in commarea, READPREV-based back paging).
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/COTRN00C.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-32058669c48c4e92a4ae4987a525b905, sfind-ecd46d84d4d0412480d73ac01dbd59bc.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- Lists all transactions in the file (not filtered by user/account).
- Invalid-selection message is set but the page still refreshes.
- Lists all transactions in key order — not filtered by the signed-on user's account/card.
- Same key-based paging algorithm as COUSR00C (USRSEC) — shared pattern, only the file/key length differ.
- Only 'S' selection is supported; invalid selection still lists.
- Start key must be numeric but is used as X(16) (left-justified; '123' starts at '123' + spaces).
