title: CREASTMT batch job - build card-ordered transaction KSDS (TRXFL) and run CBSTM03A to create text + HTML statements
description:
##### Entry point
JCL job `CREASTMT` ('Create Statement', CLASS=A, MSGCLASS=H, MSGLEVEL=(1,1), NOTIFY=&SYSUID, TIME=1440).

##### Inputs
- AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS (TRAN-RECORD from CVTRA05Y, 350 bytes)
- CARDXREF, ACCTDATA and CUSTDATA KSDS files

##### Processing flow
1. DELDEF01 IDCAMS:
   - DELETE AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRXFL.SEQ and DELETE TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS CLUSTER, then SET MAXCC=0.
   - DEFINE CLUSTER TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS: KEYS(32 0), VOLUMES(TSU023), RECORDSIZE(350 350), SHAREOPTIONS(2 3), ERASE, INDEXED, CYL(1 5). DATA is TRXFL.DATA with CISZ(4096); INDEX is TRXFL.INDEX.
2. STEP010 SORT: SORTIN is TRANSACT KSDS.
   - SORT FIELDS=(263,16,CH,A,1,16,CH,A): the sort key is TRAN-CARD-NUM (pos 263, 16 bytes) and then TRAN-ID (pos 1, 16 bytes).
   - OUTREC FIELDS=(1:263,16,17:1,262,279:279,50): the output record is the card number (1-16), then original bytes 1-262 (17-278), then original bytes 279-328 (279-328), for a total of 328 bytes in an LRECL 350 record.
   - SORTOUT is TRXFL.SEQ, NEW/CATLG/DELETE, FB, LRECL 350, BLKSIZE 3500.
3. STEP020 IDCAMS COND=(0,NE): REPRO TRXFL.SEQ to TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS. The 32-byte key is card number + transaction ID.
4. STEP030 IEFBR14 COND=(0,NE): HTMLFILE (STATEMNT.HTML) and STMTFILE (STATEMNT.PS) are allocated with DISP=(MOD,DELETE,DELETE), which deletes any prior statement outputs.
5. STEP040 CBSTM03A COND=(0,NE), STEPLIB LOADLIB, with these DDs:
   - TRNXFILE = TRXFL KSDS
   - XREFFILE = CARDXREF
   - ACCTFILE = ACCTDATA
   - CUSTFILE = CUSTDATA
   - STMTFILE = new STATEMNT.PS (FB 80, BLKSIZE 8000)
   - HTMLFILE = new STATEMNT.HTML (FB LRECL 100, BLKSIZE 800)

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  D[DELDEF01 IDCAMS delete TRXFL.SEQ/KSDS, define TRXFL KSDS KEYS 32 0] --> S10[STEP010 SORT TRANSACT by card num, tran id; OUTREC card num first]
  S10 --> S20[STEP020 REPRO TRXFL.SEQ -> TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS]
  S20 --> S30[STEP030 IEFBR14 delete STATEMNT.HTML / STATEMNT.PS]
  S30 --> S40[STEP040 CBSTM03A TRNXFILE XREFFILE ACCTFILE CUSTFILE -> STMTFILE, HTMLFILE]
```

##### Data
- TRXFL record: card number X16, then the full TRAN-RECORD bytes 1-262 (ID through merchant ZIP), then bytes 279-328 (PROC-TS and the first part of the remaining fields).
- The original TRAN-CARD-NUM at offsets 263-278 is dropped from its original position because it was moved to the front.

##### Outputs & side effects
Writes the statement text and HTML files and recreates TRXFL.

##### External calls
SORT, IDCAMS, IEFBR14, CBSTM03A. Per the matcher notes, CBSTM03A calls CBSTM03B; neither was traced in this batch.

##### Migration notes
- OUTREC copies 279 for 50 bytes (TRAN-ORIG-TS at 279-304 + TRAN-PROC-TS at 305-330 in TRAN-RECORD offsets). The copy ends at 328, so the last 2 bytes of PROC-TS and the 20-byte FILLER are cut and the output is space-padded to 350. Confirm against the CBSTM03A record layout.
- The STMTFILE DD SPACE line contains stray trailing text ('00,RECFM=FB), ATA.VSAM.KSDS') after column 72 or in continuation columns. JCL ignores columns 73-80, but the text spans earlier columns. Check whether the job actually parses before migrating, because the DD may be malformed.
- STEP030 deletes the prior statements. If they do not exist, MOD,DELETE allocates and then deletes new empty datasets.
- COND=(0,NE) chains every step after the sort.
recommendation: The JCL is fully documented. CBSTM03A/CBSTM03B are outside batch 9 and are only referenced here.
note: Duplicate of sfind-c61aa7aa8ce745ec820239c5975bbf26 (CREASTMT / CBSTM03A + CBSTM03B); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CORPT00C transaction report request (TRANSID CR00) - builds TRNRPT00 JCL and submits via TDQ JOBS
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `CORPT00C`, TRANSID `CR00`, map `CORPT0A`/mapset `CORPT00`; main menu option 9. RETURN TRANSID CR00 COMMAREA (no LENGTH).

##### Inputs
Map: MONTHLYI, YEARLYI, CUSTOMI (any non-blank selects the report type; first match wins in that order), SDTMMI/SDTDDI/SDTYYYYI and EDTMMI/EDTDDI/EDTYYYYI (custom start/end), CONFIRMI. AIDs: ENTER, PF3 (XCTL COMEN01C), other (invalid key, cursor on MONTHLY).

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C. First entry -> REENTER, SEND screen.
2. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY EVALUATE:
   - Monthly: start = current YYYY-MM-01; end = last day of current month computed as (first day of next month, rolling year if month>12) via INTEGER-OF-DATE - 1 -> DATE-OF-INTEGER.
   - Yearly: start = YYYY-01-01, end = YYYY-12-31 of current year.
   - Custom: the first empty component among start MM, DD, YYYY, end MM, DD, YYYY gives '<Start|End> Date - <Month|Day|Year> can NOT be empty...'; each component NUMVAL-C -> PIC 99/9999 and moved back (zero-padded); month non-numeric or > '12', day > '31', year non-numeric -> 'Not a valid Month/Day/Year...'; then WS-START-DATE / WS-END-DATE (YYYY-MM-DD) each validated via CALL CSUTLDTC(date,'YYYY-MM-DD',result) (ok if sev '0000' or msg '2513'); submit only if no error.
   - None selected -> 'Select a report type to print report...'.
3. SUBMIT-JOB-TO-INTRDR: CONFIRM blank -> 'Please confirm to print the <name> report...' (error). If no error: 'Y'/'y' continue; 'N'/'n' clear fields + error; other -> '"<x>" is not a valid value to confirm...'. Then loop WS-IDX 1..1000 over JOB-LINES (80-byte lines of JOB-DATA), write each to TDQ until a line equal to '/*EOF' or spaces/low-values (that terminator line is also written) or error.
4. WIRTE-JOBSUB-TDQ: `EXEC CICS WRITEQ TD QUEUE('JOBS') FROM(JCL-RECORD) LENGTH(80)`; non-NORMAL -> DISPLAY RESP/REAS, 'Unable to Write TDQ (JOBS)...'.
5. No error -> clear fields, green '<Monthly|Yearly|Custom> report submitted for printing ...'.

Generated JCL (exact lines): `//TRNRPT00 JOB 'TRAN REPORT',CLASS=A,MSGCLASS=0,` / `// NOTIFY=&SYSUID` / `//*` / `//JOBLIB JCLLIB ORDER=('AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PROC')` / `//*` / `//STEP10 EXEC PROC=TRANREPT` / `//*` / `//STEP05R.SYMNAMES DD *` / `TRAN-CARD-NUM,263,16,ZD` / `TRAN-PROC-DT,305,10,CH` / `PARM-START-DATE,C'yyyy-mm-dd'` / `PARM-END-DATE,C'yyyy-mm-dd'` / `/*` / `//STEP10R.DATEPARM DD *` / `yyyy-mm-dd yyyy-mm-dd` / `/*` / `/*EOF`.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CR00 CORPT00C] --> B{EIBCALEN=0} -- yes --> SG[XCTL COSGN00C]
  B -- no --> K{EIBAID}
  K -- PF3 --> M[XCTL COMEN01C]
  K -- ENTER --> T{report type}
  T -- Monthly --> DM[current month 1st..last day]
  T -- Yearly --> DY[Jan 1..Dec 31]
  T -- Custom --> DC[validate parts + CSUTLDTC x2]
  T -- none --> S
  DM --> SJ[SUBMIT-JOB-TO-INTRDR]
  DY --> SJ
  DC -- ok --> SJ
  DC -- err --> S
  SJ --> CF{CONFIRM}
  CF -- Y --> W[WRITEQ TD JOBS each JCL line until /*EOF]
  CF -- N/blank/other --> S
  W --> S[SEND CORPT0A]
  S --> RT[RETURN CR00]
```

##### Data
No VSAM access. TDQ `JOBS` (extrapartition, expected to route to the JES internal reader - destination defined in CSD/DCT, not in this program). Symnames positions refer to the TRANSACT record layout used by TRANREPT (card number at 263 len 16, proc date at 305 len 10).

##### Outputs & side effects
Batch job TRNRPT00 submitted (PROC TRANREPT from AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PROC, STEP05R sort symbols, STEP10R DATEPARM).

##### External calls
CALL CSUTLDTC (custom only); WRITEQ TD JOBS; XCTL COMEN01C/COSGN00C.

##### Migration notes
- Monthly/Yearly paths call SUBMIT immediately without the error check; the custom path submits only if no error, but custom component errors do not stop subsequent checks (later messages overwrite earlier).
- Day check '> 31' is a string compare after zero-padding; CSUTLDTC catches impossible dates like 02-30.
- 'N' clears and sets error but SUBMIT then skips the loop because ERR-FLG-ON; screen sent twice.
- No start<=end check.
- Job card fixed; NOTIFY=&SYSUID resolves to CICS region userid, not the CardDemo user.
- Paragraph name typo WIRTE-JOBSUB-TDQ is the real name.
recommendation: Fully documented. Replace TDQ/internal-reader submission with a job-scheduler call that passes the same start/end dates to the TRANREPT procedure.
note: Duplicate of sfind-47410982987d4cc78d6efd7d871e30aa (CR00 / CORPT00C); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: COBSWAIT batch wait utility - reads centiseconds from SYSIN and calls MVSWAIT
description:
##### Entry point
Batch program `COBSWAIT` (EXEC PGM=COBSWAIT in a JCL step; invoking JCL not in this batch).

##### Inputs
SYSIN card: first 8 bytes into PARM-VALUE X(8).

##### Processing flow
1. ACCEPT PARM-VALUE FROM SYSIN.
2. MOVE PARM-VALUE TO MVSWAIT-TIME PIC 9(8) COMP.
3. CALL 'MVSWAIT' USING MVSWAIT-TIME.
4. STOP RUN.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[COBSWAIT] --> B[ACCEPT PARM-VALUE FROM SYSIN] --> C[MOVE to 9-8 COMP] --> D[CALL MVSWAIT] --> E[STOP RUN]
```

##### Data
No files other than SYSIN.

##### Outputs & side effects
Delays the job step.

##### External calls
`MVSWAIT` (app/asm/MVSWAIT.asm): saves registers, loads the address of the fullword parm from R1, copies the value to BINLBL and issues macro `ASMWAIT BINLBL` (interval-control timer wait; macro definition not in repo), restores registers, sets R15=0 and returns. Program header documents the parm as centiseconds.

##### Migration notes
- Alphanumeric-to-COMP move: non-numeric SYSIN content yields undefined/garbage values; short input padded with spaces.
- Unit is centiseconds per COBSWAIT header comment; ASMWAIT macro semantics are not in the repo, so the unit is from the comment only.
- MVSWAIT does `MVI 12(13),X'FF'` on the caller save area before returning (flag marking save area; author comment questions its purpose).

Addendum (caller): app/jcl/WAITSTEP.jcl - job WAITSTEP ('WAIT STEP', CLASS=A, MSGCLASS=0, NOTIFY=&SYSUID), single step WAIT EXEC PGM=COBSWAIT, STEPLIB AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB, SYSOUT=*, SYSIN instream card '00003600      VALUE IN CENTISECONDS' -> first 8 bytes '00003600' = 3600 centiseconds (36 s, per header comment). Trailing text on the card is ignored because only 8 bytes are moved into the COMP field.
recommendation: Replace with a scheduler delay/sleep step. MVSWAIT is app/asm/MVSWAIT.asm (outside batch); invoked by app/jcl/WAITSTEP.jcl.
note: Duplicate of sfind-85a67e80e37c461887d6d0a4616532cc (WAITSTEP job); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: COCRDSLC credit card detail view (TRANSID CCDL) - reads CARDDAT by card number
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `COCRDSLC`, TRANSID `CCDL`, map `CCRDSLA`/mapset `COCRDSL`. Reached from main menu option 4 (COMEN01C) or from card list COCRDLIC ('S' selection, XCTL with commarea). RETURN TRANSID CCDL COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA = CARDDEMO-COMMAREA + WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA).

##### Inputs
- Commarea (COCOM01Y): CDEMO-ACCT-ID, CDEMO-CARD-NUM, FROM-PROGRAM, LAST-MAPSET, PGM-CONTEXT.
- Map: ACCTSIDI (11), CARDSIDI (16). AIDs normalized via CSSTRPFY; only ENTER/PF3 valid, others treated as ENTER.

##### Processing flow
Shared skeleton with COACTVWC (HANDLE ABEND, commarea init when EIBCALEN=0 or first entry from COMEN01C, PF3 XCTL back to FROM-PROGRAM/COMEN01C with USER-TYPE forced 'U', COMMON-RETURN, ABEND-ROUTINE abend 9999, WHEN OTHER 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO'). Differences:
1. PGM-ENTER and FROM-PROGRAM='COCRDLIC': take CDEMO-ACCT-ID/CARD-NUM from commarea, 9000-READ-DATA, send map (no input editing).
2. PGM-ENTER otherwise: send empty map with prompt 'Please enter Account and Card Number'.
3. PGM-REENTER: RECEIVE; '*' or spaces -> LOW-VALUES; 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT: blank/zero -> error 'Account number not provided'; non-numeric -> 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER'; else CDEMO-ACCT-ID. 2220-EDIT-CARD: blank/zero -> 'Card number not provided'; non-numeric -> 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER'; else CDEMO-CARD-NUM. Both blank -> 'No input received'. Any error -> send map; else 9000-READ-DATA.
4. 9000-READ-DATA performs only 9100-GETCARD-BYACCTCARD: `READ FILE('CARDDAT') RIDFLD(card number X16)` -> NORMAL: FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT; NOTFND: both filters flagged, 'Did not find cards for this search condition'; other: 'File Error: READ on CARDDAT ... RESP/RESP2'.
5. Screen: embossed name, expiry month/year (from CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE YYYY-MM-DD positions), active status; header; when arrived from COCRDLIC (LAST-MAPSET='COCRDLI' and FROM-PROGRAM='COCRDLIC') the account and card fields are protected (DFHBMPRF) and default color, otherwise unprotected; red/'*' markers for invalid/blank filters.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CCDL COCRDSLC] --> K{AID / context}
  K -- PF3 --> X[XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C]
  K -- ENTER from COCRDLIC --> R[READ CARDDAT by card num]
  K -- first entry --> S[SEND CCRDSLA prompt]
  K -- reenter --> E[2210 account + 2220 card edits]
  E -- error --> S
  E -- ok --> R
  R --> S2[SEND CCRDSLA details]
  S --> RT[RETURN CCDL]
  S2 --> RT
```

##### Data
`CARDDAT` (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS) READ; CARD-RECORD (CVACT02Y, 150 bytes): CARD-NUM X16, CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11), CARD-CVV-CD 9(3), CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME X50, CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X10, CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS X1, FILLER X59. `CARDAIX` named in 9150-GETCARD-BYACCT (READ by account) but never performed.

##### Outputs & side effects
Read-only display; commarea carries ACCT-ID/CARD-NUM forward.

##### External calls
XCTL back to caller; CICS ABEND 9999.

##### Migration notes
- Account number entered is not checked against CARD-ACCT-ID: any valid card number displays regardless of account.
- Zero account/card treated as 'not provided'.
- CVV is read but not displayed.
- 9150-GETCARD-BYACCT is unreachable (no PERFORM).
recommendation: Fully documented. Account number is validated but not used as a key or match criterion; 9150-GETCARD-BYACCT is dead code.
note: Duplicate of sfind-a56ee17531cc493a816895b68b225949 (CCDL / COCRDSLC); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: COMEN01C regular-user main menu (TRANSID CM00) - option dispatch via COMEN02Y table
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `COMEN01C`, TRANSID `CM00`. Normally reached by XCTL from COSGN00C (or by PF3 return from function programs); re-entered via `RETURN TRANSID('CM00') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)`.

##### Inputs
- Commarea CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (COCOM01Y; see COSGN00C) copied from `DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN)`.
- Map `COMEN1A`/mapset `COMEN01`: `OPTIONI` (2-char option).
- Menu table COMEN02Y `CARDDEMO-MAIN-MENU-OPTIONS`: count=11; each entry NUM 9(2), NAME X35, PGMNAME X8, USRTYPE X1 (OCCURS 12 redefinition). Entries: 1 Account View COACTVWC; 2 Account Update COACTUPC; 3 Credit Card List COCRDLIC; 4 Credit Card View COCRDSLC; 5 Credit Card Update COCRDUPC; 6 Transaction List COTRN00C; 7 Transaction View COTRN01C; 8 Transaction Add COTRN02C; 9 Transaction Reports CORPT00C; 10 Bill Payment COBIL00C; 11 Pending Authorization View COPAUS0C. All USRTYPE 'U'.

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> FROM-PROGRAM='COSGN00C', RETURN-TO-SIGNON-SCREEN (XCTL to CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, defaulting to COSGN00C if blank; no commarea).
2. Copy commarea. If PGM-CONTEXT not REENTER -> set REENTER, send menu (first display).
3. Else RECEIVE MAP; ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> TO-PROGRAM='COSGN00C', XCTL (sign-off, no commarea); other -> invalid key message.
4. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: find last non-space char of OPTIONI scanning backwards; take substring 1..idx into WS-OPTION-X (JUST RIGHT), replace spaces with '0', move to numeric WS-OPTION 9(2). Invalid if not numeric, > 11, or 0 -> 'Please enter a valid option number...'.
5. If user type 'U' and option USRTYPE='A' -> 'No access - Admin Only option... '.
6. If no error: PGMNAME='COPAUS0C' -> `EXEC CICS INQUIRE PROGRAM(...) NOHANDLE`; if EIBRESP NORMAL -> XCTL with commarea (FROM-TRANID CM00, FROM-PROGRAM COMEN01C, context 0) else red message 'This option <name> is not installed...'. PGMNAME starting 'DUMMY' -> green 'This option <name>is coming soon ...'. Otherwise set FROM fields, context 0, XCTL to the program with commarea.
7. Then SEND-MENU-SCREEN (reached only if XCTL did not occur) and RETURN CM00.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CM00 COMEN01C] --> B{EIBCALEN=0}
  B -- yes --> SG[XCTL COSGN00C]
  B -- no --> C{PGM-REENTER?}
  C -- no --> SM[SEND-MENU-SCREEN]
  C -- yes --> R[RECEIVE COMEN1A] --> K{EIBAID}
  K -- PF3 --> SG
  K -- other --> SM
  K -- ENTER --> V{option 1..11 numeric?}
  V -- no --> SM
  V -- yes --> AD{user U and opt A?}
  AD -- yes --> SM
  AD -- no --> P{PGMNAME}
  P -- COPAUS0C --> I[INQUIRE PROGRAM] --> I2{NORMAL?}
  I2 -- yes --> X[XCTL option program]
  I2 -- no --> SM
  P -- DUMMY* --> SM
  P -- other --> X
  SM --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CM00]
```

##### Data
No files read or written (USRSEC name defined but unused; CSUSR01Y copied but unused).

##### Outputs & side effects
Map COMEN1A: OPTN001O..OPTN012O lines built as `NN. <name>` for idx 1..11; header fields (date/time, CM00, COMEN01C); ERRMSGO with color DFHRED/DFHGREEN for not-installed / coming-soon.

##### External calls
XCTL to any program in COMEN02Y with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; INQUIRE PROGRAM for COPAUS0C; XCTL COSGN00C on PF3/no commarea.

##### Migration notes
- Option parsing: '1 ' and ' 1' both become 01; non-digits fail NUMERIC. A two-character input like '1A' fails.
- Menu error paths SEND the screen and then continue; after PROCESS-ENTER-KEY's error branches, the code still reaches the final SEND-MENU-SCREEN (IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON block skipped only for dispatch), so on error the screen is sent once inside the check and RETURN follows; when admin check fires after invalid-option it can SEND twice.
- When option is invalid (e.g. 0 or >11), step 5 still indexes CDEMO-MENU-OPT-USRTYPE(WS-OPTION) out of range (0 or >12) before the error flag is checked.
- 'COPAUS0C' availability is checked at runtime (optional module); other programs are XCTLed without a check (PGMIDERR would abend - no HANDLE here, unlike COADM01C).
- Duplicate `MOVE WS-PGMNAME TO CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM` (harmless).
recommendation: Fully documented. Note that the admin-only check reads table entry USRTYPE but all 11 entries are 'U', so the restriction is currently inert.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-55d67c57ae3c41d0a4e66187dea11379.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- COMEN01C OPTIONI is 2 chars; options 1-11 valid; 12 slots on screen.
- Message 'coming soon' has no space after the option name because of DELIMITED BY SPACE.


End-to-end: COMEN01C is XCTLed by COSGN00C after successful authentication of a regular user. Upstream findings: sfind-392f2c38beae46788ed4fa8bf2032a83.

title: COBIL00C online bill payment (TRANSID CB00) - pays full account balance, writes TRANSACT record, rewrites ACCTDAT
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `COBIL00C`, TRANSID `CB00`, map `COBIL0A` / mapset `COBIL00`. Reached from main menu option 10 (XCTL with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA). Pseudo-conversational `RETURN TRANSID('CB00') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)`.

##### Inputs
- CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (COCOM01Y) extended locally with CDEMO-CB00-INFO: CDEMO-CB00-TRNID-FIRST X16, CDEMO-CB00-TRNID-LAST X16, CDEMO-CB00-PAGE-NUM 9(8), CDEMO-CB00-NEXT-PAGE-FLG X1, CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SEL-FLG X1, CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED X16.
- Map fields: ACTIDINI (account id, 11), CURBALI (display only), CONFIRMI (Y/N).
- AIDs: ENTER, PF3 (back), PF4 (clear), other.

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C. Else copy commarea.
2. First entry (not REENTER): set REENTER, clear map, cursor on account; if CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED not blank -> move it to ACTIDINI and PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; then SEND screen.
3. Re-entry: RECEIVE; ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> back to CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM (default COMEN01C) via XCTL; PF4 -> CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN; other -> invalid key.
4. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY:
   - ACTIDINI blank -> 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...'.
   - CONFIRMI: 'Y'/'y' -> CONF-PAY-YES and READ-ACCTDAT-FILE; 'N'/'n' -> clear screen, error flag; blank/low -> just read & display balance; other -> 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...'.
   - Move ACCT-CURR-BAL to WS-CURR-BAL / CURBALI. If balance <= 0 and no error -> 'You have nothing to pay...'.
   - If no error: if CONF-PAY-YES -> READ-CXACAIX-FILE (by XREF-ACCT-ID); STARTBR TRANSACT at HIGH-VALUES, READPREV one record, ENDBR; WS-TRAN-ID-NUM = TRAN-ID + 1 (zero if file empty/NOTFND); INITIALIZE TRAN-RECORD; build record (below); WRITE-TRANSACT-FILE; COMPUTE ACCT-CURR-BAL = ACCT-CURR-BAL - TRAN-AMT; UPDATE-ACCTDAT-FILE (REWRITE). Else -> 'Confirm to make a bill payment...' cursor on CONFIRM.
5. New TRAN-RECORD: TRAN-ID=new id, TRAN-TYPE-CD='02', TRAN-CAT-CD=2, TRAN-SOURCE='POS TERM', TRAN-DESC='BILL PAYMENT - ONLINE', TRAN-AMT=ACCT-CURR-BAL (full balance), TRAN-CARD-NUM=XREF-CARD-NUM, TRAN-MERCHANT-ID=999999999, MERCHANT-NAME='BILL PAYMENT', CITY='N/A', ZIP='N/A', ORIG-TS and PROC-TS = current timestamp `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.000000` from ASKTIME/FORMATTIME (YYYYMMDD DATESEP('-'), TIME TIMESEP(':')), micro portion zeros.
6. WRITE RESP: NORMAL -> clear fields, green 'Payment successful.  Your Transaction ID is <id>.'; DUPKEY/DUPREC -> 'Tran ID already exist...'; other -> 'Unable to Add Bill pay Transaction...'.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CB00 COBIL00C] --> B{EIBCALEN=0} -- yes --> SG[XCTL COSGN00C]
  B -- no --> C{REENTER?}
  C -- no --> F[pre-fill from CB00-TRN-SELECTED] --> S[SEND COBIL0A]
  C -- yes --> K{EIBAID}
  K -- PF3 --> BK[XCTL FROM-PROGRAM / COMEN01C]
  K -- PF4 --> CL[clear] --> S
  K -- ENTER --> P[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY]
  P --> V{acct blank / confirm invalid?} -- yes --> S
  V -- no --> RA[READ ACCTDAT UPDATE]
  RA --> BAL{CURR-BAL <= 0?} -- yes --> S
  BAL -- no --> Y{CONFIRM = Y?}
  Y -- no --> S
  Y -- yes --> X[READ CXACAIX by acct] --> T[STARTBR/READPREV/ENDBR TRANSACT HIGH-VALUES -> id+1]
  T --> W[WRITE TRANSACT] --> U[ACCT-CURR-BAL -= TRAN-AMT; REWRITE ACCTDAT] --> S
  S --> RT[RETURN CB00]
```

##### Data
- `ACCTDAT` (account KSDS, key ACCT-ID 9(11)) READ UPDATE / REWRITE; ACCOUNT-RECORD (CVACT01Y, 300 bytes): ACCT-ID 9(11), ACTIVE-STATUS X1, CURR-BAL S9(10)V99, CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, OPEN-DATE X10, EXPIRAION-DATE X10, REISSUE-DATE X10, CURR-CYC-CREDIT S9(10)V99, CURR-CYC-DEBIT S9(10)V99, ADDR-ZIP X10, GROUP-ID X10, FILLER X178 (signed zoned display).
- `CXACAIX` (alternate index path on card xref by account id) READ; CARD-XREF-RECORD (CVACT03Y, 50 bytes): XREF-CARD-NUM X16, XREF-CUST-ID 9(9), XREF-ACCT-ID 9(11), FILLER X14.
- `TRANSACT` (KSDS key TRAN-ID X16) browse + WRITE; TRAN-RECORD (CVTRA05Y, 350 bytes): TRAN-ID X16, TYPE-CD X2, CAT-CD 9(4), SOURCE X10, DESC X100, AMT S9(9)V99, MERCHANT-ID 9(9), MERCHANT-NAME X50, MERCHANT-CITY X50, MERCHANT-ZIP X10, CARD-NUM X16, ORIG-TS X26, PROC-TS X26, FILLER X20.

##### Outputs & side effects
New TRANSACT record; ACCTDAT balance set to (old balance - payment) = 0; screen messages. Read errors: ACCTDAT NOTFND -> 'Account ID NOT found...', other -> 'Unable to lookup Account...'; CXACAIX NOTFND 'Account ID NOT found...', other 'Unable to lookup XREF AIX file...'; TRANSACT STARTBR NOTFND 'Transaction ID NOT found...'; REWRITE NOTFND 'Account ID NOT found...', other 'Unable to Update Account...'.

##### External calls
XCTL COSGN00C / CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM (or COMEN01C); CICS ASKTIME/FORMATTIME.

##### Migration notes
- Payment amount is always the full current balance; no partial payment input.
- ACCTDAT is read with UPDATE even on display-only turns (lock held until task end/RETURN).
- Order: TRANSACT WRITE happens before the account REWRITE; no SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK - if REWRITE fails, the transaction record remains (non-atomic).
- New TRAN-ID = numeric(last key)+1 via move to PIC 9(16); concurrent tasks can collide (DUPREC message). READPREV ENDFILE leaves id at zero -> first id 1.
- Account-ID input moved alphanumerically to ACCT-ID 9(11) with no numeric check before the READ.
- Balance > 0 test happens only after reading; negative balances (credits) are 'nothing to pay'.
- TRAN-CAT-CD numeric 2 vs TYPE '02' string.
recommendation: Fully documented. Re-implement as a single atomic unit (transaction insert + balance update) and preserve the max-ID+1 transaction-id rule or replace with an equivalent sequence.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-a02570a9cddb40efb8402d99950db123, sfind-e0d066d7019f460cb16f068300220533.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- 'N' confirm clears screen silently.
- Payment amount is always the entire current balance; no partial payments.
- Cycle credit/debit and `TCATBALF` are not updated by online payment (unlike batch posting).
- Error flags do not always stop later steps (e.g. balance is displayed after lookup errors); preserve message precedence.

End-to-end: XCTLed by COMEN01C via the COMEN02Y option table (main menu). Upstream findings: sfind-6417f0efb3484b28b9b140c6d330e02d.

Owners from git history (no CODEOWNERS file in repo).

title: DEFGDGD batch job - define backup GDGs and copy TRANTYPE/TRANCATG/DISCGRP reference files to (+1)
description:
##### Entry point
JCL job `DEFGDGD` ('DEF DB2 GDG', CLASS=A, MSGCLASS=0, NOTIFY=&SYSUID).

##### Inputs
- AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANTYPE.PS (LRECL 60)
- AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANCATG.PS (LRECL 60)
- AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DISCGRP.PS (LRECL 50)

##### Processing flow
1. STEP10 IDCAMS: DEFINE GDG AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANTYPE.BKUP, LIMIT(5), SCRATCH.
2. STEP20 IEBGENER COND=(0,NE): SYSUT1 TRANTYPE.PS is copied to SYSUT2 TRANTYPE.BKUP(+1), DISP=(NEW,CATLG), DCB LRECL=60 RECFM=FB BLKSIZE=600, SPACE TRK(1,1) RLSE. SYSIN is DUMMY.
3. STEP30 IDCAMS COND=(0,NE): DEFINE GDG TRANCATG.PS.BKUP, LIMIT(5), SCRATCH.
4. STEP40 IEBGENER COND=(0,NE): TRANCATG.PS is copied to TRANCATG.PS.BKUP(+1), LRECL 60 / BLKSIZE 600.
5. STEP50 IDCAMS (no COND): DEFINE GDG DISCGRP.BKUP, LIMIT(5), SCRATCH.
6. STEP60 IEBGENER COND=(0,NE): DISCGRP.PS is copied to DISCGRP.BKUP(+1), LRECL 50 / BLKSIZE 500.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S10[STEP10 DEFINE GDG TRANTYPE.BKUP] --> S20[STEP20 IEBGENER TRANTYPE.PS -> BKUP +1]
  S20 --> S30[STEP30 DEFINE GDG TRANCATG.PS.BKUP] --> S40[STEP40 IEBGENER -> +1]
  S40 --> S50[STEP50 DEFINE GDG DISCGRP.BKUP no COND] --> S60[STEP60 IEBGENER -> +1]
```

##### Data
Creates GDG bases and the first generations. LIMIT 5 with SCRATCH means the oldest generation is deleted once 5 are exceeded.

##### Outputs & side effects
Catalogs the GDG bases and generations.

##### External calls
IDCAMS, IEBGENER.

##### Migration notes
- COND=(0,NE) skips a step if any prior step returned a nonzero code. On a rerun, the DEFINE in STEP10 fails because the GDG already exists, so STEP20 through STEP40 are skipped. STEP50 still runs because it has no COND, and then STEP60 is skipped because a prior RC is nonzero. The job is therefore effectively a one-time setup and cannot be used as a recurring backup.
- The job name says DB2, but the job only touches sequential files.
recommendation: Re-implement as a reference-data backup or versioning step.

title: CBEXPORT batch job - recreate EXPORT.DATA KSDS and run CBEXPORT over customer/account/xref/transaction/card masters
description:
##### Entry point
JCL job `CBEXPORT` ('Export Customer Data for Migration', CLASS=A, MSGCLASS=0, NOTIFY=&SYSUID).

##### Inputs
DD to DSN mapping, all DISP=SHR:
- CUSTFILE -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CUSTDATA.VSAM.KSDS
- ACCTFILE -> ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS
- XREFFILE -> CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS
- TRANSACT -> TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS
- CARDFILE -> CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS

##### Processing flow
1. STEP01 IDCAMS:
   - DELETE AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.EXPORT.DATA CLUSTER PURGE, then SET MAXCC = 0.
   - DEFINE CLUSTER EXPORT.DATA: INDEXED, KEYS(4 28) (a 4-byte key at offset 28), RECORDSIZE(500 500), CYLINDERS(10 5), FREESPACE(10 10), SHAREOPTIONS(2 3). DATA is named .DATA and INDEX is named .INDEX.
2. STEP02 EXEC PGM=CBEXPORT (STEPLIB AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB). It reads the five masters and writes EXPFILE (EXPORT.DATA, DISP=SHR). SYSOUT and SYSPRINT go to the spool.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S1[STEP01 IDCAMS DELETE PURGE + DEFINE EXPORT.DATA KEYS 4 28 RECSZ 500] --> S2[STEP02 CBEXPORT]
  C[CUSTDATA KSDS] --> S2
  A[ACCTDATA KSDS] --> S2
  X[CARDXREF KSDS] --> S2
  T[TRANSACT KSDS] --> S2
  K[CARDDATA KSDS] --> S2
  S2 --> E[EXPORT.DATA KSDS]
```

##### Data
EXPORT.DATA is a 500-byte fixed-record KSDS keyed at bytes 29-32 (1-based). Its record layout is defined in program CBEXPORT's copybook, which was not resolved in this batch.

##### Outputs & side effects
Replaces the export dataset.

##### External calls
IDCAMS, CBEXPORT (batch COBOL, not traced here).

##### Migration notes
- SET MAXCC=0 is placed after the DELETE, so the DELETE result is suppressed. Any DEFINE error in the same step still sets MAXCC.
- STEP02 has no COND, so it runs even if the DEFINE failed.
- The input masters must not be open for update in CICS, or the job reads a possibly inconsistent snapshot.
recommendation: The JCL is fully documented. Program CBEXPORT itself is outside batch 9 and its record logic was not traced here; see that program's own flow.
note: Duplicate of sfind-f06fac9d5d98466b878ffde08f4dc3fc (CBEXPORT multi-record master-file export); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: COSGN00C sign-on screen (TRANSID CC00) - USRSEC authentication and routing to admin/user menu
description:
##### Entry point
CICS online program `COSGN00C`, pseudo-conversational transaction `CC00` (WS-TRANID). First entry with `EIBCALEN = 0` (typed TRANSID from a clean terminal); later turns return via `EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CC00') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) LENGTH(LENGTH OF CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)`.

##### Inputs
- BMS map `COSGN0A` / mapset `COSGN00` (copybook COSGN00): `USERIDI` (user id), `PASSWDI` (password); AID key `EIBAID`.
- Commarea layout CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (COCOM01Y): FROM-TRANID X4, FROM-PROGRAM X8, TO-TRANID X4, TO-PROGRAM X8, USER-ID X8, USER-TYPE X1 ('A' admin/'U' user), PGM-CONTEXT 9(1) (0 enter/1 reenter), CUST-ID 9(9), CUST-FNAME/MNAME/LNAME X25 each, ACCT-ID 9(11), ACCT-STATUS X1, CARD-NUM 9(16), LAST-MAP X7, LAST-MAPSET X7. Incoming commarea is NOT copied into working storage by this program (no MOVE DFHCOMMAREA).

##### Processing flow
1. MAIN-PARA: clear error flag and `ERRMSGO`.
2. `EIBCALEN = 0` -> LOW-VALUES to map output, cursor on USERID, SEND-SIGNON-SCREEN (SEND MAP ERASE CURSOR).
3. Else evaluate `EIBAID`: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> SEND-PLAIN-TEXT with CCDA-MSG-THANK-YOU ('Thank you for using CardDemo application...') then bare `EXEC CICS RETURN` (conversation ends); other -> 'Invalid key pressed. Please see below...' and redisplay.
4. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: RECEIVE MAP COSGN0A. If USERID blank/low-values -> 'Please enter User ID ...'; elif PASSWD blank -> 'Please enter Password ...' (error flag set, screen sent). Regardless, `FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(USERIDI)` -> WS-USER-ID and CDEMO-USER-ID; `UPPER-CASE(PASSWDI)` -> WS-USER-PWD. If no error -> READ-USER-SEC-FILE.
5. READ-USER-SEC-FILE: `EXEC CICS READ DATASET('USRSEC') INTO(SEC-USER-DATA) RIDFLD(WS-USER-ID) KEYLENGTH(8)`.
   - RESP 0: if `SEC-USR-PWD = WS-USER-PWD` -> set CDEMO-FROM-TRANID='CC00', FROM-PROGRAM='COSGN00C', USER-ID, USER-TYPE=SEC-USR-TYPE, PGM-CONTEXT=0; if USER-TYPE='A' XCTL `COADM01C` else XCTL `COMEN01C` with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA. Password mismatch -> 'Wrong Password. Try again ...' cursor on password.
   - RESP 13 (NOTFND) -> 'User not found. Try again ...'.
   - other -> 'Unable to verify the User ...'.
6. Fall through to RETURN TRANSID CC00.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CC00 / COSGN00C MAIN-PARA] --> B{EIBCALEN = 0?}
  B -- yes --> S[SEND-SIGNON-SCREEN COSGN0A]
  B -- no --> C{EIBAID}
  C -- PF3 --> T[SEND TEXT thank-you + RETURN no TRANSID]
  C -- other --> S
  C -- ENTER --> R[RECEIVE MAP COSGN0A]
  R --> V{userid/pwd blank?}
  V -- yes --> S
  V -- no --> U[UPPER-CASE id/pwd; READ USRSEC by user id]
  U --> W{RESP}
  W -- 13 NOTFND --> S
  W -- other --> S
  W -- 0 --> P{SEC-USR-PWD = input?}
  P -- no --> S
  P -- yes --> Q{SEC-USR-TYPE = A?}
  Q -- yes --> X1[XCTL COADM01C]
  Q -- no --> X2[XCTL COMEN01C]
  S --> RET[RETURN TRANSID CC00 COMMAREA]
```

##### Data
- Read: CICS file `USRSEC` (user security KSDS, key = SEC-USR-ID X8). Record SEC-USER-DATA (CSUSR01Y, 80 bytes): SEC-USR-ID X8, SEC-USR-FNAME X20, SEC-USR-LNAME X20, SEC-USR-PWD X8, SEC-USR-TYPE X1, FILLER X23.
- No writes.

##### Outputs & side effects
- Map COSGN0A with header: TITLE01/02 (COTTL01Y: 'AWS Mainframe Modernization' / 'CardDemo'), TRNNAME='CC00', PGMNAME='COSGN00C', CURDATE mm/dd/yy, CURTIME hh:mm:ss, APPLID and SYSID via `EXEC CICS ASSIGN`.
- Commarea populated and passed to the menu program on success.

##### External calls
- XCTL `COADM01C` (admin) or `COMEN01C` (regular) with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (no LENGTH specified on XCTL).
- CICS ASSIGN APPLID/SYSID.

##### Migration notes
- Both user id AND password are upper-cased before lookup/compare: passwords are effectively case-insensitive; stored passwords must be upper case to ever match.
- Plain-text 8-byte password compare; trailing spaces significant via fixed-width compare.
- RESP code tested with literal 13 (NOTFND) rather than DFHRESP.
- Any USER-TYPE other than 'A' (including blanks/invalid) is routed to the regular user menu.
- PF3 ends the conversation with a plain text message and RETURN without TRANSID.
- Incoming commarea is ignored; every turn rebuilds from WS (CDEMO-USER-ID is set from input even on failures).
recommendation: Fully documented. Decide whether to keep plaintext, case-folded 8-char password comparison in the target stack (business decision; record behavior only).
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-2a3030f880574206aad09069b799cfd2.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- Credentials are uppercased before lookup and compare; stored IDs/passwords must be uppercase to match. Plaintext 8-char password compare.
- Messages and cursor positioning are part of the UX contract.

title: ACCTFILE batch job - delete/define ACCTDATA VSAM KSDS and REPRO load from flat file
description:
##### Entry point
JCL job `ACCTFILE` ('Delete define Account Data', CLASS=A, MSGCLASS=0, NOTIFY=&SYSUID). It is submitted manually; no scheduler reference was found in this batch.

##### Inputs
`AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.PS`: sequential account records (ACCOUNT-RECORD from CVACT01Y, 300 bytes). DD ACCTDATA, DISP=SHR.

##### Processing flow
1. STEP05 IDCAMS: DELETE AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS CLUSTER, then `IF MAXCC LE 08 THEN SET MAXCC = 0`. A missing cluster is therefore not an error.
2. STEP10 IDCAMS: DEFINE CLUSTER with NAME AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS, CYLINDERS(1 5), VOLUMES(AWSHJ1), KEYS(11 0), RECORDSIZE(300 300), SHAREOPTIONS(2 3), ERASE, INDEXED. DATA is named .DATA and INDEX is named .INDEX.
3. STEP15 IDCAMS: REPRO INFILE(ACCTDATA) OUTFILE(ACCTVSAM). ACCTVSAM is DD DSN=...ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS, DISP=SHR.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S5[STEP05 IDCAMS DELETE ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS; MAXCC<=8 -> 0] --> S10[STEP10 IDCAMS DEFINE CLUSTER KEYS 11 0 RECSZ 300]
  S10 --> S15[STEP15 IDCAMS REPRO ACCTDATA.PS -> ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS]
```

##### Data
- Reads ACCTDATA.PS.
- Writes the KSDS (key = ACCT-ID, offset 0, length 11; fixed 300-byte records).
- The KSDS is the CICS FILE ACCTDAT.

##### Outputs & side effects
Destroys and recreates the account master, so all online account updates are lost.

##### External calls
IDCAMS.

##### Migration notes
- There are no COND parameters. STEP10 and STEP15 run even if an earlier step fails. A DEFINE failure (for example, the cluster is still in use by CICS) still lets REPRO run against the old or missing dataset.
- REPRO requires the input to be in key sequence. Duplicate or out-of-order keys fail the step.
- SHAREOPTIONS(2 3) permits one updater and many readers across regions.
- CICS must close file ACCTDAT before this job runs. The JCL itself does not do this.
recommendation: Re-implement as a data-load or migration step for the account master.
note:
End-to-end: ACCTFILE is submitted by run_posting.sh, remote_refresh.sh and run_full_batch.sh as the account-master reload step. Upstream findings: sfind-7feddedd36284cb9bb70506492952d56, sfind-89eccdc975c54f8c8f058e029a06ca5f, sfind-574c7fefe140460688d7131108eb4d55.

title: CSUTLDTC date-validation subroutine - wraps LE CEEDAYS and returns an 80-byte result message
description:
##### Entry point
Called program `CSUTLDTC` (static/dynamic CALL 'CSUTLDTC'), `PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LS-DATE, LS-DATE-FORMAT, LS-RESULT`. Callers in batch: COTRN02C, CORPT00C (CICS, so CEEDAYS runs under LE in CICS).

##### Inputs
LS-DATE X(10), LS-DATE-FORMAT X(10) (callers pass 'YYYY-MM-DD'), LS-RESULT X(80) (output).

##### Processing flow
1. INITIALIZE WS-MESSAGE, WS-DATE = spaces.
2. A000-MAIN: build LE varying strings WS-DATE-TO-TEST (length 10, text = LS-DATE) and WS-DATE-FORMAT (length 10, text = format); OUTPUT-LILLIAN = 0; CALL "CEEDAYS" USING date, format, OUTPUT-LILLIAN (S9(9) BINARY), FEEDBACK-CODE (12-byte LE condition token).
3. WS-SEVERITY-N = token severity, WS-MSG-NO-N = msg number; WS-RESULT text by token value: all-zero -> 'Date is valid'; X'000309CB59C3C5C5' 'Insufficient'; ..CC 'Datevalue error'; ..CD 'Invalid Era'; ..D1 'Unsupp. Range'; ..D5 'Invalid month'; ..D6 'Bad Pic String'; ..D8 'Nonnumeric data'; ..D9 'YearInEra is 0'; other 'Date is invalid'.
4. LS-RESULT = WS-MESSAGE; RETURN-CODE = severity; EXIT PROGRAM.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CALL CSUTLDTC date fmt result] --> B[build vstrings] --> C[CALL CEEDAYS]
  C --> D[severity, msg-no from FEEDBACK-CODE]
  D --> E{token value} --> F[WS-RESULT text]
  F --> G[LS-RESULT = WS-MESSAGE; RETURN-CODE = severity]
```

##### Data
WS-MESSAGE (80 bytes) returned: SEVERITY X4 (numeric 9(4)), 'Mesg Code:' X11, MSG-NO X4, space, RESULT X15, space, 'TstDate:' X9, DATE X10, space, 'Mask used:' X10, DATE-FMT X10, space X1, spaces X3. Callers read SEV-CD = bytes 1-4, MSG-NUM = bytes 16-19.

##### Outputs & side effects
LS-RESULT, RETURN-CODE (which also becomes the caller's RETURN-CODE special register).

##### External calls
LE callable service CEEDAYS (date string + picture -> Lilian day number, feedback token). Lilian output discarded.

##### Migration notes
- Valid date => severity '0000'. Callers additionally treat msg number 2513 as acceptable (CEEDAYS 'date outside supported range'-type condition; exact meaning not in source).
- INITIALIZE leaves FILLER VALUE literals intact only if not reinitialized - INITIALIZE does not touch FILLER, so labels remain.
- Severity moved to an unsigned 9(4) display field (sign dropped).
recommendation: Re-implement as a pure date-validation function returning severity/message code; preserve the 80-byte message layout if callers parse it.
note:
End-to-end: CSUTLDTC is CALLed by COTRN02C and CORPT00C (CALL 'CSUTLDTC' USING CSUTLDTC-DATE) and by the CSUTLDPY paragraph EDIT-DATE-LE copied into COACTUPC; it is the shared LE CEEDAYS date validator. Upstream findings: sfind-aa2005c873cb4a6eb4ea75db4a51161a, sfind-47410982987d4cc78d6efd7d871e30aa, sfind-9d93d6b2b2294cdc9d0c8242820f3e6d.

title: CREASTMT / CBSTM03A + CBSTM03B statement generation (text and HTML)
description:
##### Entry point Batch job `CREASTMT` (app/jcl/CREASTMT.JCL): `DELDEF01` IDCAMS delete/define AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS; `STEP010` SORT TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS `SORT FIELDS=(263,16,CH,A,1,16,CH,A)`, `OUTREC FIELDS=(1:263,16,17:1,262,279:279,50)` -> TRXFL.SEQ; `STEP020` IDCAMS REPRO TRXFL.SEQ -> TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS (COND=(0,NE)); `STEP030` IEFBR14 deletes old STATEMNT.HTML/STATEMNT.PS; `STEP040 EXEC PGM=CBSTM03A` (COND=(0,NE)). Program `CBSTM03A` (batch main, no USING) calls subprogram `CBSTM03B` for all VSAM I/O. ##### Inputs Via CBSTM03B (DD -> DSN): - TRNXFILE -> TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS (INDEXED SEQUENTIAL, key = TRNX-CARD-NUM X16 + TRNX-ID X16 = 32 bytes, 318 data): card-first copy of CVTRA05Y. TRNX-REST holds type, cat, source, DESC X100, AMT S9(9)V99, merchant fields, orig-ts, proc-ts. - XREFFILE -> CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS (INDEXED SEQUENTIAL; CVACT03Y). - CUSTFILE -> CUSTDATA.VSAM.KSDS (INDEXED RANDOM key X9; CUSTREC layout, 500 bytes, same fields as CVCUS01Y). - ACCTFILE -> ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS (INDEXED RANDOM key X11; CVACT01Y). Interface WS-M03B-AREA: DD X8, OPER X1 ('O' open,'C' close,'R' read next,'K' keyed read,'W' write,'Z' rewrite), RC X2 (file status), KEY X25, KEY-LN S9(4), FLDT X1000 (record). ##### Processing flow 1. Walk PSA->TCB->TIOT via POINTERs and DISPLAY job name, step name and each DD name in the TIOT (diagnostic only; flags DDs with null UCB). 2. Open STMT-FILE, HTML-FILE OUTPUT; INITIALIZE WS-TRNX-TABLE (51 cards x 10 trans) and WS-TRN-TBL-CNTL. 3. 0000-START dispatcher on WS-FL-DD using `ALTER 8100-FILE-OPEN TO PROCEED TO ...` + `GO TO`: 'TRNXFILE' -> 8100-TRNXFILE-OPEN (open 'O', first read 'R'; RC '00'/'04' ok; WS-SAVE-CARD=card, CR-CNT=1, TR-CNT=0; next 'READTRNX') -> 8500-READTRNX-READ (load loop: same card -> TR-CNT+1, else store count, CR-CNT+1, TR-CNT=1; store card/trans id/rest; read next; '10' -> 8599-EXIT store last count, next 'XREFFILE') -> 8200 open XREF -> 8300 open CUST -> 8400 open ACCT -> 1000-MAINLINE. WHEN OTHER -> 9999-GOBACK. 4. 1000-MAINLINE loop: 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT ('R'; '10' -> EOF; other abend). If not EOF: 2000-CUSTFILE-GET ('K', key XREF-CUST-ID, len 9), 3000-ACCTFILE-GET ('K', key XREF-ACCT-ID, len 11) — non-'00' abend; 5000-CREATE-STATEMENT; WS-TOTAL-AMT=0; 4000-TRNXFILE-GET. 5. 5000-CREATE-STATEMENT: name = first/middle/last each delimited by first space joined with spaces; ST-ADD1/2 = addr lines; ST-ADD3 = line3+state+country+zip (space-delimited); ACCT-ID, ACCT-CURR-BAL (PIC 9(9).99-), FICO. Writes text lines ST-LINE0..ST-LINE13 (80 bytes) and 5100-WRITE-HTML-HEADER plus HTML name/address/basic-info blocks (fixed markup lines HTML-Lnn of 100 bytes; `

` text built by STRING). 6. 4000-TRNXFILE-GET: scan table rows 1..CR-CNT until row card > XREF-CARD-NUM; on equal card, for each stored transaction 6000-WRITE-TRANS (ST-LINE14: TRAN-ID, DESC truncated to 49, amount Z(9).99-; HTML row with id/desc/amount) and ADD TRNX-AMT to WS-TOTAL-AMT. Then total lines ST-LINE12/14A/15 and closing HTML lines. 7. After EOF close TRNX, XREF, CUST, ACCT ('C'), close STMT/HTML, GOBACK. 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM calls CEE3ABD (ABCODE 999). ```mermaid flowchart TD A[CREASTMT DELDEF01/STEP010 SORT/STEP020 REPRO/STEP030 IEFBR14] --> B[STEP040 CBSTM03A] B --> C[TIOT walk DISPLAY DDs; open STMT-FILE HTML-FILE] C --> D{0000-START WS-FL-DD} D -->|TRNXFILE| E[8100-TRNXFILE-OPEN via ALTER/GO TO] E --> F[8500-READTRNX-READ load WS-TRNX-TABLE] F --> D D -->|XREFFILE/CUSTFILE/ACCTFILE| G[8200/8300/8400 open via CBSTM03B] G --> D D -->|after ACCTFILE| H[1000-MAINLINE] H --> I[1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT] I -->|10| Q[9100-9400 close; CLOSE STMT HTML] I --> J[2000-CUSTFILE-GET K; 3000-ACCTFILE-GET K] J --> K[5000-CREATE-STATEMENT] K --> L[4000-TRNXFILE-GET 6000-WRITE-TRANS] L --> I E & F & G & I & J -->|RC error| Z[9999-ABEND-PROGRAM CEE3ABD] ``` ##### Data Read-only masters. Writes STMTFILE -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.STATEMNT.PS (80-byte lines) and HTMLFILE -> STATEMNT.HTML (100-byte lines). In-memory table: WS-CARD-NUM X16, WS-TRCT S9(4), 10 x (WS-TRAN-NUM X16, WS-TRAN-REST X318). ##### Outputs & side effects One plain-text and one HTML statement per cross-reference record (i.e., per card), with transaction list and total. TIOT DISPLAY lines in SYSOUT. ##### External calls - `CBSTM03B` USING WS-M03B-AREA: performs OPEN/READ/READ KEY/CLOSE on the DD named in WS-M03B-DD and returns the VSAM file status in WS-M03B-RC and the record in WS-M03B-FLDT. Unknown DD names fall through without I/O. - `CEE3ABD` (ABCODE 999, TIMING 0). ##### Migration notes - No bounds checks: >51 distinct cards or >10 transactions per card overflow the table (storage overlay) — the whole TRANSACT file is loaded into memory first. - Lookup assumes both XREF and the table are ascending by card; break on `WS-CARD-NUM > XREF-CARD-NUM`. - One statement per card, not per account; accounts with several cards get several statements. - Proc-timestamp is truncated to 24 bytes by the SORT OUTREC (fields 279..328). - RC '04' accepted on open/first read. - ALTER/GO TO state machine must be rewritten as sequential calls; order is TRNX load, XREF, CUST, ACCT opens. - Name/address built with STRING DELIMITED BY ' ' — multi-word names are truncated at the first space. - Current balance is printed with PIC 9(9).99- (no zero suppression); totals Z(9).99-. - HTML literal markup (bank name/address, table tags) is fixed text in HTML-FIXED-LN 88-levels; reproduce verbatim from source lines ~148-223.
recommendation: HTML literal markup lines summarised, not reproduced; table-overflow behaviour beyond 51x10 is storage-dependent.
note: Duplicate of sfind-c61aa7aa8ce745ec820239c5975bbf26 (CREASTMT / CBSTM03A + CBSTM03B); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: POSTTRAN / CBTRN02C daily transaction posting (validate, post, reject)
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `POSTTRAN` (app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl), single step `STEP15 EXEC PGM=CBTRN02C` (no PARM). Program `CBTRN02C` (batch, no LINKAGE) — daily transaction posting.

##### Inputs
- `DALYTRAN` DD -> `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYTRAN.PS` (sequential, 350-byte records), read `INTO DALYTRAN-RECORD` (copybook CVTRA06Y): DALYTRAN-ID X(16), TYPE-CD X(2), CAT-CD 9(4), SOURCE X(10), DESC X(100), AMT S9(9)V99 zoned (11 bytes, sign overpunched), MERCHANT-ID 9(9), MERCHANT-NAME X(50), MERCHANT-CITY X(50), MERCHANT-ZIP X(10), CARD-NUM X(16), ORIG-TS X(26), PROC-TS X(26), FILLER X(20).
- `XREFFILE` -> `CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS` (INDEXED, RANDOM, key FD-XREF-CARD-NUM X(16)); layout CVACT03Y: XREF-CARD-NUM X(16), XREF-CUST-ID 9(9), XREF-ACCT-ID 9(11), FILLER X(14) = 50 bytes.
- `ACCTFILE` -> `ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS` (INDEXED, RANDOM, key FD-ACCT-ID 9(11), opened I-O); layout CVACT01Y (300 bytes): ACCT-ID 9(11), ACTIVE-STATUS X(1), CURR-BAL S9(10)V99, CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, OPEN-DATE X(10), EXPIRAION-DATE X(10), REISSUE-DATE X(10), CURR-CYC-CREDIT S9(10)V99, CURR-CYC-DEBIT S9(10)V99, ADDR-ZIP X(10), GROUP-ID X(10), FILLER X(178). All numerics zoned display.
- `TCATBALF` -> `TCATBALF.VSAM.KSDS` (INDEXED, RANDOM, key FD-TRAN-CAT-KEY 17 bytes, opened I-O); layout CVTRA01Y: TRANCAT-ACCT-ID 9(11), TRANCAT-TYPE-CD X(2), TRANCAT-CD 9(4), TRAN-CAT-BAL S9(9)V99, FILLER X(22) = 50 bytes.

##### Processing flow
1. Open DALYTRAN (INPUT), TRANFILE (**OUTPUT**), XREFFILE (INPUT), DALYREJS (OUTPUT), ACCTFILE (I-O), TCATBALF (I-O). Any status other than '00' -> 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS + 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM (CEE3ABD abend code 999).
2. Loop until END-OF-FILE='Y': 1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT (status '00' ok, '10' EOF, other abend). For each record: WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT+1, clear reason code/desc, PERFORM 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN.
3. 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF: random READ XREF by DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM. INVALID KEY -> reason 100 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND'. Only if reason still 0 -> 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT.
4. 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT: READ ACCOUNT by XREF-ACCT-ID. INVALID KEY -> 101 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'. Otherwise, two independent checks (both evaluated; **later one overwrites** the reason):
   - `WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT + DALYTRAN-AMT`; if `ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL` ok else 102 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'.
   - if `ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS(1:10)` (alphanumeric compare of 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings) ok else 103 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'.
5. Reason = 0 -> 2000-POST-TRANSACTION; else WS-REJECT-COUNT+1 and 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC (430-byte record: 350-byte DALYTRAN-RECORD + 80-byte trailer = reason 9(4) + desc X(76)).
6. 2000-POST-TRANSACTION: copy all DALYTRAN fields to TRAN-RECORD (CVTRA05Y, same layout), set TRAN-PROC-TS from Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP (FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE -> 'YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.hh0000'), then in order: 2700-UPDATE-TCATBAL, 2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC, 2900-WRITE-TRANSACTION-FILE.
7. 2700-UPDATE-TCATBAL: key = XREF-ACCT-ID + DALYTRAN-TYPE-CD + DALYTRAN-CAT-CD. READ; INVALID KEY -> display 'TCATBAL record not found ... Creating.' and flag create. Status not '00'/'23' -> abend. Create (2700-A): INITIALIZE, set key, TRAN-CAT-BAL = 0 + amount, WRITE. Update (2700-B): TRAN-CAT-BAL += amount, REWRITE. Non-'00' -> abend.
8. 2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC: ACCT-CURR-BAL += amount; if amount >= 0 ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT += amount else ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT += amount (debit accumulates as negative). REWRITE; INVALID KEY sets reason 109 (never acted upon).
9. 2900-WRITE-TRANSACTION-FILE: WRITE TRAN-RECORD to TRANFILE; non-'00' (e.g. '22' duplicate key) -> abend.
10. Close all files, display 'TRANSACTIONS PROCESSED :' / 'TRANSACTIONS REJECTED  :'; if rejects > 0 set RETURN-CODE = 4. GOBACK.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[POSTTRAN STEP15 CBTRN02C] --> B[Open 6 files]
  B -->|status not 00| Z[9999-ABEND-PROGRAM CEE3ABD 999]
  B --> C[1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT]
  C -->|EOF 10| K[Close files; RC=4 if rejects]
  C -->|other err| Z
  C --> D[1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF]
  D -->|INVALID KEY| R1[reason 100]
  D --> E[1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT]
  E -->|INVALID KEY| R2[reason 101]
  E --> F{CREDIT-LIMIT >= CYC-CREDIT - CYC-DEBIT + AMT}
  F -->|no| R3[reason 102]
  F --> G{EXPIRAION-DATE >= ORIG-TS 1:10}
  R3 --> G
  G -->|no| R4[reason 103]
  G -->|ok and reason 0| P[2000-POST-TRANSACTION]
  R1 --> W[2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC DALYREJS]
  R2 --> W
  R4 --> W
  P --> T[2700-UPDATE-TCATBAL create/rewrite]
  T --> U[2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC rewrite ACCTFILE]
  U --> V[2900-WRITE-TRANSACTION-FILE TRANFILE]
  V --> C
  W --> C
```

##### Data
- Read: DALYTRAN.PS, CARDXREF KSDS. Read/updated: ACCTDATA KSDS (REWRITE), TCATBALF KSDS (WRITE/REWRITE). Written: TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS (FD-TRANS-ID X(16) key + 334 bytes = CVTRA05Y TRAN-RECORD), DALYREJS GDG (+1) RECFM=F LRECL=430.

##### Outputs & side effects
Posted transaction records; account balances/cycle totals updated; category balances created/updated; reject file; SYSOUT counts; job RC 4 when any reject, abend U999 on I/O error.

##### External calls
`CEE3ABD` (LE abend service) USING ABCODE=999, TIMING=0 — terminates the step; no return.

##### Migration notes
- Credit-limit test uses cycle credit minus cycle debit plus amount, **not** ACCT-CURR-BAL. Debits are added (as negative values) to CURR-CYC-DEBIT, so `CYC-CREDIT - CYC-DEBIT` grows with debits — reproduce exactly.
- 102 and 103 both evaluated; when both fail, reason 103 is what gets written.
- Reason 109 from REWRITE INVALID KEY is set after validation and never written to rejects — the transaction is still written to TRANFILE.
- Update order is TCATBAL -> ACCOUNT -> TRANSACT with no commit/rollback; an abend mid-record leaves partial updates (no restart logic).
- TRANFILE opened OUTPUT on an existing KSDS (DISP=SHR); on z/OS this only succeeds if the cluster is empty/REUSE — environment dependent.
- Expiration compare is string-based on 'YYYY-MM-DD'; amounts are zoned decimal (use BigDecimal, scale 2, no rounding — pure adds).
- PROC-TS hundredths followed by literal '0000'.
- DALYREJS DCB RECFM=F (not FB).
recommendation: Fully documented; no unresolved behaviour.
note: Duplicate of sfind-8b266e66b8e84f7da258779d51763996 (CBTRN02C daily transaction posting (POSTTRAN)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CU03 / COUSR03C delete user
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CU03` -> program `COUSR03C` (admin "Delete User"), XCTL'd from COUSR00C (selection 'D') or admin menu; pseudo-conversational RETURN TRANSID('CU03').

##### Inputs
- COMMAREA COCOM01Y + CDEMO-CU03-INFO (same layout as CU00-INFO: USRID-FIRST X8, USRID-LAST X8, PAGE-NUM 9(8), NEXT-PAGE-FLG X1, USR-SEL-FLG X1, USR-SELECTED X8).
- Map `COUSR3A`/mapset `COUSR03`: USRIDINI (user ID), display FNAMEI, LNAMEI, USRTYPEI; EIBAID.

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C.
2. First entry: set re-enter, cursor on user ID; if CDEMO-CU03-USR-SELECTED not blank, put it in USRIDINI and PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN.
3. Re-entry RECEIVE; EIBAID: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM (or COADM01C if blank); PF4 -> CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN; PF5 -> DELETE-USER-INFO; PF12 -> XCTL COADM01C; other -> invalid key.
4. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: blank ID -> 'User ID can NOT be empty...'. Else READ-USER-SEC-FILE: `READ DATASET('USRSEC') INTO SEC-USER-DATA RIDFLD(SEC-USR-ID) UPDATE`; NORMAL -> 'Press PF5 key to delete this user ...'; NOTFND -> 'User ID NOT found...'; other -> 'Unable to lookup User...'. Show first/last name and type.
5. DELETE-USER-INFO (PF5): blank ID check; READ UPDATE again, then DELETE-USER-SEC-FILE: `DELETE DATASET('USRSEC')` (no RIDFLD — deletes the record held by READ UPDATE). NORMAL -> clear fields, green 'User <id> has been deleted ...'; NOTFND -> 'User ID NOT found...'; other -> 'Unable to Update User...'.
6. RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN sets FROM-TRANID CU03, FROM-PROGRAM COUSR03C, PGM-CONTEXT 0, XCTL with COMMAREA.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CU03 COUSR03C] -->|EIBCALEN=0| S[XCTL COSGN00C]
  A -->|first, USR-SELECTED| P[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY]
  A -->|re-enter| R[RECEIVE COUSR3A]
  R -->|ENTER| P
  R -->|PF5| D[DELETE-USER-INFO]
  R -->|PF4| C[CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN]
  R -->|PF3| B[XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COADM01C]
  R -->|PF12| ADM[XCTL COADM01C]
  P --> RD[READ USRSEC UPDATE]
  D --> RD2[READ USRSEC UPDATE] --> DEL[DELETE USRSEC]
  RD & DEL & C --> SND[SEND COUSR3A]
  SND --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CU03]
```

##### Data
CICS file `USRSEC` (CSUSR01Y 80-byte: ID X8 key, FNAME X20, LNAME X20, PWD X8, TYPE X1, FILLER X23): READ UPDATE, DELETE.

##### Outputs & side effects
Physically deletes the user security record. Screen messages.

##### External calls
CICS READ UPDATE, DELETE, SEND/RECEIVE MAP, XCTL, RETURN.

##### Migration notes
- PF5 deletes without any confirmation beyond the prior message; no check that the user isn't deleting themselves or the last admin.
- If the READ in DELETE-USER-INFO fails, DELETE is still executed (it is PERFORMed unconditionally after READ) and will fail with INVALIDREQ -> 'Unable to Update User...'.
- First-entry path can SEND the map up to three times in one task (inside READ, after populating, then main) — only the last is visible.
- READ UPDATE in the ENTER path holds a lock only until task end (RETURN).
recommendation: Fully documented; no unresolved behaviour.
note: Duplicate of sfind-94ff547d654a45d899d8b70eed962d7d (CU03 / COUSR03C); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CBEXPORT multi-record master-file export
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `CBEXPORT` (app/jcl/CBEXPORT.jcl): `STEP01 EXEC PGM=IDCAMS` (DELETE then DEFINE CLUSTER AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.EXPORT.DATA, INDEXED, KEYS(4 28) i.e. EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM at offset 28, RECORDSIZE(500 500)) then `STEP02 EXEC PGM=CBEXPORT`. Program `CBEXPORT` (batch, no LINKAGE) — branch-migration export of all master files into one multi-record file.

##### Inputs
DD -> DSN (all INDEXED, ACCESS SEQUENTIAL, opened INPUT):
- CUSTFILE -> CUSTDATA.VSAM.KSDS (CVCUS01Y 500 bytes: CUST-ID 9(9), FIRST/MIDDLE/LAST-NAME X25 each, ADDR-LINE-1..3 X50 each, ADDR-STATE-CD X2, COUNTRY-CD X3, ZIP X10, PHONE-NUM-1/2 X15, SSN 9(9), GOVT-ISSUED-ID X20, DOB-YYYY-MM-DD X10, EFT-ACCOUNT-ID X10, PRI-CARD-HOLDER-IND X1, FICO-CREDIT-SCORE 9(3), FILLER X168)
- ACCTFILE -> ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS (CVACT01Y 300 bytes)
- XREFFILE -> CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS (CVACT03Y 50 bytes)
- TRANSACT -> TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS (CVTRA05Y 350 bytes)
- CARDFILE -> CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS (CVACT02Y 150 bytes: CARD-NUM X16, ACCT-ID 9(11), CVV-CD 9(3), EMBOSSED-NAME X50, EXPIRAION-DATE X10, ACTIVE-STATUS X1, FILLER X59)

##### Processing flow
1. 1000-INITIALIZE: ACCEPT date/time, build WS-EXPORT-DATE 'YYYY-MM-DD', time 'HH:MM:SS', WS-FORMATTED-TIMESTAMP 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.00'; open the 5 inputs and EXPFILE OUTPUT (each non-'00' -> display + 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM).
2. 2000-EXPORT-CUSTOMERS, 3000-EXPORT-ACCOUNTS, 4000-EXPORT-XREFS, 5000-EXPORT-TRANSACTIONS, 5500-EXPORT-CARDS — strictly in this order. Each: priming READ, loop until status '10': INITIALIZE EXPORT-RECORD, set REC-TYPE (C/A/X/T/D), EXPORT-TIMESTAMP = run timestamp, ADD 1 to WS-SEQUENCE-COUNTER -> EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM, BRANCH-ID '0001', REGION-CODE 'NORTH', move every source field to its EXP-* field, WRITE EXPORT-OUTPUT-RECORD, increment per-type and total counters, READ next. Read status other than '00'/'10' or write not '00' -> abend.
3. 6000-FINALIZE: close all, DISPLAY counts per type and total.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CBEXPORT STEP01 IDCAMS DELETE/DEFINE EXPORT.DATA] --> B[STEP02 CBEXPORT 1000-INITIALIZE]
  B --> C[2000-EXPORT-CUSTOMERS type C]
  C --> D[3000-EXPORT-ACCOUNTS type A]
  D --> E[4000-EXPORT-XREFS type X]
  E --> F[5000-EXPORT-TRANSACTIONS type T]
  F --> G[5500-EXPORT-CARDS type D]
  G --> H[6000-FINALIZE counts]
  B & C & D & E & F & G -->|I/O error| Z[9999-ABEND-PROGRAM CEE3ABD]
```

##### Data
EXPFILE record (CVEXPORT, 500 bytes): EXPORT-REC-TYPE X1 | EXPORT-TIMESTAMP X26 | EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM 9(9) COMP (4-byte binary, KSDS key) | BRANCH-ID X4 | REGION-CODE X5 | EXPORT-RECORD-DATA X460 redefined per type: EXP-CUST-* (EXP-CUST-ID 9(9) COMP, FICO 9(3) COMP-3; addresses OCCURS 3 X50; phones OCCURS 2), EXP-ACCT-* (ACCT-CURR-BAL, CREDIT-LIMIT, CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT, CYC-CREDIT as COMP-3 S9(10)V99; CYC-DEBIT as COMP S9(10)V99), EXP-TRAN-* (TRAN-AMT COMP-3 S9(9)V99; MERCHANT-ID COMP), EXP-XREF-* (ACCT-ID 9(11) COMP), EXP-CARD-* (ACCT-ID 9(11) COMP, CVV 9(3) COMP).

##### Outputs & side effects
New KSDS AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.EXPORT.DATA (previous one deleted). DISPLAY statistics. Sources are read-only.

##### External calls
`CEE3ABD` called with **no USING parameters** (`CALL 'CEE3ABD'`) after DISPLAY 'CBEXPORT: ABENDING PROGRAM' — abend code/timing are undefined (unlike other CardDemo programs that pass 999/0). IDCAMS in STEP01.

##### Migration notes
- Card records use type **'D'** (not 'C', which is customer).
- Export changes numeric encodings: zoned display source fields become COMP-3/binary in the export (e.g. account debit as binary COMP with implied 2 decimals). Byte-level consumers must honor these.
- Sequence number is global across all types (1..N) and is the KSDS key; record order = customers, accounts, xrefs, transactions, cards.
- Branch '0001' and region 'NORTH' are hard-coded; timestamp identical for all records; '.00' hundredths are literal.
- No filtering: everything is exported, including SSNs and CVVs.
recommendation: Fully documented; no unresolved behaviour.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/CBEXPORT.cbl, app/jcl/CBEXPORT.jcl; merged duplicates: sfind-2f6215e4c414468c8c0c46231cfe98f1, sfind-75e4edd0a20d42a5a665897c495abc38, sfind-4446372f7c25426fa7f53284d478d68c.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- Mixed encodings inside one record (zoned, COMP-3, binary COMP) - a cross-platform reader must decode per type; EBCDIC for text.
- Branch '0001' / region 'NORTH' hardcoded. Sequence numbers are continuous across types in fixed order C,A,X,T,D.
- Sensitive data (SSN, CVV) exported in clear.
- The COBOL key `EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM` begins at byte offset 27 (after 1+26 bytes), but the cluster is defined `KEYS(4 28)` (length 4, offset 28). The defined key straddles the sequence number and branch id; whether the program's key description matches the cluster could only be confirmed at run time — record this discrepancy rather than "fix" it silently.
- Branch `0001` and region `NORTH` are hard-coded; one timestamp for the whole run.
- SET MAXCC=0 is placed after the DELETE, so the DELETE result is suppressed. Any DEFINE error in the same step still sets MAXCC.
- STEP02 has no COND, so it runs even if the DEFINE failed.
- The input masters must not be open for update in CICS, or the job reads a possibly inconsistent snapshot.

Owners from git history (no CODEOWNERS file in repo).

title: CT00 / COTRN00C transaction list with paging
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CT00` -> program `COTRN00C` (online "Transaction List"), menu option 6 of COMEN01C; pseudo-conversational RETURN TRANSID('CT00') COMMAREA.

##### Inputs
- COMMAREA COCOM01Y + CDEMO-CT00-INFO (TRNID-FIRST X16, TRNID-LAST X16, PAGE-NUM 9(8), NEXT-PAGE-FLG X1, TRN-SEL-FLG X1, TRN-SELECTED X16).
- Map `COTRN0A`/mapset `COTRN00`: TRNIDINI (start transaction ID), SEL0001I..SEL0010I, TRNID01I..10I; EIBAID ENTER/PF3/PF7/PF8.

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C. First entry -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY. Re-entry: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL COMEN01C; PF7 -> PROCESS-PF7-KEY; PF8 -> PROCESS-PF8-KEY; other -> invalid key message.
2. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: first non-blank SELnnnn gives flag + TRNIDnn. 'S'/'s' -> XCTL COTRN01C (Transaction View) with COMMAREA (FROM-TRANID CT00, FROM-PROGRAM COTRN00C, context 0). Other -> 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' (continues listing). Start key: TRNIDINI blank -> LOW-VALUES; numeric -> TRAN-ID; non-numeric -> 'Tran ID must be Numeric ...' + send. PAGE-NUM = 0, PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD.
3. PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD: STARTBR TRANSACT RIDFLD TRAN-ID; skip one READNEXT unless key is ENTER/PF7/PF3; clear 10 rows; READNEXT up to 10 (POPULATE-TRAN-DATA: TRAN-ID, 8-char date WS-TRAN-DATE, TRAN-DESC, amount edited +99999999.99; row1 ID -> TRNID-FIRST, row10 -> TRNID-LAST); lookahead READNEXT sets NEXT-PAGE; PAGE-NUM+1; ENDBR; send.
4. PF7: start at TRNID-FIRST; if PAGE-NUM > 1 PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD (READPREV mirror, PAGE-NUM-1 or reset to 1) else 'You are already at the top of the page...' (no erase). PF8: start at TRNID-LAST or HIGH-VALUES; NEXT-PAGE-YES -> forward else 'You are already at the bottom of the page...'.
5. STARTBR NOTFND -> 'You are at the top of the page...'; READNEXT/READPREV ENDFILE -> EOF + bottom/top messages; other RESP -> 'Unable to lookup transaction...'.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CT00 COTRN00C] -->|EIBCALEN=0| S[XCTL COSGN00C]
  A --> R[RECEIVE COTRN0A]
  R -->|PF3| M[XCTL COMEN01C]
  R -->|ENTER| E[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY]
  E -->|sel S| V[XCTL COTRN01C]
  E --> F[PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD]
  R -->|PF8| F
  R -->|PF7| B[PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD]
  F --> BR[STARTBR/READNEXT/ENDBR TRANSACT]
  B --> BP[STARTBR/READPREV/ENDBR TRANSACT]
  BR & BP --> SND[SEND-TRNLST-SCREEN] --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CT00]
```

##### Data
CICS file TRANSACT (CVTRA05Y 350 bytes, key TRAN-ID X16) browse only.

##### Outputs & side effects
List screen of 10 transactions per page; navigation to COTRN01C with CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED. No updates.

##### External calls
CICS STARTBR/READNEXT/READPREV/ENDBR, SEND/RECEIVE, XCTL, RETURN.

##### Migration notes
- Lists all transactions in key order — not filtered by the signed-on user's account/card.
- Same key-based paging algorithm as COUSR00C (USRSEC) — shared pattern, only the file/key length differ.
- Only 'S' selection is supported; invalid selection still lists.
- Start key must be numeric but is used as X(16) (left-justified; '123' starts at '123' + spaces).
recommendation: Fully documented; no unresolved behaviour.
note: Duplicate of sfind-9c73dddc77ed4e55904ad2813f757eb6 (COTRN00C transaction list (TRANSID CT00)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CARDDEMO CSD resources and CBADMCDJ DFHCSDUP install job
description:
##### Entry point
CICS System Definition resources for group `CARDDEMO`: app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD (DFHCSDUP-format DEFINE statements extracted from a live CSD) and the install job `CBADMCDJ` (app/jcl/CBADMCDJ.jcl: `STEP1 EXEC PGM=DFHCSDUP,PARM='CSD(READWRITE),PAGESIZE(60),NOCOMPAT'`, STEPLIB OEM.CICSTS.V05R06M0.CICS.SDFHLOAD, DFHCSD OEM.CICSTS.DFHCSD, SYSIN inline with `SET HLQ=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO`). This is the routing table for every online flow.

##### Inputs
DEFINE statements (no runtime input).

##### Processing flow
CARDDEMO.CSD defines:
- FILEs (all RECORDFORMAT(V), ADD/BROWSE/DELETE/READ/UPDATE YES, STRINGS(1), LSRPOOL 1, OPENTIME FIRSTREF, RECOVERY NONE, READINTEG UNCOMMITTED): ACCTDAT -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS; CARDAIX -> CARDDATA.VSAM.AIX.PATH; CARDDAT -> CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS; CCXREF -> CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS; CUSTDAT -> CUSTDATA.VSAM.KSDS; CXACAIX -> CARDXREF.VSAM.AIX.PATH; TRANSACT -> TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS; USRSEC -> USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS.
- MAPSETs: COACTUP, COACTVW, COADM01, COBIL00, COCRDLI, COCRDSL, COCRDUP, COMEN01, CORPT00, COSGN00, COTRN00, COTRN01, COTRN02, COUSR00, COUSR01, COUSR02, COUSR03.
- PROGRAMs: COACTUPC, COACTVWC, COADM01C, COBIL00C, COCRDLIC, COCRDSEC, COCRDSLC, COCRDUPC, COMEN01C, CORPT00C, COSGN00C, COTRN00C, COTRN01C, COTRN02C, COUSR00C, COUSR01C, COUSR02C, COUSR03C.
- TRANSACTIONs -> PROGRAM: CAUP COACTUPC, CAVW COACTVWC, CA00 COADM01C, CB00 COBIL00C, CCDL COCRDSLC, CCLI COCRDLIC, CCUP COCRDUPC, CC00 COSGN00C, CDV1 COCRDSEC, CM00 COMEN01C, CR00 CORPT00C, CT00 COTRN00C, CT01 COTRN01C, CT02 COTRN02C, CU00 COUSR00C, CU01 COUSR01C, CU02 COUSR02C, CU03 COUSR03C (PROFILE DFHCICST, TWASIZE 0, ENABLED).
- LIBRARY CARDDLIB DSNAME01 AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB.
CBADMCDJ (older v1.0 definition set) defines LIBRARY COM2DOLL (&HLQ..LOADLIB), mapsets COSGN00M, COACT00S, COACTVWS, COACTUPS, COACTDES, COTRN00S, COTRNVWS, COTRNVDS, COTRNATS, COBIL00S, COADM00S, COTSTP1S-4S (several duplicated), programs COSGN00C (TRANSID CC00), COACT00C, COACTVWC, COACTUPC, COACTDEC, COTRN00C, COTRNVWC, COTRNVDC, COTRNATC, COBIL00C, COADM00C (CCAD), COTSTP1C-4C (CCT1-CCT4), transactions CCDM->COADM00C, CCT1-CCT4->COTSTP1C-4C, then LIST GROUP(CARDDEMO).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J[CBADMCDJ STEP1 DFHCSDUP] --> G[GROUP CARDDEMO in OEM.CICSTS.DFHCSD]
  CSD[CARDDEMO.CSD] --> G
  G --> T1[CC00 -> COSGN00C]
  G --> T2[CM00 -> COMEN01C]
  G --> T3[CA00 -> COADM01C]
  T2 --> T4[CAVW CAUP CCLI CCDL CCUP CT00 CT01 CT02 CR00 CB00]
  T3 --> T5[CU00 CU01 CU02 CU03]
  G --> F[FILEs ACCTDAT CARDDAT CARDAIX CCXREF CXACAIX CUSTDAT TRANSACT USRSEC]
```

##### Data
FILE -> DSN mapping above (logical CICS names used in EXEC CICS READ/WRITE DATASET/FILE).

##### Outputs & side effects
CSD group CARDDEMO created/updated (CBADMCDJ). No application data touched.

##### External calls
IBM DFHCSDUP utility.

##### Migration notes
- CBADMCDJ is out of date relative to the code: it references programs/mapsets that do not exist in app/cbl (COACT00C, COACTDEC, COTRNVWC, COTRNVDC, COTRNATC, COADM00C, COTSTP*), lacks the FILE definitions and most current transactions (CM00, CAVW, CT00...), and duplicates DEFINEs. CARDDEMO.CSD is the authoritative current mapping.
- Transaction CDV1 -> COCRDSEC and program COCRDSEC are defined but COCRDSEC source is not in this batch (not verified).
- Programs reference files by logical name (8 chars, trailing space e.g. 'ACCTDAT ').
- AIX paths (CARDAIX by account on card file, CXACAIX by account on xref) are separate FILE resources; RECOVERY(NONE) means CICS backout of VSAM updates is not logged — SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK in COACTUPC therefore cannot undo the ACCTDAT rewrite unless recovery is enabled.
recommendation: COCRDSEC (CDV1) source not traced in this batch.
note:
Consolidated document for app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD; merged duplicates: sfind-ce4442182d92432a8ece75353c9f2a8b, sfind-2f22d08f99994543a1a957b982b2fb32, sfind-883d19d89b344932ab098ed096b22623.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- Security checks are disabled at resource level (RESSEC/CMDSEC NO); authorisation relies on program navigation.
- No transaction for COPAUS0C/COTRTLIC/COTRTUPC in this group (optional modules) - explains INQUIRE/PGMIDERR handling in menus.
- `READINTEG(UNCOMMITTED)` + `UPDATEMODEL(LOCKING)`: reads see uncommitted data; record locks are held until syncpoint.
