title: CAVW / COACTVWC account and customer view
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CAVW` -> program `COACTVWC` (Account View), menu option 1 of COMEN01C (CSD: TRANSACTION(CAVW) PROGRAM(COACTVWC) group CARDDEMO). Pseudo-conversational `RETURN TRANSID('CAVW') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA + WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA)`.

##### Inputs
- COMMAREA: CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (COCOM01Y) followed by program-private WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA. Reset (INITIALIZE) when EIBCALEN=0 or when coming from COMEN01C on first entry.
- Map `CACTVWA` / mapset `COACTVW`: ACCTSIDI (11-digit account ID; '*' treated as blank). EIBAID: ENTER, PF3 valid; any other key is treated as ENTER.

##### Processing flow
1. HANDLE ABEND -> ABEND-ROUTINE. Load/initialise COMMAREA; YYYY-STORE-PFKEY maps EIBAID to CCARD-AID-*.
2. PF3: TO-TRANID/TO-PROGRAM = FROM values or CM00/COMEN01C; FROM = CAVW/COACTVWC; USER-TYPE forced 'U'; PGM-CONTEXT = ENTER; LAST-MAPSET/MAP set; XCTL with COMMAREA.
3. CDEMO-PGM-ENTER: 1000-SEND-MAP (prompt for account).
4. CDEMO-PGM-REENTER: 2000-PROCESS-INPUTS (RECEIVE MAP, 2200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS -> 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT: blank -> prompt 'enter account'; not numeric / zero -> error 'Account Filter must be a non-zero 11 digit number'; else valid). Error -> resend; OK -> 9000-READ-ACCT then send.
5. Other context -> ABEND-ROUTINE code '0001' 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO'.
6. 9000-READ-ACCT: 9200-GETCARDXREF-BYACCT `READ DATASET('CXACAIX') RIDFLD(account)` -> sets CDEMO-CUST-ID, CDEMO-CARD-NUM (NOTFND: 'Account: <id> not found in Cross ref file. Resp: Reas:'); 9300-GETACCTDATA-BYACCT `READ 'ACCTDAT'` (NOTFND -> not found in Acct Master file); 9400-GETCUSTDATA-BYCUST `READ 'CUSTDAT' RIDFLD(CDEMO-CUST-ID)`. Each subsequent read only if prior succeeded. Other RESP -> 'File Error: READ on <file> returned RESP .. RESP2 ..'.
7. 1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS: if account found: status, current balance, credit limit, cash credit limit, cycle credit, cycle debit, open/expiry/reissue dates, group ID; if customer found: cust ID, SSN formatted `NNN-NN-NNNN`, FICO, DOB, first/middle/last name, address lines 1-2, line 3 shown as City, state, zip, country, phones 1/2, govt ID, EFT account, primary holder flag.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CAVW COACTVWC 0000-MAIN] -->|PF3| X[XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C]
  A -->|PGM-ENTER| S[1000-SEND-MAP CACTVWA]
  A -->|PGM-REENTER| P[2000-PROCESS-INPUTS 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT]
  P -->|INPUT-ERROR| S
  P --> R[9000-READ-ACCT]
  R --> R1[9200 READ CXACAIX]
  R1 --> R2[9300 READ ACCTDAT]
  R2 --> R3[9400 READ CUSTDAT]
  R3 --> S
  A -->|other| AB[ABEND-ROUTINE 0001]
  S --> RT[COMMON-RETURN RETURN TRANSID CAVW]
```

##### Data
CXACAIX (AIX path AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDXREF.VSAM.AIX.PATH, CVACT03Y), ACCTDAT (ACCTDATA KSDS, CVACT01Y), CUSTDAT (CUSTDATA KSDS, CVCUS01Y). Read only (no UPDATE).

##### Outputs & side effects
Account + customer detail screen; COMMAREA updated with CUST-ID, CARD-NUM. No writes.

##### External calls
CICS READ, SEND/RECEIVE MAP, XCTL, RETURN, HANDLE ABEND, ABEND (ABEND-ROUTINE sends abend text then `EXEC CICS ABEND`).

##### Migration notes
- Account lookup goes through the xref AIX first: an account with no cards cannot be viewed even if ACCTDAT has it.
- Only the first xref record for the account (AIX non-unique) supplies CUST-ID/CARD-NUM.
- Unrecognised PF keys behave as ENTER.
- PF3 forces CDEMO-USER-TYPE to 'U' — admin context is lost.
- SSN displayed unmasked; CYC-CREDIT also shown.
recommendation: Fully documented; no unresolved behaviour.
note: Duplicate of sfind-b0983abae79e4701b269db3b26b17d18 (COACTVWC account view (TRANSID CAVW)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CU00 / COUSR00C user list with paging and selection
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CU00` -> program `COUSR00C` (admin "List Users"), XCTL'd from admin menu COADM01C; pseudo-conversational via RETURN TRANSID('CU00') COMMAREA.

##### Inputs
- COMMAREA: COCOM01Y + CDEMO-CU00-INFO (USRID-FIRST X8, USRID-LAST X8, PAGE-NUM 9(8), NEXT-PAGE-FLG X1, USR-SEL-FLG X1, USR-SELECTED X8).
- Map `COUSR0A`/mapset `COUSR00`: USRIDINI (start user ID filter), SEL0001I..SEL0010I selection codes, USRID01I..10I displayed IDs; EIBAID (ENTER, PF3, PF7, PF8).

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C.
2. First entry: set re-enter, PROCESS-ENTER-KEY (lists from beginning), SEND.
3. Re-entry RECEIVE, EIBAID: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL COADM01C; PF7 -> PROCESS-PF7-KEY; PF8 -> PROCESS-PF8-KEY; other -> invalid-key message.
4. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: first non-blank SELnnnn (1..10 in order) gives flag+user ID. 'U'/'u' -> XCTL COUSR02C (update); 'D'/'d' -> XCTL COUSR03C (delete); other -> 'Invalid selection. Valid values are U and D' (continues). Then SEC-USR-ID = USRIDINI or LOW-VALUES, PAGE-NUM=0, PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD.
5. PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD: STARTBR USRSEC at SEC-USR-ID (GTEQ default) — NOTFND -> 'You are at the top of the page...'; other -> 'Unable to lookup User...'. If key is not ENTER/PF7/PF3, READNEXT once to skip the current last row. Clear 10 rows, READNEXT up to 10 rows (POPULATE-USER-DATA: row1 ID saved as USRID-FIRST, row10 as USRID-LAST). If not EOF: PAGE-NUM+1, READNEXT lookahead -> NEXT-PAGE yes/no; else NEXT-PAGE no and PAGE-NUM+1 only if at least one row. ENDBR; send.
6. PF7: start key = USRID-FIRST (or LOW-VALUES); if PAGE-NUM > 1 PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD else 'You are already at the top of the page...'. Backward: STARTBR, READPREV once (skip current first) unless ENTER/PF8, fill rows 10 down to 1 with READPREV, lookahead READPREV; if NEXT-PAGE-YES and more and PAGE-NUM>1 then PAGE-NUM-1 else PAGE-NUM=1.
7. PF8: start key = USRID-LAST (or HIGH-VALUES); if NEXT-PAGE-YES forward else 'You are already at the bottom of the page...'.
8. ENDFILE on READNEXT/READPREV -> EOF + 'You have reached the bottom/top of the page...'.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CU00 COUSR00C] -->|EIBCALEN=0| S[XCTL COSGN00C]
  A -->|first| E[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY]
  A -->|re-enter| R[RECEIVE COUSR0A]
  R -->|ENTER| E
  R -->|PF3| ADM[XCTL COADM01C]
  R -->|PF7| B[PROCESS-PF7-KEY -> PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD]
  R -->|PF8| F[PROCESS-PF8-KEY -> PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD]
  E -->|sel U| U2[XCTL COUSR02C]
  E -->|sel D| U3[XCTL COUSR03C]
  E --> F
  F --> BR[STARTBR/READNEXT/ENDBR USRSEC]
  B --> BP[STARTBR/READPREV/ENDBR USRSEC]
  BR --> SND[SEND-USRLST-SCREEN]
  BP --> SND
  SND --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CU00]
```

##### Data
CICS file `USRSEC` (browse only). Record SEC-USER-DATA (CSUSR01Y, 80 bytes): SEC-USR-ID X8 (key), FNAME X20, LNAME X20, PWD X8, TYPE X1, FILLER X23.

##### Outputs & side effects
List screen (10 users/page: ID, first, last, type); page number; navigation to COUSR02C/COUSR03C with CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED in COMMAREA. No updates.

##### External calls
CICS STARTBR/READNEXT/READPREV/ENDBR, SEND/RECEIVE MAP, XCTL, RETURN.

##### Migration notes
- Selection is the first non-blank SEL field only; others ignored. Invalid selection still re-lists from USRIDINI.
- Paging is key-based (first/last key in COMMAREA), not offset-based; page number is cosmetic and can drift.
- Lookahead read determines NEXT-PAGE; PF8 at end shows message without erase (SEND-ERASE-NO).
- Messages sent mid-browse may cause multiple SENDs in one task.
recommendation: Fully documented; no unresolved behaviour.
note: Duplicate of sfind-8e188dda1ba3423ea06ff2c7951bbc5a (CU00 / COUSR00C user list screen with paging); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CT02 / COTRN02C online transaction add
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CT02` -> program `COTRN02C` (online "Transaction Add"), menu option 8 of COMEN01C; pseudo-conversational RETURN TRANSID('CT02') COMMAREA.

##### Inputs
- COMMAREA COCOM01Y + CDEMO-CT02-INFO (TRNID-FIRST X16, TRNID-LAST X16, PAGE-NUM 9(8), NEXT-PAGE-FLG X1, TRN-SEL-FLG X1, TRN-SELECTED X16). On first entry a non-blank TRN-SELECTED is placed into the card-number field and processed.
- Map `COTRN2A`/mapset `COTRN02`: ACTIDINI (acct 11), CARDNINI (card 16), TTYPCDI (type 2), TCATCDI (cat 4), TRNSRCI (source 10), TDESCI (desc), TRNAMTI (amount 12 chars `-99999999.99`), TORIGDTI/TPROCDTI (YYYY-MM-DD), MIDI (merchant id 9), MNAMEI, MCITYI, MZIPI, CONFIRMI; EIBAID ENTER/PF3/PF4/PF5.

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C. Re-entry keys: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C; PF4 -> clear; PF5 -> COPY-LAST-TRAN-DATA; other -> invalid key.
2. VALIDATE-INPUT-KEY-FIELDS: account entered -> must be numeric ('Account ID must be Numeric...'), NUMVAL, READ CXACAIX by XREF-ACCT-ID (NOTFND 'Account ID NOT found...'), fill card number. Else card entered -> numeric check, READ CCXREF by card (NOTFND 'Card Number NOT found...'), fill account. Neither -> 'Account or Card Number must be entered...'.
3. VALIDATE-INPUT-DATA-FIELDS (first failing check wins): all fields non-empty in order Type, Category, Source, Description, Amount, Orig Date, Proc Date, Merchant ID, Name, City, Zip; type & category numeric; amount format: pos1 '+'/'-', pos2-9 digits, pos10 '.', pos11-12 digits; both dates format YYYY-MM-DD; amount normalised via NUMVAL-C and re-edited (+99999999.99); CALL CSUTLDTC for each date (severity '0000' ok; otherwise error unless message number '2513'); merchant ID numeric.
4. CONFIRMI: 'Y'/'y' -> ADD-TRANSACTION; 'N'/'n'/blank -> 'Confirm to add this transaction...'; other -> 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...'.
5. ADD-TRANSACTION: STARTBR TRANSACT at HIGH-VALUES, READPREV (ENDFILE -> 0), ENDBR, TRAN-ID = last + 1; map screen fields to TRAN-RECORD (amount NUMVAL-C; ORIG-TS/PROC-TS = the 10-char dates, rest of the 26 bytes spaces); WRITE TRANSACT: NORMAL -> clear + green 'Transaction added successfully.  Your Tran ID is <id>.'; DUPKEY/DUPREC -> 'Tran ID already exist...'; other -> 'Unable to Add Transaction...'.
6. COPY-LAST-TRAN-DATA (PF5): validate key fields, read last transaction (highest ID) and copy its type/cat/source/amount/desc/dates/merchant into the screen, then PROCESS-ENTER-KEY.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CT02 COTRN02C] -->|EIBCALEN=0| S[XCTL COSGN00C]
  A --> R[RECEIVE COTRN2A]
  R -->|PF3| B[XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C]
  R -->|PF5| C[COPY-LAST-TRAN-DATA]
  R -->|ENTER| P[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY]
  C --> P
  P --> K[VALIDATE-INPUT-KEY-FIELDS CXACAIX or CCXREF]
  K --> D[VALIDATE-INPUT-DATA-FIELDS + CALL CSUTLDTC]
  D -->|CONFIRM Y| ADD[ADD-TRANSACTION STARTBR/READPREV/ENDBR]
  ADD --> W[WRITE TRANSACT]
  K & D & W --> SND[SEND-TRNADD-SCREEN + RETURN TRANSID CT02]
```

##### Data
CCXREF (CVACT03Y key card X16) READ; CXACAIX (AIX by account) READ; TRANSACT (CVTRA05Y 350, key X16) browse + WRITE.

##### Outputs & side effects
New transaction record. **No account balance, cycle totals or category balance update** — those happen only if the transaction is later posted by batch (it is not: CBTRN02C posts from DALYTRAN, not TRANSACT).

##### External calls
- `CSUTLDTC` USING CSUTLDTC-DATE X(10), CSUTLDTC-DATE-FORMAT X(10) = 'YYYY-MM-DD', CSUTLDTC-RESULT X(80) (SEV-CD X4, filler 11, MSG-NUM X4, MSG X61). CSUTLDTC calls LE `CEEDAYS` with the date/picture and returns severity and message number of the feedback code (and sets RETURN-CODE to severity).
- CICS READ/STARTBR/READPREV/ENDBR/WRITE/SEND/RECEIVE/XCTL/RETURN.

##### Migration notes
- SEND-TRNADD-SCREEN issues `EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(CT02)` immediately after SEND, so the **first error message ends the task** — validations are effectively short-circuit.
- CEEDAYS message 2513 is tolerated (treated as valid); exact semantics depend on LE (unresolved locally — LE service).
- Amount must be exactly sign+8 digits+'.'+2 digits.
- TRAN-ID = max+1 without serialization (race -> DUPREC).
- Account input wins over card input when both entered.
- Timestamps stored as dates only (no time part).
recommendation: CEEDAYS message 2513 semantics are an LE service behaviour not in source.
note: Duplicate of sfind-aa2005c873cb4a6eb4ea75db4a51161a (COTRN02C add transaction (TRANSID CT02)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: COMBTRAN merge backup + system transactions and reload TRANSACT KSDS
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `COMBTRAN` (app/jcl/COMBTRAN.jcl). Steps: `STEP05R EXEC PGM=SORT`, then `STEP10 EXEC PGM=IDCAMS` (no COND). No COBOL program.

##### Inputs
SORTIN concatenation: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.BKUP(0) (backup produced by TRANREPT REPROC step) and AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.SYSTRAN(0) (system-generated transactions; SYSTRAN is also referenced by INTCALC.jcl/DEFGDGB.jcl). Records are 350-byte CVTRA05Y transactions; SYMNAMES defines TRAN-ID,1,16,CH.

##### Processing flow
1. STEP05R: `SORT FIELDS=(TRAN-ID,A)` merges both inputs -> SORTOUT AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.COMBINED(+1) (new GDG generation, DCB copied from input).
2. STEP10: IDCAMS `REPRO INFILE(TRANSACT) OUTFILE(TRANVSAM)` copies the combined file into AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[COMBTRAN STEP05R SORT] -->|TRANSACT.BKUP 0 + SYSTRAN 0| B[SORT FIELDS=TRAN-ID,A]
  B --> C[TRANSACT.COMBINED +1]
  C --> D[STEP10 IDCAMS REPRO]
  D --> E[TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS]
```

##### Data
Writes TRANSACT.COMBINED GDG and loads TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS (key TRAN-ID X16).

##### Outputs & side effects
Transaction master reloaded with backup + system (interest/fee) transactions.

##### External calls
DFSORT, IDCAMS.

##### Migration notes
- REPRO without REPLACE into a non-empty KSDS rejects duplicate keys (IDCAMS RC 8 after errors); the job assumes the cluster was emptied/redefined beforehand (by the operator sequence), otherwise records already present are not replaced.
- Duplicate TRAN-IDs between backup and SYSTRAN: SORT keeps both; REPRO rejects the second.
- STEP10 has no COND, runs even if SORT fails.
- Relative GDG (0) means "latest generation at job start".
recommendation: Fully documented; no unresolved behaviour.
note:
End-to-end: COMBTRAN is submitted after INTCALC+TRANBKP by run_interest_calc.sh/run_full_batch.sh and the Control-M MONTHLY folder; merges the TRANBKP backup with INTCALC system transactions into TRANSACT. Upstream findings: sfind-b70e9c924f394cb2a5965f7bce2166ce, sfind-574c7fefe140460688d7131108eb4d55, sfind-c0001c8086c54798b228ce1ea65e05ab.

title: CCDL / COCRDSLC credit card detail view
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CCDL` -> program `COCRDSLC` (Credit Card View/Detail), menu option 4 and from card list `COCRDLIC` (CCLI). CSD TRANSACTION(CCDL) PROGRAM(COCRDSLC). Pseudo-conversational RETURN TRANSID('CCDL').

##### Inputs
- COMMAREA COCOM01Y + WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA (reset when EIBCALEN=0 or first entry from COMEN01C). From COCRDLIC: CDEMO-ACCT-ID and CDEMO-CARD-NUM pre-validated.
- Map `CCRDSLA` / mapset `COCRDSL`: ACCTSIDI (11), CARDSIDI (16) ('*' = blank). Keys ENTER, PF3 (others -> ENTER).

##### Processing flow
1. PF3 -> XCTL to FROM-PROGRAM (or COMEN01C/CM00) with USER-TYPE 'U', PGM-ENTER, LAST-MAPSET/MAP.
2. PGM-ENTER and FROM-PROGRAM = COCRDLIC: move COMMAREA acct/card into CC fields, 9000-READ-DATA, send, return.
3. PGM-ENTER from elsewhere: send blank prompt screen.
4. PGM-REENTER: RECEIVE; 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT (blank -> prompt, CDEMO-ACCT-ID=0; non-numeric -> 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER'), 2220-EDIT-CARD (blank -> prompt; non-numeric -> 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER'); both blank -> 'No input received'. Error -> resend; else 9000-READ-DATA, send.
5. 9000-READ-DATA -> 9100-GETCARD-BYACCTCARD: `READ FILE('CARDDAT') RIDFLD(card number 16)` — NORMAL -> FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT; NOTFND -> 'Did not find cards for this search condition'; other -> file error message.
6. Screen: embossed name, expiry month/year (from CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE), active status; if last mapset was COCRDLI the input fields are protected.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CCDL COCRDSLC 0000-MAIN] -->|PF3| X[XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C]
  A -->|ENTER from COCRDLIC| D[9000-READ-DATA]
  A -->|ENTER other| S[1000-SEND-MAP CCRDSLA]
  A -->|REENTER| P[2000-PROCESS-INPUTS 2210/2220 edits]
  P -->|error| S
  P --> D
  D --> C[9100-GETCARD-BYACCTCARD READ CARDDAT]
  C --> S
  S --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CCDL]
```

##### Data
CARDDAT (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS, CVACT02Y 150 bytes: CARD-NUM X16 key, ACCT-ID 9(11), CVV 9(3), EMBOSSED-NAME X50, EXPIRAION-DATE X10, ACTIVE-STATUS X1). Read only.

##### Outputs & side effects
Card detail screen. No updates.

##### External calls
CICS READ, SEND/RECEIVE, XCTL, RETURN, HANDLE ABEND/ABEND.

##### Migration notes
- The account number is validated but **not used in the lookup**: the card is read by card number alone and the record's ACCT-ID is not compared to the entered account (the 'acct/card combo' message only reflects card-not-found).
- 9150-GETCARD-BYACCT (READ CARDAIX by account) exists but is never PERFORMed — dead code.
- CVV is read but not displayed.
recommendation: Fully documented; no unresolved behaviour.
note: Duplicate of sfind-a56ee17531cc493a816895b68b225949 (CCDL / COCRDSLC); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: TRANREPT / CBTRN03C transaction detail report
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `TRANREPT` (app/jcl/TRANREPT.jcl; PROC variant app/proc/TRANREPT.prc). Steps in order: `STEP05R EXEC PROC=REPROC` (IDCAMS REPRO backup of AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS -> TRANSACT.BKUP(+1)), `STEP05R EXEC PGM=SORT` (SORT FIELDS=(TRAN-CARD-NUM,A), INCLUDE TRAN-PROC-DT between hard-coded symbols PARM-START-DATE '2022-01-01' and PARM-END-DATE '2022-07-06' -> TRANSACT.DALY(+1)), `STEP10R EXEC PGM=CBTRN03C` (no PARM). Program `CBTRN03C` (batch, no LINKAGE).

##### Inputs
- `TRANFILE` -> TRANSACT.DALY(+1), sequential 350-byte TRAN-RECORD (CVTRA05Y: TRAN-ID X16, TYPE-CD X2, CAT-CD 9(4), SOURCE X10, DESC X100, AMT S9(9)V99, MERCHANT-ID 9(9), NAME X50, CITY X50, ZIP X10, CARD-NUM X16, ORIG-TS X26, PROC-TS X26, FILLER X20), sorted by card number.
- `CARDXREF` -> CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS (INDEXED RANDOM, key X16; CVACT03Y).
- `TRANTYPE` -> TRANTYPE.VSAM.KSDS (key TRAN-TYPE X2; CVTRA03Y: TRAN-TYPE X2, TRAN-TYPE-DESC X50, FILLER X8).
- `TRANCATG` -> TRANCATG.VSAM.KSDS (key = TYPE-CD X2 + CAT-CD 9(4); CVTRA04Y: key, TRAN-CAT-TYPE-DESC X50, FILLER X4).
- `DATEPARM` -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DATEPARM: one 80-byte record: WS-START-DATE X(10), FILLER X(1), WS-END-DATE X(10).

##### Processing flow
1. Open TRANFILE, REPTFILE (OUTPUT), CARDXREF, TRANTYPE, TRANCATG, DATEPARM; non-'00' -> 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM.
2. 0550-DATEPARM-READ: '00' -> DISPLAY 'Reporting from <start> to <end>'; '10' -> END-OF-FILE='Y' (report ends immediately); other -> abend.
3. Loop while END-OF-FILE='N': 1000-TRANFILE-GET-NEXT ('10' sets EOF; other errors abend).
4. Date filter: if TRAN-PROC-TS(1:10) between start and end inclusive CONTINUE, else `NEXT SENTENCE` (see notes).
5. Not EOF: DISPLAY TRAN-RECORD; if card changed: if not first time 1120-WRITE-ACCOUNT-TOTALS; save card, 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF (READ, INVALID KEY -> 'INVALID CARD NUMBER : ' + abend code 23). Then 1500-B-LOOKUP-TRANTYPE (INVALID KEY -> 'INVALID TRANSACTION TYPE' abend) and 1500-C-LOOKUP-TRANCATG (INVALID KEY -> 'INVALID TRAN CATG KEY' abend). 1100-WRITE-TRANSACTION-REPORT:
   - first time: WS-FIRST-TIME='N', start/end dates into header, 1120-WRITE-HEADERS (REPORT-NAME-HEADER, blank, TRANSACTION-HEADER-1, TRANSACTION-HEADER-2 dashes; +4 lines).
   - if MOD(WS-LINE-COUNTER, 20)=0: 1110-WRITE-PAGE-TOTALS then 1120-WRITE-HEADERS.
   - ADD TRAN-AMT to WS-PAGE-TOTAL and WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL; 1120-WRITE-DETAIL (trans id, XREF-ACCT-ID, type cd/desc, cat cd/desc, source, amount); +1 line.
6. EOF branch: ADD TRAN-AMT (still the last record's amount) to page & account totals, 1110-WRITE-PAGE-TOTALS (page total line, add page total into grand total, reset, dash line), 1110-WRITE-GRAND-TOTALS.
7. Close all files; GOBACK.
1110-WRITE-PAGE-TOTALS / 1120-WRITE-ACCOUNT-TOTALS each write a total line + dash line, +2 lines. Account totals reset WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[TRANREPT STEP05R REPROC backup] --> B[STEP05R SORT by TRAN-CARD-NUM, INCLUDE date range]
  B --> C[STEP10R CBTRN03C]
  C --> D[Open files; 0550-DATEPARM-READ]
  D --> E[1000-TRANFILE-GET-NEXT]
  E --> F{PROC-TS 1:10 in range}
  F -->|no| NS[NEXT SENTENCE: exits PERFORM loop]
  F -->|yes| G{EOF}
  G -->|no| H{card changed}
  H -->|yes| I[1120-WRITE-ACCOUNT-TOTALS if not first; 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF]
  H -->|no| J[1500-B-LOOKUP-TRANTYPE; 1500-C-LOOKUP-TRANCATG]
  I --> J
  J --> K[1100-WRITE-TRANSACTION-REPORT headers/page break/detail]
  K --> E
  G -->|yes| L[add last TRAN-AMT; 1110-WRITE-PAGE-TOTALS; 1110-WRITE-GRAND-TOTALS]
  L --> M[Close files]
  NS --> M
  J -->|INVALID KEY| Z[9999-ABEND-PROGRAM]
```

##### Data
Report REPTFILE `TRANREPT` -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANREPT(+1), 133-byte lines (CVTRA07Y). Detail line: TRANS-ID X16, sp, ACCOUNT-ID X11, sp, TYPE-CD X2, '-', TYPE-DESC X15 (truncated from X50), sp, CAT-CD 9(4), '-', CAT-DESC X29 (truncated from X50), sp, SOURCE X10, 4 sp, AMT -ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.ZZ, 2 sp. Totals lines: label + dots + `+ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.ZZ` (page X11 label/86 dots, account X13/84, grand X11/86). Header: short name X38, long name X41, 'Date Range: ' style header X12 + start ' to ' end. Accumulators WS-PAGE-TOTAL/ACCOUNT-TOTAL/GRAND-TOTAL signed S9(9)V99 display.

##### Outputs & side effects
New report GDG generation; VSAM backup GDG and filtered daily GDG created by earlier steps; DISPLAY of every transaction record to SYSOUT.

##### External calls
`CEE3ABD` (ABCODE 999, TIMING 0). JCL: `REPROC` proc (IDCAMS REPRO), DFSORT.

##### Migration notes
- `NEXT SENTENCE` inside the inline PERFORM jumps past the period after END-PERFORM, so the **first out-of-range record terminates the whole report** (no totals written). Only safe because the SORT step pre-filters; DATEPARM and the SORT symbols must agree or output is truncated.
- At EOF the last transaction amount is added a **second time** to page/account (and therefore grand) totals.
- Final account total is never written at EOF (only page + grand totals).
- "Account" totals break on card-number change, not account ID.
- Page break test MOD(line counter,20)=0 counts header/total lines; page totals also roll into grand total — grand total = sum of page totals.
- Description fields are truncated to 15/29 characters on the report.
- Date range in the JCL is hard-coded (2022-01-01..2022-07-06).
recommendation: Fully documented; no unresolved behaviour.
note: Duplicate of sfind-14d5b15e18b04d8c913cae17e3df6dce (TRANREPT batch job); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CB00 / COBIL00C online bill payment (writes transaction, zeroes balance)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CB00` -> program `COBIL00C` (online bill payment), menu option 10 of COMEN01C; pseudo-conversational RETURN TRANSID('CB00') COMMAREA.

##### Inputs
- COMMAREA COCOM01Y + CDEMO-CB00-INFO (TRNID-FIRST X16, TRNID-LAST X16, PAGE-NUM 9(8), NEXT-PAGE-FLG X1, TRN-SEL-FLG X1, TRN-SELECTED X16). If TRN-SELECTED is set on first entry it is used as the account ID.
- Map `COBIL0A`/mapset `COBIL00`: ACTIDINI (account ID, 11), CONFIRMI (Y/N), output CURBALI; EIBAID ENTER/PF3/PF4.

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C. First entry -> optional PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, SEND. Re-entry: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C; PF4 -> clear; other -> invalid key.
2. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: blank account -> 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...'. ACCT-ID and XREF-ACCT-ID = input. CONFIRMI: 'Y'/'y' -> confirm + READ-ACCTDAT-FILE; 'N'/'n' -> clear screen + error flag (no message); blank -> READ-ACCTDAT-FILE (display only); other -> 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...'.
3. Show ACCT-CURR-BAL (edited +9999999999.99). If balance <= 0 -> 'You have nothing to pay...'.
4. If no error and confirmed: READ-CXACAIX-FILE (CXACAIX alternate index by XREF-ACCT-ID -> card number); STARTBR TRANSACT at HIGH-VALUES, READPREV (ENDFILE -> TRAN-ID = 0), ENDBR; new TRAN-ID = last ID + 1 (numeric 16 digits). Build TRAN-RECORD: TYPE '02', CAT 2, SOURCE 'POS TERM', DESC 'BILL PAYMENT - ONLINE', AMT = full ACCT-CURR-BAL, CARD-NUM = XREF-CARD-NUM, MERCHANT-ID 999999999, NAME 'BILL PAYMENT', CITY 'N/A', ZIP 'N/A', ORIG-TS = PROC-TS = ASKTIME/FORMATTIME 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' + zero micro part. WRITE TRANSACT (NORMAL -> green 'Payment successful.  Your Transaction ID is <id>.'; DUPKEY/DUPREC -> 'Tran ID already exist...'; other -> 'Unable to Add Bill pay Transaction...'). Then ACCT-CURR-BAL = ACCT-CURR-BAL - TRAN-AMT (i.e. 0) and REWRITE ACCTDAT (NOTFND/other -> messages).
5. Not confirmed -> 'Confirm to make a bill payment...'. SEND screen.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CB00 COBIL00C] -->|EIBCALEN=0| S[XCTL COSGN00C]
  A --> R[RECEIVE COBIL0A]
  R -->|PF3| B[XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C]
  R -->|ENTER| P[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY]
  P --> RA[READ ACCTDAT UPDATE]
  RA -->|bal<=0| M[SEND msg]
  RA -->|CONFIRM=Y| X[READ CXACAIX by acct]
  X --> T[STARTBR/READPREV/ENDBR TRANSACT HIGH-VALUES]
  T --> W[WRITE TRANSACT id=last+1]
  W --> U[REWRITE ACCTDAT bal=bal-amt]
  U --> M
  RA -->|not confirmed| M
  M --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CB00]
```

##### Data
- ACCTDAT (CVACT01Y 300 bytes, key ACCT-ID 9(11)): READ UPDATE, REWRITE.
- CXACAIX (CVACT03Y via AIX on account ID): READ.
- TRANSACT (CVTRA05Y 350 bytes, key TRAN-ID X16): browse backwards, WRITE.

##### Outputs & side effects
New payment transaction; account current balance set to zero. Cycle credit/debit are **not** updated (unlike batch posting CBTRN02C). Category balance (TCATBAL) not updated.

##### External calls
CICS READ/REWRITE/WRITE/STARTBR/READPREV/ENDBR, ASKTIME/FORMATTIME, SEND/RECEIVE, XCTL, RETURN.

##### Migration notes
- Always pays the full balance; no partial amount entry. Amount stored is positive (type 02 payment) while balance is reduced.
- Transaction ID generation = max existing key + 1 without locking: concurrent payments can collide (DUPREC path).
- Write and rewrite are not atomic in program logic (relies on CICS UOW at task end; if REWRITE fails after WRITE, message only — the WRITE is still committed at RETURN unless the task abends).
- 'N' confirm clears screen silently.
- Error messages from READ paragraphs may SEND multiple times per task.
- ACTIDINI not checked for numeric before READ.
recommendation: Fully documented; no unresolved behaviour.
note: Duplicate of sfind-5a9fd71c03ca476780cf6a7998c54416 (COBIL00C online bill payment (TRANSID CB00)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CBTRN01C daily transaction verification (read-only, unscheduled)
description:
##### Entry point
Program `CBTRN01C` (batch, PROCEDURE DIVISION without USING). **No JCL, PROC or scheduler member in the repo executes it** (grep for CBTRN01C finds only the source itself), so its runtime DD bindings are not defined in the repo. DD names expected: DALYTRAN, CUSTFILE, XREFFILE, CARDFILE, ACCTFILE, TRANFILE.

##### Inputs
- DALYTRAN (sequential, 350 bytes) read INTO DALYTRAN-RECORD (CVTRA06Y; see layout: ID X16, TYPE X2, CAT 9(4), SOURCE X10, DESC X100, AMT S9(9)V99, MERCH-ID 9(9), NAME X50, CITY X50, ZIP X10, CARD-NUM X16, ORIG-TS X26, PROC-TS X26, FILLER X20).
- XREFFILE (KSDS random, key X(16)) INTO CARD-XREF-RECORD (CVACT03Y). ACCTFILE (KSDS random, key 9(11)) INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD (CVACT01Y).
- CUSTFILE (key 9(9), 500 bytes), CARDFILE (key X16, 150 bytes), TRANFILE (key X16, 350 bytes): opened INPUT but never read.

##### Processing flow
1. Open all six files INPUT; non-'00' -> Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS + Z-ABEND-PROGRAM.
2. Loop until END-OF-DAILY-TRANS-FILE='Y': 1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT ('00' ok; '10' sets EOF flag; else abend). If not EOF DISPLAY DALYTRAN-RECORD.
3. (Executed even on the EOF iteration) move DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM to XREF-CARD-NUM, 2000-LOOKUP-XREF: READ XREF; INVALID KEY -> display 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOR XREF', status 4; else display card/account/customer IDs.
4. If xref found: 3000-READ-ACCOUNT by XREF-ACCT-ID; INVALID KEY -> status 4 and 'ACCOUNT ... NOT FOUND'; else 'SUCCESSFUL READ OF ACCOUNT FILE'. If xref not found: 'CARD NUMBER ... COULD NOT BE VERIFIED. SKIPPING TRANSACTION ID-...'.
5. Close all six files (each checked), display end message, GOBACK.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CBTRN01C MAIN-PARA] --> B[0000-0500 open 6 files INPUT]
  B -->|not 00| Z[Z-ABEND-PROGRAM CEE3ABD 999]
  B --> C[1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT]
  C -->|10| E[EOF flag]
  C --> D[2000-LOOKUP-XREF]
  E --> D
  D -->|found| F[3000-READ-ACCOUNT]
  D -->|INVALID KEY| G[DISPLAY skipping]
  F --> H{loop until EOF}
  G --> H
  H -->|more| C
  H -->|done| I[9000-9500 close files]
```

##### Data
Read-only. No file is written or updated.

##### Outputs & side effects
SYSOUT DISPLAY lines only (record dumps, lookup results). Abend U999 on I/O errors.

##### External calls
`CEE3ABD` USING ABCODE=999, TIMING=0.

##### Migration notes
- Verification-only/diagnostic program: it validates nothing persistently; superseded by CBTRN02C posting. Treat as dead/unscheduled unless the customer has an external JCL.
- On the EOF iteration it still performs an XREF (and possibly account) lookup using the last record's card number — produces duplicate DISPLAY output.
- 9000-DALYTRAN-CLOSE reports CUSTFILE-STATUS instead of DALYTRAN-STATUS on error.
- CUSTFILE, CARDFILE, TRANFILE opened but unused — still must exist for OPEN to succeed.
recommendation: Fully documented; no unresolved behaviour.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/CBTRN01C.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-ed68bc213d6b4bb39634f550b9edaad9.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- Off-by-one: the final loop iteration after EOF re-verifies the last record a second time.
- 9000-DALYTRAN-CLOSE error branch displays 'ERROR CLOSING CUSTOMER FILE' and CUSTFILE-STATUS (copy/paste bug).
- Not referenced by any JCL in repo - candidate dead code, but cannot be proven unused outside the repo.

Confirmed dead: CBTRN01C has no invoking JCL/PROC, is absent from CardDemo.controlm, CardDemo.ca7, all scripts/*.sh and README, and no program CALLs it (grep of app/ and scripts/). It is a read-only pre-check superseded by CBTRN02C (POSTTRAN).

title: CAUP / COACTUPC account and customer update with optimistic locking
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CAUP` -> program `COACTUPC` (Account Update; edits account and its customer), menu option 2 of COMEN01C (CSD TRANSACTION(CAUP) PROGRAM(COACTUPC)). Pseudo-conversational RETURN TRANSID(LIT-THISTRANID) with COMMAREA = CARDDEMO-COMMAREA + WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA (holds ACUP-OLD-* original values, ACUP-NEW-* entered values, and the ACUP state flag).

##### Inputs
Map in mapset `COACTUP` (copybook COACTUP): account ID; account status (Y/N), open/expiry/reissue dates (year/month/day parts), credit limit, cash credit limit, current balance, cycle credit, cycle debit (signed 9V2 text), group ID; customer SSN (3 parts), DOB (y/m/d), FICO (3), first/middle/last names (25), address lines 1-2 (50), city=line 3 (50), state (2), zip (5), country (3), phone 1/2 (area/prefix/line), govt ID, EFT account (10), primary card holder (Y/N). Keys: ENTER; PF3; PF5 only when changes are OK-not-confirmed; PF12 only after details fetched; anything else -> ENTER.

##### Processing flow
State machine on ACUP flags: DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED -> SHOW-DETAILS -> CHANGES-NOT-OK | CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED -> (PF5) CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE | OKAYED-LOCK-ERROR | OKAYED-BUT-FAILED.
1. 0000-MAIN: HANDLE ABEND; COMMAREA reset when EIBCALEN=0 or first entry from COMEN01C (sets PGM-ENTER, DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED).
2. PF3: set TO/FROM (fallback CM00/COMEN01C), USER-TYPE 'U', `EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT`, XCTL.
3. First entry (DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED and PGM-ENTER, or from menu not re-enter): send empty screen asking for account.
4. After CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE or CHANGES-FAILED: reset program COMMAREA and CDEMO-ACCT-ID, send fresh screen.
5. Otherwise 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS (1100-RECEIVE-MAP: copy screen fields into ACUP-NEW-*, '*'/spaces -> LOW-VALUES; numeric conversions with NUMVAL-C), 2000-DECIDE-ACTION, 3000-SEND-MAP.
6. 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS: if not fetched only 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT (11-digit non-zero). Else 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW (case-insensitive, trimmed compare of every field) -> 'No change detected'; then edits in order: status Y/N; open date (EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD from CSUTLDPY: year/month/day numeric & ranges, day vs month/leap, then CSUTLDTC/CEEDAYS 'YYYYMMDD'); credit limit (TEST-NUMVAL-C); expiry date; cash credit limit; reissue date; current balance; cycle credit; cycle debit; SSN (part1 3 digits not 000/666/900-999, part2 2 digits, part3 4 digits); DOB (date + must be before today via INTEGER-OF-DATE); FICO numeric 3 and 300-850; first name alpha required; middle alpha optional; last alpha required; address line 1 mandatory; state alpha + valid US state code (CSLKPCDY table); zip numeric 5; city alpha required; country alpha 3; phone 1/2 (US: area code valid per CSLKPCDY list, prefix, line number numeric; blank allowed); EFT account numeric 10; primary holder Y/N; state+zip(1:2) combination must be in CSLKPCDY table. Any error -> CHANGES-NOT-OK with first error message; else CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED ('Changes validated.Press F5 to save').
7. 2000-DECIDE-ACTION: NOT-FETCHED or PF12 -> 9000-READ-ACCT (CXACAIX by account -> CDEMO-CUST-ID/CARD-NUM; ACCTDAT; CUSTDAT by CUST-ID; 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA copies into ACUP-OLD-*) -> SHOW-DETAILS. SHOW-DETAILS with valid changes -> OK-NOT-CONFIRMED. OK-NOT-CONFIRMED + PF5 -> 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING. DONE -> SHOW-DETAILS (and clear CDEMO acct/card if no FROM-TRANID). Other -> ABEND '0001'.
8. 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING: READ ACCTDAT UPDATE (fail -> 'Could not lock account record for update'); READ CUSTDAT UPDATE (fail -> could not lock customer); 9700-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC compares current records to ACUP-OLD-* (optimistic concurrency; mismatch -> 'Record changed by some one else. Please review', refresh old values, SHOW-DETAILS); build ACCT-UPDATE-RECORD (dates re-assembled 'YYYY-MM-DD', numerics from -N fields) and CUST-UPDATE-RECORD (phones formatted '(AAA)PPP-LLLL', DOB 'YYYY-MM-DD'); REWRITE ACCTDAT (fail -> LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED); REWRITE CUSTDAT (fail -> LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED + `SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK`). Success -> 'Changes committed to database'.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CAUP COACTUPC 0000-MAIN] -->|PF3| X[SYNCPOINT; XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C]
  A -->|first entry| S[3000-SEND-MAP]
  A -->|other| I[1000-PROCESS-INPUTS 1100-RECEIVE-MAP 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS]
  I --> D{2000-DECIDE-ACTION}
  D -->|DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED or PF12| R[9000-READ-ACCT CXACAIX ACCTDAT CUSTDAT]
  D -->|SHOW-DETAILS valid changes| C[CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED]
  D -->|OK-NOT-CONFIRMED + PF5| W[9600-WRITE-PROCESSING]
  W --> L[READ UPDATE ACCTDAT, CUSTDAT]
  L --> V[9700-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC]
  V -->|changed| R2[SHOW-DETAILS refresh]
  V --> U1[REWRITE ACCTDAT]
  U1 --> U2[REWRITE CUSTDAT]
  U2 -->|fail| RB[SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK]
  R & C & W & R2 --> S
  S --> RT[COMMON-RETURN RETURN TRANSID]
```

##### Data
ACCTDAT (CVACT01Y 300) READ, READ UPDATE, REWRITE; CUSTDAT (CVCUS01Y 500) READ, READ UPDATE, REWRITE; CXACAIX (CVACT03Y) READ. Lookup tables in CSLKPCDY (valid US state codes, area codes, state/zip-prefix pairs).

##### Outputs & side effects
Account and customer master records rewritten together; screen messages per state; COMMAREA carries old/new image between tasks.

##### External calls
`CSUTLDTC` (via CSUTLDPY EDIT-DATE-LE, format 'YYYYMMDD') -> LE `CEEDAYS`; CICS READ/REWRITE/SYNCPOINT/SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK/SEND/RECEIVE/XCTL/RETURN/HANDLE ABEND/ABEND.

##### Migration notes
- Optimistic locking: compares the freshly locked record to the values captured at display time; any difference aborts the save.
- Two-record update: account REWRITE failure leaves nothing written; customer REWRITE failure triggers explicit ROLLBACK (account rewrite undone). Re-implement as one transaction.
- 1250-EDIT-SIGNED-9V2 ends with `SET FLG-SIGNED-NUMBER-ISVALID` unconditionally, so field-level highlight flags show valid even when INPUT-ERROR was raised.
- CSD defines ACCTDAT/CUSTDAT with RECOVERY(NONE): the SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK cannot back out the ACCTDAT REWRITE in that configuration.
- Balances and cycle totals are directly editable online (no posting audit trail).
- Validation order determines which single error message is shown.
- Literal names for transaction/map/files are LIT-* constants in WORKING-STORAGE (values follow the COACTVWC convention ACCTDAT/CUSTDAT/CXACAIX; transaction CAUP per CSD); a ~4,200-line program — screen attribute logic (3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS via CSSETATY) is summarised here, not enumerated field by field.
recommendation: Screen-attribute logic (3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS/CSSETATY) and CSLKPCDY lookup table contents summarised; LIT-* values for COACTUPC inferred from CSD and sibling programs.
note: Duplicate of sfind-ea9f460e24fc4aafaa64553e6a0577e2 (COACTUPC account + customer update (TRANSID CAUP)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CBIMPORT export-file split into master-layout files
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `CBIMPORT` (app/jcl/CBIMPORT.jcl), step executing `PGM=CBIMPORT`. Program `CBIMPORT` (batch, no LINKAGE) — reverses CBEXPORT.

##### Inputs
`EXPFILE` -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.EXPORT.DATA (INDEXED, SEQUENTIAL by EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM, 500 bytes, CVEXPORT layout: REC-TYPE X1, TIMESTAMP X26, SEQ 9(9) COMP, BRANCH X4, REGION X5, 460-byte variant data).

##### Processing flow
1. 1000-INITIALIZE: ACCEPT date for display, open EXPFILE INPUT and the six outputs OUTPUT (any non-'00' -> 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM).
2. 2000-PROCESS-EXPORT-FILE: READ loop until '10'; each record counted then 2200-PROCESS-RECORD-BY-TYPE:
   - 'C' 2300: INITIALIZE CUSTOMER-RECORD, map EXP-CUST-* -> CUST-*, WRITE CUSTOUT.
   - 'A' 2400: map EXP-ACCT-* -> ACCT-* (COMP-3/COMP -> zoned), WRITE ACCTOUT.
   - 'X' 2500: map to CARD-XREF-RECORD, WRITE XREFOUT.
   - 'T' 2600: map to TRAN-RECORD, WRITE TRNXOUT.
   - 'D' 2650: map to CARD-RECORD, WRITE CARDOUT.
   - OTHER 2700: count unknown, build error record (timestamp, '|', record type, '|', sequence, '|', 'Unknown record type encountered'), WRITE ERROUT; failure only DISPLAYed.
   Each known type: write status not '00' -> abend; per-type counter +1.
3. 3000-VALIDATE-IMPORT: only DISPLAYs 'Import validation completed' / 'No validation errors detected' — no checks.
4. 4000-FINALIZE: close, display counts.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CBIMPORT 1000-INITIALIZE] --> B[2000-PROCESS-EXPORT-FILE READ EXPFILE]
  B -->|10| V[3000-VALIDATE-IMPORT display only]
  B --> C{2200 EXPORT-REC-TYPE}
  C -->|C| D[2300 CUSTOUT]
  C -->|A| E[2400 ACCTOUT]
  C -->|X| F[2500 XREFOUT]
  C -->|T| G[2600 TRNXOUT]
  C -->|D| H[2650 CARDOUT]
  C -->|other| I[2700 ERROUT]
  D & E & F & G & H & I --> B
  V --> W[4000-FINALIZE]
  B -->|error| Z[9999-ABEND-PROGRAM CEE3ABD]
```

##### Data
Outputs (sequential, fixed): CUSTOUT 500 (CVCUS01Y), ACCTOUT 300 (CVACT01Y), XREFOUT 50 (CVACT03Y), TRNXOUT 350 (CVTRA05Y), CARDOUT 150 (CVACT02Y), ERROUT 132 (ERR-TIMESTAMP X26 = FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE raw 'YYYYMMDDHHMMSShh+HHMM' padded, '|', ERR-RECORD-TYPE X1, '|', ERR-SEQUENCE 9(7), '|', ERR-MESSAGE X50, filler). Datasets in CBIMPORT.jcl: CUSTOUT->AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CUSTDATA.IMPORT, ACCTOUT->ACCTDATA.IMPORT, XREFOUT->CARDXREF.IMPORT, TRNXOUT->TRANSACT.IMPORT, ERROUT->IMPORT.ERRORS (all NEW,CATLG,DELETE, RECFM=FB). **No CARDOUT DD is coded in CBIMPORT.jcl.**

##### Outputs & side effects
Flat sequential files only — VSAM masters are **not** loaded; a separate REPRO would be required. Counts DISPLAYed.

##### External calls
`CEE3ABD` called with no parameters after DISPLAY 'CBIMPORT: ABENDING PROGRAM'.

##### Migration notes
- CBIMPORT.jcl lacks a CARDOUT DD, so OPEN OUTPUT CARD-OUTPUT in 1000-INITIALIZE fails (non-'00') and the program abends before reading anything, as shipped. Add the DD (LRECL 150) when re-implementing.
- Unknown-type write failure is not fatal (asymmetry with all other writes).
- "Validation" is a stub; no referential or field validation occurs.
- Branch/region/timestamp header fields are discarded.
- 9(9) COMP sequence is truncated into 9(7) in the error record.
- Numeric conversions packed/binary -> zoned must preserve sign and 2 implied decimals.
recommendation: Confirm whether CBIMPORT.jcl missing CARDOUT DD is intentional.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/CBIMPORT.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-91b6ad95d56943828eff8e613d4885dc, sfind-b171f389060c42f08e6d0581ce11d489.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- Validation paragraph is a no-op; there is no referential check (e.g. account exists for card).
- Output order equals export sequence order; numeric representation conversions between `CVEXPORT` and target copybooks are done by COBOL MOVE (sign/packing must be reproduced).


End-to-end: CBIMPORT consumes the 500-byte EXPORT-RECORD file produced by CBEXPORT; together they form the branch-migration export/import flow. Upstream findings: sfind-f06fac9d5d98466b878ffde08f4dc3fc.

title: CM00 / COMEN01C main menu dispatch
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CM00` -> program `COMEN01C` (main menu for regular users). Reached by XCTL from sign-on `COSGN00C` (and back-navigation from function programs) and re-entered via `EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CM00') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)` pseudo-conversation.

##### Inputs
- DFHCOMMAREA -> CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (COCOM01Y): CDEMO-FROM-TRANID X4, FROM-PROGRAM X8, TO-TRANID X4, TO-PROGRAM X8, USER-ID X8, USER-TYPE X1 ('A' admin/'U' user), PGM-CONTEXT 9(1) (0 enter, 1 re-enter), CUST-ID 9(9), CUST-FNAME/MNAME/LNAME X25, ACCT-ID 9(11), ACCT-STATUS X1, CARD-NUM 9(16), LAST-MAP X7, LAST-MAPSET X7.
- Map `COMEN1A` / mapset `COMEN01`: input OPTIONI (2 chars); EIBAID.
- Menu table COMEN02Y: CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT = 11; entries (num, name X35, program X8, usertype X1): 1 Account View COACTVWC; 2 Account Update COACTUPC; 3 Credit Card List COCRDLIC; 4 Credit Card View COCRDSLC; 5 Credit Card Update COCRDUPC; 6 Transaction List COTRN00C; 7 Transaction View COTRN01C; 8 Transaction Add COTRN02C; 9 Transaction Reports CORPT00C; 10 Bill Payment COBIL00C; 11 Pending Authorization View COPAUS0C — all usertype 'U'.

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN = 0 -> XCTL to COSGN00C (no COMMAREA).
2. First entry (PGM-CONTEXT not 1): set re-enter, SEND-MENU-SCREEN (header: titles CCDA-TITLE01/02, tran CM00, program, date MM/DD/YY, time HH:MM:SS; options "nn. name" into OPTN001O..OPTN012O; ERASE).
3. Re-entry: RECEIVE MAP; EIBAID: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL COSGN00C with COMMAREA? (RETURN-TO-SIGNON-SCREEN does XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) **without COMMAREA**); other -> 'Invalid key pressed. Please see below...'.
4. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: right-trim OPTIONI, replace spaces with '0', move to WS-OPTION 9(2). Invalid if not numeric, > 11, or 0 -> 'Please enter a valid option number...'. If user type 'U' and option usertype 'A' -> 'No access - Admin Only option... ' (no option currently 'A'). Otherwise:
   - program COPAUS0C: EXEC CICS INQUIRE PROGRAM NOHANDLE; NORMAL -> XCTL with COMMAREA (FROM-TRANID=CM00, FROM-PROGRAM=COMEN01C, PGM-CONTEXT=0); else red 'This option <name> is not installed...'.
   - program name starting 'DUMMY' -> green 'This option <name>is coming soon ...'.
   - other -> XCTL to the option program with COMMAREA.
   Then SEND-MENU-SCREEN (only reached if no XCTL).
5. Always end with RETURN TRANSID CM00 COMMAREA.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CM00 COMEN01C MAIN-PARA] -->|EIBCALEN=0| S[XCTL COSGN00C]
  A -->|first entry| M[SEND-MENU-SCREEN COMEN1A]
  A -->|re-enter| R[RECEIVE-MENU-SCREEN]
  R -->|PF3| S
  R -->|other key| M
  R -->|ENTER| P[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY]
  P -->|invalid/admin-only| M
  P -->|COPAUS0C| I[CICS INQUIRE PROGRAM]
  I -->|NORMAL| X[XCTL option program]
  I -->|not installed| M
  P -->|DUMMY*| M
  P -->|other| X
  M --> T[RETURN TRANSID CM00 COMMAREA]
```

##### Data
No files. COMMAREA only.

##### Outputs & side effects
Menu screen; transfer of control (XCTL) to selected function program with CDEMO-FROM-TRANID/PROGRAM set and PGM-CONTEXT reset to 0.

##### External calls
CICS SEND/RECEIVE MAP, XCTL, INQUIRE PROGRAM, RETURN TRANSID.

##### Migration notes
- Option parsing: '1 ' -> '10'? No: trailing spaces are trimmed first, then embedded/leading spaces become '0' (e.g. ' 1' -> '01'). 
- COMEN01C OPTIONI is 2 chars; options 1-11 valid; 12 slots on screen.
- PF3 XCTL to sign-on passes no COMMAREA (session state discarded).
- Admin-only check is dead with current table (no 'A' entries; admin menu is COADM01C).
- COPAUS0C availability is detected dynamically (INQUIRE) — optional authorization module.
- Message 'coming soon' has no space after the option name because of DELIMITED BY SPACE.
recommendation: Fully documented; no unresolved behaviour.
note: Duplicate of sfind-6417f0efb3484b28b9b140c6d330e02d (COMEN01C regular-user main menu (TRANSID CM00)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: DEFCUST IDCAMS delete/define customer cluster
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `DEFCUST` (app/jcl/DEFCUST.jcl), two steps both named `STEP05`, each `EXEC PGM=IDCAMS`.

##### Inputs
Inline SYSIN IDCAMS control statements only.

##### Processing flow
1. First STEP05: `DELETE AWS.CCDA.CUSTDATA.CLUSTER CLUSTER` (note different HLQ).
2. Second STEP05: `DEFINE CLUSTER (NAME(AWS.CUSTDATA.CLUSTER) INDEXED KEYS(10 0) RECORDSIZE(500 500) SHAREOPTIONS(1 4) ERASE ...)` with DATA AWS.CUSTDATA.CLUSTER.DATA and INDEX AWS.CUSTDATA.CLUSTER.INDEX.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[DEFCUST STEP05 IDCAMS DELETE AWS.CCDA.CUSTDATA.CLUSTER] --> B[STEP05 IDCAMS DEFINE AWS.CUSTDATA.CLUSTER]
```

##### Data
Creates an empty customer KSDS: 500-byte fixed records, 10-byte key at offset 0.

##### Outputs & side effects
Catalog entry for AWS.CUSTDATA.CLUSTER; possible deletion of AWS.CCDA.CUSTDATA.CLUSTER.

##### External calls
IDCAMS.

##### Migration notes
- Deleted and defined names differ (AWS.CCDA.CUSTDATA vs AWS.CUSTDATA); neither matches the name the application uses (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CUSTDATA.VSAM.KSDS) — appears to be a legacy/sample job; rerun fails at DEFINE if the cluster exists.
- KEYS(10 0) but CUST-ID is 9(9) (9 bytes): the key includes the first byte of CUST-FIRST-NAME.
- Duplicate step names; no COND, delete failure does not stop the define.
recommendation: Fully documented; no unresolved behaviour.

title: BMS COUSR01 / map COUSR1A - Add User screen contract
description:
##### Entry point
Mapset `COUSR01` (CTRL=ALARM,FREEKB), map `COUSR1A` 24x80. Used by COUSR01C (admin add user).

##### Inputs
UNPROT/FSET green underline fields: `FNAME` 8,18 len 20 (IC); `LNAME` 8,56 len 20; `USERID` 11,15 len 8 '(8 Char)'; `PASSWD` 11,55 len 8 DRK (non-display) '(8 Char)'; `USRTYPE` 14,17 len 1 '(A=Admin, U=User)'. AID legend: ENTER=Add User F3=Back F4=Clear F12=Exit.

##### Processing flow
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  H["Header"] --> N["FNAME, LNAME"] --> U["USERID, PASSWD dark"] --> T["USRTYPE A/U"] --> E["ERRMSG + key legend"]
```
Standard header fields; ERRMSG 23,1 78 red.

##### Data
Maps to the user security record (CSUSR01Y: user id 8, first/last name 20, password 8, type 1) written by COUSR01C to USRSEC.

##### Outputs & side effects
N/A.

##### External calls
N/A.

##### Migration notes
Password is only hidden on screen (DRK); it is transmitted and stored in clear by the legacy flow (handled in COUSR01C). Fixed 8-character user id/password limits.
recommendation: Fully documented as UI contract.
note: Owners from git history (no CODEOWNERS file in repo).

title: BMS COTRN01 / map COTRN1A - View Transaction screen contract
description:
##### Entry point
Mapset `COTRN01` (CTRL=ALARM,FREEKB), map `COTRN1A` 24x80. Used by COTRN01C (view transaction).

##### Inputs
`TRNIDIN` (6,21) len 16 UNPROT/IC/FSET 'Enter Tran ID:'. AID keys handled by the program (no key legend literal text; 24,1 literal is blank).

##### Processing flow
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  H["Header"] --> I["TRNIDIN 16"] --> D["Transaction detail fields"] --> E["ERRMSG"]
```
Output fields (all ASKIP, blue): TRNID 10,22 16; CARDNUM 10,58 16; TTYPCD 12,15 2; TCATCD 12,36 4; TRNSRC 12,54 10; TDESC 14,19 60; TRNAMT 16,14 12; TORIGDT 16,42 10; TPROCDT 16,68 10; MID 18,19 9; MNAME 18,48 30; MCITY 20,21 25; MZIP 20,67 10. ERRMSG 23,1 78 red. Standard header fields.

##### Data
Corresponds to TRAN-RECORD (CVTRA05Y) fields displayed by COTRN01C.

##### Outputs & side effects
N/A.

##### External calls
N/A.

##### Migration notes
Screen widths are shorter than some record fields (e.g. description shown 60, merchant name 30, timestamps shown as 10-char dates); truncation happens on display. Amount field is 12 chars, formatting done by program.
recommendation: Fully documented as UI contract.

title: DBPAUTP0 / DBPAUTX0 DBDs and PSBs - Pending authorization IMS database structure
description:
##### Entry point
IMS DBD `DBPAUTP0` (ACCESS=(HIDAM,VSAM), dataset group DD1=DDPAUTP0, 4096 CI) with primary index DBD `DBPAUTX0` (ACCESS=(INDEX,VSAM,PROT), DD DDPAUTX0, segment PAUTINDX 6 bytes, INDXSEQ packed, LCHILD PAUTSUM0 INDEX=ACCNTID). Used by every flow in this module.

##### Inputs
N/A.

##### Processing flow
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  X["DBPAUTX0 PAUTINDX key INDXSEQ P6"] -->|INDX| R["PAUTSUM0 root 100B key ACCNTID P6 at 1"]
  R --> C["PAUTDTL1 child 200B key PAUT9CTS C8 at 1"]
```
- Segment 1 `PAUTSUM0` root, BYTES=100, RULES=(,HERE), POINTER=TWINBWD; FIELD ACCNTID SEQ,U START 1 BYTES 6 TYPE P (= PA-ACCT-ID S9(11) COMP-3). Layout CIPAUSMY.
- Segment 2 `PAUTDTL1` child of PAUTSUM0, BYTES=200; FIELD PAUT9CTS SEQ,U START 1 BYTES 8 TYPE C (= PA-AUTH-DATE-9C S9(5) COMP-3 + PA-AUTH-TIME-9C S9(9) COMP-3, inverted date/time so ascending key = newest first). Layout CIPAUDTY.
- PSBs: `PSBPAUTB` (PROCOPT=AP, CMPAT=YES; used by COPAUA0C, COPAUS0C, COPAUS1C online and CBPAUP0C BMP), `PAUTBUNL` (PROCOPT=GOTP; PAUDBUNL unload), `PSBPAUTL` (PROCOPT=L load, LANG=ASSEM), `DLIGSAMP` (GOTP DB PCB + two GSAM PCBs PASFLDBD/PADFLDBD, PROCOPT=LS). All KEYLEN=14 (6 + 8).

##### Data
As above. DBD EXIT=(*,KEY,DATA,NOPATH,(NOCASCADE),LOG) - a data capture exit is declared (exit routine not in repo).

##### Outputs & side effects
N/A.

##### External calls
Data capture exit '*' (named by DBD) - not available in source.

##### Migration notes
Unique sequence keys: ISRT of a duplicate PAUT9CTS under the same account returns 'II' (COPAUA0C treats as critical error). Time key resolution is milliseconds. Packed account key requires numeric account ids. The DBD data-capture exit implies change propagation that a new store may need to replicate - source not available.
recommendation: Data capture exit referenced by EXIT=(*,...) is not in the repo; confirm whether CDC/replication depends on it.
note: Owners from git history (no CODEOWNERS file in repo).

title: COPAUA0C (TRANSID CP00) - MQ-triggered credit card authorization decision engine
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `COPAUA0C`, transaction `CP00` (CSD CRDDEMO2.csd). Started by an IBM MQ trigger monitor: `MAIN-PARA` -> `1000-INITIALIZE` issues `EXEC CICS RETRIEVE INTO(MQTM)` to obtain the trigger message (queue name `MQTM-QNAME`, `MQTM-TRIGGERDATA`). No terminal, no COMMAREA used (LINKAGE `DFHCOMMAREA` X(4096) is declared but never referenced). Ends with plain `EXEC CICS RETURN`.

##### Inputs
- **Trigger message** MQTM (copybook CMQTML): request queue name.
- **Request MQ message** (MQGET, buffer `W01-GET-BUFFER` X(500), format MQFMT-STRING, MQGMO-CONVERT): a comma-delimited text record UNSTRINGed (`2100-EXTRACT-REQUEST-MSG`) into CCPAURQY `PENDING-AUTH-REQUEST`, in this order:
  1 PA-RQ-AUTH-DATE X(6) (YYMMDD), 2 PA-RQ-AUTH-TIME X(6) (HHMMSS), 3 PA-RQ-CARD-NUM X(16), 4 PA-RQ-AUTH-TYPE X(4), 5 PA-RQ-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE X(4), 6 PA-RQ-MESSAGE-TYPE X(6), 7 PA-RQ-MESSAGE-SOURCE X(6), 8 PA-RQ-PROCESSING-CODE 9(6), 9 transaction amount -> `WS-TRANSACTION-AMT-AN` X(13) then `FUNCTION NUMVAL` into PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-AMT (PIC +9(10).99) and WS-TRANSACTION-AMT S9(10)V99, 10 PA-RQ-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE X(4), 11 PA-RQ-ACQR-COUNTRY-CODE X(3), 12 PA-RQ-POS-ENTRY-MODE 9(2), 13 PA-RQ-MERCHANT-ID X(15), 14 PA-RQ-MERCHANT-NAME X(22), 15 PA-RQ-MERCHANT-CITY X(13), 16 PA-RQ-MERCHANT-STATE X(2), 17 PA-RQ-MERCHANT-ZIP X(9), 18 PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-ID X(15).
- MQMD of the request: `MQMD-CORRELID` saved to WS-SAVE-CORRELID, `MQMD-REPLYTOQ` saved to WS-REPLY-QNAME.

##### Processing flow
1. `1000-INITIALIZE`: RETRIEVE MQTM (NOHANDLE; on non-NORMAL the queue name stays uninitialised/blank). Wait interval = 5000 ms. `1100-OPEN-REQUEST-QUEUE`: MQOPEN with MQOO-INPUT-SHARED on hconn 0 (CICS default connection). Failure -> error M001 CRITICAL -> task ends. Then first `3100-READ-REQUEST-MQ`.
2. `3100-READ-REQUEST-MQ`: MQGET options NO-SYNCPOINT + WAIT + CONVERT + FAIL-IF-QUIESCING, 5 s wait. OK -> save correlid & reply-to queue. Reason MQRC-NO-MSG-AVAILABLE -> `NO-MORE-MSG-AVAILABLE`. Other -> error M003 CRITICAL (logged with subsystem 'C' CICS, not 'M').
3. `2000-MAIN-PROCESS`: loop until no message or loop-end: extract (2100), `5000-PROCESS-AUTH`, ADD 1 to WS-MSG-PROCESSED, `EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT` (commits IMS updates for this message; PSB released, flag set NOT-SCHD), if WS-MSG-PROCESSED > 500 (`WS-REQSTS-PROCESS-LIMIT`) stop, else read next.
4. `5000-PROCESS-AUTH`: SET APPROVE-AUTH; `1200-SCHEDULE-PSB` (DLI SCHD PSBPAUTB NODHABEND; if 'TC' -> TERM and re-SCHD; failure -> I001 CRITICAL); SET CARD-FOUND-XREF and FOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR; `5100-READ-XREF-RECORD`. If card found: `5200-READ-ACCT-RECORD`, `5300-READ-CUST-RECORD`, `5500-READ-AUTH-SUMMRY`, `5600-READ-PROFILE-DATA` (empty - CONTINUE). Then `6000-MAKE-DECISION`, `7100-SEND-RESPONSE`, and only if card found `8000-WRITE-AUTH-TO-DB`.
5. `5100`: CICS READ `CCXREF` keyed by card number. NOTFND -> CARD-NFOUND-XREF + NFOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR, warning A001 'CARD NOT FOUND IN XREF'. Other -> C001 CRITICAL.
6. `5200`: READ `ACCTDAT` key XREF-ACCT-ID (11 chars). NOTFND -> NFOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR, A002. Other -> C002 CRITICAL.
7. `5300`: READ `CUSTDAT` key XREF-CUST-ID (9). NOTFND -> NFOUND-CUST-IN-MSTR, A003 'CUST NOT FOUND IN XREF'. Other -> C003 CRITICAL.
8. `5500`: `DLI GU PAUTSUM0 WHERE ACCNTID = PA-ACCT-ID` (XREF-ACCT-ID). OK/'FW' -> FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG; 'GE' -> NFOUND; other -> I002 CRITICAL.
9. `6000-MAKE-DECISION`: reply card/txn id copied; **PA-RL-AUTH-ID-CODE = PA-RQ-AUTH-TIME**. If summary found: available = PA-CREDIT-LIMIT - PA-CREDIT-BALANCE; decline (INSUFFICIENT-FUND) if amount > available. Else if account found: available = ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT - ACCT-CURR-BAL, same rule. Else decline. Declined -> resp code '05', approved amt 0; approved -> '00', approved amt = request amount. Reason '0000' unless declined: first true of {card not in xref, acct not found, cust not found} -> '3100'; INSUFFICIENT-FUND -> '4100'; CARD-NOT-ACTIVE '4200'; ACCOUNT-CLOSED '4300'; CARD-FRAUD '5100'; MERCHANT-FRAUD '5200'; other '9000'. Reply string built with STRING ... DELIMITED BY SIZE WITH POINTER WS-RESP-LENGTH into W02-PUT-BUFFER: `card(16),txnid(15),authid(6),respcode(2),reason(4),amount(-zzzzzzzzz9.99),` (trailing comma).
10. `7100-SEND-RESPONSE`: MQPUT1 to WS-REPLY-QNAME (the request's ReplyToQ), MsgType REPLY, CorrelId = request CorrelId, MsgId NONE, non-persistent, Expiry 50 (tenths of a second = 5 s), format STRING, options NO-SYNCPOINT + DEFAULT-CONTEXT, length = WS-RESP-LENGTH. Failure -> M004 CRITICAL.
11. `8400-UPDATE-SUMMARY`: if summary not found INITIALIZE (numeric->0) and set PA-ACCT-ID/PA-CUST-ID from xref. Always PA-CREDIT-LIMIT = ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT, PA-CASH-LIMIT = ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT. Approved: approved count +1, approved amt += approved amount, PA-CREDIT-BALANCE += approved amount, PA-CASH-BALANCE = 0. Declined: declined count +1, declined amt += `PA-TRANSACTION-AMT` (see notes). REPL if found else ISRT PAUTSUM0. Failure -> I003 CRITICAL.
12. `8500-INSERT-AUTH`: ASKTIME/FORMATTIME YYDDD + TIME + MILLISECONDS; key PA-AUTH-DATE-9C = 99999 - YYDDD, PA-AUTH-TIME-9C = 999999999 - (HHMMSS*1000 + ms) (descending-time key so newest sorts first). Copy all request fields to CIPAUDTY detail, response code/reason/approved amt from reply, match status 'P' if approved else 'D', fraud flag and fraud date = spaces. `DLI ISRT PAUTSUM0 WHERE ACCNTID=PA-ACCT-ID / PAUTDTL1 FROM PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS`. Failure -> I004 CRITICAL.
13. `9000-TERMINATE`: DLI TERM if scheduled; MQCLOSE request queue (failure M005 WARNING).
14. `9500-LOG-ERROR`: fills CCPAUERY ERROR-LOG-RECORD (date YYMMDD, time, application=CP00, program=COPAUA0C) and `WRITEQ TD QUEUE('CSSL')` NOHANDLE; if ERR-CRITICAL -> `9990-END-ROUTINE` = 9000-TERMINATE + `EXEC CICS RETURN` (ends task mid-loop).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["MQ trigger -> CP00 COPAUA0C"] --> B["1000-INITIALIZE RETRIEVE MQTM"]
  B --> C["1100 MQOPEN request queue"]
  C -->|fail M001| Z["9500-LOG-ERROR CSSL -> 9990 RETURN"]
  C --> D["3100 MQGET wait 5s"]
  D -->|no msg| T["9000-TERMINATE MQCLOSE"]
  D -->|msg| E["2100 UNSTRING CSV"]
  E --> F["1200 SCHD PSBPAUTB"]
  F --> G["5100 READ CCXREF"]
  G -->|found| H["5200 READ ACCTDAT / 5300 READ CUSTDAT / 5500 GU PAUTSUM0"]
  G -->|not found| I
  H --> I["6000-MAKE-DECISION available = limit - balance"]
  I --> J["7100 MQPUT1 reply to ReplyToQ"]
  J -->|card found| K["8400 REPL/ISRT PAUTSUM0 + 8500 ISRT PAUTDTL1"]
  J -->|card not found| L
  K --> L["SYNCPOINT, count+1"]
  L -->|count > 500| T
  L -->|else| D
  T --> R["CICS RETURN"]
```

##### Data
- VSAM via CICS READ (read-only): `CCXREF` (CVACT03Y CARD-XREF-RECORD: XREF-CARD-NUM X16, XREF-CUST-ID 9(9), XREF-ACCT-ID 9(11), FILLER X14 = 50 bytes), `ACCTDAT` (CVACT01Y ACCOUNT-RECORD 300 bytes: ACCT-ID 9(11), ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS X, ACCT-CURR-BAL S9(10)V99, ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, dates X10 x3, cycle credit/debit S9(10)V99, ZIP X10, GROUP X10, FILLER X178), `CUSTDAT` (CVCUS01Y 500 bytes). WS also declares `CARDDAT`/`CARDAIX` names but they are never read.
- IMS DB `DBPAUTP0` via PSB `PSBPAUTB` (PROCOPT=AP), PCB 1: root `PAUTSUM0` (CIPAUSMY, 100 bytes: PA-ACCT-ID S9(11) COMP-3 [key ACCNTID, 6 bytes packed], PA-CUST-ID 9(9), PA-AUTH-STATUS X, PA-ACCOUNT-STATUS X(2)x5, PA-CREDIT-LIMIT/CASH-LIMIT/CREDIT-BALANCE/CASH-BALANCE S9(9)V99 COMP-3, PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT/DECLINED-AUTH-CNT S9(4) COMP, PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT/DECLINED-AUTH-AMT S9(9)V99 COMP-3, FILLER X34) - read GU, written REPL/ISRT; child `PAUTDTL1` (CIPAUDTY, 200 bytes, key PAUT9CTS = PA-AUTH-DATE-9C S9(5) COMP-3 + PA-AUTH-TIME-9C S9(9) COMP-3, 8 bytes) - ISRT.
- TD queue `CSSL` (ERROR-LOG-RECORD: date X6, time X6, app X8, program X8, location X4, level X1 [L/I/W/C], subsystem X1 [A/C/I/D/M/F], code1 X9, code2 X9, message X50, event key X20).

##### Outputs & side effects
One MQ reply per processed request (even when the card is unknown); IMS summary upsert and detail insert per message whose card exists in CCXREF; CICS SYNCPOINT after each message; error records on CSSL.

##### External calls
- IBM MQ API: `MQOPEN` (hconn 0, OD request, MQOO-INPUT-SHARED -> hobj), `MQGET` (hconn, hobj, MD, GMO, buflen 500, buffer -> datalen, compcode, reason), `MQPUT1` (hconn 0, OD reply, MD reply, PMO, buflen, buffer -> compcode, reason), `MQCLOSE` (hobj, MQCO-NONE).
- EXEC DLI SCHD/GU/REPL/ISRT/TERM; EXEC CICS RETRIEVE/READ/ASKTIME/FORMATTIME/WRITEQ TD/SYNCPOINT/RETURN.

##### Migration notes
- **Stale state across messages**: per message only WS-DECLINE-FLG, CARD-FOUND-XREF and FOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR are reset. `WS-PAUT-SMRY-SEG-FLG`, `WS-CUST-MASTER-READ-FLG`, `WS-DECLINE-REASON-FLG` and the PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY / ACCOUNT-RECORD buffers carry over. If a previous message found a summary and the current card is not in CCXREF, 6000 evaluates FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG first and computes availability from the *previous account's* summary, so it can return '00' approved for an unknown card (no DB write happens because card not found). For the first message in a task the flag is uninitialised (neither 88 true).
- **Reply buffer pointer never reset**: `WS-RESP-LENGTH` (VALUE 1) is the STRING pointer and is never re-initialised and W02-PUT-BUFFER (200) is never cleared. Message 2 onwards appends after message 1's text and the MQPUT1 length grows each message (length passed = pointer = written chars + 1, so even the first reply includes one trailing byte). Once the pointer passes 200 the STRING overflows silently (no ON OVERFLOW). Behaviour of replies after the first in a task should be confirmed with the owners before replicating.
- Declined path adds `PA-TRANSACTION-AMT` (detail-segment field, populated only later in 8500 of the *previous* message) to PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT, not the current request amount.
- Customer not found does not by itself decline, but if the auth is declined for funds and the customer was not found the reason becomes '3100' (evaluate order).
- Reason codes 4200/4300/5100/5200 are unreachable: their flags are never set (5600-READ-PROFILE-DATA is an empty stub).
- If XREF found but account not found, 8400 still copies ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT / CASH limit from a stale or uninitialised ACCOUNT-RECORD into the summary.
- PA-CASH-BALANCE is zeroed on every approval.
- Processes up to 501 messages per trigger (`> 500`). MQGET is outside syncpoint, so a message is consumed even if later IMS work is backed out; reply is also non-syncpoint.
- Critical errors end the task with plain RETURN (normal end => CICS commits pending IMS updates of the current message).
- Amount parsing uses NUMVAL on up to 13 chars; date key uses Julian YYDDD (century not stored).
recommendation: Fully traced. Confirm with business owners whether the stale-flag approval path and the accumulating reply-buffer behaviour are intended; a re-implementation should normally reset all per-message state, but parity tests against the legacy system will differ on multi-message tasks.
note: Duplicate of sfind-ed8806e1e84244d6b802febe5cca0c30 (COPAUA0C (CICS tran CP00)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

             MOVE PA-RQ-AUTH-TIME        TO PA-RL-AUTH-ID-CODE                    
                                                                                  
        *-   Decline Auth if Above Limit; If no AUTH summary, use ACT data

                                         - PA-CREDIT-BALANCE

title: COACCT01 (TRANSID CDRA) - MQ request/reply account inquiry service
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `COACCT01` (IS INITIAL), transaction `CDRA` (app-vsam-mq/csd/CRDDEMOM.csd), started by an MQ trigger: `1000-CONTROL` -> `EXEC CICS RETRIEVE INTO(MQTM)`.

##### Inputs
- MQTM: `MQTM-QNAME` -> INPUT-QUEUE-NAME.
- Request message (MQGET, 1000-byte buffer, CONVERT): REQUEST-MSG-COPY: WS-FUNC X(4) (only 'INQA' supported), WS-KEY 9(11) (account id), filler X(985).

##### Processing flow
1. `2100-OPEN-ERROR-QUEUE`: MQOPEN 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR' for OUTPUT + PASS-ALL-CONTEXT + FAIL-IF-QUIESCING; failure -> DISPLAY and terminate.
2. RETRIEVE trigger; not NORMAL -> error message 'CICS RETREIVE' to error queue, terminate. Reply queue is hard-coded 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT'.
3. `2300-OPEN-INPUT-QUEUE` (INPUT-SHARED + SAVE-ALL-CONTEXT + FAIL-IF-QUIESCING), `2400-OPEN-OUTPUT-QUEUE` (reply queue, OUTPUT + PASS-ALL-CONTEXT); errors -> 9000-ERROR + terminate.
4. `3000-GET-REQUEST`: MQGET SYNCPOINT + FAIL-IF-QUIESCING + CONVERT + WAIT 5000 ms. OK -> save MsgId, CorrelId, ReplyToQ; copy message; `4000-PROCESS-REQUEST-REPLY`. No message -> NO-MORE-MSGS. Other -> error + terminate.
5. Loop `4000-MAIN-PROCESS` until NO-MORE-MSGS: `EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT` (commits previous get+put) then 3000-GET-REQUEST.
6. `4000-PROCESS-REQUEST-REPLY`: if WS-FUNC = 'INQA' and WS-KEY > 0: CICS READ `ACCTDAT` RIDFLD = key as 11 chars. NORMAL -> build WS-ACCT-RESPONSE and put; NOTFND -> 'INVALID REQUEST PARAMETERS ACCT ID : <key>' and put; other -> 9000-ERROR + terminate. Else -> 'INVALID REQUEST PARAMETERS ACCT ID : <key>FUNCTION : <func>' and put.
7. `4100-PUT-REPLY`: MQPUT to reply queue, buffer length always 1000, MsgId = request MsgId, CorrelId = request CorrelId, format STRING, CCSID = queue manager, options SYNCPOINT + DEFAULT-CONTEXT + FAIL-IF-QUIESCING; failure -> error + terminate.
8. `9000-ERROR`: put MQ-ERR-DISPLAY (para X25, message X25, condition 99, reason 99999, queue name X48) padded to 1000 bytes on the error queue (SYNCPOINT); failure -> DISPLAY + terminate.
9. `8000-TERMINATION`: MQCLOSE input/reply/error queues if open; `EXEC CICS RETURN`.

Reply layout WS-ACCT-RESPONSE (fixed text, then spaces to 1000): 'ACCOUNT ID : ' + ACCT-ID 9(11) + 'ACCOUNT STATUS : ' + X1 + 'BALANCE : ' + S9(10)V99 + 'CREDIT LIMIT : ' + S9(10)V99 + 'CASH LIMIT : ' + S9(10)V99 + 'OPEN DATE : ' + X10 + 'EXPR DATE : ' + X10 + 'REIS DATE : ' + X10 + 'CREDIT BAL : ' + S9(10)V99 + 'DEBIT BAL : ' + S9(10)V99 + 'GROUP ID : ' + X10.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["MQ trigger -> CDRA COACCT01"] --> E["2100 MQOPEN CARD.DEMO.ERROR"]
  E --> R["RETRIEVE MQTM"]
  R -->|fail| ER["9000-ERROR -> 8000-TERMINATION"]
  R --> O["2300 open input, 2400 open CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT"]
  O --> G["3000 MQGET syncpoint wait 5s"]
  G -->|no msg| T["8000 MQCLOSE all, RETURN"]
  G -->|msg| P{"func = INQA and key > 0"}
  P -->|yes| RD["READ ACCTDAT"]
  RD -->|NORMAL| PUT["4100 MQPUT account response"]
  RD -->|NOTFND| PUT2["MQPUT INVALID REQUEST PARAMETERS"]
  RD -->|other| ER
  P -->|no| PUT2
  PUT --> SP["SYNCPOINT"] --> G
  PUT2 --> SP
```

##### Data
VSAM `ACCTDAT` read-only (CVACT01Y 300-byte ACCOUNT-RECORD keyed by ACCT-ID 9(11)).

##### Outputs & side effects
Reply messages on CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT; error messages on CARD.DEMO.ERROR; get/put are under syncpoint and committed by the loop SYNCPOINT / task end.

##### External calls
MQOPEN/MQGET/MQPUT/MQCLOSE (hconn 0). CICS RETRIEVE/READ/SYNCPOINT/RETURN.

##### Migration notes
- Reply goes to the fixed queue CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT, ignoring the request's ReplyToQ (saved but unused); reply reuses request MsgId and CorrelId.
- Numeric fields in the reply are zoned decimal with implied 2 decimals and trailing sign overpunch (no decimal point), e.g. balance 0000000123{ style; consumers must decode EBCDIC overpunch.
- Reply is always 1000 bytes, space-padded.
- Flag names are swapped: input-queue open sets REPLY-QUEUE-OPEN, reply-queue open sets RESP-QUEUE-OPEN (closing logic is consistent with that).
- RETRIEVE error message bug: `MOVE WS-CICS-RESP2-CD TO WS-CICS-RESP2-CD` so RESP2 display is always 0; MQ-ERROR-PARA only set on that path.
- MQCLOSE failures PERFORM 8000-TERMINATION recursively, which retries the same close - potential infinite recursion if a close keeps failing.
- 9000-ERROR does not reset MsgId/CorrelId, so error messages inherit the last request's ids.
- WS-KEY non-numeric content makes the `> ZEROES` test unreliable; MQ-MSG-COUNT is uninitialised and unused.
recommendation: Fully documented.

title: UNLDPADB JCL - job wrapper for PAUDBUNL IMS unload
description:
##### Entry point
JOB `UNLDPADB` (CLASS=A, TIME=1440).

##### Inputs
IMS libraries (STEPLIB OEMA.IMS.IMSP.SDFSRESL, SDFSRESL.V151, AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB; IMS DD = PSBLIB + DBDLIB), DB datasets DDPAUTP0 = OEM.IMS.IMSP.PAUTHDB, DDPAUTX0 = OEM.IMS.IMSP.PAUTHDBX, DFSVSAMP = OEMPP.IMS.V15R01MB.PROCLIB(DFSVSMDB). IMSLOGR/IEFRDER DUMMY.

##### Processing flow
1. STEP0 `IEFBR14` with DD1/DD2 DISP=(OLD,DELETE,DELETE) deletes prior ROOT/CHILD files.
2. STEP01 `DFSRRC00 PARM='DLI,PAUDBUNL,PAUTBUNL,,,,,,,,,,,N'` runs PAUDBUNL (documented in the PAUDBUNL finding) and writes OUTFIL1 (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PAUTDB.ROOT.FILEO, NEW,CATLG,DELETE, FB 100) and OUTFIL2 (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PAUTDB.CHILD.FILEO, FB 206), SPACE=(400,(20,20),RLSE) on 3390.

```mermaid

  A["STEP0 IEFBR14 delete ROOT/CHILD.FILEO"] --> B["STEP01 DFSRRC00 DLI PAUDBUNL/PAUTBUNL"]
  B --> C["OUTFIL1 ROOT.FILEO FB100"]
  B --> D["OUTFIL2 CHILD.FILEO FB206"]
```

##### Data
See PAUDBUNL finding.

##### Outputs & side effects
Cataloged unload datasets.

##### External calls
IEFBR14, DFSRRC00.

##### Migration notes
No COND codes: STEP01 runs even if STEP0 fails? (STEP0 failure with DISP=OLD on missing dataset is a JCL allocation error that terminates the job). Space allocation is tiny (400-byte blocks) - large databases need more. Dataset names are environment-specific HLQs.
recommendation: Fully documented; parametrise HLQs in the target scheduler.

title: CBPAUP0J / CBPAUP0C - Purge expired pending authorizations from IMS (BMP)
description:
##### Entry point
JOB `CBPAUP0J`, STEP01 `EXEC PGM=DFSRRC00,PARM='BMP,CBPAUP0C,PSBPAUTB'` -> IMS BMP running COBOL program `CBPAUP0C` (app-authorization-ims-db2-mq/cbl/CBPAUP0C.cbl, `PROCEDURE DIVISION USING IO-PCB-MASK PGM-PCB-MASK`) with PSB PSBPAUTB (CMPAT=YES, so PCB 1 = I/O PCB and the DB PCB is PCB 2 - program uses PAUT-PCB-NUM = +2).

##### Inputs
SYSIN in-stream: `00,00001,00001,Y` read via `ACCEPT PRM-INFO FROM SYSIN` into: P-EXPIRY-DAYS 9(2), FILLER X, P-CHKP-FREQ X(5), FILLER X, P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ X(5), FILLER X, P-DEBUG-FLAG X ('Y'/'N'). Defaults: expiry non-numeric -> 5 days; chkp freq spaces/0/low -> 5; display freq -> 10; debug other than 'Y' -> 'N'. Date: ACCEPT FROM DAY (YYDDD).
IMS DB DBPAUTP0 (online, BMP), libraries IMS.SDFSRESL, XXXXXXXX.PROD.LOADLIB, IMS.PSBLIB/DBDLIB.

##### Processing flow
1. `1000-INITIALIZE` parse parameters and display them.
2. `2000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-SUMMARY`: `DLI GN PAUTSUM0`; '  ' -> count, WS-CURR-APP-ID = acct; 'GB' -> end; other -> abend.
3. For each summary: loop `3000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-DTL` (`GNP PAUTDTL1`; GE/GB -> no more). For each detail `4000-CHECK-IF-EXPIRED`: auth date = 99999 - PA-AUTH-DATE-9C (YYDDD); day diff = today YYDDD - auth date; if diff >= expiry days -> qualified: if resp '00' subtract 1 from approved count and PA-APPROVED-AMT from approved amount, else subtract 1 from declined count and PA-TRANSACTION-AMT from declined amount; `5000-DELETE-AUTH-DTL` = `DLI DLET PAUTDTL1` (error -> abend).
4. After details: `IF PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT <= 0 AND PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT <= 0` -> `6000-DELETE-AUTH-SUMMARY` (`DLI DLET PAUTSUM0`; deletes root and any remaining children per IMS hierarchy rules).
5. If summaries processed since last checkpoint > P-CHKP-FREQ -> `9000-TAKE-CHECKPOINT` (`DLI CHKP ID('RMAD0000')`, every P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ checkpoints DISPLAY progress) and reset counter.
6. Next summary; at end final checkpoint and DISPLAY totals (summaries read/deleted, details read/deleted). 9999-ABEND: DISPLAY, RC 16, GOBACK.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J["CBPAUP0J DFSRRC00 BMP CBPAUP0C PSBPAUTB"] --> I["1000-INITIALIZE SYSIN 00,00001,00001,Y"]
  I --> R["2000 GN PAUTSUM0"]
  R -->|GB| E["final CHKP, DISPLAY totals"]
  R -->|found| D["3000 GNP PAUTDTL1"]
  D -->|found| X{"today YYDDD - auth YYDDD >= expiry?"}
  X -->|yes| DL["adjust counts, DLET PAUTDTL1"] --> D
  X -->|no| D
  D -->|GE/GB| S{"approved cnt <= 0?"}
  S -->|yes| DS["DLET PAUTSUM0"]
  S -->|no| CK
  DS --> CK{"proc cnt > chkp freq?"}
  CK -->|yes| C["CHKP RMAD0000"] --> R
  CK -->|no| R
```

##### Data
IMS DBPAUTP0 PAUTSUM0 / PAUTDTL1 (layouts CIPAUSMY / CIPAUDTY) - read and deleted. Summary segments are *not* REPLaced after the in-memory count adjustments.

##### Outputs & side effects
Deleted detail and summary segments; IMS checkpoints; SYSOUT statistics; RC 16 on error.

##### External calls
DFSRRC00; EXEC DLI GN/GNP/DLET/CHKP.

##### Migration notes
- **Supplied SYSIN gives expiry = 00**, which is numeric, so every detail with day diff >= 0 (i.e. all) is deleted - the job as shipped purges all pending authorizations, not just 5-day-old ones.
- Summary-delete test checks PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT twice (declined count ignored), so a summary with only declined auths is deleted, and approved counts are only decremented in memory (never written back).
- Day difference uses YYDDD arithmetic - wrong across a year boundary (e.g. 26001 - 25365 = 636).
- P-CHKP-FREQ is alphanumeric X(5) compared with numeric counter 9(8).
- Checkpoint ID counter WK-CHKPT-ID-CTR is never incremented (always 'RMAD0000'); no symbolic checkpoint/restart areas, so restart re-processes from the start.
- WS-ERR-FLG is never set, so the outer loop ends only on GB or abend.
recommendation: Fully traced. Confirm intended expiry-days value with operations (the shipped 00 deletes everything) and whether summary counts should be persisted.
note: Duplicate of sfind-a1ed864f1dd142b0859bdc7dd3ad7e15 (CBPAUP0C / CBPAUP0J); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: COPAUS1C (TRANSID CPVD) - Authorization detail view and fraud mark/unmark
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `COPAUS1C`, transaction `CPVD`, map `COPAU1A` / mapset `COPAU01`. Entered by XCTL from COPAUS0C with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT = 0 and the selected auth key. EIBCALEN = 0 -> immediately XCTL back to COPAUS0C.

##### Inputs
COMMAREA COCOM01Y + `CDEMO-CPVD-INFO` (same byte layout as COPAUS0C's CDEMO-CPVS-INFO, so CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED is the key chosen on the list; plus CDEMO-CPVD-FRAUD-DATA X(100), always blanked on entry and otherwise unused). Uses CDEMO-ACCT-ID 9(11), CDEMO-CUST-ID 9(9). Screen input is RECEIVEd (NOHANDLE) but no input field is read - only the AID key matters.

##### Processing flow
1. First entry (not re-enter): set re-enter, `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`, send.
2. Re-enter by AID: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY + send; PF3 -> XCTL COPAUS0C (context ENTER); PF5 -> `MARK-AUTH-FRAUD` + send; PF8 -> `PROCESS-PF8-KEY` + send; other -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, invalid-key message, send. Final RETURN TRANSID CPVD with commarea.
3. `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`: clear map; if acct numeric and selected key non-blank -> `READ-AUTH-RECORD`, then SYNCPOINT to release PSB; else error flag (screen left blank). `POPULATE-AUTH-DETAILS`.
4. `READ-AUTH-RECORD`: SCHD PSBPAUTB; `GU PAUTSUM0 WHERE ACCNTID = acct`; if found `GNP PAUTDTL1 WHERE PAUT9CTS = key`. GE/GB -> AUTHS-EOF; other -> message + inline send.
5. `READ-NEXT-AUTH-RECORD` (PF8): plain GNP PAUTDTL1. PF8 path: read current, read next, syncpoint; EOF -> 'Already at the last Authorization...' (no erase, details not repopulated) else selected key = new key and populate.
6. `POPULATE-AUTH-DETAILS` (only if no error): CARDNUM, AUTHDT MM/DD/YY, AUTHTM HH:MM:SS, AUTHAMT (approved amt, -zzzzzzz9.99), AUTHRSP 'A' green if resp '00' else 'D' red, AUTHRSN = code '-' description via SEARCH ALL of WS-DECLINE-REASON-TABLE {0000 APPROVED, 3100 INVALID CARD, 4100 INSUFFICNT FUND, 4200 CARD NOT ACTIVE, 4300 ACCOUNT CLOSED, 4400 EXCED DAILY LMT, 5100 CARD FRAUD, 5200 MERCHANT FRAUD, 5300 LOST CARD, 9000 UNKNOWN} (not found -> '9999-ERROR'), AUTHCD processing code, POSEMD, AUTHSRC, MCCCD, CRDEXP 'MM/YY', AUTHTYP, TRNID, AUTHMTC match status, AUTHFRD = flag '-' fraud-report-date when 'F'/'R' else '-', merchant name/id/city/state/zip.
7. `MARK-AUTH-FRAUD` (PF5): READ-AUTH-RECORD; toggle: if PA-AUTH-FRAUD = 'F' -> set 'R' and action 'R' (remove), else set 'F' and action 'F' (report). Build WS-FRAUD-DATA {acct 9(11), cust 9(9), detail record X(200), action X1, status X1, message X50}; `EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM('COPAUS2C') COMMAREA(WS-FRAUD-DATA) NOHANDLE`. If LINK normal and status 'S' -> `UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS`; else message from COPAUS2C and `SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK`. Then repopulate.
8. `UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS`: copy returned record (with fraud report date set by COPAUS2C) to detail, DISPLAY 'RPT DT: ...', `DLI REPL PAUTDTL1`. OK -> SYNCPOINT, message 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...' or 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...'; else ROLLBACK and ' System error while FRAUD Tagging, ROLLBACK||' + status.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["CPVD COPAUS1C"] --> B{"EIBCALEN = 0?"}
  B -->|yes| X0["XCTL COPAUS0C"]
  B -->|first entry| EN["PROCESS-ENTER-KEY"]
  B -->|re-enter| K{"EIBAID"}
  K -->|ENTER/other| EN
  K -->|PF3| X0
  K -->|PF8| P8["READ current + GNP next"]
  K -->|PF5| FR["MARK-AUTH-FRAUD toggle F/R"]
  EN --> RD["SCHD, GU PAUTSUM0, GNP PAUTDTL1 by PAUT9CTS"]
  FR --> RD2["READ-AUTH-RECORD"] --> L["LINK COPAUS2C"]
  L -->|status S| UP["REPL PAUTDTL1, SYNCPOINT"]
  L -->|fail| RB["SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK"]
  RD --> PO["POPULATE-AUTH-DETAILS"]
  P8 --> PO
  UP --> PO
  RB --> PO
  PO --> S["SEND COPAU1A, RETURN TRANSID CPVD"]
```

##### Data
IMS DBPAUTP0 via PSBPAUTB PCB 1: PAUTSUM0 (GU), PAUTDTL1 (GNP, REPL). Indirect DB2 write of CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS through COPAUS2C, in the same CICS unit of work.

##### Outputs & side effects
Screen COPAU1A; IMS detail segment PA-AUTH-FRAUD ('F'/'R') and PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE (MM/DD/YY from COPAUS2C) updated; AUTHFRDS row inserted/updated; SYNCPOINT or ROLLBACK covering both IMS and DB2.

##### External calls
`COPAUS2C` via LINK (272-byte commarea described above; returns status 'S'/'F' and message X50, and modified fraud date inside the record). XCTL to COPAUS0C.

##### Migration notes
- REPL is issued after GU/GNP *without hold* (no GHU/GHNP). Standard DL/I rules require a get-hold before REPL; on a real IMS this would be expected to return a non-blank status (and hit the ROLLBACK branch). Could not be confirmed statically - verify on the runtime whether fraud tagging actually succeeds.
- If the detail is not found (EOF) or a DL/I error occurs, MARK-AUTH-FRAUD still toggles the flag on whatever is in the buffer and LINKs to COPAUS2C.
- After ROLLBACK the screen still shows the toggled fraud flag from working storage.
- Read errors SEND the map inline and processing continues (possible multiple SENDs).
- Fraud toggle semantics: any value other than 'F' (including spaces and 'R') becomes 'F'.
- CDEMO-CPVD-* and CDEMO-CPVS-* overlay the same commarea bytes; the new stack must keep the selected key handoff.
recommendation: Medium confidence only because REPL-without-hold runtime behaviour cannot be confirmed statically; validate on the IMS runtime whether PF5 fraud tagging completes or always rolls back.
note: Duplicate of sfind-cc42995660ad4a41817741c9156ff0d6 (COPAUS1C (CPVD) authorization detail view and fraud toggle); unique migration notes folded into that finding.
