title: COTRTLIC (TRANSID CTLI) - Transaction type list/filter/update/delete screen (DB2)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `COTRTLIC`, transaction `CTLI` (CSD CRDDEMOD.csd; DB2TRAN CTLITRAN -> DB2ENTRY CARDDEMO, plan CARDDEMO), map `CTRTLIA` / mapset `COTRTLI`. Reached from the admin menu `COADM01C` (CA00) or directly; PF2 goes to add program `COTRTUPC` (CTTU).

##### Inputs
- COMMAREA (2000 bytes returned): CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (COCOM01Y) + `WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA`: WS-CA-TYPE-CD X2 (last type filter), WS-CA-TYPE-DESC X50 (last desc filter), WS-CA-ALL-ROWS-OUT 7 x (code X2 + desc X50), WS-CA-ROW-SELECTED S9(4) COMP, paging: LAST-TR-CODE X2, FIRST-TR-CODE X2, WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM 9(1) (88 CA-FIRST-PAGE = 1), WS-CA-LAST-PAGE-DISPLAYED 9(1) (0 shown / 9 not shown), WS-CA-NEXT-PAGE-IND X1 ('Y' exists / low-values not), WS-CA-DELETE-FLAG X1, WS-CA-UPDATE-FLAG X1 ('Y' requested, low-values = not requested AND succeeded).
- Screen: TRTYPE (type filter, 2), TRDESC (desc filter, 50), per row 1..7: TRTSEL (action 'D'/'U'), TRTTYP (code), TRTYPD (desc, editable on update). AID via CSSTRPFY (`YYYY-STORE-PFKEY`).

##### Processing flow
1. `0000-MAIN`: initialise; EIBCALEN = 0 -> fresh commarea, admin user, first page. Else split commarea. Store AID. If entering from another program (PGM-ENTER and from-program not this) or PF3 coming back from CTTU -> reset local area, treat as ENTER, first page.
2. If re-entering from itself: `1000-RECEIVE-MAP` -> `1100-RECEIVE-SCREEN` (filters; per-row selection, code, trimmed desc ('*' or spaces -> low-values)) -> `1200-EDIT-INPUTS`: `1210-EDIT-ARRAY` (if a filter changed: clear selections; else count blanks/'D'/'U'; >1 action -> 'Please select only 1 action'; invalid code -> 'Action code selected is invalid'; for 'U' `1211-EDIT-ARRAY-DESC`: case-insensitive trimmed compare with DB value -> 'No change detected with respect to database values.'; else `1240-EDIT-ALPHANUM-REQD` - required, only A-Z a-z 0-9 and spaces: '<name> must be supplied.' / '<name> can have numbers or alphabets only.'), remember selected row (changed -> FLG-ROW-SELECTION-CHANGED-YES); `1230-EDIT-DESC` (non-blank -> filter '%'+trim+'%'; change resets paging); `1220-EDIT-TYPECD` (blank/0 -> no filter; non-numeric -> 'TYPE CODE FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 2 DIGIT NUMBER'; change resets paging); `1290-CROSS-EDITS` (if any filter: `9100-CHECK-FILTERS` SELECT COUNT(1) with the same predicates; 0 -> 'No Records found for these filter conditions', rows protected).
3. Valid keys: ENTER, PF2, PF3, PF7, PF8, PF10 (only if delete/update was requested on the previous turn); others treated as ENTER. PF10 is downgraded to ENTER if filters or row selection changed.
4. PF3: to-tranid/program = caller (or CA00/COADM01C if blank or self), SYNCPOINT, XCTL. PF2 (from self): XCTL `COTRTUPC`.
5. `9998-PRIMING-QUERY` (SELECT 1 FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1); failure -> SEND TEXT of formatted DB2 message and RETURN (no TRANSID).
6. EVALUATE:
   - INPUT-ERROR: read forward from first code (unless a filter is bad) and send.
   - PF7 on first page: re-read forward from first code.
   - PF3 / re-enter from other program: reset and read first page.
   - PF8 with next page: start = LAST-TR-CODE, screen num +1, read forward, clear selections.
   - PF7 not first page: start = FIRST-TR-CODE, screen num -1, `8100-READ-BACKWARDS`.
   - ENTER with 1 delete requested: re-display, row highlighted, info 'Delete HIGHLIGHTED row ? Press F10 to confirm'.
   - PF10 with delete: `9300-DELETE-RECORD` (`DELETE FROM CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE WHERE TR_TYPE = :code`; 0 -> SYNCPOINT, 'HIGHLIGHTED row deleted.Hit Enter to continue'; -532 -> 'Please delete associated child records first:' + DSNTIAC text; other -> 'Delete failed with message:'); after a successful delete the commarea is reset to first page.
   - ENTER with update requested: re-display with description unprotected, 'Update HIGHLIGHTED row. Press F10 to save'.
   - PF10 with update: `9200-UPDATE-RECORD` (`UPDATE ... SET TR_DESCRIPTION = :desc WHERE TR_TYPE = :code`; 0 -> SYNCPOINT, 'HIGHLIGHTED row was updated'; +100 'Record not found. Deleted by others ? '; -911 'Deadlock. Someone else updating ?'; <0 'Update failed with'), then re-read forward from first code.
   - OTHER: read forward from first code and send.
7. `8000-READ-FORWARD`: OPEN cursor `C-TR-TYPE-FORWARD` = `SELECT TR_TYPE, TR_DESCRIPTION FROM CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE WHERE TR_TYPE >= :WS-START-KEY AND ((:type-flag='1' AND TR_TYPE = :type-filter) OR :type-flag<>'1') AND ((:desc-flag='1' AND TR_DESCRIPTION LIKE TRIM(:desc-filter)) OR :desc-flag<>'1') ORDER BY TR_TYPE`; fetch up to 7 rows into commarea; on the 7th fetch one more to set next-page indicator and LAST-TR-CODE (= the 8th row's code); +100 -> no next page ('No more pages for these search conditions' on PF8; 'No records found for this search condition.' when page 1 empty); CLOSE.
8. `8100-READ-BACKWARDS`: cursor `C-TR-TYPE-BACKWARD` (TR_TYPE < start, same filters, ORDER BY TR_TYPE DESC) fills rows 7..1, FIRST-TR-CODE = last fetched.
9. `2000-SEND-MAP`: header, PAGENO = screen num, row attributes (protect empty rows; red for row errors; neutral highlight for selected; FSET/unprotect desc for update), filter echo/attributes, centred info message, SEND MAP ERASE FREEKB; `COMMON-RETURN`: RETURN TRANSID CTLI COMMAREA(2000).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["CTLI COTRTLIC 0000-MAIN"] --> RC{"re-enter from self?"}
  RC -->|yes| RM["1000-RECEIVE-MAP + 1200-EDIT-INPUTS"]
  RC -->|no| PK
  RM --> PK{"AID"}
  PK -->|PF3| X3["SYNCPOINT XCTL caller or COADM01C"]
  PK -->|PF2| X2["XCTL COTRTUPC"]
  PK --> PQ["9998 priming SELECT SYSDUMMY1"]
  PQ -->|error| TX["SEND TEXT, RETURN"]
  PQ --> EV{"EVALUATE"}
  EV -->|PF8| F["8000-READ-FORWARD cursor FORWARD"]
  EV -->|PF7| B["8100-READ-BACKWARDS cursor BACKWARD"]
  EV -->|PF10 + D| DL["9300 DELETE + SYNCPOINT"]
  EV -->|PF10 + U| UP["9200 UPDATE + SYNCPOINT"] --> F
  EV -->|ENTER/other| F
  F --> SM["2000-SEND-MAP"]
  B --> SM
  DL --> SM
  SM --> RT["RETURN TRANSID CTLI COMMAREA 2000"]
```

##### Data
DB2 `CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE` (TR_TYPE CHAR2 PK, TR_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR50) read via two cursors and COUNT, updated and deleted. FK from `TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY` (ON DELETE RESTRICT) produces SQLCODE -532 on delete of a parent with categories. DCLGEN DCLTRTYP host vars DCL-TR-TYPE X2, DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION (LEN S9(4) COMP + TEXT X50).

##### Outputs & side effects
Screen CTRTLIA; DB2 update/delete committed by explicit CICS SYNCPOINT; error text built by `9999-FORMAT-DB2-MESSAGE` (CALL 'DSNTIAC' USING DFHEIBLK, DFHCOMMAREA, SQLCA, 10x72 message area, LRECL 72).

##### External calls
`DSNTIAC` (DB2 message formatter); XCTL `COTRTUPC` (PF2) and caller/`COADM01C` (PF3) with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA.

##### Migration notes
- Update stores `DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION-LEN = FUNCTION LENGTH(WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN)` = 50 always, so updated descriptions are saved right-padded with spaces to 50.
- Description validation allows only letters, digits and spaces; change detection is case-insensitive (changing only case is rejected as 'No change').
- LIKE filter is case-sensitive and substring ('%x%').
- WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM is PIC 9(1): page numbers wrap after 9 (truncation) which also breaks CA-FIRST-PAGE logic.
- Backward cursor treats +100 as an error (WHEN OTHER) and shows a DB2 message if fewer than 7 earlier rows exist.
- 88 levels CA-DELETE-SUCCEEDED / CA-DELETE-NOT-REQUESTED share LOW-VALUES (same for update) - 'succeeded' tests are true whenever nothing was requested.
- Duplicate WHEN for 'PF7 AND CA-FIRST-PAGE'; WS-TYPE-CD-DELETE-FILTER is declared but unused.
- PF3 takes a SYNCPOINT before XCTL; DB2 errors in priming query end the conversation (RETURN without TRANSID).

title: COPAUS2C - Fraud record insert/update in DB2 CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS (LINKed subprogram)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS program `COPAUS2C`, invoked only via `EXEC CICS LINK` from COPAUS1C (MARK-AUTH-FRAUD). CSD lists TRANSID(CPVD) on the PROGRAM definition; DB2TRAN CPVDTRAN maps CPVD to DB2ENTRY AWS01PLN (plan AWS01PLN). Returns with `EXEC CICS RETURN`.

##### Inputs
LINKAGE DFHCOMMAREA (272 bytes): WS-ACCT-ID 9(11), WS-CUST-ID 9(9), WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD = CIPAUDTY detail segment layout (200 bytes), WS-FRD-ACTION X1 ('F' report / 'R' remove), WS-FRD-UPDATE-STATUS X1 (out), WS-FRD-ACT-MSG X50 (out).

##### Processing flow
1. ASKTIME + FORMATTIME MMDDYY with DATESEP -> WS-CUR-DATE 'MM/DD/YY'; moved into PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE of the caller's record (returned to caller).
2. Build AUTH-TS text: YY-MM-DD from PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE(1:2/3:2/5:2); time = 999999999 - PA-AUTH-TIME-9C (i.e. the *processing* HHMMSSmmm from the IMS key, not the original request time) -> 'YY-MM-DD HH.MI.SSmmm000' (23 chars in a X(26) host var, space padded).
3. Map detail fields to DCLAUTHFRDS host variables; MERCHANT-NAME VARCHAR length = 22 always; AUTH-FRAUD = action; ACCT-ID, CUST-ID from commarea.
4. `INSERT INTO CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS (...) VALUES (..., TIMESTAMP_FORMAT(:AUTH-TS,'YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN'), ..., FRAUD_RPT_DATE = CURRENT DATE, ...)`.
5. SQLCODE 0 -> status 'S', 'ADD SUCCESS'. SQLCODE -803 (duplicate PK CARD_NUM+AUTH_TS) -> `FRAUD-UPDATE`: `UPDATE AUTHFRDS SET AUTH_FRAUD = :AUTH-FRAUD, FRAUD_RPT_DATE = CURRENT DATE WHERE CARD_NUM = :CARD-NUM AND AUTH_TS = TIMESTAMP_FORMAT(...)`; 0 -> 'S' 'UPDT SUCCESS', else 'F' ' UPDT ERROR DB2: CODE:<sqlcode>, STATE: <sqlstate>'. Other SQLCODE -> 'F' ' SYSTEM ERROR DB2: CODE:..., STATE: ...'.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["LINK from COPAUS1C"] --> B["FORMATTIME MM/DD/YY -> PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE"]
  B --> C["Build AUTH-TS from orig date + inverted time key"]
  C --> D["INSERT CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS"]
  D -->|SQLCODE 0| S["status S ADD SUCCESS"]
  D -->|-803| U["FRAUD-UPDATE UPDATE AUTH_FRAUD, FRAUD_RPT_DATE"]
  U -->|0| S2["status S UPDT SUCCESS"]
  U -->|else| F2["status F UPDT ERROR"]
  D -->|other| F["status F SYSTEM ERROR"]
  S --> R["CICS RETURN"]
  S2 --> R
  F --> R
  F2 --> R
```

##### Data
DB2 table `CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS` (AUTHFRDS.ddl): CARD_NUM CHAR16 NN, AUTH_TS TIMESTAMP NN, AUTH_TYPE CHAR4, CARD_EXPIRY_DATE CHAR4, MESSAGE_TYPE CHAR6, MESSAGE_SOURCE CHAR6, AUTH_ID_CODE CHAR6, AUTH_RESP_CODE CHAR2, AUTH_RESP_REASON CHAR4, PROCESSING_CODE CHAR6, TRANSACTION_AMT DEC(12,2), APPROVED_AMT DEC(12,2), MERCHANT_CATAGORY_CODE CHAR4, ACQR_COUNTRY_CODE CHAR3, POS_ENTRY_MODE SMALLINT, MERCHANT_ID CHAR15, MERCHANT_NAME VARCHAR22, MERCHANT_CITY CHAR13, MERCHANT_STATE CHAR2, MERCHANT_ZIP CHAR9, TRANSACTION_ID CHAR15, MATCH_STATUS CHAR1, AUTH_FRAUD CHAR1, FRAUD_RPT_DATE DATE, ACCT_ID DEC(11), CUST_ID DEC(9); PK (CARD_NUM, AUTH_TS); unique index XAUTHFRD (CARD_NUM ASC, AUTH_TS DESC). DCLGEN AUTHFRDS.dcl host vars (amounts COMP-3, POS SMALLINT COMP).

##### Outputs & side effects
One AUTHFRDS row inserted or its fraud flag/date updated; commarea status/message and fraud date returned. No COMMIT here - the caller SYNCPOINTs or rolls back.

##### External calls
DB2 via CICS attachment (plan AWS01PLN). None other.

##### Migration notes
- AUTH_TS combines the request's original date with the *system processing time* stored (inverted) in the IMS key; a remove ('R') on the same auth updates the same row via the -803 path, so removal never deletes - it sets AUTH_FRAUD = 'R'.
- Year is 2-digit (TIMESTAMP_FORMAT 'YY'); century inference is DB2's.
- PROCESSING_CODE is 9(6) moved to CHAR(6); POS_ENTRY_MODE 9(2) moved to SMALLINT.
- MERCHANT_NAME always stored with length 22 (trailing spaces kept).
- Two different dates: IMS gets MM/DD/YY from CICS time, DB2 gets CURRENT DATE.
recommendation: Fully documented.

title: COPAUS0C (TRANSID CPVS) - Pending authorization summary/list screen
description:
##### Entry point
CICS pseudo-conversational program `COPAUS0C`, transaction `CPVS`, map `COPAU0A` in mapset `COPAU00`. Reached by XCTL from the main menu (`COMEN01C`) or from `COPAUS1C` (PF3), or by typing CPVS (EIBCALEN = 0).

##### Inputs
- COMMAREA `CARDDEMO-COMMAREA` (COCOM01Y: from/to tranid X4/program X8, user id X8, user type X1, CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT 9(1) [0 enter, 1 re-enter], customer id 9(9)+names, CDEMO-ACCT-ID 9(11), acct status X1, CDEMO-CARD-NUM 9(16), last map/mapset X7) followed by program extension `CDEMO-CPVS-INFO`: PAU-SEL-FLG X1, PAU-SELECTED X8, PAUKEY-PREV-PG X8 OCCURS 20, PAUKEY-LAST X8, PAGE-NUM S9(4) COMP, NEXT-PAGE-FLG X1, AUTH-KEYS X8 OCCURS 5.
- Screen fields (COPAU0AI): ACCTID (account id), SEL0001..SEL0005 (row selection), AID key.

##### Processing flow
1. MAIN-PARA resets flags, cursor on ACCTID. EIBCALEN = 0: initialise commarea, mark re-enter, send empty screen.
2. Commarea present and not re-enter (first arrival via XCTL): mark re-enter; if CDEMO-ACCT-ID numeric use it, else blank; `GATHER-DETAILS`; send with ERASE.
3. Re-enter: RECEIVE map, then by EIBAID:
   - ENTER -> `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`: blank ACCTID -> 'Please enter Acct Id...'; non-numeric -> 'Acct Id must be Numeric ...'; else store to WS-ACCT-ID and CDEMO-ACCT-ID, take the first non-blank SEL000n (1..5) as flag and the matching CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS(n) as selected key. If flag 'S'/'s' -> set to-program COPAUS1C, from CPVS/COPAUS0C, context ENTER, `XCTL COPAUS1C`. Other flag -> 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S'. Then `GATHER-DETAILS` and send.
   - PF3 -> to-program COMEN01C; `RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN` (defaults to COSGN00C if blank) XCTL.
   - PF7 -> `PROCESS-PF7-KEY`: if page > 1 then page-1, key = PREV-PG(page), GET-AUTH-SUMMARY, re-init rows, PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD (first row via REPOSITION); else 'You are already at the top of the page...'.
   - PF8 -> `PROCESS-PF8-KEY`: if PAUKEY-LAST set, GET-AUTH-SUMMARY + REPOSITION at last key; if NEXT-PAGE-YES (from commarea) re-init rows and page forward, else 'You are already at the bottom of the page...'.
   - other -> CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY.
4. `GATHER-DETAILS`: page = 0; if account id present: `GATHER-ACCOUNT-DETAILS`, `INITIALIZE-AUTH-DATA` (protect SELn, blank row fields), and if summary found `PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD`.
5. `GATHER-ACCOUNT-DETAILS`: READ `CXACAIX` (card xref alternate index by account id) -> CDEMO-CUST-ID/CDEMO-CARD-NUM; READ `ACCTDAT` by XREF-ACCT-ID; READ `CUSTDAT` by XREF-CUST-ID. Builds CUSTID, CNAME = first + ' ' + middle initial + ' ' + last, ADDR001 = line1 ',' line2, ADDR002 = line3 ',' state ',' zip(1:5), PHONE1, CREDLIM (-zzzzzzz9.99), CASHLIM (-zzzz9.99). Then `GET-AUTH-SUMMARY`; if found shows APPRCNT, DECLCNT (9(3)), CREDBAL, CASHBAL, APPRAMT, DECLAMT; else zeros.
6. `GET-AUTH-SUMMARY`: `SCHEDULE-PSB` (SCHD PSBPAUTB, TC -> TERM+SCHD) and `DLI GU PAUTSUM0 WHERE ACCNTID = CDEMO-ACCT-ID`.
7. `PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD`: up to 5 rows: GNP PAUTDTL1 (or REPOSITION GNP WHERE PAUT9CTS = saved key when EIBAID = PF7 and row 1); `POPULATE-AUTH-LIST` per row; remember PAUKEY-LAST; when the first row has been added, page+1 and PREV-PG(page) = first key. After 5 rows one extra GNP decides NEXT-PAGE-YES/NO.
8. `POPULATE-AUTH-LIST`: row n: AUTH-KEYS(n) = key, TRNID = PA-TRANSACTION-ID, PDATE = MM/DD/YY from PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE (YYMMDD), PTIME = HH:MM:SS from PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME, PTYPE = PA-AUTH-TYPE, PAPRV = 'A' if resp '00' else 'D', PSTAT = PA-MATCH-STATUS, PAMT = PA-APPROVED-AMT (-zzzzzzz9.99), SELn unprotected.
9. `SEND-PAULST-SCREEN`: if PSB scheduled -> CICS SYNCPOINT (releases PSB); header (titles, CPVS, COPAUS0C, date mm/dd/yy, time); SEND map with or without ERASE. Final `EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CPVS') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)`.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["CPVS COPAUS0C"] --> B{"EIBCALEN = 0?"}
  B -->|yes| S["SEND-PAULST-SCREEN blank"]
  B -->|no, first entry| G["GATHER-DETAILS"]
  B -->|re-enter| R["RECEIVE COPAU0A"]
  R --> K{"EIBAID"}
  K -->|ENTER| E["PROCESS-ENTER-KEY validate ACCTID / SELn"]
  E -->|SEL = S| X["XCTL COPAUS1C"]
  E --> G
  K -->|PF3| M["XCTL COMEN01C"]
  K -->|PF7| P7["PROCESS-PF7-KEY"]
  K -->|PF8| P8["PROCESS-PF8-KEY"]
  K -->|other| S
  G --> AD["READ CXACAIX, ACCTDAT, CUSTDAT"]
  AD --> SU["SCHD PSBPAUTB, GU PAUTSUM0"]
  SU --> PF["PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD GNP PAUTDTL1 x5"]
  P7 --> PF
  P8 --> PF
  PF --> S
  S --> RT["RETURN TRANSID CPVS"]
```

##### Data
Read-only: VSAM `CXACAIX` (CVACT03Y layout, keyed by 11-char account id), `ACCTDAT` (CVACT01Y), `CUSTDAT` (CVCUS01Y); IMS DBPAUTP0 PAUTSUM0 (GU) and PAUTDTL1 (GNP / GNP qualified on PAUT9CTS). Copybooks CVACT02Y (card) is included but unused; `CARDDAT` and `CCXREF` names declared but unused.

##### Outputs & side effects
Screen COPAU0A (header, customer block, summary totals, 5 auth rows, ERRMSG). COMMAREA updated: CDEMO-ACCT-ID, CDEMO-CUST-ID, CDEMO-CARD-NUM, paging keys, selected key. No data updates (SYNCPOINT only releases the PSB).

##### External calls
XCTL to `COPAUS1C` (commarea incl. CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED = 8-byte auth key), `COMEN01C` or `COSGN00C`. EXEC DLI SCHD/GU/GNP/TERM.

##### Migration notes
- Read errors call SEND-PAULST-SCREEN *inline* and then continue, so a single task can SEND the map several times; XREF/ACCT/CUST NOTFND does not set the error flag, so later reads proceed with stale keys.
- SEND-PAULST-SCREEN takes a SYNCPOINT that ends the PSB schedule; if it is invoked mid-loop (error paths) subsequent GNP calls run without a scheduled PSB.
- Paging counter quirk: PF7 decrements CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM and PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD increments it again and overwrites PREV-PG(page) with the previous page's first key, so after PF7 the stored page number is unchanged and the previous-page table is shifted. Repeated PF7 can redisplay the same page. PREV-PG has 20 entries with no bound check.
- GET-AUTH-SUMMARY keys on CDEMO-ACCT-ID (commarea), not WS-ACCT-ID.
- Account id must be numeric 11 chars (PICIN/NUMERIC test). Selection accepts only 'S' or 's' and only the first non-blank row is honoured.
- Dates shown MM/DD/YY derived from the request's YYMMDD; amounts shown are APPROVED amounts (0 for declines).
recommendation: Fully traced. Re-implementation should decide whether to reproduce the PF7 page-number quirk; recommend confirming expected paging behaviour with users.

Commentary: PF7/PF8 paging and PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD key bookkeeping.
Code:
         PROCESS-PF7-KEY.
        *****************************************************************
  
             IF CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM > 1
                COMPUTE CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM = CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM - 1
  
                MOVE CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG(CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM)
                                             TO WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE
                PERFORM GET-AUTH-SUMMARY
  
                SET SEND-ERASE-NO            TO TRUE
  
                SET NEXT-PAGE-YES            TO TRUE
                MOVE -1                      TO ACCTIDL OF COPAU0AI
  
                PERFORM INITIALIZE-AUTH-DATA
  
                PERFORM PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD
             ELSE
                MOVE 'You are already at the top of the page...' TO
                                 WS-MESSAGE
                SET SEND-ERASE-NO            TO TRUE
             END-IF
             .
  
        *****************************************************************
         PROCESS-PF8-KEY.
        *****************************************************************
  
             IF CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES
                 MOVE LOW-VALUES             TO WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE
             ELSE
                 MOVE CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST TO WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE
  
                 PERFORM GET-AUTH-SUMMARY
                 PERFORM REPOSITION-AUTHORIZATIONS
             END-IF
  
             MOVE -1                         TO ACCTIDL OF COPAU0AI
  
             SET SEND-ERASE-NO               TO TRUE
  
             IF NEXT-PAGE-YES
                 PERFORM INITIALIZE-AUTH-DATA
  
                 PERFORM PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD
             ELSE
                 MOVE 'You are already at the bottom of the page...'
                                             TO WS-MESSAGE
             END-IF
             .
  
        *****************************************************************
         PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD.
        *****************************************************************
  
             IF ERR-FLG-OFF
  
                 MOVE 1             TO  WS-IDX
  
                 MOVE LOW-VALUES    TO CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST
  
                 PERFORM UNTIL WS-IDX > 5 OR AUTHS-EOF OR ERR-FLG-ON
                     IF EIBAID = DFHPF7 AND WS-IDX = 1
                        PERFORM REPOSITION-AUTHORIZATIONS
                     ELSE
                        PERFORM GET-AUTHORIZATIONS
                     END-IF
                     IF AUTHS-NOT-EOF AND ERR-FLG-OFF
                         PERFORM POPULATE-AUTH-LIST
                         COMPUTE WS-IDX = WS-IDX + 1
  
                         MOVE PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY TO
                                               CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST
                         IF WS-IDX = 2
                            COMPUTE CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM =
                                    CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM + 1
                            MOVE PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY TO
                            CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG(CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM)
                         END-IF
                     END-IF
                 END-PERFORM
  
                 IF AUTHS-NOT-EOF AND ERR-FLG-OFF
                     PERFORM GET-AUTHORIZATIONS
                     IF AUTHS-NOT-EOF AND ERR-FLG-OFF
                         SET NEXT-PAGE-YES TO TRUE
                     ELSE
                         SET NEXT-PAGE-NO TO TRUE
                     END-IF
                 END-IF
  
             END-IF.
  
  
        *****************************************************************
         GET-AUTHORIZATIONS.
        *****************************************************************

title: BMS COACTVW / map CACTVWA - View Account screen contract
description:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  H["Header TRNNAME, TITLE01/02, CURDATE, PGMNAME, CURTIME"] --> I["Input ACCTSID 11 digits"]
  I --> A["Account block"] --> C["Customer block"] --> M["INFOMSG / ERRMSG / F3=Exit"]
```
Fields (name row,col len): header TRNNAME 1,7 4; TITLE01 1,21 40; CURDATE 1,71 8 ('mm/dd/yy'); PGMNAME 2,7 8; TITLE02 2,21 40; CURTIME 2,71 8 ('hh:mm:ss'). Account: ACSTTUS 5,70 1 (Active Y/N); ADTOPEN 6,17 10; ACRDLIM 6,61 15 PICOUT '+ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.99'; AEXPDT 7,17 10; ACSHLIM 7,61 15 (same PICOUT); AREISDT 8,17 10; ACURBAL 8,61 15; ACRCYCR 9,61 15; AADDGRP 10,23 10; ACRCYDB 10,61 15. INFOMSG 22,23 45 PROT neutral; ERRMSG 23,1 78 ASKIP/BRT/FSET red; literal ' F3=Exit ' at 24,1.

##### Data
Display-only fields map to ACCOUNT-RECORD (CVACT01Y) and CUSTOMER-RECORD (CVCUS01Y) values formatted by the program.

N/A (definition).

N/A.

Amount fields use PICOUT '+ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.99' (leading sign, thousands separators). Output fields without ATTRB default to unprotected in BMS unless the program sets attributes - the program is responsible for protecting them. SSN field is 12 chars (formatted NNN-NN-NNNN by the program). ADDR line 3 is labelled 'City'.

title: CRDDEMO2 CSD - CICS resources for the pending-authorization module
description:
##### Entry point
CICS CSD group `CARDDEMO` definitions (online entry points):
- TRANSACTION `CP00` -> PROGRAM `COPAUA0C` (MQ-triggered authorization engine).
- TRANSACTION `CPVS` -> PROGRAM `COPAUS0C` (authorization summary screen).
- TRANSACTION `CPVD` -> PROGRAM `COPAUS1C` (authorization detail screen).
- PROGRAM `COPAUS2C` (DB2 fraud writer; LINK target; CSD sets TRANSID(CPVD) on the program definition).
- MAPSET `COPAU00` (summary map) and `COPAU01` (details map).
- DB2ENTRY `AWS01PLN` (PLAN AWS01PLN, AUTHTYPE USERID, THREADLIMIT 1, THREADWAIT YES, DROLLBACK YES) and DB2TRAN `CPVDTRAN` mapping TRANSID CPVD to that entry.

##### Inputs
N/A (definitions).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  MQ["MQ trigger"] --> CP00["CP00"] --> A0["COPAUA0C"]
  MENU["COMEN01C"] -->|XCTL| S0["COPAUS0C / CPVS"]
  S0 -->|XCTL| S1["COPAUS1C / CPVD"]
  S1 -->|LINK| S2["COPAUS2C"]
  S2 --> DB2["DB2ENTRY AWS01PLN via DB2TRAN CPVDTRAN"]
```
All transactions: PROFILE DFHCICST, TASKDATALOC ANY, ISOLATE YES, ACTION(BACKOUT), PRIORITY 1, TRANCLASS DFHTCL00. Programs: COBOL, RELOAD(YES), CONCURRENCY QUASIRENT, EXECKEY USER, DATALOCATION ANY.

No FILE definitions in this group: ACCTDAT, CUSTDAT, CCXREF, CXACAIX used by these programs are defined elsewhere (base CardDemo CSD).

N/A.

N/A.

##### Migration notes
COPAUS2C runs under the calling task CPVD, so its DB2 work uses plan AWS01PLN through DB2TRAN CPVDTRAN with a single thread (THREADLIMIT 1, THREADWAIT YES) - concurrency is serialised. The MQ trigger process/initiation queue definitions for CP00 are not in this repository.

title: PAUDBUNL / job UNLDPADB - Unload pending-authorization IMS database to flat files
description:
##### Entry point
Batch IMS DL/I program `PAUDBUNL` (internal WS name 'IMSUNLOD'), run by JCL `UNLDPADB` step STEP01 `EXEC PGM=DFSRRC00,PARM='DLI,PAUDBUNL,PAUTBUNL,,,,,,,,,,,N'` (DLI region, PSB `PAUTBUNL`). `PROCEDURE DIVISION USING PAUTBPCB` with `ENTRY 'DLITCBL' USING PAUTBPCB`. Preceding STEP0 (IEFBR14) deletes the previous outputs (`AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PAUTDB.ROOT.FILEO`, `...CHILD.FILEO`, DISP=(OLD,DELETE,DELETE)).

##### Inputs
IMS DB DBPAUTP0 (DD DDPAUTP0 = OEM.IMS.IMSP.PAUTHDB, index DDPAUTX0 = OEM.IMS.IMSP.PAUTHDBX) via PSB PAUTBUNL (single DB PCB, PROCOPT=GOTP, KEYLEN 14, SENSEG PAUTSUM0 + PAUTDTL1). PCB mask PAUTBPCB: DBDNAME X8, SEG-LEVEL X2, STATUS X2, PROCOPT X4, FILLER S9(5) COMP, SEG-NAME X8, KEYFB length S9(5) COMP, NUM-SENSEGS S9(5) COMP, KEYFB X255. No SYSIN/PARM parameters.

##### Processing flow
1. `1000-INITIALIZE`: ACCEPT DATE/DAY, DISPLAY banner; OPEN OUTPUT OPFILE1 (DD OUTFIL1) and OPFILE2 (DD OUTFIL2); status not spaces/'00' -> 9999-ABEND.
2. Loop `2000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-SUMMARY` until WS-END-OF-ROOT-SEG = 'Y': `CALL 'CBLTDLI' USING 'GN  ', PAUTBPCB, PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY, ROOT-UNQUAL-SSA ('PAUTSUM0 ')`. Status spaces: count, OPFIL1-REC = summary (100 bytes); ROOT-SEG-KEY = PA-ACCT-ID; if PA-ACCT-ID numeric (valid packed) WRITE OPFIL1-REC and loop `3000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-DTL` until child end. Status 'GB' -> end. Any other status -> DISPLAY status and key feedback, 9999-ABEND.
3. `3000`: `CBLTDLI 'GNP '` with 'PAUTDTL1 ' SSA into PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS. Spaces -> CHILD-SEG-REC = detail, WRITE OPFIL2-REC (root key + child). 'GE' -> child end (DISPLAY 'CHILD SEG FLAG GE : Y'). Other -> abend. Status re-initialised.
4. `4000-FILE-CLOSE`: close both, display close errors; GOBACK.
5. `9999-ABEND`: DISPLAY 'IMSUNLOD ABENDING ...', RETURN-CODE 16, GOBACK (files not closed).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J["UNLDPADB STEP0 IEFBR14 delete old files"] --> S1["STEP01 DFSRRC00 DLI PAUDBUNL PSB PAUTBUNL"]
  S1 --> I["1000-INITIALIZE OPEN OUTFIL1, OUTFIL2"]
  I --> R["2000 GN PAUTSUM0"]
  R -->|status spaces, key numeric| W1["WRITE OUTFIL1 summary 100B"]
  W1 --> C["3000 GNP PAUTDTL1"]
  C -->|spaces| W2["WRITE OUTFIL2 key+detail 206B"] --> C
  C -->|GE| R
  R -->|GB| CL["4000-FILE-CLOSE GOBACK"]
  R -->|other| AB["9999-ABEND RC 16"]
  C -->|other| AB
```

##### Data
- OUTFIL1 `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PAUTDB.ROOT.FILEO` FB LRECL 100: raw PAUTSUM0 image (CIPAUSMY layout incl. COMP-3/COMP fields).
- OUTFIL2 `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PAUTDB.CHILD.FILEO` FB LRECL 206: ROOT-SEG-KEY S9(11) COMP-3 (6 bytes) + CHILD-SEG-REC X(200) raw PAUTDTL1 (CIPAUDTY).
- IMS DBPAUTP0 read only.

##### Outputs & side effects
Two binary sequential files; DISPLAY counters/messages to SYSOUT; RC 16 on failure.

##### External calls
`CBLTDLI` (function code X4 from IMSFUNCS, PCB, I/O area, unqualified SSA X9). DFSRRC00 region controller.

##### Migration notes
- Output files are binary (packed decimal, halfword counts); the reload (PAUDBLOD, outside batch) expects this exact layout.
- Summaries whose PA-ACCT-ID is not valid packed are skipped *and their children are not read*; subsequent GN continues at the next root.
- WS-NO-SUMRY-READ is incremented for both roots and details; other counters declared are never used/displayed.
- GNP returning 'GB' (instead of 'GE') would be treated as an error and abend.
- STEP0 fails with a JCL error if the old datasets do not exist (DISP=OLD); abend path does not close files.
recommendation: Fully documented.

title: COBDATFT - Assembler date format conversion subroutine
description:
##### Entry point
Assembler CSECT `COBDATFT`, standard OS linkage (save area chaining, R12 base). Called statically by batch COBOL `CBACT01C` (`CALL 'COBDATFT' USING CODATECN-REC`, paragraph 1300-POPUL-ACCT-RECORD).

##### Inputs
R1 -> parameter list; first address = CODATECN-REC (copybook CODATECN / DSECT COCDATFT in maclib/COCDATFT.mac): COINTYPE CL1 (CODATECN-TYPE: '1' YYYYMMDD in, '2' YYYY-MM-DD in), COINPDT CL20 (input date), COOUTYPE CL1 (CODATECN-OUTTYPE: '1' YYYY-MM-DD out, '2' YYYYMMDD out), COOUTDT CL20 (output), COERMSG CL38 (error message).

##### Processing flow
1. COINTYPE '1' -> VALIDIN1: if COINPDT+4 compares equal to '-' or COOUTYPE = '2' -> error; else COOUTDT = in(1:4) '-' in(5:2) '-' in(7:2) (YYYYMMDD -> YYYY-MM-DD).
2. COINTYPE '2' -> VALIDIN2 (the '-' check is commented out): if COOUTYPE = '1' -> error; else COOUTDT(1:8) = in(1:4) in(6:2) in(9:2) (YYYY-MM-DD -> YYYYMMDD).
3. Other type -> GOTOERR: MVC COERMSG,=C'INVALID INPUT'.
4. Restore registers, R15 = 0 (always), return.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["CALL COBDATFT USING CODATECN-REC"] --> T{"COINTYPE"}
  T -->|1| V1{"in+4 = '-' or OUTTYPE = 2?"}
  V1 -->|no| O1["OUT = YYYY-MM-DD"]
  V1 -->|yes| ER
  T -->|2| V2{"OUTTYPE = 1?"}
  V2 -->|no| O2["OUT = YYYYMMDD"]
  V2 -->|yes| ER["COERMSG = INVALID INPUT"]
  T -->|other| ER
  O1 --> X["return R15=0"]
  O2 --> X
  ER --> X
```

##### Data
Only the parameter record. CBACT01C passes ACCT-REISSUE-DATE with type '2' and outtype '2' and uses CODATECN-0UT-DATE as OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE.

##### Outputs & side effects
COOUTDT (first 10 or 8 bytes written; remaining bytes untouched) or COERMSG; RC always 0.

##### External calls
None.

##### Migration notes
- No validation of digits or month/day ranges - pure substring rearrangement.
- Error path does not touch COOUTDT; caller CBACT01C does not check COERMSG, so on error the previous/initial output content is used.
- `CLC COINPDT+4,=C'-'` and `MVC COERMSG,=C'INVALID INPUT'` take their length from the first operand's length attribute (COINPDT = 20, COERMSG = 38), not from the literal; the CLC therefore compares 20 bytes against the literal pool (effectively never equal) and the MVC copies 38 bytes including bytes beyond the 13-char literal. Exact runtime bytes depend on the assembled literal pool - verify on the target assembler; treat the '-' check as ineffective.
- For type '2' output, bytes 9-20 of COOUTDT keep prior content.
recommendation: Medium confidence due to assembler implicit-length behaviour on CLC/MVC with literals; verify with an assembly listing. Replace with a standard date-format utility.

title: COBTUPDT / job MNTTRDB2 - Batch maintenance of CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE from a flat file
description:
##### Entry point
Batch DB2 program `COBTUPDT`, run by JCL `MNTTRDB2` (app-transaction-type-db2/jcl): `EXEC PGM=IKJEFT01` with SYSTSIN `DSN SYSTEM(DAZ1)` / `RUN PROGRAM(COBTUPDT) PLAN(CARDDEMO)`; DD INPFILE = dataset `INPFILE` (DISP=SHR).

##### Inputs
Sequential file `TR-RECORD` ASSIGN INPFILE, RECORDING MODE F, read INTO WS-INPUT-REC (53 bytes): INPUT-REC-TYPE X(1) ('A' add, 'U' update, 'D' delete, '*' comment), INPUT-REC-NUMBER X(2) (type code), INPUT-REC-DESC X(50).

##### Processing flow
Paragraphs execute by fall-through from `0001-OPEN-FILES`:
1. OPEN INPUT; DISPLAY 'OPEN FILE OK' or 'OPEN FILE NOT OK' (processing continues either way).
2. `1001-READ-NEXT-RECORDS`: read first, loop until LASTREC = 'Y': `1003-TREAT-RECORD`, read next (each record DISPLAYed 'PROCESSING ...'). Then `2001-CLOSE-STOP` and STOP RUN.
3. `1003-TREAT-RECORD`:
   - 'A' -> `10031-INSERT-DB`: `INSERT INTO CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE (TR_TYPE, TR_DESCRIPTION) VALUES (:INPUT-REC-NUMBER, :INPUT-REC-DESC)`; 0 -> 'RECORD INSERTED SUCCESSFULLY'; <0 -> message 'Error accessing: TRANSACTION_TYPE table. SQLCODE:nnnn' -> 9999-ABEND.
   - 'U' -> `10032-UPDATE-DB`: `UPDATE ... SET TR_DESCRIPTION = :INPUT-REC-DESC WHERE TR_TYPE = :INPUT-REC-NUMBER`; 0 ok; +100 'No records found.'; <0 error.
   - 'D' -> `10033-DELETE-DB`: `DELETE FROM ... WHERE TR_TYPE = :INPUT-REC-NUMBER`; same handling.
   - '*' -> 'IGNORING COMMENTED LINE'.
   - other -> 'ERROR: TYPE NOT VALID' -> 9999-ABEND.
4. `9999-ABEND`: DISPLAY message, MOVE 4 TO RETURN-CODE, EXIT - returns to caller and processing **continues** with the next record.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J["MNTTRDB2 IKJEFT01 DSN RUN COBTUPDT PLAN CARDDEMO"] --> O["0001-OPEN-FILES INPFILE"]
  O --> R["1002-READ-RECORDS"]
  R -->|EOF| C["2001-CLOSE-STOP, STOP RUN"]
  R --> T{"INPUT-REC-TYPE"}
  T -->|A| I["INSERT TRANSACTION_TYPE"]
  T -->|U| U["UPDATE TR_DESCRIPTION"]
  T -->|D| D["DELETE by TR_TYPE"]
  T -->|*| R
  T -->|other| E["9999-ABEND RC=4, continue"]
  I --> R
  U --> R
  D --> R
  E --> R
```

##### Data
DB2 `CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE` (TRNTYPE.ddl): TR_TYPE CHAR(2) NOT NULL PK, TR_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL; unique index XTRAN_TYPE. Child table TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY has FK TRC_TYPE_CODE -> TR_TYPE ON DELETE RESTRICT (deletes of referenced types fail with a negative SQLCODE). DCLGEN DCLTRTYP is included but host variables actually used are the file fields (INPUT-REC-DESC is fixed X(50) bound to VARCHAR, i.e. stored with trailing spaces).

##### Outputs & side effects
Rows inserted/updated/deleted; SYSTSPRT DISPLAY log; RETURN-CODE 4 if any error occurred (sticky).

##### External calls
DB2 via TSO DSN RUN (IKJEFT01), plan CARDDEMO.

##### Migration notes
- No explicit COMMIT/ROLLBACK: all changes commit at normal program end via DSN; errors do not roll back earlier or later records.
- 'Abend' is not an abend - RC 4, continues.
- If OPEN fails, READ returns a non-AT END error status and LASTREC is never set: the loop can spin on the stale record (FILE STATUS not checked after READ).
- Insert does not check +100/positive warnings; duplicate key (-803) is a negative SQLCODE -> error message, continues.
- Descriptions inserted are 50 bytes padded (VARCHAR length = 50).
recommendation: Fully documented. Decide whether the target should keep all-or-nothing-per-record semantics with a single final commit.
note:
Consolidated document for app/app-transaction-type-db2/cbl/COBTUPDT.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-0290d80742f8428a9d61c10b698ee784.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- Errors don't stop the run; failed records are skipped and RC=4 is sticky. No rollback - successful rows are committed alongside failures.
- Description inserted from fixed X(50): VARCHAR column receives 50 chars including trailing spaces.
- Duplicate insert (SQLCODE -803) is just an error message; positive SQLCODEs on insert are ignored.

End-to-end: MNTTRDB2/COBTUPDT is scheduled in the Control-M WEEKLY DB2 refresh folder (followed by TRANEXTR); together they form the DB2 transaction-type maintenance flow. Upstream findings: sfind-c0001c8086c54798b228ce1ea65e05ab.

title: CAVW / COACTVWC - Account view (XREF by account AIX -> ACCTDAT -> CUSTDAT)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CAVW** -> **COACTVWC** (LIT-THISTRANID 'CAVW', LIT-THISPGM 'COACTVWC'), map `CACTVWA` mapset `COACTVW`. Invoked from main menu COMEN01C (LIT-MENUPGM, tran CM00). `EXEC CICS HANDLE ABEND LABEL(ABEND-ROUTINE)`. Pseudo-conversational RETURN TRANSID('CAVW') COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA) = CARDDEMO-COMMAREA + program-specific area.

##### Inputs
COMMAREA: `COCOM01Y` CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (FROM/TO tranid & program, USER-ID, USER-TYPE, PGM-CONTEXT, CUST-ID 9(9), names, ACCT-ID 9(11), ACCT-STATUS, CARD-NUM 9(16), LAST-MAP/MAPSET) followed by WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA. Map input ACCTSID (11-digit account). AID mapped via `CSSTRPFY` (PF13-24 fold onto PF1-12); only ENTER and PF3 are valid, anything else is treated as ENTER.

##### Processing flow
1. If EIBCALEN=0 or (FROM-PROGRAM='COMEN01C' and not re-enter) -> INITIALIZE commarea; else split DFHCOMMAREA into CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and program area.
2. PF3 -> TO-TRANID = FROM-TRANID or 'CM00'; TO-PROGRAM = FROM-PROGRAM or 'COMEN01C'; FROM = CAVW/COACTVWC; **sets CDEMO-USRTYP-USER** and PGM-ENTER; LAST-MAPSET/MAP; XCTL with COMMAREA.
3. PGM-ENTER -> 1000-SEND-MAP (prompt) -> COMMON-RETURN.
4. PGM-REENTER -> 2000-PROCESS-INPUTS: RECEIVE CACTVWA; 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT: '*' or spaces -> blank, INPUT-ERROR, prompt 'enter account'; non-numeric or zero -> 'Account Filter must be a non-zero 11 digit number'; else CDEMO-ACCT-ID = input. Error -> send map. OK -> 9000-READ-ACCT:
   - 9200-GETCARDXREF-BYACCT: `READ DATASET('CXACAIX') RIDFLD(acct id X11)` -> CDEMO-CUST-ID, CDEMO-CARD-NUM from XREF. NOTFND 'Account:<id> not found in Cross ref file. Resp:.. Reas:..'; other -> 'File Error: READ on CXACAIX returned RESP .. ,RESP2 ..'.
   - 9300-GETACCTDATA-BYACCT: `READ DATASET('ACCTDAT') RIDFLD(acct id)` -> FOUND-ACCT-IN-MASTER; NOTFND 'not found in Acct Master file'.
   - 9400-GETCUSTDATA-BYCUST: `READ DATASET('CUSTDAT') RIDFLD(cust id X9)` -> FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER; NOTFND 'CustId:.. not found in customer master'.
   - 1000-SEND-MAP: 1100 header (titles, tran, pgm, date/time); 1200 moves account fields (status, curr bal, credit limit, cash limit, cyc credit/debit, open/expiry/reissue dates, group id) and customer fields (id, SSN formatted `ddd-dd-dddd`, FICO, DOB, names, address lines 1-2, line 3 as city, state, zip, country, phones, govt id, EFT acct, primary holder flag); 1300 attributes (red account field on error, '*' when blank on re-entry); 1400 SEND MAP ERASE FREEKB CURSOR and sets REENTER.
5. Unexpected context -> SEND TEXT 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO' + bare RETURN.
6. ABEND-ROUTINE: SEND ABEND-DATA (culprit, code, reason, msg 'UNEXPECTED ABEND OCCURRED.'), HANDLE ABEND CANCEL, `EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999')`.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CAVW COACTVWC 0000-MAIN] --> H[HANDLE ABEND ABEND-ROUTINE]
  H --> I{EIBCALEN=0 or from COMEN01C first}
  I --> K{AID}
  K -- PF3 --> X[XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C]
  K -- ENTER first --> S[1000-SEND-MAP prompt]
  K -- ENTER reenter --> P[2000-PROCESS-INPUTS RECEIVE + 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT]
  P -- error --> S
  P -- ok --> R1[9200 READ CXACAIX by acct]
  R1 -- found --> R2[9300 READ ACCTDAT]
  R2 -- found --> R3[9400 READ CUSTDAT by XREF cust id]
  R1 & R2 & R3 --> S
  S --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CAVW COMMAREA]
  AB[ABEND-ROUTINE] --> AB2[SEND ABEND-DATA, ABEND 9999]
```

##### Data
Read-only: CXACAIX (AIX path of CARDXREF by account, `CVACT03Y`), ACCTDAT (`CVACT01Y` 300 bytes), CUSTDAT (`CVCUS01Y` 500 bytes). CARDDAT/CARDAIX literals declared but not used.

##### Outputs & side effects
Account + customer details screen; CDEMO-ACCT-ID / CUST-ID / CARD-NUM set in commarea for downstream programs.

##### External calls
XCTL to FROM-PROGRAM/COMEN01C; CICS ABEND 9999.

##### Migration notes
- PF3 forcibly sets user type to 'U' in commarea (admin users lose admin flag when returning).
- Invalid PF keys are silently treated as ENTER.
- If account found but customer not found, account fields are still shown (FOUND-ACCT-IN-MASTER) with error message.
- Only the first message is kept (WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF guard).
- When an account has multiple cards, the AIX read returns the first xref record (non-unique AIX).
- Address line 3 is shown in the City field.
recommendation: Fully documented. Full SSN is displayed formatted on screen (CUST-SSN 999-99-9999); confirm masking requirements with the customer.

title: CBTRN01C - Daily transaction card/account verification (read-only pre-check)
description:
##### Entry point
Batch main program `PROGRAM-ID. CBTRN01C`, `PROCEDURE DIVISION` / MAIN-PARA (line 154). No JCL/PROC in the repo references it, so DD bindings are inferred only from the SELECT ASSIGN names: DALYTRAN, CUSTFILE, XREFFILE, CARDFILE, ACCTFILE, TRANFILE.

##### Inputs
- DALYTRAN (sequential, 350 bytes) -> `CVTRA06Y` DALYTRAN-RECORD (ID X16, TYPE X2, CAT 9(4), SOURCE X10, DESC X100, AMT S9(9)V99, MERCHANT-ID 9(9), NAME X50, CITY X50, ZIP X10, CARD-NUM X16, ORIG-TS X26, PROC-TS X26, FILLER X20).
- XREFFILE (indexed RANDOM, key FD-XREF-CARD-NUM X16) -> `CVACT03Y`.
- ACCTFILE (indexed RANDOM, key 9(11)) -> `CVACT01Y`.
- CUSTFILE (key 9(9), `CVCUS01Y`), CARDFILE (key X16, `CVACT02Y`: CARD-NUM X16, ACCT-ID 9(11), CVV 9(3), EMBOSSED-NAME X50, EXPIRAION-DATE X10, ACTIVE-STATUS X, filler 59), TRANFILE (key X16, `CVTRA05Y`) - opened INPUT and closed but **never read**.

##### Processing flow
1. Open the six files INPUT (0000-0500); non-'00' -> DISPLAY, Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, Z-ABEND-PROGRAM.
2. Loop until END-OF-DAILY-TRANS-FILE='Y': 1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT ('00' ok, '10' sets EOF, other abend). If not EOF DISPLAY the whole record.
3. **Even after EOF in the same iteration**, it moves DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM (still holding the last record) to XREF-CARD-NUM and performs 2000-LOOKUP-XREF (keyed READ; INVALID KEY -> DISPLAY 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOR XREF', status 4; else DISPLAY card/account/customer). If status 0 -> 3000-READ-ACCOUNT by XREF-ACCT-ID (INVALID KEY -> status 4, DISPLAY 'ACCOUNT ... NOT FOUND'). Else DISPLAY 'CARD NUMBER ... COULD NOT BE VERIFIED. SKIPPING TRANSACTION ID-...'.
4. Close all six files; DISPLAY end; GOBACK.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CBTRN01C MAIN-PARA] --> O[0000-0500 OPEN INPUT 6 files]
  O --> R[1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT]
  R --> X[2000-LOOKUP-XREF by DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM]
  X -- found --> AC[3000-READ-ACCOUNT by XREF-ACCT-ID]
  X -- invalid --> SK[DISPLAY could not be verified]
  AC --> L{EOF?}
  SK --> L
  L -- no --> R
  L -- yes --> C[9000-9500 CLOSE, GOBACK]
  R -- error --> AB[Z-ABEND-PROGRAM CEE3ABD 999]
```

##### Data
Read only: DALYTRAN, XREF, ACCOUNT. Opened but unused: CUSTOMER, CARD, TRANSACT. Nothing written.

##### Outputs & side effects
SYSOUT DISPLAY lines only. Abend 999 on I/O errors.

##### External calls
`CALL 'CEE3ABD' USING ABCODE(999), TIMING(0)`.

##### Migration notes
- Pure verification/diagnostic: no records are posted or rejected to a file despite the "SKIPPING" message.
- Off-by-one: the final loop iteration after EOF re-verifies the last record a second time.
- 9000-DALYTRAN-CLOSE error branch displays 'ERROR CLOSING CUSTOMER FILE' and CUSTFILE-STATUS (copy/paste bug).
- Not referenced by any JCL in repo - candidate dead code, but cannot be proven unused outside the repo.
recommendation: No JCL in app/jcl or app/proc invokes CBTRN01C (grep for CBTRN01C finds only POSTTRAN/TRANREPT for the other CBTRN programs); customer must confirm whether/how it is scheduled. Behaviour is fully traced but it produces only SYSOUT.

title: CA00 / COADM01C - Admin menu (table-driven XCTL dispatch)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CA00** -> **COADM01C**, reached by XCTL from sign-on COSGN00C for admin users, and as the PF3/PF12 return target of COUSR0xC. Map `COADM1A` mapset `COADM01`. `HANDLE CONDITION PGMIDERR(PGMIDERR-ERR-PARA)`.

##### Inputs
COMMAREA `COCOM01Y`. Map OPTION (2 chars). EIBAID ENTER/PF3.
Menu table `COADM02Y` CARDDEMO-ADMIN-MENU-OPTIONS: CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT 9(2)=6; entries (NUM 9(2), NAME X(35), PGMNAME X(8)) OCCURS 9 (redefined):
1 User List (Security) COUSR00C; 2 User Add (Security) COUSR01C; 3 User Update (Security) COUSR02C; 4 User Delete (Security) COUSR03C; 5 Transaction Type List/Update (Db2) COTRTLIC; 6 Transaction Type Maintenance (Db2) COTRTUPC.

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM='COSGN00C', RETURN-TO-SIGNON-SCREEN: XCTL CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM (COSGN00C if blank) **without COMMAREA**.
2. First entry: set re-enter, clear map, SEND-MENU-SCREEN (header + BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS: 'NN. name' into OPTN001O..OPTN010O for 1..count).
3. Re-entry RECEIVE: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL COSGN00C (no commarea); other -> invalid key.
4. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: right-trim OPTION, replace spaces with '0' (e.g. '1 ' -> '1' -> ... ' 1'->'01'), move to WS-OPTION 9(2); invalid if non-numeric, > 6, or 0 -> 'Please enter a valid option number...'. Valid: if program name does not start with 'DUMMY', set FROM-TRANID/PROGRAM, context 0, `XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-PGMNAME(n)) COMMAREA`. If XCTL raises PGMIDERR -> PGMIDERR-ERR-PARA: green 'This option <name> is not installed ...', SEND, RETURN TRANSID CA00. If name starts DUMMY the same 'not installed' message is shown.
5. RETURN TRANSID('CA00') COMMAREA.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CA00 COADM01C] --> B{EIBCALEN=0}
  B -- yes --> SG[XCTL COSGN00C no commarea]
  B -- no --> C{REENTER}
  C -- no --> S[SEND COADM1A with options]
  C -- yes --> R[RECEIVE] --> K{EIBAID}
  K -- PF3 --> SG
  K -- other --> IK[invalid key]
  K -- ENTER --> V{option 1..6 numeric}
  V -- no --> E[valid option msg]
  V -- yes --> D{PGMNAME starts DUMMY}
  D -- no --> X[XCTL COUSR00C/01C/02C/03C/COTRTLIC/COTRTUPC]
  X -. PGMIDERR .-> NI[not installed msg + RETURN]
  D -- yes --> NI
  S & IK & E --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CA00]
```

##### Data
No file I/O (WS-USRSEC-FILE declared, unused).

##### Outputs & side effects
Navigation only.

##### External calls
XCTL to option programs with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; XCTL COSGN00C without commarea.

##### Migration notes
- Option parsing: the field is right-trimmed, then every remaining space is replaced by '0' before moving to the 2-digit WS-OPTION, so '1', ' 1' and '01' all select option 1; non-digits fail the NUMERIC test.
- PGMIDERR is handled globally via HANDLE CONDITION, so missing Db2 programs degrade to a message.
- Sign-on return XCTL passes no COMMAREA (so COSGN00C starts fresh) unlike other programs.
- No check that CDEMO-USER-TYPE='A'.
recommendation: Fully documented. Options 5 and 6 (COTRTLIC/COTRTUPC Db2 programs) depend on optional Db2 modules - confirm whether they are installed in the target.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/COADM01C.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-ee5203cfeb4c481faf09bbfca4d39eca.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- No check that the caller is actually an admin: the program trusts that it was reached from sign-on; any task with a commarea can drive it.
- Error branches SEND then continue; invalid option leads to the IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON block being skipped (single send).

End-to-end: COADM01C is XCTLed by COSGN00C after successful USRSEC authentication of an admin (user type A). Upstream findings: sfind-392f2c38beae46788ed4fa8bf2032a83.

Owners from git history (no CODEOWNERS file in repo).

title: CT02 / COTRN02C - Online "Add Transaction" (validates, assigns next tran id, WRITE TRANSACT)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CT02** -> **COTRN02C** (CSD), reached from main menu COMEN01C. Map `COTRN2A` mapset `COTRN02`. RETURN TRANSID('CT02') COMMAREA. If entered with CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED set, that value is placed in the **card number** field and processed immediately.

##### Inputs
COMMAREA = `COCOM01Y` + CDEMO-CT02-INFO (TRNID-FIRST X16, TRNID-LAST X16, PAGE-NUM 9(8), NEXT-PAGE-FLG X1, TRN-SEL-FLG X1, TRN-SELECTED X16).
Map fields: ACTIDIN (account id), CARDNIN (card number), TTYPCD, TCATCD, TRNSRC, TRNAMT, TDESC, TORIGDT, TPROCDT, MID, MNAME, MCITY, MZIP, CONFIRM. EIBAID ENTER/PF3/PF4/PF5/other.

##### Processing flow
SEND-TRNADD-SCREEN always issues `EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(CT02)` right after SEND, so **the first error encountered ends the task**.
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C. First entry -> set re-enter, cursor ACTIDIN, optional preselect, SEND.
2. Re-entry RECEIVE: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL FROM-PROGRAM (COMEN01C if blank); PF4 -> clear; PF5 -> COPY-LAST-TRAN-DATA; other -> invalid key.
3. VALIDATE-INPUT-KEY-FIELDS: if ACTIDIN given: must be numeric; NUMVAL -> XREF-ACCT-ID; `READ DATASET('CXACAIX') RIDFLD(XREF-ACCT-ID) KEYLENGTH(11)` (alternate index on account id over card xref) -> card number filled from XREF. NOTFND 'Account ID NOT found...', other 'Unable to lookup Acct in XREF AIX file...'. Else if CARDNIN given: numeric; `READ DATASET('CCXREF') RIDFLD(XREF-CARD-NUM) KEYLENGTH(16)` -> account id filled. NOTFND 'Card Number NOT found...'. Neither -> 'Account or Card Number must be entered...'.
4. VALIDATE-INPUT-DATA-FIELDS (in order): mandatory Type CD, Category CD, Source, Description, Amount, Orig Date, Proc Date, Merchant ID, Merchant Name, Merchant City, Merchant Zip; Type and Category numeric; Amount format `[+-]99999999.99` (pos1 sign, 2-9 digits, 10 '.', 11-12 digits); Orig/Proc dates `YYYY-MM-DD` shape; amount re-edited via NUMVAL-C to +99999999.99 and redisplayed; `CALL 'CSUTLDTC'` on Orig and Proc date (valid if SEV '0000' or MSG-NUM '2513'); Merchant ID numeric.
5. CONFIRM: 'Y'/'y' -> ADD-TRANSACTION; 'N'/'n'/blank -> 'Confirm to add this transaction...'; other -> 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...'.
6. ADD-TRANSACTION: TRAN-ID=HIGH-VALUES; STARTBR TRANSACT; READPREV (gets the highest key; ENDFILE -> TRAN-ID=0); ENDBR; WS-TRAN-ID-N 9(16) = TRAN-ID + 1; INITIALIZE TRAN-RECORD; move fields (amount via NUMVAL-C to S9(9)V99; orig/proc date 10 chars into 26-byte TS fields, rest spaces); `EXEC CICS WRITE DATASET('TRANSACT') RIDFLD(TRAN-ID) KEYLENGTH(16)`. NORMAL -> clear fields, green 'Transaction added successfully.  Your Tran ID is <id>.'; DUPKEY/DUPREC 'Tran ID already exist...'; other 'Unable to Add Transaction...'.
7. COPY-LAST-TRAN-DATA (PF5): validate key fields, read the last transaction in the file (highest tran id, regardless of account/card) and copy its type, category, source, amount, desc, orig/proc TS, merchant fields into the screen, then PROCESS-ENTER-KEY (so if CONFIRM='Y' already, it adds immediately).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CT02 COTRN02C] --> B{EIBCALEN=0}
  B -- yes --> SG[XCTL COSGN00C]
  B -- no --> C{REENTER}
  C -- no --> S[SEND COTRN2A + RETURN]
  C -- yes --> R[RECEIVE] --> K{EIBAID}
  K -- PF3 --> FP[XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C]
  K -- PF4 --> CL[clear]
  K -- PF5 --> CP[COPY-LAST-TRAN-DATA READPREV last tran] --> PE
  K -- ENTER --> PE[VALIDATE-INPUT-KEY-FIELDS]
  PE --> KX{acct id or card}
  KX -- acct --> AIX[READ CXACAIX by acct]
  KX -- card --> XR[READ CCXREF by card]
  AIX & XR --> VD[VALIDATE-INPUT-DATA-FIELDS + CSUTLDTC]
  VD --> CF{CONFIRM Y}
  CF -- yes --> AT[STARTBR/READPREV/ENDBR TRANSACT max id +1, WRITE TRANSACT]
  CF -- no --> E[message]
  AT --> OK[success msg]
  E & OK & CL --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CT02]
```

##### Data
Read: CXACAIX (AIX path over CARDXREF keyed by account id 9(11)), CCXREF (CARDXREF KSDS key card X16) -> `CVACT03Y`; TRANSACT browse. Written: TRANSACT (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS) 350-byte `CVTRA05Y` TRAN-RECORD. `CVACT01Y` copied but ACCTDAT never accessed (WS-ACCTDAT-FILE unused).

##### Outputs & side effects
New transaction record (not posted to balances). Screen messages.

##### External calls
`CALL 'CSUTLDTC'` (date validation) x2; XCTL COSGN00C / COMEN01C / FROM-PROGRAM.

##### Migration notes
- Id generation = last key + 1 via READPREV from HIGH-VALUES; numeric conversion of an X(16) key; race-prone under concurrency (DUPREC path handles collisions by error).
- When account id is entered, the card number is taken from the AIX (first card for the account if many).
- Validation order matters; first error wins (SEND + RETURN).
- TRAN-ORIG-TS/PROC-TS receive only 'YYYY-MM-DD' + spaces, unlike batch DB2-format timestamps; CBTRN03C/SORT use bytes 1-10 so still match.
- No balance, credit-limit or account-status checks online; TCATBAL and ACCTDAT not updated.
- PF5 copies the globally last transaction, not the last for the selected card.
- Amount NUMVAL-C into S9(9)V99: values > 999,999,999.99 impossible due to format check (8 integer digits).
recommendation: Fully documented. Customer should confirm that online-added transactions intentionally bypass balance/limit/expiry checks and account/TCATBAL updates (those happen only in batch POSTTRAN for DALYTRAN input), and that max(TRAN-ID)+1 id generation without locking is acceptable.
note: Duplicate of sfind-aa2005c873cb4a6eb4ea75db4a51161a (COTRN02C add transaction (TRANSID CT02)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CARDDEMO.CSD - CICS resource definitions (transactions, programs, mapsets, files, TDQ, libraries)
description:
##### Entry point
Not executable: CSD extract for group **CARDDEMO** loaded into the CICS region (via DFHCSDUP/CEDA, then INSTALL GROUP(CARDDEMO)). Defines how terminal transaction ids enter the online programs.

##### Inputs
CSD DEFINE statements.

##### Processing flow
Transaction -> program routing (all PROFILE(DFHCICST), TASKDATALOC(ANY), ACTION(BACKOUT), RESSEC(NO), CMDSEC(NO)):
CAUP->COACTUPC (account update), CAVW->COACTVWC (account view), CA00->COADM01C (admin menu), CB00->COBIL00C (bill pay), CC00->COSGN00C (sign-on), CCDL->COCRDSLC (card detail), CCLI->COCRDLIC (card list), CCUP->COCRDUPC (card update), CDV1->COCRDSEC, CM00->COMEN01C (main menu), CR00->CORPT00C (report request), CT00->COTRN00C (tran list), CT01->COTRN01C (tran view), CT02->COTRN02C (tran add), CU00->COUSR00C, CU01->COUSR01C, CU02->COUSR02C, CU03->COUSR03C.
Programs: the 18 above, LANGUAGE(COBOL), EXECKEY(USER), CONCURRENCY(QUASIRENT).
Mapsets: COACTUP, COACTVW, COADM01, COBIL00, COCRDLI, COCRDSL, COCRDUP, COMEN01, CORPT00, COSGN00, COTRN00, COTRN01, COTRN02, COUSR00, COUSR01, COUSR02, COUSR03.
Files (all RECORDFORMAT(V), ADD/BROWSE/DELETE/READ/UPDATE YES, UPDATEMODEL(LOCKING), RLSACCESS(NO)): ACCTDAT=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS; CARDAIX=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDDATA.VSAM.AIX.PATH; CARDDAT=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS; CCXREF=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS; CUSTDAT=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CUSTDATA.VSAM.KSDS; CXACAIX=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDXREF.VSAM.AIX.PATH; TRANSACT=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS; USRSEC=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS.
TDQUEUE JOBS 'SUBMIT JOBS FROM CICS': TYPE(EXTRA) DDNAME(INREADER) TYPEFILE(OUTPUT) RECORDSIZE(80) ERROROPTION(IGNORE) OPENTIME(INITIAL) - used by CORPT00C to submit JCL to the internal reader.
Libraries CARDDLIB and COM2DOLL: DSNAME01(AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CC00 --> COSGN00C --> CM00[CM00 COMEN01C]
  COSGN00C --> CA00[CA00 COADM01C]
  CM00 --> CAVW[CAVW COACTVWC] & CAUP[CAUP COACTUPC] & CCLI[CCLI COCRDLIC] & CT00[CT00 COTRN00C] & CT02[CT02 COTRN02C] & CR00[CR00 CORPT00C] & CB00[CB00 COBIL00C]
  CCLI --> CCDL[CCDL COCRDSLC] & CCUP[CCUP COCRDUPC]
  CT00 --> CT01[CT01 COTRN01C]
  CA00 --> CU00[CU00 COUSR00C] & CU01[CU01 COUSR01C] & CU02[CU02 COUSR02C] & CU03[CU03 COUSR03C]
  CR00 --> JOBS[TDQ JOBS -> INREADER]
```
(Navigation edges are from the programs' XCTL targets, not from the CSD itself.)

##### Data
Defines the logical file names used in EXEC CICS FILE/DATASET and their VSAM clusters/AIX paths.

##### Outputs & side effects
Installed CICS resources.

##### External calls
None.

##### Migration notes
- CARDAIX and CXACAIX are AIX paths (non-unique alternate keys by account id) - re-implement as secondary indexes with "first match" semantics.
- RECORDFORMAT(V) on files whose copybooks are fixed length.
- Security checks are disabled at resource level (RESSEC/CMDSEC NO); authorisation relies on program navigation.
- CDV1->COCRDSEC, COUSR00C, COUSR02C, COTRN01C, COBIL00C, COMEN01C, COSGN00C, COCRDUPC are outside this batch.
recommendation: Fully documented. This (DFHCSDUP extract) is the authoritative online topology; CBADMCDJ.jcl defines a different, older resource set and should not be used as the source of truth.
note: Duplicate of sfind-ddc6cc125b6f4f368de91c4ed0956a59 (CARDDEMO CSD resources and CBADMCDJ DFHCSDUP install job); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CREASTMT / CBSTM03A + CBSTM03B - Account statement generation (text + HTML)
description:
##### Entry point Batch job **CREASTMT** (`app/jcl/CREASTMT.JCL`, scheduled in `app/scheduler/CardDemo.ca7` as JOB=CREASTMT SCHID=030). Step order: 1. `DELDEF01` IDCAMS: DELETE `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRXFL.SEQ` and cluster `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS`, `SET MAXCC=0`, then DEFINE CLUSTER TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS KEYS(32 0) RECORDSIZE(350 350) SHAREOPTIONS(2 3) INDEXED CISZ 4096. 2. `STEP010` SORT: SORTIN = `TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS`; `SORT FIELDS=(263,16,CH,A,1,16,CH,A)` (card number then tran id); `OUTREC FIELDS=(1:263,16,17:1,262,279:279,50)` -> output record = card-num(16) + bytes 1-262 of TRAN-RECORD (tran-id..merchant-zip) + bytes 279-328 (orig/proc TS) ; LRECL 350 to `TRXFL.SEQ`. (Note OUTREC copies positions 279..328 to 279..328, so bytes 329-350 (FILLER) are blank-filled.) 3. `STEP020` IDCAMS REPRO TRXFL.SEQ -> TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS (COND=(0,NE)). 4. `STEP030` IEFBR14 deletes previous `STATEMNT.HTML` and `STATEMNT.PS` (DISP=(MOD,DELETE,DELETE)). 5. `STEP040` `EXEC PGM=CBSTM03A` with DDs TRNXFILE=TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS, XREFFILE=CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS, ACCTFILE=ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS, CUSTFILE=CUSTDATA.VSAM.KSDS, STMTFILE=STATEMNT.PS (NEW, LRECL 80 FB), HTMLFILE=STATEMNT.HTML (NEW, LRECL 100 FB). CBSTM03A is a batch main program (no PROCEDURE USING). CBSTM03B is a CALLed file-service subprogram (`PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LK-M03B-AREA`). ##### Inputs - **TRNXFILE** (KSDS, key 32 = card 16 + tran id 16), read via CBSTM03B, record mapped to copybook `COSTM01.CPY` TRNX-RECORD: TRNX-CARD-NUM X(16), TRNX-ID X(16), TRNX-REST (318): TYPE-CD X(2), CAT-CD 9(4), SOURCE X(10), DESC X(100), AMT S9(9)V99 (zoned), MERCHANT-ID 9(9), MERCHANT-NAME X(50), MERCHANT-CITY X(50), MERCHANT-ZIP X(10), ORIG-TS X(26), PROC-TS X(26), FILLER X(20). - **XREFFILE** (KSDS sequential) -> `CVACT03Y` CARD-XREF-RECORD: XREF-CARD-NUM X(16), XREF-CUST-ID 9(9), XREF-ACCT-ID 9(11), FILLER X(14) (50 bytes). - **CUSTFILE** (KSDS random, key 9) -> `CUSTREC.cpy` CUSTOMER-RECORD (500 bytes): CUST-ID 9(9), FIRST/MIDDLE/LAST-NAME X(25) each, ADDR-LINE-1/2/3 X(50), STATE-CD X(2), COUNTRY-CD X(3), ZIP X(10), PHONE-1/2 X(15), SSN 9(9), GOVT-ID X(20), DOB-YYYYMMDD X(10), EFT-ACCOUNT-ID X(10), PRI-CARD-HOLDER-IND X(1), FICO 9(3), FILLER X(168). - **ACCTFILE** (KSDS random, key 9(11)) -> `CVACT01Y` ACCOUNT-RECORD (300 bytes): ACCT-ID 9(11), ACTIVE-STATUS X, CURR-BAL S9(10)V99, CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, OPEN-DATE X(10), EXPIRAION-DATE X(10), REISSUE-DATE X(10), CURR-CYC-CREDIT S9(10)V99, CURR-CYC-DEBIT S9(10)V99, ADDR-ZIP X(10), GROUP-ID X(10), FILLER X(178). - **CBSTM03B call interface** WS-M03B-AREA / LK-M03B-AREA: DD X(8) ('TRNXFILE','XREFFILE','CUSTFILE','ACCTFILE'), OPER X(1) ('O' open,'C' close,'R' sequential read,'K' keyed read,'W' write,'Z' rewrite), RC X(2) (returned file status), KEY X(25), KEY-LN S9(4), FLDT X(1000) (record buffer). ##### Processing flow 1. **TIOT diagnostic** (lines 262-291): sets addressability PSA->TCB->TIOT via pointers (PSAPTR is never initialised, i.e. relies on address 0 = PSA on z/OS), DISPLAYs job name/step and every DD name in the TIOT with "valid UCB"/"null UCB". Pure diagnostic; no business effect. 2. `OPEN OUTPUT STMT-FILE HTML-FILE`; INITIALIZE WS-TRNX-TABLE and WS-TRN-TBL-CNTR. 3. **0000-START dispatcher driven by WS-FL-DD** (initial value 'TRNXFILE'). Uses `ALTER 8100-FILE-OPEN TO PROCEED TO 8x00-...` then `GO TO 8100-FILE-OPEN`. The chain is: - 8100-TRNXFILE-OPEN: CBSTM03B open TRNXFILE (RC '00'/'04' OK else abend), then one sequential read (RC '00'/'04' OK); moves buffer to TRNX-RECORD, WS-SAVE-CARD=card, CR-CNT=1, TR-CNT=0, WS-FL-DD='READTRNX', GO TO 0000-START. - 'READTRNX' -> 8500-READTRNX-READ: **loads the entire TRNXFILE into WS-TRNX-TABLE** (51 card slots x 10 transactions). If card equals WS-SAVE-CARD then TR-CNT+1 else store TR-CNT into WS-TRCT(CR-CNT), CR-CNT+1, TR-CNT=1. Stores card num, tran id and TRNX-REST in slot (CR-CNT,TR-CNT); reads next ('00' loop, '10' EOF -> 8599-EXIT, other abend). 8599-EXIT stores final TR-CNT, WS-FL-DD='XREFFILE', GO TO 0000-START. - 8200-XREFFILE-OPEN -> WS-FL-DD='CUSTFILE'; 8300-CUSTFILE-OPEN -> 'ACCTFILE'; 8400-ACCTFILE-OPEN -> GO TO 1000-MAINLINE. 4. **1000-MAINLINE** loop until END-OF-FILE='Y': - 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT: CBSTM03B 'R' XREFFILE. '00' continue, '10' set EOF, other -> abend. Buffer moved to CARD-XREF-RECORD (also on EOF, harmless). - If not EOF: 2000-CUSTFILE-GET (keyed read 'K' with key XREF-CUST-ID, KEY-LN = LENGTH OF XREF-CUST-ID = 9; RC must be '00' else abend), 3000-ACCTFILE-GET (key XREF-ACCT-ID, length 11; RC '00' else abend), 5000-CREATE-STATEMENT, CR-JMP=1, WS-TOTAL-AMT=0, 4000-TRNXFILE-GET. 5. **5000-CREATE-STATEMENT**: INITIALIZE STATEMENT-LINES (INITIALIZE skips FILLER items, so the VALUE literals in the FILLERs survive); write ST-LINE0 ("****START OF STATEMENT****"); 5100-WRITE-HTML-HEADER (DOCTYPE, html, head, meta, title "HTML Table Layout", body, table, `

Statement for Account Number: {ACCT-ID}

`, bank block "Bank of XYZ / 410 Terry Ave N / Seattle WA 99999"); build ST-NAME = STRING first, middle, last name each DELIMITED BY ' ' (first space - so only the first word of each name part is kept) separated by single spaces; ST-ADD1 = addr line 1, ST-ADD2 = addr line 2, ST-ADD3 = STRING addr-line-3, state, country, zip each delimited by first space; ST-ACCT-ID=ACCT-ID, ST-CURR-BAL (PIC 9(9).99- edited) = ACCT-CURR-BAL (S9(10)V99: **high-order digit truncated**), ST-FICO-SCORE=FICO; 5200-WRITE-HTML-NMADBS writes name/address `

` lines (STRING delimited by double space) and "Basic Details" section with Account ID / Current Balance / FICO Score, then the Transaction Summary header row (Tran ID / Tran Details / Amount). Then writes text lines ST-LINE1..ST-LINE13 (name, 3 address lines, dashes, "Basic Details", Account ID, Current Balance, FICO Score, dashes, "TRANSACTION SUMMARY", column header). 6. **4000-TRNXFILE-GET**: scan table CR-JMP 1..CR-CNT until slot card > XREF-CARD-NUM (relies on both files being in ascending card order). For the matching slot, for each TR-JMP 1..WS-TRCT: move tran id/rest into TRNX-RECORD, 6000-WRITE-TRANS (text ST-LINE14: tran id X(16), DESC truncated to 49 chars, '$', amount Z(9).99-; HTML row of 3 ``s), and **`ADD TRNX-AMT TO WS-TOTAL-AMT`** (line 429; COMP-3 S9(9)V99). After loop: WS-TRN-AMT = total, ST-TOTAL-TRAMT edited; write ST-LINE12 dashes, ST-LINE14A "Total EXP:" ... "$" total, ST-LINE15 "****END OF STATEMENT****"; HTML closes with `

End of Statement

`, ``. 7. At XREF EOF: close TRNX, XREF, CUST, ACCT via CBSTM03B 'C' (RC '00'/'04' OK else abend), CLOSE STMT-FILE HTML-FILE, GOBACK. 8. 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM: DISPLAY 'ABENDING PROGRAM', `CALL 'CEE3ABD'` (no parameters). **CBSTM03B** (subprogram): EVALUATE LK-M03B-DD -> 1000/2000/3000/4000 paragraph per file; unknown DD -> GOBACK without touching RC. Per file: 'O' -> OPEN INPUT; 'R' -> READ (next) INTO LK-M03B-FLDT (TRNX, XREF only); 'K' -> MOVE LK-M03B-KEY(1:KEY-LN) to record key, keyed READ INTO FLDT (CUST, ACCT only); 'C' -> CLOSE. Always returns the 2-byte file status in LK-M03B-RC. 'W' and 'Z' are declared but **not implemented** for any file (status returned unchanged); 'K' on TRNX/XREF and 'R' on CUST/ACCT fall through with no I/O and just return the last status. ```mermaid flowchart TD J[CREASTMT JCL] --> D1[DELDEF01 IDCAMS define TRXFL KSDS] D1 --> S10[STEP010 SORT TRANSACT by card,tranid -> TRXFL.SEQ] S10 --> S20[STEP020 REPRO -> TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS] S20 --> S30[STEP030 IEFBR14 delete STATEMNT.PS/HTML] S30 --> S40[STEP040 CBSTM03A] S40 --> T[TIOT DD display] T --> O[OPEN STMT-FILE HTML-FILE] O --> ST0[0000-START ALTER/GO TO dispatcher] ST0 --> P81[8100-TRNXFILE-OPEN + first read] P81 --> P85[8500-READTRNX-READ load WS-TRNX-TABLE 51x10] P85 --> P82[8200 XREF open] --> P83[8300 CUST open] --> P84[8400 ACCT open] --> ML[1000-MAINLINE] ML --> X{XREF read RC} X -- '10' EOF --> CL[9100-9400 close via CBSTM03B, close outputs, GOBACK] X -- other --> AB[9999-ABEND CEE3ABD] X -- '00' --> C2[2000-CUSTFILE-GET key XREF-CUST-ID] C2 --> C3[3000-ACCTFILE-GET key XREF-ACCT-ID] C3 --> C5[5000-CREATE-STATEMENT header text+HTML] C5 --> C4[4000-TRNXFILE-GET match card in table] C4 --> W6[6000-WRITE-TRANS per txn, ADD TRNX-AMT TO WS-TOTAL-AMT] W6 --> TOT[write Total EXP + END OF STATEMENT] TOT --> ML C2 & C3 -. RC not 00 .-> AB ``` ##### Data Read only: TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS (sorted copy of TRANSACT), CARDXREF, CUSTDATA, ACCTDATA (all via CBSTM03B, OPEN INPUT). Written: STATEMNT.PS (80-byte text), STATEMNT.HTML (100-byte lines). Intermediate: TRXFL.SEQ (LRECL 350). No master file is updated. ##### Outputs & side effects - STATEMNT.PS: one statement block per XREF record (i.e. **per card**, not per account) - an account with several cards gets several statements, each listing only that card's transactions. - STATEMNT.HTML: one complete `...` document per card concatenated into a single file. - SYSOUT DISPLAYs of TIOT DD names and error messages. Abend via CEE3ABD on any unexpected status. ##### External calls - `CALL 'CBSTM03B' USING WS-M03B-AREA` (open/read/keyed-read/close; returns file status in RC and record in FLDT). - `CALL 'CEE3ABD'` (LE abend service, no args here - abend code undefined). - SORT, IDCAMS, IEFBR14 utilities in JCL. ##### Migration notes - Control flow uses **ALTER** and GO TO chains; WS-FL-DD acts as a state machine. Re-implement as straight-line: open trnx -> load all -> open xref/cust/acct -> main loop. - Whole transaction file is held in a fixed table OCCURS 51 cards x 10 tran: **no bounds checking**; >51 distinct cards or >10 transactions per card overwrite storage. Card-matching loop stops early when slot card > xref card, so XREF and TRXFL must both be ascending by card number. - A card in XREF with no transactions still gets a statement with Total 0. Transactions whose card is not in XREF are silently ignored. - Name/address STRING uses DELIMITED BY ' ' -> multi-word first/last names or address line 3 are truncated at the first space. - ST-CURR-BAL PIC 9(9).99- drops the 10th integer digit of ACCT-CURR-BAL; ST-TRANDT truncates DESC from 100 to 49 chars. - Total is a signed sum of all amounts (credits/payments negative reduce it) labelled "Total EXP". - HTML lines are fixed 100-byte records padded with spaces. Bank name/address are hard-coded. - RC '04' accepted on open/first read; keyed reads accept only '00' (missing cust/acct = abend). - CBSTM03B write/rewrite ops are declared but unimplemented; an unknown DD returns without setting RC, so the caller sees whatever RC value it passed in. - TIOT walk depends on z/OS control blocks (PSA at address 0) - not portable; drop in migration. - CREASTMT STEP040 STMTFILE DD has a garbled `SPACE=(CYL,(1,1),RLSE), 00,RECFM=FB), ATA.VSAM.KSDS` line in the repo source.
recommendation: Fully documented. Confirm with the customer whether the 51-card x 10-transaction in-memory limit is a known business limit (overflow is unchecked) and whether "Total EXP" should include transactions of all types (it is a raw signed sum). The corrupted SPACE= continuation line in CREASTMT STEP040 STMTFILE DD (line 89) should be verified against the production JCL.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/CBSTM03A.CBL, app/jcl/CREASTMT.JCL; merged duplicates: sfind-d2b5c3ecef2a4503a20f552ddae9f0eb, sfind-ff5547fd77664e7497f849587a42023e, sfind-239a8e083ed1403eb5ec2e149d6a2ed3, sfind-97c4660ba93344889754f2a26d07facd.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- Hard capacity: 51 cards x 10 transactions per card in WS-TRNX-TABLE; no bounds check - more data overwrites storage. Table lookup relies on cards sorted ascending and stops at first greater card.
- Name/address STRING DELIMITED BY ' ' truncates multi-word values at the first space (e.g. '123 Main St' -> '123'). Address line 3 + state etc. likewise.
- No bounds checks: >51 distinct cards or >10 transactions per card overflow the table (storage overlay) — the whole TRANSACT file is loaded into memory first.
- Lookup assumes both XREF and the table are ascending by card; break on `WS-CARD-NUM > XREF-CARD-NUM`.
- Proc-timestamp is truncated to 24 bytes by the SORT OUTREC (fields 279..328).
- HTML literal markup (bank name/address, table tags) is fixed text in HTML-FIXED-LN 88-levels; reproduce verbatim from source lines ~148-223.

- Customer/account keyed-read failures abend the run; there is no "skip" path.
- Amounts totalled without ROUNDED; total field is edited numeric for print.

- OUTREC copies 279 for 50 bytes (TRAN-ORIG-TS at 279-304 + TRAN-PROC-TS at 305-330 in TRAN-RECORD offsets). The copy ends at 328, so the last 2 bytes of PROC-TS and the 20-byte FILLER are cut and the output is space-padded to 350. Confirm against the CBSTM03A record layout.
- The STMTFILE DD SPACE line contains stray trailing text ('00,RECFM=FB), ATA.VSAM.KSDS') after column 72 or in continuation columns. JCL ignores columns 73-80, but the text spans earlier columns. Check whether the job actually parses before migrating, because the DD may be malformed.

End-to-end: CREASTMT is the statement-generation job in the CA-7 network. Upstream findings: sfind-768eeaac8ac240da839e576915f7309d.
