title: POSTTRAN / CBTRN02C - Daily transaction posting (validate, post, update balances)
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job **POSTTRAN** (`app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl`) step `STEP15 EXEC PGM=CBTRN02C` (STEPLIB AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB). Batch main program, no linkage.
DD -> SELECT mapping: DALYTRAN=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYTRAN.PS (sequential, OPEN INPUT); TRANFILE=TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS (indexed RANDOM key FD-TRANS-ID X(16), **OPEN OUTPUT**); XREFFILE=CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS (indexed RANDOM key card 16, INPUT); DALYREJS=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYREJS(+1) new GDG generation RECFM=F LRECL=430 (OUTPUT); ACCTFILE=ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS (RANDOM key 9(11), **I-O**); TCATBALF=TCATBALF.VSAM.KSDS (RANDOM key acct 9(11)+type X(2)+cat 9(4) = 17 bytes, **I-O**).

##### Inputs
DALYTRAN record 350 bytes, copybook `CVTRA06Y` DALYTRAN-RECORD: ID X(16), TYPE-CD X(2), CAT-CD 9(4), SOURCE X(10), DESC X(100), AMT S9(9)V99 (zoned, sign overpunch), MERCHANT-ID 9(9), MERCHANT-NAME X(50), MERCHANT-CITY X(50), MERCHANT-ZIP X(10), CARD-NUM X(16), ORIG-TS X(26), PROC-TS X(26), FILLER X(20).
Lookup layouts: CARD-XREF-RECORD (`CVACT03Y`: card X16, cust 9(9), acct 9(11), filler 14); ACCOUNT-RECORD (`CVACT01Y`, 300 bytes: ACCT-ID 9(11), ACTIVE-STATUS X, CURR-BAL, CREDIT-LIMIT, CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, OPEN/EXPIRAION/REISSUE dates X(10) 'YYYY-MM-DD', CURR-CYC-CREDIT, CURR-CYC-DEBIT S9(10)V99, ADDR-ZIP X10, GROUP-ID X10, filler 178); TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD (`CVTRA01Y`, 50 bytes: TRANCAT-ACCT-ID 9(11), TRANCAT-TYPE-CD X(2), TRANCAT-CD 9(4), TRAN-CAT-BAL S9(9)V99, filler 22).

##### Processing flow
1. Open all six files (0000-0500); any status other than '00' -> DISPLAY, 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM.
2. Loop until END-OF-FILE='Y': 1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT ('00' ok, '10' EOF, other abend). For each record: WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT+1, reset reason=0/desc=spaces, **1500-VALIDATE-TRAN**:
   - 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF: keyed READ XREF by DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM; INVALID KEY -> reason **100 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND'**.
   - only if reason=0: 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT: READ ACCOUNT by XREF-ACCT-ID; INVALID KEY -> **101 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'**. Else compute `WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT + DALYTRAN-AMT` (WS-TEMP-BAL S9(9)V99, truncation of high-order digit possible); if ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT < WS-TEMP-BAL -> **102 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'**; then independently if ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE < DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS(1:10) (string compare of YYYY-MM-DD) -> **103 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'** (103 overwrites 102 if both fail).
3. reason=0 -> **2000-POST-TRANSACTION**: copy all DALYTRAN fields into TRAN-RECORD (`CVTRA05Y`, same 350-byte layout), TRAN-PROC-TS = Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP (FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE reformatted to `YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.hh0000`); then in order:
   - 2700-UPDATE-TCATBAL: key = XREF-ACCT-ID + DALYTRAN-TYPE-CD + DALYTRAN-CAT-CD; READ; INVALID KEY (status '23') -> create flag 'Y'. Status other than '00'/'23' -> abend. Create: INITIALIZE record, set key, ADD amount to TRAN-CAT-BAL, WRITE. Update: ADD amount, REWRITE. Non-'00' -> abend.
   - 2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC: `ACCT-CURR-BAL += DALYTRAN-AMT`; if amount >= 0 `ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT += amt` else `ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT += amt` (debit accumulates **negative** values); REWRITE; INVALID KEY sets reason 109 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND' but nothing checks it (no reject, no abend).
   - 2900-WRITE-TRANSACTION-FILE: WRITE TRAN-RECORD to TRANFILE; non-'00' (e.g. duplicate '22') -> abend.
4. reason<>0 -> WS-REJECT-COUNT+1, 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC: 430-byte record = 350-byte DALYTRAN-RECORD + 80-byte trailer (reason 9(4) + desc X(76)); write error -> abend.
5. Close all files (close errors abend; 9300 displays XREFFILE-STATUS instead of DALYREJS-STATUS). DISPLAY processed/rejected counts; if rejects > 0 set **RETURN-CODE = 4**. GOBACK.
6. 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM: CALL 'CEE3ABD' USING ABCODE=999, TIMING=0. 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS formats status as 4 digits (binary conversion of byte 2 when stat1='9' or non-numeric).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[POSTTRAN STEP15 CBTRN02C] --> O[0000-0500 open DALYTRAN in, TRANFILE out, XREF in, DALYREJS out, ACCT I-O, TCATBAL I-O]
  O --> R[1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT]
  R -- EOF 10 --> C[9000-9500 close, display counts, RC=4 if rejects]
  R -- 00 --> V1[1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF]
  V1 -- invalid --> RJ100[reason 100]
  V1 -- ok --> V2[1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT]
  V2 -- invalid --> RJ101[reason 101]
  V2 -- ok --> L{CREDIT-LIMIT >= CYC-CREDIT - CYC-DEBIT + AMT}
  L -- no --> RJ102[reason 102]
  L --> E{EXPIRAION-DATE >= ORIG-TS 1:10}
  E -- no --> RJ103[reason 103]
  E -- yes and reason 0 --> P[2000-POST-TRANSACTION]
  P --> TC[2700-UPDATE-TCATBAL write or rewrite]
  TC --> AC[2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC rewrite]
  AC --> WT[2900-WRITE-TRANSACTION-FILE]
  WT --> R
  RJ100 & RJ101 & RJ102 & RJ103 --> WR[2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC DALYREJS]
  WR --> R
  R -- other --> AB[9999-ABEND-PROGRAM CEE3ABD 999]
```

##### Data
Read: DALYTRAN.PS, CARDXREF KSDS. Updated: ACCTDATA KSDS (CURR-BAL, CURR-CYC-CREDIT/DEBIT), TCATBALF KSDS (insert or add to TRAN-CAT-BAL). Written: TRANSACT KSDS (new posted transactions), DALYREJS(+1) GDG.

##### Outputs & side effects
Posted transactions in TRANSACT; balances updated; rejects file with reason codes 100/101/102/103; SYSOUT counts; job RC 4 when any reject, abend U999 on I/O error.

##### External calls
`CALL 'CEE3ABD' USING ABCODE, TIMING` (999, 0). FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE.

##### Migration notes
- No commit/restart logic: an abend mid-run leaves ACCT/TCATBAL partially updated and TRANFILE partially written; order per txn is TCATBAL -> ACCOUNT -> TRANSACT.
- TRANFILE opened OUTPUT although it is the master KSDS; on z/OS this requires an empty or REUSE cluster - otherwise open fails/data replaced. Re-implementation must decide append vs. replace semantics with the customer.
- Overlimit check ignores ACCT-CURR-BAL and uses cycle credit minus cycle debit (where debit is stored negative, so subtraction adds magnitude). Edge: equality passes.
- Expiry check is a lexical compare of 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings; blank expiry date fails (spaces < digits) -> 103.
- Both 102 and 103 checks run; the last failing one wins the reason code.
- Reason 109 set after a failed REWRITE is dead (never reported) and the transaction is still written.
- WS-TEMP-BAL S9(9)V99 vs account S9(10)V99 fields: silent high-order truncation possible.
- Amounts are zoned decimal signed (overpunch) in files; use BigDecimal scale 2.
- RETURN-CODE 4 signals "rejects present" to the scheduler.
recommendation: Fully documented. Customer should confirm: (1) TRANFILE is opened OUTPUT on an existing KSDS (behaviour depends on REUSE attribute / runtime), (2) reason code 109 set on ACCOUNT REWRITE failure is never acted on, (3) credit-limit test uses cycle credit - cycle debit + amount rather than current balance.
note: Duplicate of sfind-8b266e66b8e84f7da258779d51763996 (CBTRN02C daily transaction posting (POSTTRAN)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: TRANREPT / CBTRN03C - Daily transaction detail report with page/account/grand totals
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job **TRANREPT** (`app/jcl/TRANREPT.jcl`, JOBLIB JCLLIB AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PROC):
1. `STEP05R EXEC PROC=REPROC` (CNTLLIB=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CNTL): IDCAMS REPRO (control member `app/ctl/REPROCT.ctl`: `REPRO INFILE(FILEIN) OUTFILE(FILEOUT)`) copying TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS -> TRANSACT.BKUP(+1) (LRECL 350 FB).
2. `STEP05R EXEC PGM=SORT` (duplicate step name): SORTIN TRANSACT.BKUP(+1); SYMNAMES TRAN-CARD-NUM=263,16,ZD; TRAN-PROC-DT=305,10,CH; PARM-START-DATE C'2022-01-01'; PARM-END-DATE C'2022-07-06'; `SORT FIELDS=(TRAN-CARD-NUM,A)`; `INCLUDE COND=(TRAN-PROC-DT,GE,start,AND,TRAN-PROC-DT,LE,end)` -> TRANSACT.DALY(+1).
3. `STEP10R EXEC PGM=CBTRN03C`: TRANFILE=TRANSACT.DALY(+1) (sequential), CARDXREF=CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS, TRANTYPE=TRANTYPE.VSAM.KSDS, TRANCATG=TRANCATG.VSAM.KSDS, DATEPARM=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DATEPARM, TRANREPT=TRANREPT(+1) new LRECL 133 FB.
GDG bases TRANSACT.BKUP, TRANSACT.DALY, TRANREPT are created by DEFGDGB.

##### Inputs
- TRANFILE 350 bytes -> `CVTRA05Y` TRAN-RECORD (TRAN-ID X16, TYPE-CD X2, CAT-CD 9(4), SOURCE X10, DESC X100, AMT S9(9)V99, MERCHANT-ID 9(9), NAME X50, CITY X50, ZIP X10, CARD-NUM X16, ORIG-TS X26, PROC-TS X26, filler X20).
- DATEPARM first 80-byte record -> WS-DATEPARM-RECORD: START-DATE X(10), filler X(1), END-DATE X(10).
- CARDXREF key X16 -> `CVACT03Y`; TRANTYPE key X(2) -> `CVTRA03Y` (TRAN-TYPE X2, TRAN-TYPE-DESC X50, filler 8); TRANCATG key type X2 + cat 9(4) -> `CVTRA04Y` (TRAN-CAT-TYPE-DESC X50, filler 4).

##### Processing flow
1. Open TRANFILE in, REPORT out, XREF/TRANTYPE/TRANCATG/DATEPARM in (non-'00' abend).
2. 0550-DATEPARM-READ: '00' DISPLAY 'Reporting from <start> to <end>'; '10' sets END-OF-FILE='Y' (report then produces nothing); other abend.
3. Loop until END-OF-FILE: 1000-TRANFILE-GET-NEXT ('10' -> EOF). Date test `TRAN-PROC-TS(1:10) between start and end`: true -> CONTINUE; false -> **NEXT SENTENCE**, which jumps past the period ending the PERFORM-UNTIL body, i.e. the record is skipped (and nothing else for that iteration runs).
4. If not EOF: DISPLAY record; on card change (WS-CURR-CARD-NUM <> TRAN-CARD-NUM): if not first time write account totals (1120-WRITE-ACCOUNT-TOTALS: 'Account Total' line, reset account total, dashes line); remember card; 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF (INVALID KEY -> abend). Then 1500-B-LOOKUP-TRANTYPE and 1500-C-LOOKUP-TRANCATG (INVALID KEY -> DISPLAY, status 23, abend). 1100-WRITE-TRANSACTION-REPORT: first time writes headers (report name 'DALYREPT' 'Daily Transaction Report' 'Date Range: start to end', blank, column header, dashes); if `MOD(WS-LINE-COUNTER, 20) = 0` writes page totals + headers again; adds TRAN-AMT to page and account totals; 1120-WRITE-DETAIL (tran id, XREF-ACCT-ID, type cd-desc(15), cat cd-desc(29), source, amount -ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.ZZ).
5. On EOF iteration: DISPLAY TRAN-AMT and page total, **ADD TRAN-AMT (still the last record's amount) TO page and account totals**, 1110-WRITE-PAGE-TOTALS (page total line, add page total into grand total, reset page, dashes) and 1110-WRITE-GRAND-TOTALS. The final account total is **never written**.
6. Close files, GOBACK. 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM: CEE3ABD 999.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J[TRANREPT JCL] --> R1[REPROC IDCAMS REPRO TRANSACT -> BKUP+1]
  R1 --> S[SORT by card, INCLUDE proc date range -> DALY+1]
  S --> P[CBTRN03C]
  P --> DP[0550-DATEPARM-READ]
  DP --> L[1000-TRANFILE-GET-NEXT]
  L --> F{PROC-TS date in range}
  F -- no --> L
  F -- yes / EOF --> E{EOF}
  E -- no --> CC{card changed}
  CC -- yes --> AT[1120-WRITE-ACCOUNT-TOTALS if not first] --> X[1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF]
  CC -- no --> TT
  X --> TT[1500-B TRANTYPE, 1500-C TRANCATG]
  TT --> W[1100-WRITE-TRANSACTION-REPORT headers/page break/detail]
  W --> L
  E -- yes --> PT[add last amt again, page totals, grand total] --> CL[close, GOBACK]
  X & TT -. invalid key .-> AB[9999-ABEND CEE3ABD]
```

##### Data
Read only: TRANSACT.DALY(+1), CARDXREF, TRANTYPE, TRANCATG, DATEPARM. Written: TRANREPT(+1) 133-byte report (`CVTRA07Y` layouts), TRANSACT.BKUP(+1) via REPROC.

##### Outputs & side effects
Report file; SYSOUT display of every transaction record.

##### External calls
IDCAMS (REPROC), DFSORT, `CALL 'CEE3ABD' USING ABCODE, TIMING`.

##### Migration notes
- Two date filters: SORT INCLUDE hard-codes 2022-01-01..2022-07-06 in JCL symnames, COBOL uses DATEPARM; both must agree or the narrower wins.
- Grand total quirk: on EOF the last transaction amount is added a second time to page/account totals before the final page total, so the grand total is overstated by the last amount; the last card's account total line is not printed.
- Page break is based on WS-LINE-COUNTER counting all lines (headers, totals) modulo 20, not detail lines; the first header block sets counter to 4.
- The page-total line written at a page break is followed by headers but page total resets; account totals are not reset at page breaks.
- Missing XREF/type/category aborts the whole report (abend), unlike posting which rejects.
- TRAN-REPORT-ACCOUNT-ID is X(11) moved from 9(11).
- Duplicate JCL step name STEP05R.
recommendation: Fully documented. Confirm with customer the intended behaviour of the date filter (the COBOL IF uses NEXT SENTENCE which skips the rest of the loop body, the real filtering is done by the SORT INCLUDE in TRANREPT) and whether the final grand total double-counting the last page total is a known defect.
note: Duplicate of sfind-14d5b15e18b04d8c913cae17e3df6dce (TRANREPT batch job); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CBADMCDJ - DFHCSDUP job defining (legacy) CardDemo CICS resources
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job **CBADMCDJ** (`//CBADMCDJ JOB (COBOL),'AWSCODR',CLASS=A,MSGCLASS=H,NOTIFY=&SYSUID,TIME=1440`), `SET HLQ=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO`, single step `STEP1 EXEC PGM=DFHCSDUP,REGION=0M,PARM='CSD(READWRITE),PAGESIZE(60),NOCOMPAT'`.

##### Inputs
STEPLIB=OEM.CICSTS.V05R06M0.CICS.SDFHLOAD; DFHCSD=OEM.CICSTS.DFHCSD (DISP=SHR); SYSIN inline with SYMBOLS=JCLONLY (so &HLQ is substituted); OUTDD/SYSPRINT to SYSOUT.

##### Processing flow
In order (DELETE GROUP(CARDDEMO) is commented out - rerun fails on duplicates unless uncommented):
1. DEFINE LIBRARY(COM2DOLL) DSNAME01(&HLQ..LOADLIB). TDQUEUEs CSSD, IRDC commented out.
2. DEFINE MAPSET: COSGN00M (twice), COACT00S, COACTVWS, COACTUPS, COACTDES (each defined twice with account then card descriptions), COTRN00S, COTRNVWS, COTRNVDS, COTRNATS, COBIL00S, COADM00S, COTSTP1S..COTSTP4S.
3. DEFINE PROGRAM: COSGN00C TRANSID(CC00); COACT00C, COACTVWC, COACTUPC, COACTDEC (each twice: account/card descriptions); COTRN00C, COTRNVWC, COTRNVDC, COTRNATC, COBIL00C; COADM00C TRANSID(CCAD); COTSTP1C..4C TRANSID(CCT1..CCT4).
4. DEFINE TRANSACTION: CCDM->COADM00C, CCT1->COTSTP1C, CCT2->COTSTP2C, CCT3->COTSTP3C, CCT4->COTSTP4C (TASKDATAL(ANY)).
5. LIST GROUP(CARDDEMO).
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J[CBADMCDJ] --> S1[STEP1 DFHCSDUP CSD READWRITE]
  S1 --> L[DEFINE LIBRARY COM2DOLL]
  L --> M[DEFINE MAPSETs]
  M --> P[DEFINE PROGRAMs]
  P --> T[DEFINE TRANSACTIONs CCDM CCT1-4]
  T --> LS[LIST GROUP CARDDEMO]
```

##### Data
Updates the CICS system definition file OEM.CICSTS.DFHCSD.

##### Outputs & side effects
CSD group CARDDEMO entries; SYSPRINT listing.

##### External calls
DFHCSDUP (CICS utility).

##### Migration notes
- No FILE definitions and no CC00 TRANSACTION definition (only PROGRAM TRANSID attribute) - the online app cannot run from this job alone.
- Duplicate DEFINEs of the same name in one run: the second overwrites/fails depending on DFHCSDUP options.
- Program names (COACT00C, COACTDEC, COTRNVWC, COTRNVDC, COTRNATC, COADM00C, COTSTPnC) have no source in app/cbl; transaction CCDM points to COADM00C while that program declares TRANSID(CCAD).
- Treat as historical; use CARDDEMO.CSD for the migration inventory.
recommendation: The resource names in this job do not match the programs/mapsets in app/cbl and app/bms (e.g. COADM00C, COACT00C, COTRNVWC, COTSTP1C, mapsets with S/M suffixes). Customer should confirm it is obsolete; app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD is the matching definition set.

title: CCDL / COCRDSLC - Credit card detail view (READ CARDDAT by card number)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CCDL** -> **COCRDSLC** (LIT-THISTRANID 'CCDL', map `CCRDSLA`, mapset `COCRDSL`). Reached from menu COMEN01C or from card list COCRDLIC ('S' selection, LIT-CCLISTPGM). `HANDLE ABEND LABEL(ABEND-ROUTINE)`. RETURN TRANSID('CCDL') COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA X(2000)).

##### Inputs
COMMAREA = `COCOM01Y` CARDDEMO-COMMAREA + WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA (CA-FROM-PROGRAM X8, CA-FROM-TRANID X4). Map inputs ACCTSID (11 digits), CARDSID (16 digits). AID via `CSSTRPFY`; only ENTER/PF3 valid, others treated as ENTER.
Copybooks: CVCRD01Y (CC-WORK-AREA: AID flags, CC-ACCT-ID/-N, CC-CARD-NUM/-N, next prog/map, error msg), COCOM01Y, DFHBMSCA, DFHAID, COTTL01Y (titles), COCRDSL (BMS map), CSDAT01Y (date/time), CSMSG01Y/CSMSG02Y (messages, abend data), CSUSR01Y, CVACT02Y CARD-RECORD (CARD-NUM X16, CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11), CVV 9(3), EMBOSSED-NAME X50, EXPIRAION-DATE X10, ACTIVE-STATUS X1, FILLER X59 = 150 bytes), CVCUS01Y.

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 or (from COMEN01C and not re-enter) -> initialise commareas; else restore.
2. PF3: TO-TRANID/PROGRAM = FROM values or CM00/COMEN01C, FROM=CCDL/COCRDSLC, user type forced 'U', PGM-ENTER, XCTL.
3. PGM-ENTER and FROM-PROGRAM='COCRDLIC': take CDEMO-ACCT-ID and CDEMO-CARD-NUM from commarea, 9000-READ-DATA, send map (filters protected/default colour since came from list).
4. PGM-ENTER otherwise: send blank prompt map.
5. PGM-REENTER: RECEIVE; 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT ('*'/blank/zero -> blank + prompt; not numeric -> 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER'); 2220-EDIT-CARD (blank/zero -> blank; non-numeric -> 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER'). Any error (including blanks) -> send map. OK -> 9000-READ-DATA -> 9100-GETCARD-BYACCTCARD: `EXEC CICS READ FILE('CARDDAT') RIDFLD(card num X16) KEYLENGTH(16) INTO(CARD-RECORD)`. NORMAL -> FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT; NOTFND -> both filters red, DID-NOT-FIND-ACCTCARD-COMBO message; other -> 'File Error: READ on CARDDAT ...'.
6. 1000-SEND-MAP: shows account/card ids, embossed name, expiry month/year (split from CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE), status; SEND MAP ERASE FREEKB CURSOR.
7. Unexpected state -> SEND TEXT 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO' + RETURN. ABEND-ROUTINE -> SEND ABEND-DATA, ABEND '9999'.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CCDL COCRDSLC] --> K{AID / context}
  K -- PF3 --> X[XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C]
  K -- ENTER from COCRDLIC --> RD[9100-GETCARD-BYACCTCARD READ CARDDAT]
  K -- ENTER first --> S[1000-SEND-MAP prompt]
  K -- reenter --> E[2000-PROCESS-INPUTS edit acct + card]
  E -- error --> S
  E -- ok --> RD
  RD --> S
  S --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CCDL]
```

##### Data
Read-only CARDDAT (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS) key card number. CARDAIX (alternate index by account) referenced only by unreachable 9150-GETCARD-BYACCT.

##### Outputs & side effects
Card details screen. No updates.

##### External calls
XCTL COMEN01C / FROM-PROGRAM; CICS ABEND 9999.

##### Migration notes
- Card lookup ignores the account id: an account/card mismatch still displays the card (account only validated for numeric).
- Both account and card are mandatory on manual entry (blank -> INPUT-ERROR).
- 9150-GETCARD-BYACCT is dead code (no PERFORM).
- CVV is read but not shown.
- PF3 forces user type 'U'.
recommendation: Fully documented. 9150-GETCARD-BYACCT (CARDAIX read) is never PERFORMed - dead code; the account id entered is validated but not used to filter the card lookup.

title: CU03 / COUSR03C - Admin "Delete User" screen (READ UPDATE + DELETE USRSEC)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CU03** -> **COUSR03C**, reached from admin menu COADM01C option 4 or from user list COUSR00C (selection passes CDEMO-CU03-USR-SELECTED). Map `COUSR3A` mapset `COUSR03`. RETURN TRANSID('CU03').

##### Inputs
COMMAREA = `COCOM01Y` CARDDEMO-COMMAREA followed by program extension CDEMO-CU03-INFO: USRID-FIRST X8, USRID-LAST X8, PAGE-NUM 9(8), NEXT-PAGE-FLG X1, USR-SEL-FLG X1, USR-SELECTED X8. Map input USRIDIN (+ display-only FNAME, LNAME, USRTYPE). EIBAID ENTER/PF3/PF4/PF5/PF12.

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C. First entry: set re-enter, blank map; if CU03-USR-SELECTED not spaces/low-values, place into USRIDIN and PROCESS-ENTER-KEY (lookup); SEND.
2. Re-entry RECEIVE: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM (or COADM01C if blank); PF4 -> clear; PF5 -> DELETE-USER-INFO; PF12 -> XCTL COADM01C; other -> invalid key.
3. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: blank id -> 'User ID can NOT be empty...'. Else READ-USER-SEC-FILE: `EXEC CICS READ DATASET('USRSEC') INTO(SEC-USER-DATA) RIDFLD(SEC-USR-ID) KEYLENGTH(8) UPDATE`. NORMAL -> 'Press PF5 key to delete this user ...' (neutral colour) and SEND; NOTFND -> 'User ID NOT found...'; other -> DISPLAY RESP/RESP2, 'Unable to lookup User...'. Then if no error, FNAME/LNAME/USRTYPE are filled from record and SEND again.
4. DELETE-USER-INFO (PF5): blank id check; READ UPDATE again (sends the 'Press PF5' screen) then `EXEC CICS DELETE DATASET('USRSEC')` (deletes the record held by the READ UPDATE). NORMAL -> clear, green 'User <id> has been deleted ...'; NOTFND -> 'User ID NOT found...'; other -> 'Unable to Update User...'.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CU03 COUSR03C] --> B{EIBCALEN=0}
  B -- yes --> SG[XCTL COSGN00C]
  B -- no --> C{REENTER}
  C -- no --> SEL{CU03-USR-SELECTED set} -- yes --> PE
  SEL -- no --> S[SEND COUSR3A]
  C -- yes --> R[RECEIVE] --> K{EIBAID}
  K -- ENTER --> PE[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY READ USRSEC UPDATE]
  K -- PF5 --> DL[DELETE-USER-INFO READ UPDATE + DELETE USRSEC]
  K -- PF3 --> FP[XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COADM01C]
  K -- PF12 --> AD[XCTL COADM01C]
  K -- PF4 --> CL[clear]
  PE --> S
  DL --> S
  CL --> S
  S --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CU03]
```

##### Data
USRSEC KSDS (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS) via `CSUSR01Y` SEC-USER-DATA (ID X8, FNAME X20, LNAME X20, PWD X8, TYPE X1, filler X23). Read for update, then delete.

##### Outputs & side effects
Deletes a user record; multiple SEND MAP calls can occur within one task (lookup sends 'Press PF5' screen and then a second populated screen; delete sends after READ and after DELETE).

##### External calls
XCTL COSGN00C / COADM01C / CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM.

##### Migration notes
- Enter performs READ with UPDATE (lock) but the lock is released at task end by RETURN - no cross-turn locking; PF5 re-reads.
- DELETE-USER-INFO performs READ then DELETE unconditionally; ERR-FLG from the READ is not re-checked, so DELETE is attempted even after a failed READ (the resulting non-NORMAL RESP falls into the NOTFND or 'Unable to Update User...' branch).
- Error message for other DELETE failures says 'Update' not 'Delete'.
- USR-MODIFIED flag set but unused.
- Multiple SEND MAP ERASE per task: final screen is the last sent.
- No confirmation beyond PF5; no admin authorisation check.
recommendation: Fully documented.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/COUSR03C.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-f0ac197e691c42e9b586b4bd4e5592d6.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- PF5 deletes without any confirmation beyond the prior message; no check that the user isn't deleting themselves or the last admin.
- If the READ in DELETE-USER-INFO fails, DELETE is still executed (it is PERFORMed unconditionally after READ) and will fail with INVALIDREQ -> 'Unable to Update User...'.

title: CCLI / COCRDLIC - Credit card list (7-row paged browse of CARDDAT with account/card filters; S=view, U=update)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CCLI** -> **COCRDLIC** (map `CCRDLIA`, mapset `COCRDLI`), from main menu COMEN01C. RETURN TRANSID('CCLI') COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA X(2000)) at COMMON-RETURN. No HANDLE ABEND in this program.

##### Inputs
COMMAREA = `COCOM01Y` + WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA: LAST-CARDKEY (card X16, acct 9(11)), FIRST-CARDKEY (card X16, acct 9(11)), SCREEN-NUM 9(1) (1=first page), LAST-PAGE-DISPLAYED 9(1) (0 shown / 9 not shown), NEXT-PAGE-IND X1 ('Y' exists / low-values), RETURN-FLAG X1.
Map: ACCTSID (account filter), CARDSID (card filter), CRDSEL1..7 (selection 'S' or 'U'). AID ENTER/PF3/PF7/PF8 (others -> ENTER). Card record `CVACT02Y` (150 bytes). WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES = 7.

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> initialise commarea, FROM=CCLI/COCRDLIC, user type 'U', first page. If PGM-ENTER and FROM-PROGRAM is not COCRDLIC -> reset program area, first page.
2. If returning to self (EIBCALEN>0 and FROM=COCRDLIC) -> 2000-RECEIVE-MAP: receive filters/selections; 2210 account filter (blank OK; non-numeric -> error, rows protected, 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER'); 2220 card filter (non-numeric 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER'); 2250-EDIT-ARRAY: count of 'S'+'U' > 1 -> error (more than one action, flagged rows); any value other than S/U/blank -> invalid action code; I-SELECTED = selected row.
3. PF3 while in self -> XCTL COMEN01C with commarea (user type 'U').
4. EVALUATE:
   - INPUT-ERROR: if filters themselves are OK re-read forward; send map with error.
   - PF7 on first page: read forward from FIRST-CARD-NUM (message 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY').
   - PF3 or re-enter from other program: reset and read first page.
   - PF8 with next page: start key = LAST-CARD-NUM, SCREEN-NUM+1, 9000-READ-FORWARD.
   - PF7 not first page: start key FIRST-CARD-NUM, SCREEN-NUM-1, 9100-READ-BACKWARDS.
   - ENTER + 'S' on a row (and from self): CDEMO-ACCT-ID/CARD-NUM = row values, XCTL **COCRDSLC** (view).
   - ENTER + 'U': same, XCTL **COCRDUPC** (card update; not in this batch).
   - OTHER: read forward from FIRST-CARD-NUM.
5. 9000-READ-FORWARD: `STARTBR DATASET('CARDDAT') RIDFLD(card) GTEQ`; READNEXT loop; each record passes 9500-FILTER-RECORDS (exclude if account filter valid and CARD-ACCT-ID <> filter, or card filter valid and CARD-NUM <> filter); fills up to 7 rows (acct, card, active status); row 1 saved as FIRST key; when 7 rows filled saves LAST key and does one look-ahead READNEXT to set NEXT-PAGE exists/not ('NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW'); ENDFILE -> no next page, 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW', and if page 1 with zero rows -> WS-NO-RECORDS-FOUND; other RESP -> 'File Error' message. ENDBR.
6. 9100-READ-BACKWARDS: STARTBR GTEQ at FIRST key; counter = 8; one READPREV to step over current first row; then READPREV filling rows 7..1 (filtered), saving FIRST key at row 1; ENDBR.
7. 1000-SEND-MAP: header + page number, rows (unprotect selection fields for filled rows unless errors), filter echo, messages (1400: PF7 first page 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY', PF8 last page 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY', info message), SEND MAP ERASE FREEKB CURSOR.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CCLI COCRDLIC] --> I{EIBCALEN / from self}
  I -- from self --> RM[2000-RECEIVE-MAP edit filters + selections]
  I --> K{EVALUATE}
  RM --> K
  K -- PF3 self --> M[XCTL COMEN01C]
  K -- S row --> V[XCTL COCRDSLC]
  K -- U row --> U[XCTL COCRDUPC]
  K -- PF8 next --> F[9000-READ-FORWARD STARTBR GTEQ / READNEXT x7 + lookahead]
  K -- PF7 not first --> B[9100-READ-BACKWARDS READPREV]
  K -- error/other/first --> F
  F --> FL[9500-FILTER-RECORDS acct/card]
  B --> FL
  FL --> S[1000-SEND-MAP]
  S --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CCLI]
```

##### Data
Read-only browse of CARDDAT (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS), key CARD-NUM X16. LIT-CARD-FILE-ACCT-PATH 'CARDAIX' declared but not used.

##### Outputs & side effects
List screen; on selection, CDEMO-ACCT-ID and CDEMO-CARD-NUM set in commarea and control passed to COCRDSLC/COCRDUPC with CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM='COCRDLIC'.

##### External calls
XCTL COMEN01C, COCRDSLC, COCRDUPC (all with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA).

##### Migration notes
- Filtering is done client-side while browsing the whole card file in key order (full scan for sparse filters).
- SCREEN-NUM is PIC 9(1): wraps after page 9.
- Backward paging re-reads from FIRST key and relies on the GTEQ position; with filters active, pages may differ from forward pages.
- Only first selected row is actioned; >1 'S'/'U' is an error.
- PF3 / navigation always force user type 'U'.
- No HANDLE ABEND (unlike sibling programs).
recommendation: Fully documented. Note that the list does not restrict cards to the signed-in user's account unless an account filter is typed (admin vs user context is not applied).
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/COCRDLIC.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-127591b4acad40bb92eb82e4ecf9c249, sfind-a246dd3d99f548af8caa588580c53fa5, sfind-3d33040d2a94436791d9222a9ac22c31.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- MEDIUM/LOW confidence: only the CICS command skeleton, literals and targets (lines cited) were read; the exact filter edit messages, page size, selection validation (multiple selections, invalid codes), admin-vs-user filtering, and the program-specific COMMAREA layout were NOT fully traced and must be read from COCRDLIC.cbl before re-implementation.
- Filtering is applied while browsing the full card file by primary key (not via the account AIX), so a filtered page may scan many records.

- Page size is WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES = 7 (COMP).
- Blank/zero filters exit the edit paragraph (GO TO ...-EXIT) and mean 'no filter'; only non-numeric input is an error.
- WHEN PF7 AND CA-FIRST-PAGE appears twice (first WHEN falls through to the second).
- Rows count only 'S'/'U' uppercase.
- Every XCTL forces `CDEMO-USRTYP-USER` and `CDEMO-PGM-ENTER`, so admin status is not propagated.
- Only first error message wins (`WS-ERROR-MSG-OFF` checks).
- Header comments describe admin-sees-all vs user-sees-own-account behavior; no such role-based filter was found in the executed paragraphs (filtering depends only on the screen filters).


End-to-end: XCTLed by COMEN01C via the COMEN02Y option table (main menu). Upstream findings: sfind-6417f0efb3484b28b9b140c6d330e02d.

title: CU01 / COUSR01C - Admin "Add User" screen (writes USRSEC)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CU01** -> **COUSR01C** (CSD), reached via admin menu COADM01C option 2. Map `COUSR1A` mapset `COUSR01`. Pseudo-conversational RETURN TRANSID('CU01') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA).

##### Inputs
COMMAREA `COCOM01Y` (see layout: FROM/TO tranid/program, USER-ID, USER-TYPE, PGM-CONTEXT, customer/account/card info, last map). Map inputs FNAME, LNAME, USERID, PASSWD, USRTYPE. EIBAID ENTER/PF3/PF4.

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C. First entry (context<>1): set re-enter, blank map, cursor FNAME, SEND.
2. Re-entry RECEIVE: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL COADM01C; PF4 -> clear fields and resend; other -> 'Invalid key' (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY).
3. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: EVALUATE in order First Name, Last Name, User ID, Password, User Type must not be spaces/low-values (message '<field> can NOT be empty...', cursor on field). No further validation (user type not checked for 'A'/'U').
4. Valid: build SEC-USER-DATA (`CSUSR01Y`, 80 bytes: SEC-USR-ID X8, FNAME X20, LNAME X20, PWD X8, TYPE X1, FILLER X23) and `EXEC CICS WRITE DATASET('USRSEC') RIDFLD(SEC-USR-ID) KEYLENGTH(8)`.
   - NORMAL -> clear fields, green 'User <id> has been added ...'.
   - DUPKEY/DUPREC -> 'User ID already exist...'.
   - other -> 'Unable to Add User...'.
5. RETURN TRANSID CU01. XCTL paths set FROM-TRANID/PROGRAM and context 0.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CU01 COUSR01C] --> B{EIBCALEN=0}
  B -- yes --> SG[XCTL COSGN00C]
  B -- no --> C{REENTER}
  C -- no --> S[SEND COUSR1A]
  C -- yes --> R[RECEIVE COUSR1A] --> K{EIBAID}
  K -- PF3 --> AD[XCTL COADM01C]
  K -- PF4 --> CL[clear + SEND]
  K -- other --> IK[invalid key SEND]
  K -- ENTER --> V{all 5 fields non-blank}
  V -- no --> E[error SEND]
  V -- yes --> W[WRITE USRSEC key SEC-USR-ID]
  W -- NORMAL --> OK[added msg]
  W -- DUPKEY/DUPREC --> DU[already exist]
  W -- other --> UF[Unable to Add]
  S & CL & IK & E & OK & DU & UF --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CU01]
```

##### Data
Writes USRSEC (CSD FILE USRSEC -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS), key 8-byte user id, 80-byte record.

##### Outputs & side effects
New security user; screen messages; header shows title, tran, program, date MM/DD/YY, time HH:MM:SS.

##### External calls
XCTL COSGN00C / COADM01C with COMMAREA.

##### Migration notes
- Unlike COUSR03C, PF3 always goes to COADM01C (ignores FROM-PROGRAM).
- Map field lengths may exceed record fields; MOVE truncates (FNAME/LNAME to 20, ID/PWD to 8).
- Password stored as plain text; user type is free text (any non-blank character accepted).
- SEND is not followed by GO TO, so after an error SEND the EVALUATE still falls into `IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON` (skipped because flag set) - single send per task.
- No authorisation check that the caller is an admin (relies on menu navigation).
recommendation: Fully documented. Passwords are stored in clear text in USRSEC (SEC-USR-PWD X(8)) - the migration should decide on hashing with the customer.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/COUSR01C.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-b8ffcb47e47b4d68973a2a405f5c833b.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- User id not upper-cased either, while sign-on upper-cases the lookup key.
- User type accepts any non-blank character; only 'A' gets admin menu at sign-on.
- No authorization check that caller is admin.

title: CAUP / COACTUPC - Account + customer update (fetch, edit, confirm PF5, READ UPDATE / REWRITE ACCTDAT + CUSTDAT)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CAUP** -> **COACTUPC** (LIT-THISTRANID 'CAUP', LIT-THISPGM 'COACTUPC', map `CACTUPA`, mapset `COACTUP`), invoked from main menu COMEN01C. `EXEC CICS HANDLE ABEND LABEL(ABEND-ROUTINE)` (line 862). Pseudo-conversational `RETURN TRANSID('CAUP') COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA) LENGTH(2000)` at COMMON-RETURN (line 1015).

##### Inputs
- DFHCOMMAREA = `COCOM01Y` CARDDEMO-COMMAREA + WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, which carries ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION X(1) state: LOW-VALUES/space = DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, 'S' SHOW-DETAILS, 'E' CHANGES-NOT-OK, 'N' CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED, 'C' CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE, 'L' lock error, 'F' update failed; plus ACUP-OLD-DETAILS (snapshot of account + customer as fetched) and ACUP-NEW-DETAILS.
- Map CACTUPA inputs: ACCTSID (11 digits), ACSTTUS (Y/N), ACRDLIM, ACSHLIM, ACURBAL, ACRCYCR, ACRCYDB (signed amounts), open/expiry/reissue date parts (year/month/day), AADDGRP group id, customer id, first/middle/last name, address lines 1-3 (3 = city), state, zip, country, phone 1 & 2 (area/prefix/line), SSN (3/2/4), DOB parts, FICO, govt id, EFT account, primary holder flag. '*' or spaces in an input means "not supplied" (LOW-VALUES).
- AID via `CSSTRPFY`; valid keys: ENTER, PF3, PF5 only when state 'N', PF12 only after details fetched; all others treated as ENTER.
- Layouts: `CVACT01Y` ACCOUNT-RECORD (300), `CVCUS01Y` CUSTOMER-RECORD (500), `CVACT03Y` CARD-XREF-RECORD (50); ACCT-UPDATE-RECORD / CUST-UPDATE-RECORD (same layouts as the masters, built for REWRITE).

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 or (from COMEN01C and not re-enter) -> initialise, PGM-ENTER, DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED. Else restore commarea.
2. **PF3**: TO-TRANID/PROGRAM = FROM values or CM00/COMEN01C; FROM=CAUP/COACTUPC; user type forced 'U'; `EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT`; XCTL (line 956).
3. DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED + PGM-ENTER, or from menu first time -> 3000-SEND-MAP (prompt for account), set REENTER -> return.
4. State 'C' or 'L'/'F' (after an update attempt) -> reset program area and CDEMO-ACCT-ID, send fresh prompt map.
5. Otherwise: **1000-PROCESS-INPUTS** (1100-RECEIVE-MAP: move every screen field to ACUP-NEW-*, amounts via TEST-NUMVAL-C/NUMVAL-C; 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS), **2000-DECIDE-ACTION**, **3000-SEND-MAP**.
6. 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS: if details not fetched -> only 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT (blank -> prompt; non-numeric/zero -> 'Account Number if supplied must be a 11 digit Non-Zero Number') and exit. If fetched -> 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW (case-insensitive, trimmed comparisons of all fields; no change -> NO-CHANGES-DETECTED). If no changes or already confirmed/done, skip edits. Else edits in order: Account Status Y/N (1220); Open Date (EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD from `CSUTLDPY`: year 4 digits, month 1-12, day 1-31, then CALL 'CSUTLDTC'); Credit Limit (1250 signed 9V2 via TEST-NUMVAL-C); Expiry Date; Cash Credit Limit; Reissue Date; Current Balance; Current Cycle Credit; Current Cycle Debit; SSN (1265: part1 3 digits not 000/666/900-999 (INVALID-SSN-PART1), part2 2 digits, part3 4 digits); Date of Birth (date edit + EDIT-DATE-OF-BIRTH 'cannot be in the future'); FICO (3 digits, 1275 range FICO-RANGE-IS-VALID); First Name (alpha required, 25); Middle Name (alpha optional); Last Name (alpha required); Address Line 1 mandatory (50); State (alpha 2 + 1270 VALID-US-STATE-CODE); Zip (numeric 5); City = address line 3 (alpha required 50); Country (alpha 3); Phone 1 and Phone 2 (1260: optional as a whole; area code numeric, non-zero, VALID-GENERAL-PURP-CODE; prefix numeric non-zero; line number numeric non-zero); EFT Account Id numeric 10; Primary Card Holder Y/N; if state and zip valid -> 1280 state/zip-prefix combo (VALID-US-STATE-ZIP-CD2-COMBO). No error -> state 'N' (CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED). First error message wins (WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF guard), but every field flag is evaluated for highlighting.
7. 2000-DECIDE-ACTION:
   - not fetched / PF12: if account filter valid -> **9000-READ-ACCT**: 9200 `READ DATASET('CXACAIX') RIDFLD(acct)` -> CDEMO-CUST-ID/CARD-NUM; 9300 `READ DATASET('ACCTDAT')`; 9400 `READ DATASET('CUSTDAT') RIDFLD(cust id)`; 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA copies both records into ACUP-OLD-DETAILS. If customer found -> state 'S'.
   - 'S': if no input error and changes detected -> 'N'.
   - 'E': nothing.
   - 'N' + PF5 -> **9600-WRITE-PROCESSING**: `READ FILE('ACCTDAT') UPDATE` (fail -> COULD-NOT-LOCK-ACCT-FOR-UPDATE); `READ FILE('CUSTDAT') UPDATE` (fail -> COULD-NOT-LOCK-CUST-FOR-UPDATE); 9700-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC compares current master values with ACUP-OLD snapshot (optimistic concurrency) -> DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE; build ACCT-UPDATE-RECORD (dates rebuilt 'YYYY-MM-DD' from parts, amounts from -N fields) and CUST-UPDATE-RECORD (phones formatted '(aaa)bbb-cccc', DOB 'YYYY-MM-DD'); `REWRITE FILE('ACCTDAT')` (fail -> LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED); `REWRITE FILE('CUSTDAT')` (fail -> LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED + `SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK`). Result: lock error -> 'L'; update failed -> 'F'; data changed -> 'S' (re-show); else 'C'.
   - 'N' without PF5: wait for confirmation.
   - 'C': 'S'; if no FROM-TRANID clear CDEMO-ACCT-ID/CARD-NUM/STATUS.
   - other -> ABEND-ROUTINE with 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO'.
8. 3000-SEND-MAP: 3100 header; 3200 shows initial (prompt), original (fetched) or updated values; 3250 info message by state (e.g. prompt, review/confirm with PF5, changes committed, failed); 3300 attributes (protect all when not fetched, unprotect editable fields after fetch, red/'*' for bad fields); 3400 `SEND MAP('CACTUPA') MAPSET('COACTUP') ERASE FREEKB CURSOR`.
9. ABEND-ROUTINE: SEND ABEND-DATA ERASE NOHANDLE, HANDLE ABEND CANCEL, `ABEND ABCODE('9999')`.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CAUP COACTUPC 0000-MAIN] --> H[HANDLE ABEND]
  H --> K{AID / ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION}
  K -- PF3 --> SP[SYNCPOINT + XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C]
  K -- first entry --> S[3000-SEND-MAP prompt]
  K -- C/L/F --> RS[reset, prompt] --> S
  K -- other --> P[1000-PROCESS-INPUTS RECEIVE CACTUPA + 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS]
  P --> D[2000-DECIDE-ACTION]
  D -- not fetched/PF12 --> R[9000-READ-ACCT CXACAIX -> ACCTDAT -> CUSTDAT]
  R --> SD[state S]
  D -- S + valid changes --> N[state N confirm]
  D -- N + PF5 --> W[9600-WRITE-PROCESSING READ UPDATE acct+cust]
  W --> CK{9700 changed since fetch}
  CK -- yes --> SD
  CK -- no --> RW[REWRITE ACCTDAT, REWRITE CUSTDAT]
  RW -- cust fail --> RB[SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK, state F]
  RW -- ok --> C[state C]
  W -- lock fail --> L[state L]
  SD & N & C & L & RB --> S
  S --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CAUP]
  D -- unexpected --> AB[ABEND-ROUTINE ABEND 9999]
```

##### Data
Read: CXACAIX (CARDXREF AIX path AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDXREF.VSAM.AIX.PATH, by account). Read/update: ACCTDAT (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS, key acct 9(11)), CUSTDAT (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CUSTDATA.VSAM.KSDS, key cust 9(9)). Commarea holds old/new snapshots between turns.

##### Outputs & side effects
Account master and customer master rewritten in one CICS unit of work; screen messages; on PF3 an explicit SYNCPOINT.

##### External calls
`CALL 'CSUTLDTC'` (date validation inside CSUTLDPY EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD); XCTL to FROM-PROGRAM / COMEN01C; CICS SYNCPOINT, SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK, ABEND 9999.

##### Migration notes
- Two-phase interaction: fetch -> edit -> confirm with PF5; state is entirely in commarea byte ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION.
- Optimistic concurrency: 9700 compares the master with the snapshot taken at fetch; mismatch re-shows data without writing. Note the DOB comparison uses old snapshot offsets (5:2)/(7:2) vs master (6:2)/(9:2) - the snapshot DOB is stored without dashes.
- If ACCTDAT REWRITE fails, the code still attempts CUSTDAT REWRITE and only CUSTDAT failure triggers SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK; an ACCT failure followed by a CUST success is committed at task end.
- Lock failures: the code continues to the change check / rewrite even after a failed READ UPDATE (only flags are set) - REWRITE then fails with INVALREQ.
- Admin-editable financial fields (current balance, cycle credit/debit, limits) are directly overwritten - no audit trail, no transaction posting.
- Comparison for "no change" is case-insensitive; uppercase/lowercase-only edits are ignored.
- PF3 performs SYNCPOINT and forces user type 'U'.
- Zip edited as 5 digits although stored X(10); phone stored formatted '(aaa)bbb-cccc'.
recommendation: Core state machine, edits and write path are traced. Not individually transcribed: the screen-attribute paragraphs 3300-3584 (field protect/colour) and the exact text of each edit error message in 1215-1280; the lookup tables behind VALID-US-STATE-CODE, VALID-GENERAL-PURP-CODE (phone area codes) and VALID-US-STATE-ZIP-CD2-COMBO come from copybook CSLKPCDY and should be ported verbatim. Customer should confirm the intended rollback semantics (account REWRITE failure is not rolled back explicitly).
note: Duplicate of sfind-ea9f460e24fc4aafaa64553e6a0577e2 (COACTUPC account + customer update (TRANSID CAUP)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CBSTM03B - File-service subprogram for statement generation (open/read/keyed-read/close for 4 VSAM files)
description:
##### Entry point
Called subprogram `PROGRAM-ID. CBSTM03B`, `PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LK-M03B-AREA` (line 114). Invoked by `CALL 'CBSTM03B' USING WS-M03B-AREA` from CBSTM03A (CREASTMT STEP040); inherits that step's DDs.

##### Inputs
LK-M03B-AREA: LK-M03B-DD X(8) file selector; LK-M03B-OPER X(1) 'O' open, 'C' close, 'R' read next, 'K' keyed read, 'W' write, 'Z' rewrite; LK-M03B-RC X(2) out status; LK-M03B-KEY X(25); LK-M03B-KEY-LN S9(4); LK-M03B-FLDT X(1000) record buffer.

##### Processing flow
EVALUATE LK-M03B-DD:
- 'TRNXFILE' -> 1000-TRNXFILE-PROC: TRNX-FILE (DD TRNXFILE, indexed SEQUENTIAL, key FD-TRNXS-ID = card X16 + tran id X16, record 350 = 32 key + 318 data). 'O' OPEN INPUT; 'R' READ (next) INTO FLDT; 'C' CLOSE. RC = TRNXFILE-STATUS.
- 'XREFFILE' -> 2000: XREF-FILE (indexed SEQUENTIAL, key card X16, data X34). 'O','R','C' as above.
- 'CUSTFILE' -> 3000: CUST-FILE (indexed RANDOM, key FD-CUST-ID X(9), data X491). 'O'; 'K' MOVE KEY(1:KEY-LN) to key, READ INTO FLDT; 'C'.
- 'ACCTFILE' -> 4000: ACCT-FILE (indexed RANDOM, key FD-ACCT-ID 9(11), data X289). 'O'; 'K' keyed read; 'C'.
- other -> GOBACK (RC untouched).
Every branch ends by moving the file status to LK-M03B-RC, then GOBACK.
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  C[CALL CBSTM03B USING LK-M03B-AREA] --> D{LK-M03B-DD}
  D -- TRNXFILE --> T{OPER O/R/C}
  D -- XREFFILE --> X{OPER O/R/C}
  D -- CUSTFILE --> CU{OPER O/K/C}
  D -- ACCTFILE --> A{OPER O/K/C}
  D -- other --> G[GOBACK]
  T & X & CU & A --> RC[RC = file status] --> G
```

##### Data
Read-only access to TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS, CARDXREF, CUSTDATA, ACCTDATA KSDS.

##### Outputs & side effects
Record in FLDT, status in RC.

##### External calls
None.

##### Migration notes
- 'W'/'Z' declared but not implemented anywhere; unsupported op/file combos return the previous status without I/O.
- Keyed read uses caller-supplied key length substring (9 for cust, 11 for acct).
- Files stay open across calls (subprogram storage persists), so the caller must close.
recommendation: Fully documented. Only caller in repo is CBSTM03A.
note:
End-to-end: CBSTM03B is CALLed (USING WS-M03B-AREA) by CBSTM03A in job CREASTMT for every open/read/keyed-read/close of TRNXFILE, XREFFILE, CUSTFILE, ACCTFILE; together they form the statement-generation flow. Upstream findings: sfind-c61aa7aa8ce745ec820239c5975bbf26.

title: CR00 / CORPT00C - Online transaction report request (submits TRANREPT JCL to TDQ JOBS)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CR00** -> program **CORPT00C** (CSD `DEFINE TRANSACTION(CR00)`), reached by XCTL from main menu COMEN01C. Pseudo-conversational: every exit is `EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CR00') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)`. Map `CORPT0A` mapset `CORPT00`.

##### Inputs
- DFHCOMMAREA -> `COCOM01Y` CARDDEMO-COMMAREA: FROM-TRANID X4, FROM-PROGRAM X8, TO-TRANID X4, TO-PROGRAM X8, USER-ID X8, USER-TYPE X1 ('A'/'U'), PGM-CONTEXT 9(1) (0 enter / 1 re-enter), CUST-ID 9(9), CUST F/M/L NAME X25 each, ACCT-ID 9(11), ACCT-STATUS X1, CARD-NUM 9(16), LAST-MAP X7, LAST-MAPSET X7.
- Map fields: MONTHLY, YEARLY, CUSTOM (selector - any non-blank), SDTMM/SDTDD/SDTYYYY, EDTMM/EDTDD/EDTYYYY, CONFIRM (Y/N). EIBAID ENTER/PF3/other.

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C (sign-on). Else copy commarea; first entry (context<>1): set re-enter, clear map, cursor MONTHLY, send screen.
2. Re-entry: RECEIVE map; ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL COMEN01C; other -> 'Invalid key' message.
3. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY (first non-blank selector wins, order Monthly, Yearly, Custom):
   - **Monthly**: start = current YYYY-MM-01; end = last day of current month (day=1, month+1 with year rollover, then DATE-OF-INTEGER(INTEGER-OF-DATE - 1)).
   - **Yearly**: start YYYY-01-01, end YYYY-12-31 of current year.
   - **Custom**: mandatory checks (start MM, DD, YYYY, end MM, DD, YYYY) in that order; NUMVAL-C conversion back into fields; month <= '12', day <= '31', year numeric; then `CALL 'CSUTLDTC' USING date(X10 'YYYY-MM-DD'), format 'YYYY-MM-DD', result(80)`; valid if SEV-CD='0000' or MSG-NUM='2513' (accepted), else 'Start/End Date - Not a valid date...'.
   - none selected -> 'Select a report type to print report...'.
   - Dates are moved into the in-storage JCL deck (JOB-DATA): `PARM-START-DATE,C'yyyy-mm-dd'` / `PARM-END-DATE,C'...'` SYMNAMES lines and the DATEPARM record `start end`.
4. SUBMIT-JOB-TO-INTRDR: CONFIRM blank -> 'Please confirm to print the <name> report...'; 'N'/'n' -> clear fields and redisplay; not Y/y -> '"x" is not a valid value to confirm...'. On 'Y': loop JOB-LINES(1..1000) writing each 80-byte line with `EXEC CICS WRITEQ TD QUEUE('JOBS')` until a line equal to '/*EOF' or spaces/low-values (that terminating line **is also written**). Error -> 'Unable to Write TDQ (JOBS)...'.
5. Success: clear fields, green message '<Monthly|Yearly|Custom> report submitted for printing ...'.
Every SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN ends with `GO TO RETURN-TO-CICS`, so the **first** validation error sends the screen and ends the task immediately (later checks never run).

Submitted JCL deck: `//TRNRPT00 JOB 'TRAN REPORT',CLASS=A,MSGCLASS=0, // NOTIFY=&SYSUID`, `//JOBLIB JCLLIB ORDER=('AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PROC')`, `//STEP10 EXEC PROC=TRANREPT`, `//STEP05R.SYMNAMES DD *` (TRAN-CARD-NUM,263,16,ZD / TRAN-PROC-DT,305,10,CH / PARM-START-DATE / PARM-END-DATE), `/*`, `//STEP10R.DATEPARM DD *` (start + space + end), `/*`, `/*EOF`.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CR00 CORPT00C MAIN-PARA] --> B{EIBCALEN = 0}
  B -- yes --> SG[XCTL COSGN00C]
  B -- no --> C{CDEMO-PGM-REENTER}
  C -- no --> S1[SEND CORPT0A blank]
  C -- yes --> R[RECEIVE CORPT0A]
  R --> K{EIBAID}
  K -- PF3 --> M[XCTL COMEN01C]
  K -- other --> ER[invalid key msg]
  K -- ENTER --> P{selector}
  P -- Monthly --> DM[current month 1st..last day]
  P -- Yearly --> DY[Jan 1..Dec 31]
  P -- Custom --> V[field checks + CALL CSUTLDTC x2]
  P -- none --> ER
  DM & DY & V --> CF{CONFIRM}
  CF -- blank/invalid --> ER
  CF -- N --> CLR[clear + send]
  CF -- Y --> TD[WRITEQ TD JOBS each JOB-LINE until /*EOF]
  TD --> OK[report submitted msg]
  ER & OK & S1 & CLR --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CR00 COMMAREA]
```

##### Data
No VSAM access (WS-TRANSACT-FILE 'TRANSACT' and CVTRA05Y are declared but unused). Writes TD queue JOBS (CSD: `DEFINE TDQUEUE(JOBS)` 'SUBMIT JOBS FROM CICS', extrapartition to internal reader).

##### Outputs & side effects
Batch job TRNRPT00 submitted (runs PROC TRANREPT -> CBTRN03C report). Screen messages.

##### External calls
`CALL 'CSUTLDTC'` (date validation, LE CEEDAYS wrapper - returns severity and message number). `XCTL` to COSGN00C / COMEN01C. `WRITEQ TD JOBS`.

##### Migration notes
- Validation is "first error wins" because SEND does GO TO RETURN.
- Month/day checks are character compares ('12','31'), and CSUTLDTC msg 2513 is treated as valid (accepted as-is).
- Start <= end is never checked.
- Monthly end-date logic uses the integer-date functions; yearly ignores leap issues (12-31 always valid).
- JOB-LINES OCCURS 1000 REDEFINES a ~17-line area; the loop relies on finding '/*EOF' - removing it would read past storage.
- The submitted job overrides the PROC's SYMNAMES/DATEPARM but the PROC TRANREPT itself is not in app/jcl (app/jcl/TRANREPT.jcl is the standalone job).
- Uses &SYSUID in NOTIFY - the CICS region user.
- Re-implementation: replace with async job submission API carrying start/end dates.
recommendation: Fully documented within the program. The downstream PROC TRANREPT in AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PROC and the internal-reader binding of TDQ JOBS (extrapartition, defined in CSD) should be confirmed with the customer; CSUTLDTC is documented by its own batch.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/CORPT00C.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-1e0cfdd4b46d41dca7027cd7e6b3cd81, sfind-769e58066263486e8bb2b02f5fbae9e1.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- CSUTLDTC message 2513 is treated as valid (bypass) - preserve or document.
- Range check compares alphanumerics ('12','31'), not calendar-aware except via CSUTLDTC; start > end is not checked.
- Monthly end date relies on WS-CURDATE-N (numeric YYYYMMDD redefinition in CSDAT01Y) INTEGER-OF-DATE arithmetic.
- Job submission via TDQ to internal reader is environment-specific; replace with a scheduler/API job trigger passing start/end dates.

- Day check '> 31' is a string compare after zero-padding; CSUTLDTC catches impossible dates like 02-30.
- 'N' clears and sets error but SUBMIT then skips the loop because ERR-FLG-ON; screen sent twice.
- Paragraph name typo WIRTE-JOBSUB-TDQ is the real name.

End-to-end: XCTLed by COMEN01C via the COMEN02Y option table (main menu). Upstream findings: sfind-6417f0efb3484b28b9b140c6d330e02d.

title: CT00 / COTRN00C - Online transaction list (paged browse of TRANSACT, select to view)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CT00** -> **COTRN00C**, from main menu COMEN01C. Map `COTRN0A` mapset `COTRN00`. RETURN TRANSID('CT00') COMMAREA.

##### Inputs
COMMAREA = `COCOM01Y` + CDEMO-CT00-INFO (TRNID-FIRST X16, TRNID-LAST X16, PAGE-NUM 9(8), NEXT-PAGE-FLG X1, TRN-SEL-FLG X1, TRN-SELECTED X16). Map: TRNIDIN (start tran id), SEL0001..SEL0010 selectors with TRNID01..10, output TDATEnn, TDESCnn, TAMTnnn, PAGENUM. Keys ENTER/PF3/PF7/PF8.

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C. First entry: set re-enter, PROCESS-ENTER-KEY (shows first page from start of file), SEND.
2. Re-entry: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL COMEN01C; PF7 -> PROCESS-PF7-KEY; PF8 -> PROCESS-PF8-KEY; other invalid key.
3. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: first non-blank SELnnnn (1..10) gives sel flag + tran id; if both set: 'S'/'s' -> XCTL COTRN01C (view) with FROM=CT00/COTRN00C, context 0; other -> 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' (no send yet). TRNIDIN blank -> TRAN-ID=LOW-VALUES; numeric -> start key; non-numeric -> 'Tran ID must be Numeric ...' + SEND. Then PAGE-NUM=0 and PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD.
4. PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD: `STARTBR DATASET('TRANSACT') RIDFLD(TRAN-ID) KEYLENGTH(16)` (NOTFND -> EOF + 'You are at the top of the page...'). If key is not ENTER/PF7/PF3 (i.e. PF8) skip one READNEXT (the last row of previous page). Clear 10 rows; READNEXT up to 10 rows populating TRNIDnn, date MM/DD/YY from ORIG-TS, DESC, amount +99999999.99; row 1 id -> TRNID-FIRST, row 10 -> TRNID-LAST. If 10 read, page+1 and one more READNEXT to set NEXT-PAGE yes/no; else NEXT-PAGE no and page+1 if any rows. ENDBR, SEND. ENDFILE -> 'You have reached the bottom of the page...'.
5. PF7: start from TRNID-FIRST; if PAGE-NUM > 1 PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD (STARTBR, skip one READPREV unless ENTER/PF8, READPREV 10 rows filling slots 10..1, extra READPREV then page-1 (min 1)) else 'You are already at the top of the page...' without ERASE.
6. PF8: start from TRNID-LAST (HIGH-VALUES if blank); if NEXT-PAGE-YES forward else 'You are already at the bottom of the page...'.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CT00 COTRN00C] --> B{EIBCALEN=0}
  B -- yes --> SG[XCTL COSGN00C]
  B -- no --> C{REENTER}
  C -- no --> PE
  C -- yes --> R[RECEIVE COTRN0A] --> K{EIBAID}
  K -- ENTER --> PE[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY]
  PE --> SEL{SELnn = S}
  SEL -- yes --> V[XCTL COTRN01C]
  SEL -- no --> PF[PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD STARTBR/READNEXT x10/ENDBR]
  K -- PF8 --> PF
  K -- PF7 --> PB[PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD STARTBR/READPREV x10/ENDBR]
  K -- PF3 --> M[XCTL COMEN01C]
  PF & PB --> S[SEND COTRN0A]
  S --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CT00]
```

##### Data
Read-only browse of TRANSACT (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS) key TRAN-ID X16, record `CVTRA05Y`.

##### Outputs & side effects
Screen with up to 10 transactions; navigation to COTRN01C carrying CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED.

##### External calls
XCTL COSGN00C / COMEN01C / COTRN01C.

##### Migration notes
- Lists all transactions in the file (not filtered by user/account).
- Paging state is held in COMMAREA (first/last key, page number); page numbers may drift (backward logic resets to 1).
- Invalid-selection message is set but the page still refreshes.
- Several SEND MAP calls can occur in one task (e.g. NOTFND then normal SEND).
- Tran id start key must be numeric.
recommendation: Fully documented.
note: Duplicate of sfind-9c73dddc77ed4e55904ad2813f757eb6 (COTRN00C transaction list (TRANSID CT00)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: PAUDBLOD (job LOADPADB) - Load pending-authorization IMS database from root/child sequential files
description:
##### Entry point
JCL `app-authorization-ims-db2-mq/jcl/LOADPADB.JCL`: `EXEC PGM=DFSRRC00,PARM='BMP,PAUDBLOD,PSBPAUTB'` (IMS BMP region). Program PAUDBLOD: `PROCEDURE DIVISION USING IO-PCB-MASK PAUTBPCB` and `ENTRY 'DLITCBL' USING PAUTBPCB` (line 171).

##### Inputs
- **INFILE1** (DD INFILE1 = AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PAUTDB.ROOT.FILEO, sequential): INFIL1-REC X(100) = one PAUTSUM0 image (CIPAUSMY layout).
- **INFILE2** (DD INFILE2 = AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PAUTDB.CHILD.FILEO): 206 bytes = ROOT-SEG-KEY S9(11) COMP-3 (6 bytes, parent account id) + CHILD-SEG-REC X(200) (CIPAUDTY layout).
- PRM-INFO (expiry days, checkpoint freq, debug flag) is declared but never ACCEPTed or used.

##### Processing flow
1. DISPLAY 'STARTING PAUDBLOD'. **1000-INITIALIZE**: ACCEPT DATE and DAY, display date; OPEN INPUT INFILE1 and INFILE2; status not spaces/'00' -> 9999-ABEND.
2. **2000-READ-ROOT-SEG-FILE** repeated until END-ROOT-SEG-FILE='Y': READ INFILE1; OK -> move to PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY, **2100-INSERT-ROOT-SEG**: `CALL 'CBLTDLI' USING FUNC-ISRT PAUTBPCB PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY ROOT-UNQUAL-SSA('PAUTSUM0 ')`. Status spaces -> 'ROOT INSERT SUCCESS'; 'II' -> 'ROOT SEGMENT ALREADY IN DB' (continue); other -> 'ROOT INSERT FAILED' + abend. Status '10' -> EOF; other read status -> DISPLAY 'ERROR READING ROOT SEG INFILE' and keep looping.
3. **3000-READ-CHILD-SEG-FILE** until END-CHILD-SEG-FILE='Y': READ INFILE2; OK and ROOT-SEG-KEY numeric -> QUAL-SSA-KEY-VALUE = key, PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS = child data, **3100-INSERT-CHILD-SEG**: `CBLTDLI GU PAUTBPCB PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY ROOT-QUAL-SSA` where SSA = 'PAUTSUM0(ACCNTID EQ<packed key>)'. If status spaces -> **3200-INSERT-IMS-CALL**: `CBLTDLI ISRT PAUTBPCB PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS CHILD-UNQUAL-SSA('PAUTDTL1 ')` (inserted under the parent just positioned); spaces -> success, 'II' -> already in DB, other -> abend. Non-numeric key -> record silently skipped.
4. **4000-FILE-CLOSE**: close both files, display errors only.
5. GOBACK. **9999-ABEND**: DISPLAY 'IMS LOAD ABENDING ...', RETURN-CODE=16, GOBACK.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J["LOADPADB: DFSRRC00 BMP PAUDBLOD PSBPAUTB"] --> I["1000-INITIALIZE open INFILE1/INFILE2"]
  I --> R["2000 READ INFILE1"]
  R -->|rec| RI["2100 ISRT PAUTSUM0"]
  RI -->|ok or II| R
  RI -->|error| AB["9999-ABEND RC 16"]
  R -->|EOF| C["3000 READ INFILE2"]
  C -->|numeric key| GU["3100 GU PAUTSUM0 ACCNTID EQ key"]
  GU -->|status spaces| CI["3200 ISRT PAUTDTL1"]
  GU -->|other status| C
  CI -->|ok or II| C
  CI -->|error| AB
  C -->|EOF| CL["4000-FILE-CLOSE / GOBACK"]
```

##### Data
- IMS DBPAUTP0 (HIDAM, DD DDPAUTP0 not in LOADPADB JCL - DB access via BMP online region) via PSB PSBPAUTB (PROCOPT=AP, KEYLEN 14, SENSEG PAUTSUM0 root, PAUTDTL1 child). Segments PAUTSUM0 100 bytes (CIPAUSMY), PAUTDTL1 200 bytes (CIPAUDTY).
- PCB mask PAUTBPCB (copybook PAUTBPCB.CPY): DBDNAME X8, SEG-LEVEL X2, PCB-STATUS X2, PROCOPT X4, reserved S9(5) COMP, SEG-NAME X8, KEYFB length S9(5) COMP, NUM-SENSEGS S9(5) COMP, KEYFB X(255).
- IMSFUNCS copybook: function codes 'GU  ','GHU ','GN  ','GHN ','GNP ','GHNP','REPL','ISRT','DLET'.

##### Outputs & side effects
Inserts root and child segments into the authorization IMS DB; SYSOUT DISPLAY log of each insert; RC 16 on failure. No checkpoints are taken (WK-CHKPT-ID declared but unused), so the whole run is one unit of work until program end.

##### External calls
`CBLTDLI` (IMS DL/I language interface) with ISRT and GU, 4 parameters each.

##### Migration notes
- **Silent skip of orphan children**: in 3100 the abend check is nested inside `IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS = SPACES` (no END-IF; period ends both), so when the parent GU fails (e.g., 'GE') nothing is logged except the banner and the child is skipped without abend.
- Duplicates ('II') are tolerated for both roots and children.
- A persistent non-EOF read error loops forever (status re-read without abend).
- 9999-ABEND returns RC 16 via GOBACK without explicit rollback; in a BMP the inserted segments up to that point are committed at normal termination unless the region backs out - environment-dependent.
- ENTRY 'DLITCBL' lists only PAUTBPCB while the PROCEDURE DIVISION expects IO-PCB first. In a BMP with CMPAT=YES IMS passes the I/O PCB first; if the module is entered via DLITCBL, PAUTBPCB would address the I/O PCB. Which entry point is bound (link-edit ENTRY) is not in the repo - **unresolved**.
- WS-PGMNAME = 'IMSUNLOD' (copy artifact) and unused counters/flags.
- Root and child loads are two independent passes; children rely on roots already present.
- INFILE2 format (6-byte packed key + 200) differs from the GSAM child file written by DBUNLDGS (200 bytes, no key); input is expected from PAUDBUNL (other unload program, not in this batch).
recommendation: Confirm the link-edit entry point (DLITCBL vs program entry) and PCB list order for the BMP; confirm which unload job produces PAUTDB.*.FILEO (PAUDBUNL, not in this batch). Decide whether orphan-child skipping should become an error.

title: COPAUA0C (CICS tran CP00) - MQ-triggered card authorization decision, reply and IMS pending-auth posting
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CP00** -> program **COPAUA0C** (CSD group CARDDEMO, `app-authorization-ims-db2-mq/csd/CRDDEMO2.csd` lines 11-15, 59-60). It is started by the IBM MQ CICS trigger monitor (CKTI): `MAIN-PARA` (line 218) runs `1000-INITIALIZE` -> `2000-MAIN-PROCESS` -> `9000-TERMINATE` -> `EXEC CICS RETURN` (no TRANSID, not pseudo-conversational). `DFHCOMMAREA` (LK-COMMAREA X(4096), line 214) is declared but never referenced.

##### Inputs
1. **Trigger message** via `EXEC CICS RETRIEVE INTO(MQTM) NOHANDLE` (line 233, layout = IBM copybook CMQTML). Only if EIBRESP=NORMAL: `MQTM-QNAME` -> WS-REQUEST-QNAME (X48), `MQTM-TRIGGERDATA` -> WS-TRIGGER-DATA (X64, never used afterwards).
2. **Request messages** read by MQGET from that queue into W01-GET-BUFFER X(500). Payload is a comma-delimited text string, UNSTRINGed (2100-EXTRACT-REQUEST-MSG) in this order into copybook **CCPAURQY**:
| # | Field | PIC |
|---|---|---|
|1|PA-RQ-AUTH-DATE|X(06)|
|2|PA-RQ-AUTH-TIME|X(06)|
|3|PA-RQ-CARD-NUM|X(16)|
|4|PA-RQ-AUTH-TYPE|X(04)|
|5|PA-RQ-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE|X(04)|
|6|PA-RQ-MESSAGE-TYPE|X(06)|
|7|PA-RQ-MESSAGE-SOURCE|X(06)|
|8|PA-RQ-PROCESSING-CODE|9(06)|
|9|transaction amount -> WS-TRANSACTION-AMT-AN X(13), then `FUNCTION NUMVAL` -> PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-AMT (+9(10).99) -> WS-TRANSACTION-AMT S9(10)V99|
|10|PA-RQ-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE|X(04)|
|11|PA-RQ-ACQR-COUNTRY-CODE|X(03)|
|12|PA-RQ-POS-ENTRY-MODE|9(02)|
|13|PA-RQ-MERCHANT-ID|X(15)|
|14|PA-RQ-MERCHANT-NAME|X(22)|
|15|PA-RQ-MERCHANT-CITY|X(13)|
|16|PA-RQ-MERCHANT-STATE|X(02)|
|17|PA-RQ-MERCHANT-ZIP|X(09)|
|18|PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-ID|X(15)|
The MQMD of each request supplies CorrelId (saved to WS-SAVE-CORRELID X24) and ReplyToQ (saved to WS-REPLY-QNAME).

##### Processing flow
1. **1000-INITIALIZE**: RETRIEVE trigger; WS-WAIT-INTERVAL=5000 (ms); **1100-OPEN-REQUEST-QUEUE**: MQOPEN (MQOO-INPUT-SHARED, HCONN=0 i.e. CICS default connection); failure -> error M001 (critical). Then **3100-READ-REQUEST-MQ** reads the first message.
2. **3100-READ-REQUEST-MQ**: MQGET with options NO-SYNCPOINT + WAIT + CONVERT + FAIL-IF-QUIESCING, wait 5000 ms, MsgId/CorrelId = NONE (get any), format MQSTR, buffer length 500. OK -> save CorrelId/ReplyToQ. Reason MQRC-NO-MSG-AVAILABLE -> set NO-MORE-MSG-AVAILABLE. Other -> error M003 (critical, subsystem logged as 'C' CICS).
3. **2000-MAIN-PROCESS**: loop UNTIL NO-MORE-MSG-AVAILABLE OR WS-LOOP-END (test before each iteration): 2100 parse -> 5000 process -> WS-MSG-PROCESSED+1 -> `EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT` (commits IMS updates; also releases PSB, so flag set IMS-PSB-NOT-SCHD) -> if WS-MSG-PROCESSED > 500 (WS-REQSTS-PROCESS-LIMIT) set WS-LOOP-END else read next message.
4. **5000-PROCESS-AUTH**: SET APPROVE-AUTH; **1200-SCHEDULE-PSB** (`EXEC DLI SCHD PSB(PSBPAUTB) NODHABEND`; if DIBSTAT='TC' -> DLI TERM and SCHD again; status not OK -> error I001 critical). Set CARD-FOUND-XREF and FOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR to TRUE, then:
   - **5100-READ-XREF-RECORD**: CICS READ file **CCXREF** key XREF-CARD-NUM = PA-RQ-CARD-NUM (16). NORMAL -> found; NOTFND -> CARD-NFOUND-XREF + NFOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR, warning A001 'CARD NOT FOUND IN XREF'; other -> critical C001.
   - If card found: **5200-READ-ACCT-RECORD** (file **ACCTDAT**, key XREF-ACCT-ID as X(11); NOTFND -> NFOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR, warning A002; other -> C002), **5300-READ-CUST-RECORD** (file **CUSTDAT**, key XREF-CUST-ID X(9); NOTFND -> NFOUND-CUST-IN-MSTR, warning A003; other -> C003), **5500-READ-AUTH-SUMMRY** (`EXEC DLI GU SEGMENT(PAUTSUM0) WHERE(ACCNTID = PA-ACCT-ID)` with PA-ACCT-ID = XREF-ACCT-ID; ' '/'FW' -> FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG; 'GE' -> NFOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG; other -> critical I002), **5600-READ-PROFILE-DATA** (empty: CONTINUE).
   - **6000-MAKE-DECISION** (always), **7100-SEND-RESPONSE** (always), **8000-WRITE-AUTH-TO-DB** only if card found in XREF.
5. **6000-MAKE-DECISION**:
   - Copy card num, transaction id to reply; **PA-RQ-AUTH-TIME is copied into PA-RL-AUTH-ID-CODE** (auth id code = request time).
   - If FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG: available = PA-CREDIT-LIMIT - PA-CREDIT-BALANCE (summary segment). Else if FOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR: available = ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT - ACCT-CURR-BAL. Else DECLINE. If WS-TRANSACTION-AMT > available -> DECLINE + INSUFFICIENT-FUND.
   - DECLINE -> resp code '05', approved amount 0. Approve -> '00', approved amount = PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-AMT.
   - Reason '0000'; if declined: EVALUATE (first match wins) CARD-NFOUND-XREF / NFOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR / NFOUND-CUST-IN-MSTR -> '3100'; INSUFFICIENT-FUND -> '4100'; CARD-NOT-ACTIVE '4200'; ACCOUNT-CLOSED '4300'; CARD-FRAUD '5100'; MERCHANT-FRAUD '5200'; OTHER '9000'.
   - Build reply: `STRING card ',' tranid ',' authid ',' respcode ',' reason ',' WS-APPROVED-AMT-DIS ',' DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO W02-PUT-BUFFER WITH POINTER WS-RESP-LENGTH`. WS-APPROVED-AMT-DIS is PIC -zzzzzzzzz9.99 (14 chars, leading blanks).
6. **7100-SEND-RESPONSE**: MQPUT1 to WS-REPLY-QNAME (the request's ReplyToQ); MsgType REPLY, CorrelId = request CorrelId, MsgId NONE, Persistence NOT-PERSISTENT, Expiry 50 (tenths of a second = 5 s), Format MQSTR, PMO NO-SYNCPOINT + DEFAULT-CONTEXT, length = WS-RESP-LENGTH. Failure -> critical M004.
7. **8400-UPDATE-SUMMARY**: if summary not found, `INITIALIZE PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY REPLACING NUMERIC DATA BY ZERO`, set PA-ACCT-ID/PA-CUST-ID from XREF. Always set PA-CREDIT-LIMIT = ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT, PA-CASH-LIMIT = ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT. Approved: APPROVED-AUTH-CNT+1, APPROVED-AUTH-AMT += WS-APPROVED-AMT, CREDIT-BALANCE += WS-APPROVED-AMT, CASH-BALANCE = 0. Declined: DECLINED-AUTH-CNT+1, DECLINED-AUTH-AMT += **PA-TRANSACTION-AMT** (see migration notes). Then DLI **REPL** PAUTSUM0 (if previously found) or **ISRT** PAUTSUM0; status not OK -> critical I003.
8. **8500-INSERT-AUTH**: ASKTIME/FORMATTIME YYDDD + TIME + MILLISECONDS. Key: PA-AUTH-DATE-9C = 99999 - YYDDD; PA-AUTH-TIME-9C = 999999999 - (HHMMSS*1000 + ms) (inverted so newest sorts first). Map request fields to CIPAUDTY (orig date/time, card, type, expiry, msg type/source, processing code, amount, MCC, country, POS mode, merchant id/name/city/state/zip, tran id), reply auth-id/resp-code/reason/approved-amt; PA-MATCH-STATUS = 'P' (approved) or 'D' (declined); PA-AUTH-FRAUD and PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE = spaces. `EXEC DLI ISRT SEGMENT(PAUTSUM0) WHERE(ACCNTID=PA-ACCT-ID) SEGMENT(PAUTDTL1) FROM(PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)`; not OK -> critical I004.
9. **9000-TERMINATE**: DLI TERM if PSB scheduled; **9100-CLOSE-REQUEST-QUEUE**: MQCLOSE if open (failure -> warning M005).
10. **9500-LOG-ERROR**: fill ERR-DATE (YYMMDD), ERR-TIME, ERR-APPLICATION='CP00', ERR-PROGRAM='COPAUA0C'; `WRITEQ TD QUEUE('CSSL')` NOHANDLE; if ERR-CRITICAL -> **9990-END-ROUTINE** (9000-TERMINATE then CICS RETURN, ending the task). Warnings continue processing.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["CKTI trigger -> CP00 / COPAUA0C"] --> B["1000-INITIALIZE: RETRIEVE MQTM"]
  B --> C["1100-OPEN-REQUEST-QUEUE MQOPEN"]
  C --> D["3100-READ-REQUEST-MQ MQGET wait 5s"]
  D -->|no msg| T["9000-TERMINATE: DLI TERM, MQCLOSE"]
  D -->|msg| E["2100-EXTRACT-REQUEST-MSG UNSTRING CSV"]
  E --> F["5000-PROCESS-AUTH / 1200-SCHEDULE-PSB PSBPAUTB"]
  F --> G["5100 READ CCXREF by card"]
  G -->|found| H["5200 READ ACCTDAT / 5300 READ CUSTDAT / 5500 DLI GU PAUTSUM0"]
  G -->|not found| I
  H --> I["6000-MAKE-DECISION: avail = limit - balance"]
  I --> J["7100-SEND-RESPONSE MQPUT1 to ReplyToQ"]
  J -->|card found| K["8400 REPL/ISRT PAUTSUM0; 8500 ISRT PAUTDTL1"]
  J -->|card not found| L
  K --> L["SYNCPOINT; count+1"]
  L -->|count > 500| T
  L -->|else| D
  T --> R["EXEC CICS RETURN"]
  X["any critical error -> 9500 WRITEQ TD CSSL -> 9990 RETURN"]
```

##### Data
- **CCXREF** (VSAM KSDS, CICS READ, key card number X16), layout CVACT03Y: XREF-CARD-NUM X(16), XREF-CUST-ID 9(9), XREF-ACCT-ID 9(11), FILLER X(14) = 50 bytes.
- **ACCTDAT** (READ, key acct id X11), layout CVACT01Y (300 bytes): ACCT-ID 9(11), ACTIVE-STATUS X, CURR-BAL S9(10)V99, CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, OPEN/EXPIRAION/REISSUE dates X(10) each, CURR-CYC-CREDIT/DEBIT S9(10)V99, ADDR-ZIP X(10), GROUP-ID X(10), FILLER X(178). Only CREDIT-LIMIT, CURR-BAL, CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT are used.
- **CUSTDAT** (READ, key cust id X9), layout CVCUS01Y (500 bytes). Read only for existence; no field used.
- **IMS DBPAUTP0** (HIDAM) via PSB **PSBPAUTB** (PCB 1, PROCOPT=AP, KEYLEN 14): root **PAUTSUM0** (100 bytes, key ACCNTID = packed 6 bytes at offset 1) layout CIPAUSMY: PA-ACCT-ID S9(11) COMP-3, PA-CUST-ID 9(9), PA-AUTH-STATUS X, PA-ACCOUNT-STATUS X(2) x5, PA-CREDIT-LIMIT / PA-CASH-LIMIT / PA-CREDIT-BALANCE / PA-CASH-BALANCE S9(9)V99 COMP-3, PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT / PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT S9(4) COMP, PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT / PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT S9(9)V99 COMP-3, FILLER X(34). Child **PAUTDTL1** (200 bytes, key PAUT9CTS = first 8 bytes = PA-AUTH-DATE-9C S9(5) COMP-3 + PA-AUTH-TIME-9C S9(9) COMP-3) layout CIPAUDTY (see field list in processing step 8; PA-TRANSACTION-AMT/PA-APPROVED-AMT S9(10)V99 COMP-3; PA-MATCH-STATUS P/D/E/M; PA-AUTH-FRAUD F/R; FILLER X(17)).
- **TD queue CSSL**: ERROR-LOG-RECORD (CCPAUERY, 126 bytes): ERR-DATE X6, ERR-TIME X6, ERR-APPLICATION X8, ERR-PROGRAM X8, ERR-LOCATION X4, ERR-LEVEL X (L/I/W/C), ERR-SUBSYSTEM X (A/C/I/D/M/F), ERR-CODE-1 X9, ERR-CODE-2 X9, ERR-MESSAGE X50, ERR-EVENT-KEY X20.

##### Outputs & side effects
- One MQ reply per request (CSV: card,tranid,authid,respcode,reason,amount,) to the request's ReplyToQ with matching CorrelId; non-persistent, 5 s expiry, outside syncpoint (sent even if IMS update later fails).
- IMS PAUTSUM0 inserted/replaced and PAUTDTL1 inserted per request whose card exists in CCXREF; committed by SYNCPOINT after each message.
- Error records on TD queue CSSL.
- VSAM files are read only.

##### External calls
- IBM MQ API: MQOPEN (input shared), MQGET, MQPUT1, MQCLOSE (HCONN 0). Layout copybooks CMQODV, CMQMDV, CMQV, CMQTML, CMQPMOV, CMQGMOV (IBM-supplied; not in repo).
- IMS DL/I through CICS (EXEC DLI SCHD/GU/REPL/ISRT/TERM) on PSB PSBPAUTB.
- CICS: RETRIEVE, READ, SYNCPOINT, ASKTIME, FORMATTIME, WRITEQ TD, RETURN.

##### Migration notes
- **Reply buffer pointer is never reset**: WS-RESP-LENGTH starts at 1 (VALUE) and is the STRING POINTER; it is never re-initialised between messages, and W02-PUT-BUFFER (X200) is never cleared. Message 1 is sent with length = data length + 1 (pointer is one past the last char). From message 2 onward the new reply is appended after the previous one and the whole accumulated buffer is sent; once the pointer exceeds 200 the STRING overflows and nothing new is added. A faithful re-implementation would reproduce this; a corrected one should send one fresh CSV per request — needs a business decision.
- **Stale flags between messages**: WS-PAUT-SMRY-SEG-FLG, WS-CUST-MASTER-READ-FLG and WS-DECLINE-REASON-FLG are not reset per message (only APPROVE-AUTH, CARD-FOUND-XREF, FOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR are). If a card is not in XREF, 5500 is skipped and FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG may still be 'Y' from the previous message, so the decision uses the previous account's summary limit/balance and can **approve** an unknown card (reason '0000'); no DB write occurs in that case. INSUFFICIENT-FUND once set stays set, so later declines for other causes can report '4100' unless an earlier WHEN matches. On the very first message the summary flag is uninitialised (no VALUE).
- **Declined amount bug**: 8400 adds PA-TRANSACTION-AMT (detail segment area) to PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT, but that field is only populated later in 8500, so it holds the previous message's amount (or uninitialised COMP-3 storage on the first message).
- INITIALIZE ... REPLACING NUMERIC DATA BY ZERO leaves alphanumeric fields (PA-AUTH-STATUS, PA-ACCOUNT-STATUS, FILLER) with leftover content from previous messages on a new summary.
- Customer-not-found does not cause a decline by itself; it only affects reason code (3100) when declined for another reason.
- Reason codes 4200/4300/5100/5200 are **dead**: CARD-NOT-ACTIVE, ACCOUNT-CLOSED, CARD-FRAUD, MERCHANT-FRAUD are never set. ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS and card expiry are not checked. 5600-READ-PROFILE-DATA is an empty stub.
- When a summary exists the available amount comes only from the IMS summary (limit refreshed from ACCTDAT after decision, balance = sum of approved auths), not from ACCT-CURR-BAL. PA-CASH-BALANCE is forced to 0 on every approval.
- Batch limit: `> 500` means up to 501 messages per task.
- Auth ID code returned = request auth time (X6).
- Amount parsing uses NUMVAL on up to 13 chars; no validation of non-numeric input; PROCESSING-CODE and POS-ENTRY-MODE are numeric-display targets of UNSTRING (non-numeric input lands unchecked).
- Error handling asymmetry: the reply is sent with NO-SYNCPOINT before IMS writes, so a later IMS failure (critical -> task RETURN, which commits prior work) leaves the requester with a decision that was not recorded. MQGET errors are logged with subsystem 'C' (CICS) rather than 'M'.
- Detail key uses Julian YYDDD (2-digit year) inverted with 99999, so ordering breaks across century rollover.
- Request MQ get is NO-SYNCPOINT: a message is removed from the queue even if processing later abends.
recommendation: Fully traced. Business decisions needed: whether to reproduce the non-reset reply pointer (WS-RESP-LENGTH), stale per-message flags, and the declined-amount accumulation bug, or correct them in the target. IBM MQ copybooks (CMQ*) are vendor-supplied and not in the repo.

Consolidated document for app/app-authorization-ims-db2-mq/cbl/COPAUA0C.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-1b2f9aeec9ff472fa65ca15e67262d98, sfind-b104f3c64a3a478d8bbddf089a327ac2, sfind-d8252b447784402484ffdff5a23148da.

- Limit check: `WS-MSG-PROCESSED > 500` means up to **501** messages are processed per trigger.
- If the account is not found but the card is, NFOUND-ACCT is set, so the auth is declined with '3100'. The summary update still runs, using whatever ACCOUNT-RECORD contains (stale/uninitialized credit limits). This is a quirk.

- Message limit test is `> 500` (501 messages). RETRIEVE failure is silently ignored.

- Stale state across messages**: per message only WS-DECLINE-FLG, CARD-FOUND-XREF and FOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR are reset. `WS-PAUT-SMRY-SEG-FLG`, `WS-CUST-MASTER-READ-FLG`, `WS-DECLINE-REASON-FLG` and the PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY / ACCOUNT-RECORD buffers carry over. title: UNLDGSAM job -> DBUNLDGS: unload pending-authorization IMS DB to root/child GSAM files
description:
##### Entry point
Job **UNLDGSAM** (line 1), single step STEP01 `EXEC PGM=DFSRRC00,PARM='DLI,DBUNLDGS,DLIGSAMP,,,,,,,,,,,N'` (IMS DL/I batch region, program DBUNLDGS, PSB DLIGSAMP).

##### Inputs
- IMS DB DBPAUTP0 (DD **DDPAUTP0** = OEM.IMS.IMSP.PAUTHDB) and its primary index DBPAUTX0 (DD **DDPAUTX0** = OEM.IMS.IMSP.PAUTHDBX), DISP=SHR.
- Libraries: STEPLIB OEMA.IMS.IMSP.SDFSRESL, ...SDFSRESL.V151, AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB; DFSRESLB; IMS DD = PSBLIB + DBDLIB; DFSVSAMP = OEMPP.IMS.V15R01MB.PROCLIB(DFSVSMDB) buffer parms; IMSLOGR/IEFRDER DUMMY (no IMS log).
- PSB **DLIGSAMP** (ims/DLIGSAMP.PSB): PCB1 DB DBPAUTP0 PROCOPT=GOTP KEYLEN 14 (SENSEG PAUTSUM0, PAUTDTL1); PCB2 GSAM PASFLDBD PROCOPT=LS; PCB3 GSAM PADFLDBD PROCOPT=LS.

##### Processing flow
DBUNLDGS (`PROCEDURE DIVISION USING PAUTBPCB PASFLPCB PADFLPCB`, ENTRY 'DLITCBL' same list):
1. 1000-INITIALIZE: ACCEPT DATE/DAY, DISPLAY start banner.
2. Loop 2000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-SUMMARY until WS-END-OF-ROOT-SEG='Y': `CBLTDLI GN PAUTBPCB PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY ROOT-UNQUAL-SSA('PAUTSUM0')`.
   - status spaces: counters +1, copy to OPFIL1-REC, ROOT-SEG-KEY = PA-ACCT-ID; **if PA-ACCT-ID numeric**: 3100 `CBLTDLI ISRT PASFLPCB PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY` (GSAM root file; status not spaces -> abend), then loop 3000 `CBLTDLI GNP PAUTBPCB PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS CHILD-UNQUAL-SSA('PAUTDTL1')` until 'GE': each child -> 3200 `CBLTDLI ISRT PADFLPCB PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS` (status not spaces -> abend); GNP other than spaces/'GE' -> abend.
   - 'GB' -> end of DB.
   - other -> DISPLAY 'AUTH SUM  GN FAILED' + key feedback, abend.
3. 4000-FILE-CLOSE: DISPLAY only (GSAM closed by IMS at termination).
4. 9999-ABEND: RC 16, GOBACK.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J["UNLDGSAM STEP01 DFSRRC00 DLI DBUNLDGS DLIGSAMP"] --> G["2000 GN PAUTSUM0"]
  G -->|ok, ACCT numeric| W1["3100 ISRT GSAM PASFLDBD -> PASFILOP"]
  W1 --> C["3000 GNP PAUTDTL1"]
  C -->|ok| W2["3200 ISRT GSAM PADFLDBD -> PADFILOP"]
  W2 --> C
  C -->|GE| G
  G -->|GB| E["4000 close / GOBACK"]
  G -->|error| AB["9999-ABEND RC 16"]
```

##### Data
- Output GSAM root: DBD **PASFLDBD** (GSAM/BSAM, DD1=PASFILIP input, DD2=PASFILOP output, RECORD=100, RECFM=F) -> DD **PASFILOP** = AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PAUTDB.ROOT.GSAM, DISP=(OLD,KEEP,KEEP). Record = PAUTSUM0 image (CIPAUSMY, 100 bytes).
- Output GSAM child: DBD **PADFLDBD** (GSAM/BSAM, DD1=PADFILIP, DD2=PADFILOP, RECORD=200, RECFM=F) -> DD **PADFILOP** = AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PAUTDB.CHILD.GSAM, DISP=(OLD,KEEP,KEEP). Record = PAUTDTL1 image (CIPAUDTY, 200 bytes) with **no parent key**; parent association is only by sequence (children follow their root in processing order, but the two files are separate).
- GSAM PCB masks PASFLPCB (KEYFB X100) and PADFLPCB (KEYFB X255).

##### Outputs & side effects
Two fixed-length GSAM datasets overwritten from the start (DISP OLD); SYSPRINT/IMSERR/SYSUDUMP SYSOUT.

##### External calls
IMS region controller DFSRRC00 -> DBUNLDGS; CBLTDLI GN/GNP/ISRT.

##### Migration notes
- Roots with non-numeric PA-ACCT-ID (invalid packed data) and all their children are silently skipped.
- Child GSAM records carry no root key, so this output is **not** the format PAUDBLOD's INFILE2 expects (6-byte packed key + 200). Parent/child relationship must be reconstructed from the root order, which cannot be done from the child file alone.
- Datasets must pre-exist (DISP=OLD); IMS log is DUMMY so the run is not recoverable/restartable.
- PSB DLIGSAMP is CMPAT=NO and DLI region, so no I/O PCB is passed - the 3-PCB USING list matches.
- WS-NO-SUMRY-READ / WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT are incremented for both roots and children.
recommendation: Fully traced (job, PSB, DBDs, DBUNLDGS). Confirm with owners which unload (this GSAM one or PAUDBUNL) feeds downstream loads, since child record formats differ.
note:
Consolidated document for app/app-authorization-ims-db2-mq/cbl/DBUNLDGS.CBL, app/app-authorization-ims-db2-mq/jcl/UNLDGSAM.JCL; merged duplicates: sfind-74670a93dc5f4cdeb571b5f89f1fed43.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- Child GSAM records are the raw 200-byte detail **without the parent key** (ROOT-SEG-KEY/CHILD-SEG-REC are filled in OPFIL2-REC but the ISRT passes PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS), so parent linkage is implicit only by file order; contrast with PAUDBLOD which expects key+detail (206 bytes) in INFILE2 - the outputs of this unload are not directly the input format of PAUDBLOD.
- Detail-read counter increments WS-NO-SUMRY-READ (copy/paste); WS-NO-DTL-READ unused. FD/SELECTs for OPFILE1/OPFILE2 commented out; WS-PGMNAME literal is 'IMSUNLOD'.
- 'GE' on root GN or 'GB' on GNP are treated as errors (abend).
