title: COPAUS0C (CICS tran CPVS) - Pending authorization summary/list screen (IMS + VSAM, map COPAU0A)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CPVS** -> **COPAUS0C** (CRDDEMO2.csd lines 18-22, 49-50). Pseudo-conversational: every path ends with `EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CPVS') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)`. Entered from the main menu (COMEN01C via XCTL with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) or directly (EIBCALEN=0).

##### Inputs
- **COMMAREA**: CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (copybook COCOM01Y, includes CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, CDEMO-FROM-TRANID/PROGRAM, CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT/REENTER, CDEMO-ACCT-ID, CDEMO-CUST-ID, CDEMO-CARD-NUM) extended in this program with **CDEMO-CPVS-INFO**: PAU-SEL-FLG X(1), PAU-SELECTED X(8), PAUKEY-PREV-PG X(8) OCCURS 20, PAUKEY-LAST X(8), PAGE-NUM S9(4) COMP, NEXT-PAGE-FLG X (Y/N), AUTH-KEYS X(8) OCCURS 5 (the 8-byte PAUTDTL1 key of each displayed row).
- **Screen** map COPAU0A / mapset COPAU00 (symbolic map COPAU00 copybook): input ACCTID (11, unprotected), SEL0001-SEL0005 (1 char each); AID keys ENTER, PF3, PF7, PF8.

##### Processing flow
1. MAIN-PARA: reset ERR flag, AUTHS-NOT-EOF, NEXT-PAGE-NO, SEND-ERASE-YES, clear message, cursor on ACCTID.
2. **EIBCALEN = 0**: initialize commarea, CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM='COPAUS0C', set REENTER, send empty screen.
3. **First entry with commarea (not REENTER)**: set REENTER; if CDEMO-ACCT-ID numeric use it as WS-ACCT-ID and display it, else blank; GATHER-DETAILS; send with ERASE.
4. **Re-entry**: RECEIVE MAP into COPAU0AI, then by EIBAID:
   - **ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY**: ACCTID blank/low -> 'Please enter Acct Id...'; not numeric -> 'Acct Id must be Numeric ...' (both set error flag, WS-ACCT-ID=low-values). Else WS-ACCT-ID and CDEMO-ACCT-ID = input; first non-blank SEL000n (n=1..5 in order) -> CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SEL-FLG and PAU-SELECTED = CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS(n). If flag and key non-blank: 'S'/'s' -> set TO-PROGRAM='COPAUS1C', FROM-TRANID='CPVS', FROM-PROGRAM='COPAUS0C', CONTEXT=0, PGM-ENTER, **XCTL COPAUS1C** with commarea (detail screen); other -> 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' (error flag NOT set). Then GATHER-DETAILS and send.
   - **PF3**: CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM='COMEN01C' -> RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN (defaults to 'COSGN00C' if blank) XCTL with FROM fields set and CONTEXT=0.
   - **PF7 -> PROCESS-PF7-KEY**: if PAGE-NUM > 1: PAGE-NUM-1, WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE = PAUKEY-PREV-PG(PAGE-NUM), GET-AUTH-SUMMARY, no erase, NEXT-PAGE-YES, INITIALIZE-AUTH-DATA, PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD (first row repositioned on the saved key). Else 'You are already at the top of the page...'.
   - **PF8 -> PROCESS-PF8-KEY**: if PAUKEY-LAST blank -> key low-values (no reposition) else GET-AUTH-SUMMARY + REPOSITION-AUTHORIZATIONS on PAUKEY-LAST. If NEXT-PAGE-YES (from commarea) -> clear rows + PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD, else 'You are already at the bottom of the page...'.
   - **Other key**: error flag, CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY.
5. **GATHER-DETAILS**: PAGE-NUM=0; if WS-ACCT-ID not low-values: GATHER-ACCOUNT-DETAILS, INITIALIZE-AUTH-DATA, and if summary found PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD.
6. **GATHER-ACCOUNT-DETAILS**: GETCARDXREF-BYACCT (CICS READ **CXACAIX** - alternate-index path of the card xref by account id X(11); sets CDEMO-CUST-ID/CDEMO-CARD-NUM), GETACCTDATA-BYACCT (READ **ACCTDAT** by XREF-ACCT-ID), GETCUSTDATA-BYCUST (READ **CUSTDAT** by XREF-CUST-ID). NOTFND -> message 'Account:<id> not found in XREF/ACCT file...' or 'Customer:... not found in CUST file' + send screen (error flag NOT set); other RESP -> error flag + 'System error while reading ... Resp: Reas:' + send. Then screen: CUSTID, CNAME = first-name (to first space) + ' ' + middle initial + ' ' + last-name, ADDR001 = addr1 ',' addr2 (each up to double space), ADDR002 = addr3 ',' state ',' zip(1:5), PHONE1, CREDLIM (-zzzzzzz9.99), CASHLIM (-zzzz9.99). GET-AUTH-SUMMARY: if found APPRCNT/DECLCNT (9(3)), CREDBAL (-zzzzzzz9.99), CASHBAL/APPRAMT/DECLAMT (-zzzz9.99) from PAUTSUM0; else zeros.
7. **GET-AUTH-SUMMARY**: SCHEDULE-PSB (`DLI SCHD PSBPAUTB NODHABEND`, 'TC' -> TERM + re-SCHD; failure -> error message + send), then `DLI GU PAUTSUM0 WHERE ACCNTID = CDEMO-ACCT-ID`; GE -> not found; other -> error.
8. **PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD** (only if no error): PAUKEY-LAST = low-values; for WS-IDX 1..5 until EOF/error: if EIBAID=PF7 and IDX=1 REPOSITION-AUTHORIZATIONS (`DLI GNP PAUTDTL1 WHERE PAUT9CTS = WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE`) else GET-AUTHORIZATIONS (`DLI GNP PAUTDTL1` unqualified); GE/GB -> EOF; other -> error message + send. Each record -> POPULATE-AUTH-LIST, IDX+1, PAUKEY-LAST = key; when IDX becomes 2 PAGE-NUM+1 and PAUKEY-PREV-PG(PAGE-NUM) = key of first row. After 5 rows, one extra GNP look-ahead sets NEXT-PAGE-YES/NO.
9. **POPULATE-AUTH-LIST** row n: AUTH-KEYS(n)=key; TRNID0n = PA-TRANSACTION-ID; PDATE0n = MM/DD/YY built from PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE (positions 1-2 -> YY, 3-4 -> MM, 5-6 -> DD); PTIME0n = HH:MM:SS from PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME; PTYPE0n = PA-AUTH-TYPE; PAPRV0n = 'A' if PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE='00' else 'D'; PSTAT0n = PA-MATCH-STATUS; PAMT00n = PA-APPROVED-AMT (-zzzzzzz9.99); SEL000n attribute unprotected. INITIALIZE-AUTH-DATA blanks all 5 rows and protects SEL fields.
10. **SEND-PAULST-SCREEN**: if PSB scheduled -> `EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT` (releases PSB); header (CCDA-TITLE01/02, 'CPVS', 'COPAUS0C', current date MM/DD/YY, time HH:MM:SS); ERRMSG = WS-MESSAGE; SEND MAP COPAU0A with ERASE (or without when SEND-ERASE-NO) and CURSOR.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["CPVS / COPAUS0C"] --> B{EIBCALEN = 0?}
  B -->|yes| S["SEND-PAULST-SCREEN empty"]
  B -->|no| C{CDEMO-PGM-REENTER?}
  C -->|no| G["GATHER-DETAILS with CDEMO-ACCT-ID"]
  C -->|yes| R["RECEIVE MAP COPAU0A"]
  R --> K{EIBAID}
  K -->|ENTER| E["PROCESS-ENTER-KEY validate ACCTID"]
  E -->|SEL = S| X["XCTL COPAUS1C"]
  E --> G
  K -->|PF3| M["XCTL COMEN01C"]
  K -->|PF7| P7["PROCESS-PF7-KEY reposition PREV-PG key"]
  K -->|PF8| P8["PROCESS-PF8-KEY reposition PAUKEY-LAST"]
  K -->|other| INV["invalid key msg"]
  G --> GA["READ CXACAIX, ACCTDAT, CUSTDAT; DLI GU PAUTSUM0"]
  GA --> PF["PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD DLI GNP PAUTDTL1 x5 + lookahead"]
  P7 --> PF
  P8 --> PF
  PF --> S
  INV --> S
  S --> RT["RETURN TRANSID CPVS COMMAREA"]
```

##### Data
- **CXACAIX** (VSAM AIX path over card xref, key account id X11, read into CVACT03Y 50-byte record), **ACCTDAT** (CVACT01Y), **CUSTDAT** (CVCUS01Y): CICS READ only. CVACT02Y (card record) is copied but not used.
- **IMS DBPAUTP0** via PSB **PSBPAUTB** PCB 1: GU PAUTSUM0 (CIPAUSMY 100 bytes), GNP PAUTDTL1 (CIPAUDTY 200 bytes; key PAUT9CTS 8 bytes). Read only.

##### Outputs & side effects
- Screen COPAU0A (fields: CNAME, CUSTID, ADDR001, ADDR002, PHONE1, APPRCNT, DECLCNT, CREDLIM, CASHLIM, APPRAMT, CREDBAL, CASHBAL, DECLAMT, 5 list rows, ERRMSG).
- COMMAREA updated: CDEMO-ACCT-ID, CDEMO-CUST-ID, CDEMO-CARD-NUM, CPVS paging keys, selected key passed to COPAUS1C.
- No data is written; SYNCPOINT only releases the PSB.

##### External calls
- XCTL **COPAUS1C** (authorization detail; commarea carries CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED = 8-byte detail key and CDEMO-ACCT-ID) - not in this batch.
- XCTL **COMEN01C** (PF3) or **COSGN00C** (fallback).
- EXEC DLI SCHD/GU/GNP/TERM; CICS READ/SEND/RECEIVE/SYNCPOINT/XCTL/RETURN.

##### Migration notes
- Error paragraphs PERFORM SEND-PAULST-SCREEN and then **continue** processing, so a single task can SEND the map several times (e.g., account not found, then summary lookup still runs and sends again). NOTFND conditions do not set the error flag, so the list paging still runs for that account id.
- GET-AUTH-SUMMARY keys on CDEMO-ACCT-ID (commarea), not WS-ACCT-ID; on first entry with non-numeric CDEMO-ACCT-ID GATHER-DETAILS is skipped anyway.
- Paging stores first-row keys in a 20-entry array with no bounds check; > 20 pages would overwrite adjacent commarea storage.
- PF7 repositions with GNP WHERE PAUT9CTS = saved key under the current parent; PF8 repositions on the last displayed key and the following unqualified GNP returns the next one (last row not repeated). PF8 relies on NEXT-PAGE flag carried in the commarea.
- Rows are shown newest-first because of the inverted date/time key written by COPAUA0C.
- ACCSTAT screen field is never populated. Date display assumes PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE is YYMMDD.
- 'Invalid selection' does not block list refresh; only the first non-blank selection among rows 1-5 is honored.
- The amount shown per row is PA-APPROVED-AMT (0 for declines), not the requested amount.
recommendation: Fully traced within this program. COPAUS1C (detail target) and COMEN01C are documented in other batches. Decide whether to preserve multiple-SEND behavior on errors and the unbounded 20-page key array.
note:
Consolidated document for app/app-authorization-ims-db2-mq/cbl/COPAUS0C.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-16ec6dc12f36477d9e9f343094929d15, sfind-a0bed7e037934d899b0abf63a45667b2.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- The account read errors set WS-ERR-FLG only for "OTHER" responses. NOTFND does not set it, so the summary GU still runs.
- The amount display uses edit mask `-zzzzzzz9.99`, so values above 99,999,999.99 are truncated.
- Paging counter quirk: PF7 decrements CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM and PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD increments it again and overwrites PREV-PG(page) with the previous page's first key, so after PF7 the stored page number is unchanged and the previous-page table is shifted. Repeated PF7 can redisplay the same page. PREV-PG has 20 entries with no bound check.
- Account id must be numeric 11 chars (PICIN/NUMERIC test). Selection accepts only 'S' or 's' and only the first non-blank row is honoured.

End-to-end: XCTLed by COMEN01C via the COMEN02Y option table (main menu). Upstream findings: sfind-6417f0efb3484b28b9b140c6d330e02d.

Commentary: Page-forward loop, GNP / repositioning and look-ahead.
Code:
         PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD.
        *****************************************************************
  
             IF ERR-FLG-OFF
  
                 MOVE 1             TO  WS-IDX
  
                 MOVE LOW-VALUES    TO CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST
  
                 PERFORM UNTIL WS-IDX > 5 OR AUTHS-EOF OR ERR-FLG-ON
                     IF EIBAID = DFHPF7 AND WS-IDX = 1
                        PERFORM REPOSITION-AUTHORIZATIONS
                     ELSE
                        PERFORM GET-AUTHORIZATIONS
                     END-IF
                     IF AUTHS-NOT-EOF AND ERR-FLG-OFF
                         PERFORM POPULATE-AUTH-LIST
                         COMPUTE WS-IDX = WS-IDX + 1
  
                         MOVE PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY TO
                                               CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST
                         IF WS-IDX = 2
                            COMPUTE CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM =
                                    CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM + 1
                            MOVE PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY TO
                            CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG(CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM)
                         END-IF
                     END-IF
                 END-PERFORM
  
                 IF AUTHS-NOT-EOF AND ERR-FLG-OFF
                     PERFORM GET-AUTHORIZATIONS
                     IF AUTHS-NOT-EOF AND ERR-FLG-OFF
                         SET NEXT-PAGE-YES TO TRUE
                     ELSE
                         SET NEXT-PAGE-NO TO TRUE
                     END-IF
                 END-IF
  
             END-IF.
  
  
        *****************************************************************
         GET-AUTHORIZATIONS.
        *****************************************************************
  
             EXEC DLI GNP USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
                 SEGMENT (PAUTDTL1)
                 INTO (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)
             END-EXEC
  
             MOVE DIBSTAT                          TO IMS-RETURN-CODE
             EVALUATE TRUE
                 WHEN STATUS-OK
                    SET AUTHS-NOT-EOF              TO TRUE
                 WHEN SEGMENT-NOT-FOUND
                 WHEN END-OF-DB
                    SET AUTHS-EOF                  TO TRUE
                 WHEN OTHER
                    MOVE 'Y'     TO WS-ERR-FLG
  
                    STRING
                    ' System error while reading AUTH Details: Code:'
                    IMS-RETURN-CODE
                    DELIMITED BY SIZE
                    INTO WS-MESSAGE
                    END-STRING
                    MOVE -1       TO ACCTIDL OF COPAU0AI
                    PERFORM SEND-PAULST-SCREEN
             END-EVALUATE
  
             .
        *****************************************************************
         REPOSITION-AUTHORIZATIONS.
        *****************************************************************
  
             MOVE WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE          TO PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY
  
             EXEC DLI GNP USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
                 SEGMENT (PAUTDTL1)
                 INTO (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)
                 WHERE (PAUT9CTS = PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY)
             END-EXEC
  
             MOVE DIBSTAT                          TO IMS-RETURN-CODE
             EVALUATE TRUE
                 WHEN STATUS-OK
                    SET AUTHS-NOT-EOF              TO TRUE
                 WHEN SEGMENT-NOT-FOUND
                 WHEN END-OF-DB
                    SET AUTHS-EOF                  TO TRUE
                 WHEN OTHER
                    MOVE 'Y'     TO WS-ERR-FLG
  
                    STRING
                    ' System error while repos. AUTH Details: Code:'
                    IMS-RETURN-CODE
                    DELIMITED BY SIZE
                    INTO WS-MESSAGE
                    END-STRING
                    MOVE -1       TO ACCTIDL OF COPAU0AI
                    PERFORM SEND-PAULST-SCREEN
             END-EVALUATE
  
             .
  
        *****************************************************************

title: TRANEXTR job - Back up and re-extract transaction type/category reference files from DB2 (DSNTIAUL)
description:
##### Entry point
Job **TRANEXTR** (CLASS=A, MSGCLASS=0). Scheduled in Control-M (`app/scheduler/CardDemo.controlm` line 58: sub-application TransactionTypesDBRefresh, folder WEEKLY-DisclosureGroupsRefresh, TIMETO 23:00). Symbol HLQ=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.

##### Inputs
- AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANTYPE.PS and AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANCATG.PS (existing extracts, 60-byte FB).
- DB2 subsystem DAZ1 tables CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE and CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY.

##### Processing flow
1. **STEP10** IEBGENER: copy TRANTYPE.PS -> new GDG generation **TRANTYPE.BKUP(+1)** (NEW,CATLG; LRECL=60 RECFM=FB BLKSIZE=600).
2. **STEP20** IEBGENER, COND=(0,NE) (runs only if all prior RCs = 0): TRANCATG.PS -> **TRANCATG.PS.BKUP(+1)**.
3. **STEP30** IEFBR14, COND=(0,NE): DD01/DD02 DISP=(MOD,DELETE,DELETE) delete TRANTYPE.PS and TRANCATG.PS.
4. **STEP40** IKJEFT01 COND=(0,NE): `DSN SYSTEM(DAZ1) RUN PROGRAM(DSNTIAUL) PLAN(DSNTIAUL) PARMS('SQL')`; SYSIN SQL: `SELECT CAST(CONCAT(CONCAT(TR_TYPE, CAST(TR_DESCRIPTION AS CHAR(50))), REPEAT('0',8)) AS CHAR(60)) FROM CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE ORDER BY TR_TYPE`; output SYSREC00 -> new TRANTYPE.PS (NEW,CATLG,DELETE).
5. **STEP50** IKJEFT01 COND=(4,LT) (runs if all prior RCs <= 4): `SELECT CAST(TRC_TYPE_CODE || TRC_TYPE_CATEGORY || CAST(TRC_CAT_DATA AS CHAR(50)) || REPEAT('0',4) AS CHAR(60)) FROM CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY ORDER BY TRC_TYPE_CODE, TRC_TYPE_CATEGORY` -> new TRANCATG.PS.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S10["STEP10 IEBGENER TRANTYPE.PS -> TRANTYPE.BKUP(+1)"] --> S20["STEP20 IEBGENER TRANCATG.PS -> TRANCATG.PS.BKUP(+1)"]
  S20 --> S30["STEP30 IEFBR14 delete TRANTYPE.PS, TRANCATG.PS"]
  S30 --> S40["STEP40 DSNTIAUL TRANSACTION_TYPE -> TRANTYPE.PS"]
  S40 --> S50["STEP50 DSNTIAUL TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY -> TRANCATG.PS"]
```

##### Data
- TRANTYPE.PS record (60): TR_TYPE X2 + description padded to X50 + '00000000' X8 - same shape as base copybook CVTRA03Y (TRAN-TYPE X2, TRAN-TYPE-DESC X50, FILLER X8).
- TRANCATG.PS record (60): type X2 + category X4 + description X50 + '0000' X4 - same shape as CVTRA04Y (TRAN-TYPE-CD X2, TRAN-CAT-CD 9(4), TRAN-CAT-TYPE-DESC X50, FILLER X4).
- Backups are GDGs TRANTYPE.BKUP and TRANCATG.PS.BKUP (GDG bases must pre-exist; defined elsewhere).

##### Outputs & side effects
Two GDG backup generations; recreated TRANTYPE.PS and TRANCATG.PS sequential datasets used by the base application's reference loads/reports.

##### External calls
IEBGENER, IEFBR14, IKJEFT01 (TSO batch) -> DB2 DSN command processor -> DSNTIAUL (DB2 sample unload program, plan DSNTIAUL).

##### Migration notes
- Filler is literal character '0's, not spaces.
- If STEP40 fails after STEP30 deleted the files, TRANTYPE.PS is gone (DISP NEW,CATLG,DELETE) - recovery is from the BKUP GDG; STEP50 then still runs only if RC <= 4.
- STEP50 uses COND=(4,LT) while others use (0,NE): a warning RC 4 from STEP40 still allows STEP50.
- SYSREC00 has no DCB; DSNTIAUL determines LRECL from the CAST(... AS CHAR(60)).
- Comment says 'runs once a day' but Control-M places it in a weekly folder - schedule needs confirmation.
- Naming asymmetry: TRANTYPE.BKUP vs TRANCATG.PS.BKUP.
recommendation: Fully traced. Confirm actual schedule (daily per comment vs weekly folder in Control-M) and GDG base definitions.
note:
End-to-end: TRANEXTR runs after MNTTRDB2 in the Control-M WEEKLY DB2 refresh folder, re-extracting TRANTYPE/TRANCATG flat files from DB2 for the VSAM reloads. Upstream findings: sfind-c0001c8086c54798b228ce1ea65e05ab, sfind-37d154bf0920499bab6026c0250f1e44.

title: COTRTLIC (CICS tran CTLI) - Transaction Type list / filter / inline update & delete on DB2 TRANSACTION_TYPE
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CTLI** -> **COTRTLIC** (CRDDEMOD.csd lines 11-15, 25-26; DB2TRAN CTLITRAN plan entry CARDDEMO). Pseudo-conversational: COMMON-RETURN does `EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CTLI') COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)` where WS-COMMAREA = CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (COCOM01Y) followed by WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA. Reached from admin menu COADM01C (CA00) or back from COTRTUPC (CTTU).

##### Inputs
- **Map CTRTLIA / mapset COTRTLI**: TRTYPE (6,44) len 2 type-code filter; TRDESC (8,25) len 50 description filter; 7 rows (lines 12-18): TRTSELn (col 6, len 1 action), TRTTYPn (col 17, len 2, protected), TRTYPDn (col 25, len 50, editable description). Keys: ENTER, PF2 (add), PF3 (exit), PF7, PF8, PF10 (confirm).
- **Program commarea WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA**: WS-CA-TYPE-CD X2, WS-CA-TYPE-DESC X50, WS-CA-ALL-ROWS-OUT 7 x (code X2 + desc X50) = 364, WS-CA-ROW-SELECTED S9(4) COMP, WS-CA-LAST-TR-CODE X2, WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE X2, WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM 9(1), WS-CA-LAST-PAGE-DISPLAYED 9(1) (0 shown / 9 not shown), WS-CA-NEXT-PAGE-IND X ('Y' exists / low-values not), WS-CA-DELETE-FLAG X, WS-CA-UPDATE-FLAG X.

##### Processing flow
1. **0000-MAIN**: initialize work areas. EIBCALEN=0 -> init commareas, FROM='CTLI'/'COTRTLIC', user type admin, PGM-ENTER, first page, last-page-not-shown. Else split DFHCOMMAREA into both commareas. YYYY-STORE-PFKEY maps EIBAID to CCARD-AID-* (CSSTRPFY).
2. If (PGM-ENTER and came from another program) or (PF3 and came from CTTU): reset program commarea, force ENTER, first page.
3. If EIBCALEN>0 and FROM-PROGRAM='COTRTLIC': **1000-RECEIVE-MAP** = 1100-RECEIVE-SCREEN (RECEIVE map; TRTYPEI->WS-IN-TYPE-CD, TRDESCI->WS-IN-TYPE-DESC; per row selection, code, and description = TRIM(input) unless '*' or spaces -> low-values) + **1200-EDIT-INPUTS** (below).
4. Valid keys: ENTER, PF2, PF3, PF7, PF8, PF10 only when CA-DELETE-REQUESTED or CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED; anything else is treated as ENTER.
5. **PF3**: TO-TRANID = FROM-TRANID unless blank/'CTLI' -> 'CA00'; TO-PROGRAM = FROM-PROGRAM unless blank/self -> 'COADM01C'; set FROM=self, admin, PGM-ENTER; **SYNCPOINT**; **XCTL** TO-PROGRAM.
6. **PF2** (from self): set user type USER (sic), PGM-ENTER, next map COTRTUP/CTRTUPA; **XCTL COTRTUPC** (add transaction type screen).
7. Not PF8 -> CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN. PF10 is downgraded to ENTER unless a delete/update is pending AND neither filter nor row selection changed.
8. **9998-PRIMING-QUERY**: `SELECT 1 FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY`; failure -> 'Db2 access failure.' + SEND-LONG-TEXT (SEND TEXT 800 bytes + bare RETURN, conversation ends).
9. **Dispatch** (EVALUATE, first true):
   - INPUT-ERROR: start key = first code on page; re-read forward unless a filter is invalid; send map.
   - PF7 on first page: re-read forward from first code (message 'No previous pages to display').
   - PF3 / (REENTER from another program): full reset and read first page (effectively unreachable for PF3 because step 5 XCTLs).
   - PF8 with next page: start key = WS-CA-LAST-TR-CODE, SCREEN-NUM+1, **8000-READ-FORWARD**, clear selections.
   - PF7 not first page: start key = first code, SCREEN-NUM-1, **8100-READ-BACKWARDS**, clear selections.
   - ENTER with 1+ 'D' (from self): re-read and show row highlighted + 'Delete HIGHLIGHTED row ? Press F10 to confirm'.
   - PF10 with 'D': **9300-DELETE-RECORD**; send map ('HIGHLIGHTED row deleted.Hit Enter to continue'); on success reset commareas to first page.
   - ENTER with 'U': re-read and show description field editable + 'Update HIGHLIGHTED row. Press F10 to save'.
   - PF10 with 'U': **9200-UPDATE-RECORD**; on success FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED; re-read from first code; send map ('HIGHLIGHTED row was updated').
   - OTHER: read forward from first code, send.
10. **1200-EDIT-INPUTS**:
   - **1210-EDIT-ARRAY**: if either filter changed -> clear selections and skip. Else count blanks/low-values, 'D', 'U' over the 7 selection bytes; actions = 7 - blanks; valid = D + U. Loop rows 7..1: 'D'/'U' -> remember row (I-SELECTED ends as the lowest row number), if >1 action mark row error; 'U' -> **1211-EDIT-ARRAY-DESC** (case-insensitive trimmed compare with stored desc; same -> 'No change detected with respect to database values.'; else 1240 alphanumeric-required check on 50 chars). Other value -> INPUT-ERROR 'Action code selected is invalid'. Row selection changed vs WS-CA-ROW-SELECTED tracked. >1 action -> INPUT-ERROR 'Please select only 1 action'.
   - **1230-EDIT-DESC**: non-blank -> WS-TYPE-DESC-FILTER = '%' || TRIM(desc) || '%'; change vs WS-CA-TYPE-DESC resets paging.
   - **1220-EDIT-TYPECD**: blank/zeros -> filter '00' and blank; non-numeric -> INPUT-ERROR 'TYPE CODE FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 2 DIGIT NUMBER', protect rows; else filter = code. Change vs WS-CA-TYPE-CD resets paging.
   - **1240-EDIT-ALPHANUM-REQD**: blank -> '<name> must be supplied.'; any character other than A-Z, a-z, 0-9 (converted to spaces) and space -> '<name> can have numbers or alphabets only.'.
   - **1290-CROSS-EDITS**: if any filter valid, **9100-CHECK-FILTERS** `SELECT COUNT(1)` with same predicates; 0 -> INPUT-ERROR 'No Records found for these filter conditions', mark filters not-ok, protect rows.
11. **8000-READ-FORWARD**: clear rows; OPEN C-TR-TYPE-FORWARD (`SELECT TR_TYPE, TR_DESCRIPTION FROM CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE WHERE TR_TYPE >= :WS-START-KEY AND (type filter flag='1' -> TR_TYPE = :filter) AND (desc filter flag='1' -> TR_DESCRIPTION LIKE TRIM(:filter)) ORDER BY TR_TYPE`); FETCH up to 7 rows into commarea; row 1 sets WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE (SCREEN-NUM 0 -> 1); at row 7 set LAST code and fetch one more: found -> next page exists and **WS-CA-LAST-TR-CODE = the 8th row's code**; +100 -> no next page ('No more pages for these search conditions' if PF8). +100 before 7 rows -> no next page; page 1 with 0 rows -> 'No records found for this search condition.'. Other SQLCODE -> DB2 error message. CLOSE cursor.
12. **8100-READ-BACKWARDS**: OPEN C-TR-TYPE-BACKWARD (`TR_TYPE < :WS-START-KEY ... ORDER BY TR_TYPE DESC`), fill rows 7 down to 1, last fetched becomes FIRST code; LAST key set to previous first key. Any non-zero SQLCODE (including +100) -> DB2 error flag.
13. **9200-UPDATE-RECORD**: DCL-TR-TYPE = row code (I-SELECTED); DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION-TEXT = TRIM(new desc); DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION-LEN = LENGTH(untrimmed field) = 50; `UPDATE CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE SET TR_DESCRIPTION = :DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION WHERE TR_TYPE = :DCL-TR-TYPE`. 0 -> **SYNCPOINT**, success; +100 -> 'Record not found. Deleted by others ?'; -911 -> 'Deadlock. Someone else updating ?' + INPUT-ERROR; <0 -> 'Update failed with'.
14. **9300-DELETE-RECORD**: `DELETE FROM CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE WHERE TR_TYPE = :DCL-TR-TYPE`. 0 -> **SYNCPOINT**, success; -532 (RI RESTRICT from TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY) -> 'Please delete associated child records first:'; other -> 'Delete failed with message:'.
15. **9999-FORMAT-DB2-MESSAGE**: CALL **DSNTIAC** (DFHEIBLK, DFHCOMMAREA, SQLCA, 10x72 text area, LRECL 72); WS-LONG-MSG = action ' SQLCODE:' code ' ' formatted text; first 75 chars -> WS-RETURN-MSG (ERRMSG).
16. **2000-SEND-MAP**: 2100 header (titles, CTLI, COTRTLIC, date, time, PAGENO = SCREEN-NUM); 2200 row attributes (empty rows or protect flag -> selection protected; error rows red; selected D row neutral color + cursor; selected U row description unprotected FSET + cursor, red if invalid); 2300 rows from commarea (deleted row selection cleared; pending sets CA-DELETE/UPDATE-REQUESTED; updated description shown as entered or '*' if blank); 2400 filter field echo/attributes; 2500 messages (info line centered in 45 chars: 'Type U to update, D to delete any record' default); 2600 SEND MAP ERASE CURSOR FREEKB.

##### Data
- **CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE** (ddl/TRNTYPE.ddl): TR_TYPE CHAR(2) PK, TR_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL; DCLGEN DCLTRTYP: DCL-TR-TYPE X2, DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION (49 LEN S9(4) COMP + 49 TEXT X50). Read via two cursors and COUNT; UPDATE and DELETE by TR_TYPE.
- Child table TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY (FK TRC_TYPE_CODE -> TR_TYPE ON DELETE RESTRICT) causes -532 on delete.
- SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 for priming.

##### Outputs & side effects
- Screen CTRTLIA; DB2 UPDATE/DELETE committed by explicit SYNCPOINT; commarea state for paging/pending action.
- SYNCPOINT before XCTL on PF3.

##### External calls
- **DSNTIAC** (DB2 message formatter, CICS version) - passes EIB, commarea, SQLCA, output area; returns formatted text and RETURN-CODE.
- XCTL **COADM01C** (admin menu) / caller; XCTL **COTRTUPC** (add/update screen, other batch).

##### Migration notes
- **Description length bug**: DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION-LEN is computed from the untrimmed 50-byte field, so every update stores a 50-character VARCHAR padded with trailing spaces.
- CA-DELETE-SUCCEEDED and CA-DELETE-NOT-REQUESTED share VALUE LOW-VALUES: 'succeeded' is true whenever no delete is pending; delete failure branches other than -532 leave the flag as it was ('Y').
- PF10 update path does not GO TO COMMON-RETURN inside the WHEN; it falls through to the post-EVALUATE INPUT-ERROR check (same end result).
- Duplicate `WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK07 AND CA-FIRST-PAGE` clause; `WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK03` in the EVALUATE is unreachable unless XCTL fails.
- PF2 sets CDEMO-USRTYP-USER before XCTL to the add program (user type downgraded).
- When >1 row is selected, the processed row I-SELECTED is the lowest row number (loop runs 7 -> 1).
- 8000 sets WS-CA-LAST-TR-CODE to the look-ahead (8th) row; PF8 then starts at `>=` that key so the 8th row appears first on the next page (no duplicate/skip). Backward cursor treats +100 as a DB2 error (shows SQLCODE message on early start of table).
- WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM is 9(1): page numbers wrap after 9.
- Type-code filter of '00' is treated as blank; description filter is a contains-match ('%text%'), case-sensitive per DB2 collation, applied with TRIM on the host variable.
- Description edit allows only letters, digits and spaces (no punctuation).
- DB2 errors at priming end the conversation with plain text (no TRANSID).
recommendation: Fully traced within COTRTLIC; COTRTUPC/COADM01C are in other batches. Decide whether to keep 50-char padded VARCHAR updates and the user-type downgrade on PF2.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- Page size 7 (WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES); WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM is PIC 9(1) so page counter wraps after 9.
- Paging key semantics: next page starts at the look-ahead (8th) row code, not after last displayed row. Backward read treats +100 as DB2 error (WS-DB2-ERROR) - fewer than 7 previous rows leaves leading rows LOW-VALUES and flags error.
- Only lowest-numbered selected row is acted on (loop runs 7->1).
- The alnum edit rejects punctuation and the description update stores TRIM(text) but sets LEN = FUNCTION LENGTH of the untrimmed 50-byte field, so DB2 VARCHAR gets 50 bytes (trailing spaces padded).
- PF02 sets CDEMO-USRTYP-USER before XCTL to COTRTUPC (inconsistent with admin flows).
- Error after delete SQL uses WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF guard: only first message wins. 1220 exit paragraph contains logic (code after the -EXIT label executes).
- Hidden DB2 round trip.** The filter-count query and the priming query each add a DB2 call per interaction.
- Paging.** It is keyset-based, using the first and last codes on the page.
- 'No change' comparison is case-insensitive; description validation allows only letters, digits and spaces.
- Update sets VARCHAR length = 50 (FUNCTION LENGTH of untrimmed field) - stores trailing spaces.
- PF3 entry from CTTU resets state; PF2 marks user as regular user (CDEMO-USRTYP-USER) before XCTL - asymmetric with other paths that set ADMIN.
- Unmapped 8th row (TRTSELA/TRTTYPA/TRTDSCA) in BMS.

- Update stores `DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION-LEN = FUNCTION LENGTH(WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN)` = 50 always, so updated descriptions are saved right-padded with spaces to 50.
- Description validation allows only letters, digits and spaces; change detection is case-insensitive (changing only case is rejected as 'No change').
- 88 levels CA-DELETE-SUCCEEDED / CA-DELETE-NOT-REQUESTED share LOW-VALUES (same for update) - 'succeeded' tests are true whenever nothing was requested.
- Duplicate WHEN for 'PF7 AND CA-FIRST-PAGE'; WS-TYPE-CD-DELETE-FILTER is declared but unused.

Defines a view usable only for initial database load (PROCOPT=L permits ISRT in load mode only).

None.

None.

- No JCL in this module references PSBPAUTL: LOADPADB uses PSBPAUTB (PROCOPT=AP) and UNLDGSAM uses DLIGSAMP (searched jcl/ directory). It may be used by an external load utility; usage unproven, not proven dead.

title: XAUTHFRD - Unique index on CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS (fraud-flagged authorizations)
description:
##### Entry point
DB2 DDL: `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CARDDEMO.XAUTHFRD ON CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS (CARD_NUM ASC, AUTH_TS DESC) COPY YES`.

##### Inputs
N/A.

##### Processing flow
Supports the primary key of AUTHFRDS (ddl/AUTHFRDS.ddl): CARD_NUM CHAR(16) NOT NULL, AUTH_TS TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, AUTH_TYPE CHAR(4), CARD_EXPIRY_DATE CHAR(4), MESSAGE_TYPE CHAR(6), MESSAGE_SOURCE CHAR(6), AUTH_ID_CODE CHAR(6), AUTH_RESP_CODE CHAR(2), AUTH_RESP_REASON CHAR(4), PROCESSING_CODE CHAR(6), TRANSACTION_AMT DECIMAL(12,2), APPROVED_AMT DECIMAL(12,2), MERCHANT_CATAGORY_CODE CHAR(4), ACQR_COUNTRY_CODE CHAR(3), POS_ENTRY_MODE SMALLINT, MERCHANT_ID CHAR(15), MERCHANT_NAME VARCHAR(22), MERCHANT_CITY CHAR(13), MERCHANT_STATE CHAR(2), MERCHANT_ZIP CHAR(9), TRANSACTION_ID CHAR(15), MATCH_STATUS CHAR(1), AUTH_FRAUD CHAR(1), FRAUD_RPT_DATE DATE, ACCT_ID DECIMAL(11), CUST_ID DECIMAL(9); PRIMARY KEY (CARD_NUM, AUTH_TS).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  T["CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS"] --> I["XAUTHFRD unique CARD_NUM ASC, AUTH_TS DESC"]
```

##### Data
Columns mirror CIPAUDTY detail fields plus account/customer ids; written by the fraud-marking flow (COPAUS1C/COPAUS2C, DB2 tran CPVD - other batch).

##### Outputs & side effects
None.

##### External calls
None.

##### Migration notes
DESC on AUTH_TS gives newest-first access per card, matching the IMS inverted-timestamp ordering. COPY YES enables image copies of the index.
recommendation: Fully documented; writer logic is in COPAUS2C (other batch).

title: BMS mapset COPAU01 / map COPAU1A - View Authorization Details screen (used by COPAUS1C)
description:
##### Entry point
Screen definition; mapset **COPAU01** (CTRL=(ALARM,FREEKB), EXTATT=YES, MODE=INOUT, TIOAPFX=YES), map **COPAU1A** 24x80. Referenced by COPAUS1C (tran CPVD, outside this batch), reached from COPAUS0C by selecting 'S'.

##### Inputs
No unprotected input fields; all fields ASKIP. Only AID keys matter: footer ' F3=Back  F5=Mark/Remove Fraud  F8=Next Auth'.

##### Processing flow
Layout (row,col,len), all output-only:
- Header identical pattern to COPAU0A (TRNNAME, TITLE01, CURDATE, PGMNAME, TITLE02, CURTIME) but without FSET; title 'View Authorization Details' (4,27).
- 'Card #:' CARDNUM (7,11,16) PINK; 'Auth Date:' AUTHDT (7,43,10); 'Auth Time:' AUTHTM (7,68,10).
- 'Auth Resp:' AUTHRSP (9,14,1); 'Resp Reason:' AUTHRSN (9,32,20); 'Auth Code:' AUTHCD (9,68,6).
- 'Amount:' AUTHAMT (11,11,12); 'POS Entry Mode:' POSEMD (11,46,4); 'Source :' AUTHSRC (11,68,10).
- 'MCC Code:' MCCCD (13,13,4); 'Card Exp. Date:' CRDEXP (13,42,5); 'Auth Type:' AUTHTYP (13,64,14).
- 'Tran Id:' TRNID (15,12,15); 'Match Status:' AUTHMTC (15,46,1) RED; 'Fraud Status:' AUTHFRD (15,67,10) RED.
- 'Merchant Details ---' (17,2); 'Name:' MERNAME (19,9,25); 'Merchant ID:' MERID (19,55,15); 'City:' MERCITY (21,9,25); 'State:' MERST (21,49,2); 'Zip:' MERZIP (21,61,10).
- ERRMSG (23,1,78) RED BRT FSET; footer (24,1,45).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["COPAU1A header"] --> B["Card/Auth date/time"]
  B --> C["Resp/Reason/Code, Amount/POS/Source, MCC/Exp/Type"]
  C --> D["Tran Id / Match / Fraud status"]
  D --> E["Merchant details"]
  E --> F["ERRMSG + F3/F5/F8 legend"]
```

##### Data
Symbolic map `cpy-bms/COPAU01.cpy`. Field contents map to CIPAUDTY detail segment fields (filled by COPAUS1C).

##### Outputs & side effects
None (definition).

##### External calls
None.

##### Migration notes
- 'Tran Id:' literal is declared LENGTH=18 at (15,2) though text is 8 chars and TRNID starts at col 12 (overlap is BMS-tolerated attribute byte placement) - keep positions as-is for pixel-faithful rendering.
- The screen has no input fields; F5 toggles fraud status (business logic in COPAUS1C, not traced here).
recommendation: Screen fully documented; behavior behind F5/F8 lives in COPAUS1C (other batch).

title: BMS mapset COTRTUP / map CTRTUPA - Maintain Transaction Type screen (COTRTUPC)
description:
##### Entry point
Mapset **COTRTUP** (line 20, LANG=COBOL, MODE=INOUT, STORAGE=AUTO), map **CTRTUPA** (line 25, CTRL=FREEKB, DSATTS/MAPATTS COLOR,HILIGHT,PS,VALIDN). Used by COTRTUPC (tran CTTU); COTRTLIC names it as next mapset when XCTLing on PF2.

##### Inputs
- **TRTYPCD** (12,26) len 2, UNPROT, IC (initial cursor), UNDERLINE - transaction type code.
- **TRTYDSC** (14,26) len 50, UNPROT, UNDERLINE - description.
- Keys per footer: ENTER=Process, F3=Exit, F4=Delete, F5=Save, F6=Add, F12=Cancel.

##### Processing flow
Layout: header (TRNNAME 1,7,4; TITLE01 1,21,40; CURDATE 1,71,8; PGMNAME 2,7,8; TITLE02 2,21,40; CURTIME 2,71,8), title 'Maintain Transaction Type', labels 'Transaction Type  :' and 'Description       :', INFOMSG (22,23,45) NEUTRAL, ERRMSG (23,1,78) RED BRT FSET, FKEYS (24,1,21) 'ENTER=Process F3=Exit', FKEY04 (24,23,9) 'F4=Delete', FKEY05 (24,33,8) 'F5=Save', FKEY06 (24,43,6) 'F6=Add', FKEY12 (24,69,10) 'F12=Cancel'. FKEY04/05/06/12 are ASKIP **DRK** (hidden) by default - the program reveals them per state.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  H["CTRTUPA header"] --> I["TRTYPCD 2 + TRTYDSC 50 inputs"]
  I --> M["INFOMSG / ERRMSG"]
  M --> F["FKEYS + hidden FKEY04/05/06/12"]
```

##### Data
Symbolic map cpy-bms/COTRTUP.cpy; fields correspond to TRANSACTION_TYPE.TR_TYPE / TR_DESCRIPTION.

##### Outputs & side effects
None.

##### External calls
None.

##### Migration notes
Conditional visibility of F4/F5/F6/F12 is driven by attribute bytes set in COTRTUPC (other batch); UI must support per-state hidden actions. Mapset has a second DFHMSD TYPE=FINAL at line 136.
recommendation: Screen documented; state logic is in COTRTUPC (other batch).

title: CRDDEMOM.csd - CICS definitions for VSAM-MQ module: CDRA->COACCT01, CDRD->CODATE01, library CARDDLIB
description:
##### Entry point
CICS CSD group **CARDDEMO** definitions (app-vsam-mq):
- `DEFINE TRANSACTION(CDRA) PROGRAM(COACCT01)` (lines 17-18) and `DEFINE TRANSACTION(CDRD) PROGRAM(CODATE01)` (lines 27-28): PROFILE DFHCICST, TASKDATALOC ANY, ISOLATE YES, PRIORITY 1, TRANCLASS DFHTCL00, DTIMOUT NO, RESTART NO, SPURGE/TPURGE YES, ACTION BACKOUT, DUMP/TRACE YES, RESSEC/CMDSEC NO.
- `DEFINE PROGRAM(COACCT01)` (line 1) and `DEFINE PROGRAM(CODATE01)` (line 9): DESCRIPTION 'LIST CARDS' (both), RELOAD NO, RESIDENT NO, CEDF YES, DATALOCATION ANY, EXECKEY USER, CONCURRENCY QUASIRENT, API CICSAPI, DYNAMIC NO, TRANSID CDRA / CDRD, EXECUTIONSET FULLAPI.
- `DEFINE LIBRARY(CARDDLIB)` (line 37): RANKING 50, CRITICAL NO, DSNAME01 AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB.

##### Inputs
Both programs (grep of source) begin with `EXEC CICS RETRIEVE` of an MQ trigger message (MQTM-QNAME), so CDRA/CDRD are started by the MQ trigger monitor, not from a terminal.

##### Processing flow
TRANSID -> program routing only. Program behavior (observed by scan of calls, not fully traced here): COACCT01 MQOPENs three queues, MQGETs a request, CICS READs file ACCTDAT, MQPUTs reply/error; CODATE01 same MQ pattern using ASKTIME/FORMATTIME (date service). title: BMS mapset COPAU00 / map COPAU0A - View Authorizations list screen (used by COPAUS0C)
description:
##### Entry point
Screen definition, not executable. Mapset **COPAU00** (DFHMSD CTRL=(ALARM,FREEKB), EXTATT=YES, LANG=COBOL, MODE=INOUT, STORAGE=AUTO, TIOAPFX=YES), map **COPAU0A** 24x80. Sent/received by COPAUS0C (tran CPVS).

##### Inputs
Unprotected fields: **ACCTID** (5,19) len 11 GREEN UNDERLINE FSET; **SEL0001..SEL0005** (rows 16-20, col 3) len 1 GREEN UNDERLINE FSET (program toggles them protected/unprotected per row). PF keys per footer: ENTER=Continue F3=Back F7=Backward F8=Forward.

##### Processing flow
Layout (row,col,len):
- Header: 'Tran:' (1,1) TRNNAME (1,7,4); TITLE01 (1,21,40) yellow; 'Date:' CURDATE (1,71,8 init mm/dd/yy); 'Prog:' PGMNAME (2,7,8); TITLE02 (2,21,40); 'Time:' CURTIME (2,71,8 init hh:mm:ss); title 'View Authorizations' (3,30).
- 'Search Acct Id:' (5,3) ACCTID (5,19,11).
- 'Name:' CNAME (6,10,25); 'Customer Id:' CUSTID (6,58,9); ADDR001 (7,10,25); 'Acct Status:' ACCSTAT (7,58,1); ADDR002 (8,10,25); 'PH:' PHONE1 (9,15,13); 'Approval # :' APPRCNT (9,58,3); 'Decline #:' DECLCNT (9,76,3).
- 'Credit Lim:' CREDLIM (11,19,12); 'Cash Lim:' CASHLIM (11,46,9); 'Appr Amt:' APPRAMT (11,69,10); 'Credit Bal:' CREDBAL (12,19,12); 'Cash Bal:' CASHBAL (12,46,9); 'Decl Amt:' DECLAMT (12,69,10).
- Column headings row 14: Sel | Transaction ID | Date | Time | Type | A/D | STS | Amount; dashes row 15.
- Rows n=01..05 at lines 16..20: SEL000n (col 3,1), TRNIDnn (8,16), PDATEnn (27,8), PTIMEnn (38,8), PTYPEnn (49,4), PAPRVnn (58,1), PSTATnn (63,1), PAMT00n (67,12); all output fields ASKIP FSET BLUE.
- (22,12) 'Type ''S'' to View Authorization details from the list'; ERRMSG (23,1,78) RED BRT; footer (24,1) 'ENTER=Continue  F3=Back  F7=Backward  F8=Forward'.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["COPAU0A header TRNNAME/TITLE/DATE/TIME"] --> B["ACCTID input"]
  B --> C["Customer + summary block CNAME..DECLAMT"]
  C --> D["5 rows SEL000n + TRNID/PDATE/PTIME/PTYPE/PAPRV/PSTAT/PAMT"]
  D --> E["ERRMSG + PF key legend"]
```

##### Data
Symbolic map copybook `app-authorization-ims-db2-mq/cpy-bms/COPAU00.cpy` (COPAU0AI/COPAU0AO with L/F/A/I and O suffixes) is the program contract.

##### Outputs & side effects
None (definition). Populated values are documented in the COPAUS0C flow.

##### External calls
None.

##### Migration notes
- ACCSTAT is defined but never filled by COPAUS0C.
- Many output fields carry FSET, so they are returned on every RECEIVE (program ignores them).
- SEL0005 is defined after row 5's data fields in source order (fields order in the symbolic map follows source order, not screen order).
- Row amount field is 12 chars but program edit mask -zzzzzzz9.99 is 12 chars; summary fields APPRAMT/DECLAMT are 10 wide but receive -zzzz9.99 (9 chars).
recommendation: Fully documented. Use cpy-bms/COPAU00.cpy for exact symbolic field order when building the UI DTO.

title: READACCT / CBACT01C account file extract to fixed, array and variable-length files
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `READACCT` (app/jcl/READACCT.jcl): PREDEL IEFBR14 deletes ACCTDATA.PSCOMP / ARRYPS / VBPS; STEP05 `EXEC PGM=CBACT01C` (no PARM, `PROCEDURE DIVISION.` without USING).

##### Inputs
`ACCTFILE` -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS, INDEXED, SEQUENTIAL, key FD-ACCT-ID 9(11), read INTO CVACT01Y ACCOUNT-RECORD (300 bytes: ACCT-ID 9(11), ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS X, ACCT-CURR-BAL S9(10)V99, ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, ACCT-OPEN-DATE X10, ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE X10, ACCT-REISSUE-DATE X10, ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT S9(10)V99, ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT S9(10)V99, ACCT-ADDR-ZIP X10, ACCT-GROUP-ID X10, FILLER X178).

##### Processing flow
1. Open ACCTFILE INPUT (0000), OUTFILE OUTPUT (2000), ARRYFILE OUTPUT (3000), VBRCFILE OUTPUT (4000); non-'00' -> 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS + 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM.
2. Loop until END-OF-FILE='Y': 1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT. Status '00' -> DISPLAY fields, then:
   - 1300-POPUL-ACCT-RECORD: copy ID, status, balances, limits, open/expiry dates; ACCT-REISSUE-DATE -> CODATECN-INP-DATE and WS-REISSUE-DATE; CODATECN-TYPE='2' (input YYYY-MM-DD), CODATECN-OUTTYPE='2' (output YYYYMMDD); `CALL 'COBDATFT' USING CODATECN-REC`; CODATECN-0UT-DATE -> OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE; cycle credit copied; IF ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT = 0 MOVE 2525.00 to OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT (no ELSE: non-zero debit is NOT copied); group id copied. 1350 WRITE (abend unless '00' or '10').
   - 1400-POPUL-ARRAY-RECORD: ARR-ACCT-ID; occurrence 1 = (ACCT-CURR-BAL, 1005.00); 2 = (ACCT-CURR-BAL, 1525.00); 3 = (-1025.00, -2500.00); occurrences 4-5 not set. 1450 WRITE (abend unless '00').
   - 1500-POPUL-VBRC-RECORD: VBRC-REC1 = acct id + status (12 bytes); VBRC-REC2 = acct id, curr bal, credit limit, WS-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY (39 bytes). 1550 WRITE length 12; 1575 WRITE length 39.
   Status '10' -> EOF; anything else -> abend.
3. 9000-ACCTFILE-CLOSE; GOBACK.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J[READACCT PREDEL IEFBR14 -> STEP05 CBACT01C] --> O[0000/2000/3000/4000 opens]
  O --> R[1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT]
  R -->|00| P[1300-POPUL-ACCT-RECORD CALL COBDATFT] --> W1[1350-WRITE-ACCT-RECORD OUTFILE]
  W1 --> A[1400-POPUL-ARRAY-RECORD] --> W2[1450-WRITE-ARRY-RECORD]
  W2 --> V[1500-POPUL-VBRC-RECORD] --> W3[1550-WRITE-VB1 len12; 1575-WRITE-VB2 len39] --> R
  R -->|10| C[9000-ACCTFILE-CLOSE; GOBACK]
  R -->|other| X[9999-ABEND-PROGRAM CEE3ABD 999]
```

##### Data
- `OUTFILE` -> ACCTDATA.PSCOMP FB LRECL 107: OUT-ACCT-ID 9(11), STATUS X, CURR-BAL S9(10)V99, CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, OPEN-DATE X10, EXPIRAION-DATE X10, REISSUE-DATE X10, CURR-CYC-CREDIT S9(10)V99, CURR-CYC-DEBIT S9(10)V99 COMP-3 (7 bytes), GROUP-ID X10.
- `ARRYFILE` -> ACCTDATA.ARRYPS FB LRECL 110: ARR-ACCT-ID 9(11), 5 x {CURR-BAL S9(10)V99 zoned 12, CYC-DEBIT S9(10)V99 COMP-3 7}, FILLER X4.
- `VBRCFILE` -> ACCTDATA.VBPS RECFM VB LRECL 84, record VBR-REC X(80) varying 10-80 DEPENDING ON WS-RECD-LEN. Rec1 12 bytes (ID 9(11), status X); Rec2 39 bytes (ID 9(11), bal S9(10)V99, limit S9(10)V99, reissue year X4).
- CODATECN-REC: TYPE X ('1' YYYYMMDD, '2' YYYY-MM-DD), INP-DATE X20, OUTTYPE X ('1' YYYY-MM-DD, '2' YYYYMMDD), 0UT-DATE X20, ERROR-MSG X38.

##### Outputs & side effects
Three sequential files per account (1 fixed, 1 fixed array, 2 variable records), SYSOUT displays. No VSAM update.

##### External calls
- `COBDATFT` (assembler date-format routine; source is not COBOL in this batch - app/asm per repo naming, not traced) USING CODATECN-REC; expected to return the reissue date reformatted to YYYYMMDD in CODATECN-0UT-DATE (first 10 bytes moved to OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE).
- `CEE3ABD` USING ABCODE=999, TIMING=0.

##### Migration notes
- Hardcoded test values: debit 2525.00 when zero; array literals 1005.00/1525.00/-1025.00/-2500.00; occurrences 4-5 left as uninitialized FD storage (whatever the buffer contains, likely low-values/previous record).
- When ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT != 0 the output debit field is never moved -> keeps prior record's value in the FD buffer.
- Only ACCTFILE is closed; OUT/ARRY/VBRC files are left to be closed implicitly at GOBACK.
- OUTFILE write accepts status '10' as success (asymmetry with other writes).
- COBDATFT behaviour inferred from parameter names/types only - its source was not read; treat date conversion as unverified.
- WS-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY derived by REDEFINES of the raw date (first 4 chars), independent of COBDATFT.
recommendation: COBDATFT (assembler) source not traced; verify its date conversion.
note: Duplicate of sfind-a67fbe5a171a4912927b7bc4e1a093b0 (CBACT01C account extract to PS/array/VB files (READACCT)); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CU02 / COUSR02C user update screen (USRSEC)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CU02` -> program `COUSR02C` (CSD DEFINE TRANSACTION(CU02) PROGRAM(COUSR02C)), normally XCTL'd from COUSR00C (user list, selection 'U') with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA. Pseudo-conversational RETURN TRANSID('CU02') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA).

##### Inputs
- COMMAREA: COCOM01Y CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (layout as in COTRN01C flow) + CDEMO-CU02-INFO: USRID-FIRST X8, USRID-LAST X8, PAGE-NUM 9(8), NEXT-PAGE-FLG X1, USR-SEL-FLG X1, USR-SELECTED X8. NOTE: COUSR00C writes its selection into CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED which occupies the same offset (identical extension layout), so CU02 sees it as CDEMO-CU02-USR-SELECTED.
- Map COUSR2A / mapset COUSR02 fields: USRIDINI (user id), FNAMEI, LNAMEI, PASSWDI, USRTYPEI.

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C.
2. First entry: set re-enter, clear map; if USR-SELECTED non-blank -> USRIDINI and PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; SEND-USRUPD-SCREEN.
3. Re-entry RECEIVE; EIBAID: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> UPDATE-USER-INFO then XCTL to FROM-PROGRAM (default 'COADM01C'); PF4 -> clear; PF5 -> UPDATE-USER-INFO; PF12 -> XCTL 'COADM01C' (no save); other -> invalid-key message.
4. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: blank id -> 'User ID can NOT be empty...'. Else blank name/pwd/type fields, READ-USER-SEC-FILE (`CICS READ DATASET('USRSEC') INTO(SEC-USER-DATA) RIDFLD(SEC-USR-ID) KEYLENGTH(8) UPDATE`): NORMAL -> message 'Press PF5 key to save your updates ...' (neutral color) and SEND (before fields are filled); NOTFND -> 'User ID NOT found...'; other -> 'Unable to lookup User...'. If no error, move SEC-USR-FNAME/LNAME/PWD/TYPE to the map and SEND again.
5. UPDATE-USER-INFO: validate in order id, first name, last name, password, user type non-blank (first failure -> message, cursor, send). Then re-READ UPDATE, compare each screen field to record; changed fields copied and USR-MODIFIED-YES. If modified -> UPDATE-USER-SEC-FILE `CICS REWRITE DATASET('USRSEC') FROM(SEC-USER-DATA)`: NORMAL -> green 'User <id> has been updated ...'; NOTFND -> 'User ID NOT found...'; other -> 'Unable to Update User...'. If not modified -> red 'Please modify to update ...'.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S[CU02 COUSR02C MAIN-PARA] --> A{EIBCALEN=0}
  A -->|yes| X0[XCTL COSGN00C]
  A -->|no| B{REENTER}
  B -->|no| P0[USR-SELECTED -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY] --> SND[SEND-USRUPD-SCREEN]
  B -->|yes| K{EIBAID}
  K -->|ENTER| P[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY READ USRSEC UPDATE] --> SND
  K -->|PF5| U[UPDATE-USER-INFO validate, READ UPDATE, compare, REWRITE USRSEC] --> SND
  K -->|PF3| U3[UPDATE-USER-INFO] --> X3[XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COADM01C]
  K -->|PF12| X12[XCTL COADM01C]
  K -->|PF4| SND
  K -->|other| SND
  SND --> RET[RETURN TRANSID CU02]
```

##### Data
CICS file USRSEC -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS; CSUSR01Y SEC-USER-DATA 80 bytes: SEC-USR-ID X8 (key), SEC-USR-FNAME X20, SEC-USR-LNAME X20, SEC-USR-PWD X8 (plain text), SEC-USR-TYPE X1, FILLER X23. Read with UPDATE and REWRITE.

##### Outputs & side effects
Updated user security record; screen messages; COMMAREA returned.

##### External calls
CICS XCTL to COSGN00C, COADM01C, or CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (FROM set to CU02/COUSR02C, context 0).

##### Migration notes
- PF3 saves (runs UPDATE-USER-INFO) and then exits even if validation failed or nothing changed - the screen SENDs then XCTL happens in the same task (the sent screen is immediately replaced).
- ENTER path may issue two SENDs in one task (message send inside READ, then data send).
- USRTYPE is not validated to 'A'/'U'; any non-blank char accepted. Passwords stored/compared in clear, 8 chars.
- USRSEC read UPDATE on ENTER holds lock only for the task; PF5 rereads, so concurrent updates are last-writer-wins.
- If the user id is changed on screen between ENTER and PF5, PF5 updates the newly typed id.
recommendation: Fully documented.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/COUSR02C.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-37559c30c8f9429ab119627bec06d589.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- User type only checked non-blank: any character (not just A/U) is stored; sign-on treats non-'A' as regular user.
- Password stored/displayed in plaintext; input is NOT uppercased here although sign-on uppercases input — a lowercase password set here can never sign on.
- PF3 saves before exiting (and exits even if validation fails).


End-to-end: XCTLed by COADM01C via the COADM02Y option table (admin menu). Also XCTLed from COUSR00C on row selection 'U'. Upstream findings: sfind-e0898a948b0c4184bdd559c110c475d8, sfind-8e188dda1ba3423ea06ff2c7951bbc5a.

title: CREASTMT / CBSTM03A+CBSTM03B customer statement generation (text + HTML)
description: ##### Entry point Batch job `CREASTMT` (app/jcl/CREASTMT.JCL) step `STEP040 EXEC PGM=CBSTM03A,COND=(0,NE)`. Prior steps: DELDEF01 IDCAMS delete/define TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS (KEYS(32 0), RECORDSIZE 350); STEP010 SORT TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS by card(263,16) then tran-id(1,16), OUTREC moves card num to pos 1-16, tran 1-262 to 17-278, 279-328 kept -> TRXFL.SEQ; STEP020 REPRO into TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS; STEP030 IEFBR14 deletes old STATEMNT.HTML/PS. CBSTM03A is the main program; CBSTM03B (app/cbl/CBSTM03B.CBL) is a called file-service subprogram. ##### Inputs - `TRNXFILE` TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS via CBSTM03B (seq): COSTM01 TRNX-RECORD 350: TRNX-CARD-NUM X16, TRNX-ID X16 (key 32), TRNX-REST: TYPE-CD X2, CAT-CD 9(4), SOURCE X10, DESC X100, AMT S9(9)V99, MERCHANT-ID 9(9), NAME X50, CITY X50, ZIP X10, ORIG-TS X26, PROC-TS X26, FILLER X20. - `XREFFILE` CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS sequential (CVACT03Y). - `CUSTFILE` CUSTDATA.VSAM.KSDS random key X(9) (CUSTREC layout, 500 bytes: CUST-ID 9(9), names X25x3, addr lines X50x3, state X2, country X3, zip X10, phones X15x2, SSN 9(9), govt id X20, DOB X10, EFT X10, pri-holder X1, FICO 9(3), filler X168). - `ACCTFILE` ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS random key 9(11) (CVACT01Y). ##### Processing flow 1. Walk MVS control blocks (PSA->TCB->TIOT via POINTERs) and DISPLAY job/step name and every DD name with valid/null UCB (diagnostic only). 2. OPEN OUTPUT STMT-FILE (STMTFILE, 80) and HTML-FILE (HTMLFILE, 100); initialize WS-TRNX-TABLE (51 cards x 10 trans x 334 bytes) and counters. 3. 0000-START dispatcher on WS-FL-DD with ALTER/GO TO state machine: 'TRNXFILE' -> 8100-TRNXFILE-OPEN (open + first read via CBSTM03B, RC '00'/'04' ok else abend), set CR-CNT=1, TR-CNT=0, WS-FL-DD='READTRNX'; 'READTRNX' -> 8500-READTRNX-READ loads ALL transactions into the in-memory table, grouping consecutive records by card (new card -> store WS-TRCT for previous card, CR-CNT+1, TR-CNT=1); at RC '10' -> 8599-EXIT stores last count, WS-FL-DD='XREFFILE'; 'XREFFILE' -> 8200 open, then 'CUSTFILE' -> 8300 open, 'ACCTFILE' -> 8400 open, then GO TO 1000-MAINLINE. WHEN OTHER -> GOBACK. 4. 1000-MAINLINE: for each XREF record (1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT, CBSTM03B op 'R'; '10' = EOF; other abend): 2000-CUSTFILE-GET (op 'K', key XREF-CUST-ID len 9), 3000-ACCTFILE-GET (key XREF-ACCT-ID len 11) - any RC != '00' abends; 5000-CREATE-STATEMENT; WS-TOTAL-AMT=0; 4000-TRNXFILE-GET. 5. 5000-CREATE-STATEMENT: writes ST-LINE0 ('*'x31 'START OF STATEMENT' '*'x31), HTML header (5100: doctype, head, table, 'Statement for Account Number: ' + ACCT-ID, bank address 'Bank of XYZ / 410 Terry Ave N / Seattle WA 99999'), name = first/middle/last each delimited by first space, address lines 1,2 and line3+state+country+zip (each delimited by space), Account ID, Current Balance (PIC 9(9).99-), FICO, then text lines 1-13 and HTML 5200 sections (Basic Details, Transaction Summary column headers). 6. 4000-TRNXFILE-GET: scan table entries 1..CR-CNT, stop when WS-CARD-NUM > XREF-CARD-NUM; for matching card write each transaction (6000-WRITE-TRANS: ST-LINE14 = TRNX-ID, DESC truncated to 49, '$', AMT Z(9).99-; plus HTML row) and ADD TRNX-AMT to WS-TOTAL-AMT. Then write ST-LINE12, ST-LINE14A 'Total EXP:' total, ST-LINE15 END OF STATEMENT, and HTML closing tags () per statement. 7. After EOF close 4 files via CBSTM03B op 'C' and CLOSE STMT/HTML. ```mermaid flowchart TD J[CREASTMT: DELDEF01 -> STEP010 SORT -> STEP020 REPRO -> STEP030 delete -> STEP040 CBSTM03A] --> T[TIOT DD display] T --> S[0000-START ALTER dispatcher] S --> A[8100-TRNXFILE-OPEN] --> B[8500-READTRNX-READ load table by card] B --> C[8200 XREF open] --> D[8300 CUST open] --> E[8400 ACCT open] --> M[1000-MAINLINE] M --> X[1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT CBSTM03B R] X -->|RC 10| Z[9100-9400 close via CBSTM03B; CLOSE STMT/HTML] X -->|00| G[2000-CUSTFILE-GET K; 3000-ACCTFILE-GET K] G --> ST[5000-CREATE-STATEMENT text+HTML header] ST --> TR[4000-TRNXFILE-GET table lookup; 6000-WRITE-TRANS each; total] TR --> X G -->|RC not 00| AB[9999-ABEND-PROGRAM CEE3ABD] ``` ##### Data Read: TRXFL KSDS, CARDXREF, CUSTDATA, ACCTDATA (via CBSTM03B). Written: STMTFILE -> STATEMNT.PS (FB 80), HTMLFILE -> STATEMNT.HTML (FB 100). No updates. ##### Outputs & side effects One plain-text and one HTML statement per XREF (card) record; HTML document header/footer is emitted per statement, so the HTML file is a concatenation of multiple documents. ##### External calls - `CBSTM03B` USING WS-M03B-AREA: DD X(8) ('TRNXFILE','XREFFILE','CUSTFILE','ACCTFILE'), OPER X(1) (O open, C close, R sequential read, K keyed read; W/Z defined but not implemented), RC X(2) (returned = file status), KEY X(25), KEY-LN S9(4), FLDT X(1000) (record returned via READ ... INTO). For 'K' it moves KEY(1:KEY-LN) to the record key then random READ. Unknown DD -> GOBACK without setting RC. - `CEE3ABD` (no parameters) on errors. ##### Migration notes - ALTER/GO TO state machine; re-implement as linear open sequence. 8100-FILE-OPEN default target is 8100-TRNXFILE-OPEN. - Hard capacity: 51 cards x 10 transactions per card in WS-TRNX-TABLE; no bounds check - more data overwrites storage. Table lookup relies on cards sorted ascending and stops at first greater card. - Statements are per card (XREF record), not per account; cards with no transactions still get a statement with total 0. - Text statement balance edit 9(9).99- loses nothing but display; descriptions truncated to 49. - Name/address STRING DELIMITED BY ' ' truncates multi-word values at the first space (e.g. '123 Main St' -> '123'). Address line 3 + state etc. likewise. - WS-TOTAL-AMT is COMP-3 S9(9)V99. - TIOT/PSA pointer walking is z/OS-specific diagnostic code; drop it. - CREASTMT.JCL STMTFILE SPACE line contains stray characters (`00,RECFM=FB), ATA.VSAM.KSDS`) after column 72-like text; on a real JES it is treated as comment after a blank.
recommendation: Fully documented. Decide whether to keep 51x10 table capacity limit and space-delimited name/address truncation.
note: Duplicate of sfind-c61aa7aa8ce745ec820239c5975bbf26 (CREASTMT / CBSTM03A + CBSTM03B); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CAUP / COACTUPC account and customer update screen (partially traced)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CAUP` -> program `COACTUPC` (CSD DEFINE TRANSACTION(CAUP) DESCRIPTION(CREDIT CARD DEMO ACCOUNT UPDATE) PROGRAM(COACTUPC)), 4236 lines; `HANDLE ABEND` at line 862; pseudo-conversational RETURN at line 1015.

##### Inputs
COMMAREA COCOM01Y + program area (old/new account and customer details, change-action state - layout not captured). Map via RECEIVE MAP(LIT-THISMAP) (line 1040) in mapset COACTUP: account id and editable account fields (status, limits, balances, dates, group) and customer fields (names, address, phones, SSN, DOB, FICO, EFT, primary-holder).

##### Processing flow
1. Entry/re-entry handling and PF3 XCTL (line 956) to calling program or COMEN01C (CM00).
2. Fetch: `READ DATASET('CXACAIX ') RIDFLD(WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X)` (xref by account AIX, line 3654) -> `READ DATASET('ACCTDAT ') RIDFLD(acct id)` (3703) -> `READ DATASET('CUSTDAT ') RIDFLD(cust id)` (3753); display.
3. Edit changed fields (large set of field-level edits - not traced), ask confirmation.
4. Save: `READ FILE('ACCTDAT ') UPDATE` (3894), `READ FILE('CUSTDAT ') UPDATE` (3921), change detection against old values, `REWRITE FILE('ACCTDAT ')` (4066) and `REWRITE FILE('CUSTDAT ')` (4086).
5. SEND MAP (3594), RETURN TRANSID CAUP; abend path SEND + HANDLE ABEND CANCEL + ABEND (4211-4222).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S[CAUP COACTUPC] --> K{state}
  K -->|PF3| X[XCTL caller or COMEN01C]
  K -->|fetch| R[READ CXACAIX -> READ ACCTDAT -> READ CUSTDAT]
  K -->|edit| E[field edits; confirm]
  K -->|save| W[READ UPDATE ACCTDAT/CUSTDAT; compare; REWRITE ACCTDAT; REWRITE CUSTDAT]
  R & E & W --> SND[SEND MAP] --> RET[RETURN TRANSID CAUP]
```

##### Data
ACCTDAT (ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS, CVACT01Y 300 bytes), CUSTDAT (CUSTDATA.VSAM.KSDS, CVCUS01Y 500 bytes), CXACAIX (CARDXREF.VSAM.AIX.PATH, CVACT03Y 50 bytes, keyed by account id). Updates to account and customer masters.

##### Outputs & side effects
Account and customer records rewritten in one task (two REWRITEs, no explicit compensation between them observed).

##### External calls
XCTL to caller/COMEN01C; CICS ABEND. Static calls/copybook paragraphs (e.g. date validation) flagged by the scanner were not resolved.

##### Migration notes
- LOW confidence: only the CICS I/O skeleton (line numbers above) and literals were read. All field edits (formats, ranges, phone/SSN/ZIP/state validations, date checks), the state machine, confirmation logic, error messages, and the program COMMAREA layout remain UNTRACED and must be documented from COACTUPC.cbl.
- Two-file update (account then customer) in one CICS unit of work: if the customer REWRITE fails after account REWRITE, rollback depends on CICS task-end/syncpoint behaviour - verify.
recommendation: Needs full trace of edits, state machine and messages.

title: CBIMPORT export-file split into normalized master files
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `CBIMPORT` (app/jcl/CBIMPORT.jcl) single step `STEP01 EXEC PGM=CBIMPORT` (STEPLIB AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB); program paragraph 0000-MAIN-PROCESSING.

##### Inputs
`EXPFILE` -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.EXPORT.DATA (KSDS written by CBEXPORT), INDEXED SEQUENTIAL by EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM, read INTO CVEXPORT EXPORT-RECORD (500 bytes; layout in the CBEXPORT flow: type X1, ts X26, seq 9(9) COMP, branch X4, region X5, 460-byte typed payload with COMP/COMP-3 fields).

##### Processing flow
1. 1000-INITIALIZE: WS-IMPORT-DATE 'YYYY-MM-DD', WS-IMPORT-TIME 'HH:MM:SS' from FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE; 1100-OPEN-FILES: EXPFILE INPUT, CUSTOUT, ACCTOUT, XREFOUT, TRNXOUT, CARDOUT, ERROUT OUTPUT; any non-'00' -> 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM.
2. 2000-PROCESS-EXPORT-FILE: read loop until '10'; WS-TOTAL-RECORDS-READ+1; 2200-PROCESS-RECORD-BY-TYPE EVALUATE EXPORT-REC-TYPE: 'C' -> 2300 (EXP-CUST-* to CUSTOMER-RECORD, WRITE), 'A' -> 2400 (ACCOUNT-RECORD), 'X' -> 2500 (CARD-XREF-RECORD), 'T' -> 2600 (TRAN-RECORD), 'D' -> 2650 (CARD-RECORD), OTHER -> 2700-PROCESS-UNKNOWN-RECORD (count, build WS-ERROR-RECORD, 2750-WRITE-ERROR). Write failures on data outputs abend; failure writing error record only displays.
3. 3000-VALIDATE-IMPORT: only DISPLAYs 'Import validation completed' / 'No validation errors detected' (no validation performed).
4. 4000-FINALIZE: close all, display counters.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J[CBIMPORT.jcl STEP01] --> I[1000-INITIALIZE + 1100-OPEN-FILES]
  I --> R[2100-READ-EXPORT-RECORD]
  R -->|EOF 10| V[3000-VALIDATE-IMPORT displays only] --> F[4000-FINALIZE]
  R -->|00| E{EXPORT-REC-TYPE}
  E -->|C| C[2300 CUSTOUT]
  E -->|A| A[2400 ACCTOUT]
  E -->|X| X[2500 XREFOUT]
  E -->|T| T[2600 TRNXOUT]
  E -->|D| D[2650 CARDOUT]
  E -->|other| U[2700 + 2750-WRITE-ERROR ERROUT]
  C & A & X & T & D & U --> R
  I -->|error| AB[9999-ABEND-PROGRAM CEE3ABD]
```

##### Data
Outputs (JCL DD -> DSN, DISP=(NEW,CATLG,DELETE)): CUSTOUT -> CUSTDATA.IMPORT FB 500 (CVCUS01Y); ACCTOUT -> ACCTDATA.IMPORT FB 300 (CVACT01Y); XREFOUT -> CARDXREF.IMPORT FB 50 (CVACT03Y); TRNXOUT -> TRANSACT.IMPORT FB 350 (CVTRA05Y); CARDOUT (FB 150, CVACT02Y) - NO DD in CBIMPORT.jcl; ERROUT -> IMPORT.ERRORS FB 132: ERR-TIMESTAMP X26 (FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE raw 21 chars), '|', ERR-RECORD-TYPE X1, '|', ERR-SEQUENCE 9(7), '|', ERR-MESSAGE X50 ('Unknown record type encountered'), 43 spaces.

##### Outputs & side effects
Five normalized sequential files plus error file; SYSOUT counts. COMP/COMP-3 export fields are converted back to the display/zoned layouts of the target copybooks via MOVE.

##### External calls
`CEE3ABD` (no parameters) on errors.

##### Migration notes
- CBIMPORT.jcl defines no CARDOUT DD, so OPEN OUTPUT CARD-OUTPUT fails (non-'00') and the program abends before processing, as written; card records cannot be imported with the shipped JCL.
- ERR-SEQUENCE 9(7) truncates the 9-digit sequence number (high-order digits lost).
- 3000-VALIDATE-IMPORT is a no-op that always reports success.
- Error-file write failure is non-fatal while data writes are fatal (asymmetry).
- No dedup/key checks; output order is export order (sequence number), with types interleaved per CBEXPORT order.
recommendation: Fully documented. CBIMPORT.jcl lacks a CARDOUT DD; customer must confirm intended DSN.
note: Duplicate of sfind-5749e63024e546c398ee8c10b5d64b29 (CBIMPORT export-file split into master-layout files); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CU00 / COUSR00C user list screen with paging
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CU00` -> program `COUSR00C` (CSD), reached from admin menu COADM01C via XCTL. Pseudo-conversational RETURN TRANSID('CU00') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA).

##### Inputs
- COMMAREA COCOM01Y + CDEMO-CU00-INFO: USRID-FIRST X8, USRID-LAST X8, PAGE-NUM 9(8), NEXT-PAGE-FLG X1, USR-SEL-FLG X1, USR-SELECTED X8.
- Map COUSR0A / mapset COUSR00: USRIDINI (start-from user id), 10 rows each SEL00nnI (selection char), USRIDnnI, FNAMEnnI, LNAMEnnI, UTYPEnnI; PAGENUMI.

##### Processing flow
1. Init flags (ERR off, EOF off, NEXT-PAGE-NO, SEND-ERASE-YES). EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C.
2. First entry: set re-enter, clear map, PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, SEND-USRLST-SCREEN. Re-entry: RECEIVE; ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL 'COADM01C'; PF7 -> PROCESS-PF7-KEY; PF8 -> PROCESS-PF8-KEY; other -> invalid key message + send.
3. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: first non-blank SEL0001..SEL0010 wins -> USR-SEL-FLG and USR-SELECTED = that row's user id; none -> both spaces. If both set: 'U'/'u' -> XCTL 'COUSR02C'; 'D'/'d' -> XCTL 'COUSR03C' (FROM=CU00/COUSR00C, context 0); other -> 'Invalid selection. Valid values are U and D'. Then SEC-USR-ID = USRIDINI or LOW-VALUES; PAGE-NUM=0; PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD; clear USRIDINO.
4. PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD: STARTBR USRSEC RIDFLD(SEC-USR-ID) (NOTFND -> EOF + 'You are at the top of the page...' + send; other -> error). If EIBAID not ENTER/PF7/PF3, one READNEXT to skip the current last key. Clear 10 rows; READNEXT up to 10 records into rows (row 1 -> USRID-FIRST, row 10 -> USRID-LAST). If more: PAGE-NUM+1 and one look-ahead READNEXT sets NEXT-PAGE-YES/NO; else NEXT-PAGE-NO and PAGE-NUM+1 only if at least 1 row. ENDBR; SEND. READNEXT ENDFILE -> EOF + 'You have reached the bottom of the page...' + send.
5. PF7: key = USRID-FIRST or LOW-VALUES; NEXT-PAGE-YES; if PAGE-NUM > 1 PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD (STARTBR, READPREV skip unless ENTER/PF8, fill rows 10 down to 1 with READPREV, one extra READPREV then PAGE-NUM-1 or 1, ENDBR, send) else 'You are already at the top of the page...' without ERASE.
6. PF8: key = USRID-LAST or HIGH-VALUES; if NEXT-PAGE-YES forward else 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' without ERASE. NOTE: NEXT-PAGE-NO is set at the start of every task (MAIN-PARA) and the COMMAREA flag is CDEMO-CU00-NEXT-PAGE-FLG, so the 88 tested is the COMMAREA one after the MOVE of DFHCOMMAREA - the initial SET happens before the COMMAREA copy and is overwritten.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S[CU00 COUSR00C MAIN-PARA] --> A{EIBCALEN=0}
  A -->|yes| X0[XCTL COSGN00C]
  A -->|no| B{REENTER}
  B -->|no| E[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY]
  B -->|yes| K{EIBAID}
  K -->|ENTER| E
  K -->|PF3| X3[XCTL COADM01C]
  K -->|PF7| P7[PROCESS-PF7-KEY -> PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD STARTBR/READPREV]
  K -->|PF8| P8[PROCESS-PF8-KEY -> PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD STARTBR/READNEXT]
  E --> SEL{row selection}
  SEL -->|U| XU[XCTL COUSR02C]
  SEL -->|D| XD[XCTL COUSR03C]
  SEL -->|none/other| F[PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD]
  F & P7 & P8 --> SND[SEND-USRLST-SCREEN] --> RET[RETURN TRANSID CU00]
```

##### Data
CICS file USRSEC (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS), SEC-USER-DATA 80 bytes (ID X8 key, FNAME X20, LNAME X20, PWD X8, TYPE X1, FILLER X23); browse only (STARTBR/READNEXT/READPREV/ENDBR).

##### Outputs & side effects
List screen of up to 10 users (id, first name, last name, type; password not shown) with page number; selection forwarded through COMMAREA.

##### External calls
XCTL COUSR02C (update), COUSR03C (delete - not in this batch), COADM01C, COSGN00C with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA.

##### Migration notes
- Selection precedence is row order; only the first marked row is honored.
- STARTBR is GTEQ on typed id; paging uses first/last keys stored in COMMAREA (keyset pagination), PF8 skips one record on restart to avoid duplicating the last row.
- Multiple SENDs possible in one task (error sends inside browse paragraphs followed by the final send).
- Page number is approximate (resets to 0 on ENTER; backward sets to 1 when it cannot decrement).
recommendation: COUSR03C (delete target) is outside this batch.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/COUSR00C.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-d50bd2feda1a4076af85c42fee8e0bf5, sfind-5ad2b5097a6a439a8347e7b72ae2c55e.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- Lookahead read determines NEXT-PAGE; PF8 at end shows message without erase (SEND-ERASE-NO).
- First non-blank selection wins; later selections are ignored silently.
- Invalid selection message is set but the page is still re-read and redisplayed.
- Paging is key-based (first/last ids in commarea), not offset based; records inserted/deleted between screens shift pages.
- Passwords are never displayed here.


End-to-end: XCTLed by COADM01C via the COADM02Y option table (admin menu). Upstream findings: sfind-e0898a948b0c4184bdd559c110c475d8.

title: CARDFILE / CUSTFILE VSAM master rebuild jobs (IDCAMS + CEMT)
description:
##### Entry point
Operator batch jobs `CARDFILE` (app/jcl/CARDFILE.jcl) and `CUSTFILE` (app/jcl/CUSTFILE.jcl) that (re)build VSAM masters from flat files while CICS region CICSAWSA is up.

##### Inputs
- CARDFILE: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDDATA.PS (DD CARDDATA, 150-byte CVACT02Y card records).
- CUSTFILE: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CUSTDATA.PS (DD CUSTDATA, 500-byte CVCUS01Y customer records).

##### Processing flow
CARDFILE steps in order: CLCIFIL `PGM=SDSF` issues `/F CICSAWSA,'CEMT SET FIL(CARDDAT ) CLO'` and `FIL(CARDAIX ) CLO`; STEP05 IDCAMS DELETE CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS and CARDDATA.VSAM.AIX (`IF MAXCC LE 08 THEN SET MAXCC = 0` so not-found is ignored); STEP10 IDCAMS DEFINE CLUSTER CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS KEYS(16 0) RECORDSIZE(150 150) SHAREOPTIONS(2 3) INDEXED (.DATA/.INDEX components); STEP15 IDCAMS REPRO INFILE(CARDDATA) OUTFILE(CARDVSAM -> KSDS); STEP40 DEFINE ALTERNATEINDEX CARDDATA.VSAM.AIX RELATE(KSDS) KEYS(11 16) (CARD-ACCT-ID) NONUNIQUEKEY UPGRADE RECORDSIZE(150,150); STEP50 DEFINE PATH CARDDATA.VSAM.AIX.PATH PATHENTRY(AIX); STEP60 BLDINDEX INDATASET(KSDS) OUTDATASET(AIX); OPCIFIL SDSF `CEMT SET FIL(CARDDAT ) OPE` and `FIL(CARDAIX ) OPE`.
CUSTFILE steps: CLCIFIL CEMT close FIL(CUSTDAT); STEP05 DELETE CUSTDATA.VSAM.KSDS (MAXCC reset); STEP10 DEFINE CLUSTER CUSTDATA.VSAM.KSDS KEYS(9 0) RECORDSIZE(500 500) SHAREOPTIONS(2 3) INDEXED; STEP15 REPRO INFILE(CUSTDATA) OUTFILE(CUSTVSAM); OPCIFIL CEMT open FIL(CUSTDAT).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CLCIFIL SDSF CEMT SET FIL CLO] --> B[STEP05 IDCAMS DELETE MAXCC<=8 -> 0]
  B --> C[STEP10 DEFINE CLUSTER]
  C --> D[STEP15 REPRO PS -> KSDS]
  D -->|CARDFILE only| E[STEP40 DEFINE AIX KEYS 11 16 NONUNIQUE] --> F[STEP50 DEFINE PATH] --> G[STEP60 BLDINDEX]
  G --> H[OPCIFIL SDSF CEMT SET FIL OPE]
  D -->|CUSTFILE| H
```

##### Data
Writes (replaces) CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS + AIX + PATH (card key = card number 16 bytes at offset 0; AIX = account id 11 bytes at offset 16) and CUSTDATA.VSAM.KSDS (key = customer id 9 bytes at offset 0).

##### Outputs & side effects
Destructive rebuild of the online master files; CICS files CARDDAT/CARDAIX/CUSTDAT closed and reopened through console commands. SYSPRINT IDCAMS listings.

##### External calls
SDSF console MODIFY to CICS region CICSAWSA running CEMT; IDCAMS; no application programs.

##### Migration notes
- No COND codes between steps: if DEFINE or REPRO fails, later steps still run and OPCIFIL reopens CICS files on a broken/empty dataset.
- DELETE errors up to RC 8 are suppressed so first-time runs work.
- REPRO requires input sorted by key (card number / customer id); duplicates or out-of-order records fail REPRO.
- The card AIX is non-unique (many cards per account) and is what online programs (CARDAIX) and batch xref use to look up cards by account.
- Region name CICSAWSA and CICS file names (CARDDAT, CARDAIX, CUSTDAT) are environment-specific and must match CARDDEMO.CSD.
recommendation: Fully documented.
note:
End-to-end: CARDFILE and CUSTFILE are submitted by remote_refresh.sh and run_full_batch.sh master-data refresh. Upstream findings: sfind-89eccdc975c54f8c8f058e029a06ca5f, sfind-574c7fefe140460688d7131108eb4d55.
