title: INTCALC / CBACT04C monthly interest calculation and account balance posting
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `INTCALC` (app/jcl/INTCALC.jcl) step `STEP15 EXEC PGM=CBACT04C,PARM='2022071800'`. Batch program CBACT04C, `PROCEDURE DIVISION USING EXTERNAL-PARMS` (LINKAGE: `PARM-LENGTH PIC S9(04) COMP`, `PARM-DATE PIC X(10)`).

##### Inputs
- JCL PARM (10 chars, e.g. `2022071800`) -> PARM-DATE; used only as TRAN-ID prefix.
- `TCATBALF` DD -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.VSAM.KSDS, INDEXED, SEQUENTIAL, key FD-TRAN-CAT-KEY. Layout CVTRA01Y TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD (50 bytes): TRANCAT-ACCT-ID 9(11), TRANCAT-TYPE-CD X(2), TRANCAT-CD 9(4), TRAN-CAT-BAL S9(9)V99 (zoned, signed), FILLER X(22).
- `XREFFILE` DD -> CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS, INDEXED RANDOM, primary key FD-XREF-CARD-NUM, ALTERNATE RECORD KEY FD-XREF-ACCT-ID (read via alternate key; JCL also supplies `XREFFIL1` = CARDXREF.VSAM.AIX.PATH). Layout CVACT03Y (50): XREF-CARD-NUM X(16), XREF-CUST-ID 9(9), XREF-ACCT-ID 9(11), FILLER X(14).
- `ACCTFILE` DD -> ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS, INDEXED RANDOM, key FD-ACCT-ID, opened I-O. Layout CVACT01Y (300): ACCT-ID 9(11), ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS X, ACCT-CURR-BAL S9(10)V99, ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, ACCT-OPEN-DATE X(10), ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE X(10), ACCT-REISSUE-DATE X(10), ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT S9(10)V99, ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT S9(10)V99, ACCT-ADDR-ZIP X(10), ACCT-GROUP-ID X(10), FILLER X(178).
- `DISCGRP` DD -> DISCGRP.VSAM.KSDS, INDEXED RANDOM, key FD-DISCGRP-KEY. Layout CVTRA02Y (50): DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID X(10), DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD X(2), DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD 9(4), DIS-INT-RATE S9(4)V99, FILLER X(28).

##### Processing flow
1. Open TCATBALF (INPUT), XREFFILE (INPUT), DISCGRP (INPUT), ACCTFILE (I-O), TRANSACT (OUTPUT). Any status != '00' -> display, 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM.
2. Loop until END-OF-FILE='Y': 1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT reads next category-balance record ('10' -> EOF; other non-'00' -> abend). For each record: ADD 1 to WS-RECORD-COUNT, DISPLAY record.
3. Control break on account: if TRANCAT-ACCT-ID != WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM: if not first record -> 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT for the previous account; reset WS-TOTAL-INT=0; save acct; read ACCOUNT-FILE by FD-ACCT-ID (1100-GET-ACCT-DATA); read XREF-FILE by alternate key FD-XREF-ACCT-ID (1110-GET-XREF-DATA). INVALID KEY only displays 'ACCOUNT NOT FOUND' but the subsequent status check (!='00') abends.
4. Build DISCGRP key = ACCT-GROUP-ID + TRANCAT-TYPE-CD + TRANCAT-CD; 1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE. Status '23' (not found) -> key group-id replaced by 'DEFAULT' and 1200-A-GET-DEFAULT-INT-RATE re-reads (must be '00' else abend). Other statuses abend.
5. If DIS-INT-RATE != 0: 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST: `WS-MONTHLY-INT = (TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200` (no ROUNDED -> truncated to 2 decimals), ADD to WS-TOTAL-INT; 1300-B-WRITE-TX writes an interest transaction; then 1400-COMPUTE-FEES (empty stub, EXIT only).
6. At EOF the loop's ELSE branch performs 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT for the last account.
7. 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT: ACCT-CURR-BAL += WS-TOTAL-INT; ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT=0; ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT=0; REWRITE (non-'00' -> abend).
8. Close all 5 files (abend on error); GOBACK.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[INTCALC STEP15 PARM date] --> B[Open TCATBALF XREFFILE DISCGRP ACCTFILE I-O TRANSACT OUTPUT]
  B --> C[1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT]
  C -->|EOF| U2[1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT last acct] --> Z[9000-9400 close; GOBACK]
  C -->|record| D{TRANCAT-ACCT-ID != WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM}
  D -->|yes, not first| U[1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT prev acct REWRITE]
  U --> G[1100-GET-ACCT-DATA; 1110-GET-XREF-DATA by AIX acct id]
  D -->|yes, first| G
  D -->|no| R
  G --> R[1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE DISCGRP]
  R -->|status 23| R2[1200-A-GET-DEFAULT-INT-RATE group 'DEFAULT']
  R -->|00| Q{DIS-INT-RATE != 0}
  R2 --> Q
  Q -->|yes| I[1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST bal*rate/1200; 1300-B-WRITE-TX; 1400-COMPUTE-FEES stub]
  Q -->|no| C
  I --> C
  R -->|other| X[9999-ABEND-PROGRAM CEE3ABD 999]
```

##### Data
Read: TCATBALF (seq), ACCTFILE (random), XREFFILE (random via alternate key), DISCGRP (random). Updated: ACCTFILE REWRITE (ACCT-CURR-BAL, ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT, ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT). Written: `TRANSACT` DD -> new GDG AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.SYSTRAN(+1), RECFM=F LRECL=350, CVTRA05Y TRAN-RECORD: TRAN-ID X(16), TRAN-TYPE-CD X(2), TRAN-CAT-CD 9(4), TRAN-SOURCE X(10), TRAN-DESC X(100), TRAN-AMT S9(9)V99, TRAN-MERCHANT-ID 9(9), TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME X(50), TRAN-MERCHANT-CITY X(50), TRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP X(10), TRAN-CARD-NUM X(16), TRAN-ORIG-TS X(26), TRAN-PROC-TS X(26), FILLER X(20).

##### Outputs & side effects
Per interest-bearing category record one TRAN-RECORD: TRAN-ID = PARM-DATE(10) || WS-TRANID-SUFFIX 9(6) (running counter across whole run), TYPE '01', CAT '05', SOURCE 'System', DESC 'Int. for a/c ' || ACCT-ID, AMT = WS-MONTHLY-INT, merchant id 0 / name/city/zip spaces, CARD-NUM = XREF-CARD-NUM, ORIG-TS = PROC-TS = Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP (`YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.nn0000` from FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE, hundredths into DB2-MIL + '0000'). Account balances increased by total monthly interest and cycle credit/debit zeroed. SYSOUT displays every category record.

##### External calls
`CEE3ABD` (LE abend) USING ABCODE=999, TIMING=0 on any I/O error. No other calls.

##### Migration notes
- Formula: monthly interest = TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE / 1200, result truncated (no ROUNDED) into S9(9)V99; use BigDecimal with RoundingMode.DOWN. Negative balances produce negative interest.
- Cycle credit/debit are zeroed for EVERY account that has at least one TCATBAL record, even if rate=0 (no interest) - 1050 runs regardless.
- Default-group fallback is triggered only by status '23'; the DEFAULT key keeps the original type/category codes.
- WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM is X(11) compared to 9(11) TRANCAT-ACCT-ID (alphanumeric compare of digits).
- If the TCATBAL file is empty the EOF branch still calls 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT with no account read -> REWRITE without prior READ (likely error status -> abend).
- XREF read by alternate key returns the first card for the account (AIX non-unique); that card number is stamped on the interest transaction.
- 1400-COMPUTE-FEES is an empty stub (no fees computed).
- TRAN-ID uniqueness depends on PARM-DATE being unique per run; the JCL hardcodes `2022071800`.
- Requires category file sorted by account (KSDS key order guarantees this).
recommendation: Fully documented. Confirm with business whether the cycle credit/debit zeroing for zero-rate accounts and the truncation (no rounding) must be preserved.
note: Duplicate of sfind-d232d1a1035546fe9e6bed2a7c05caab (INTCALC / CBACT04C); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CT01 / COTRN01C transaction view screen
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CT01` -> program `COTRN01C` (CARDDEMO.CSD: DEFINE TRANSACTION(CT01) PROGRAM(COTRN01C)); reached by XCTL from COTRN00C (transaction list) or menu with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA. Pseudo-conversational: every exit is `EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CT01') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)` unless an XCTL happens first.

##### Inputs
- DFHCOMMAREA (EIBCALEN bytes) -> CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (COCOM01Y): FROM-TRANID X4, FROM-PROGRAM X8, TO-TRANID X4, TO-PROGRAM X8, USER-ID X8, USER-TYPE X1 ('A'/'U'), PGM-CONTEXT 9(1) (0 enter, 1 re-enter), CUST-ID 9(9), CUST F/M/L NAME X25 each, ACCT-ID 9(11), ACCT-STATUS X1, CARD-NUM 9(16), LAST-MAP X7, LAST-MAPSET X7; followed by program extension CDEMO-CT01-INFO: TRNID-FIRST X16, TRNID-LAST X16, PAGE-NUM 9(8), NEXT-PAGE-FLG X1, TRN-SEL-FLG X1, TRN-SELECTED X16.
- Map COTRN1A / mapset COTRN01 (RECEIVE INTO COTRN1AI): input field TRNIDINI (transaction id); EIBAID key.

##### Processing flow
1. Reset error flag/message. EIBCALEN=0 -> TO-PROGRAM 'COSGN00C', RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN (XCTL to sign-on).
2. First entry (PGM-CONTEXT != 1): set re-enter, clear map, cursor on TRNIDIN; if CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED non-blank, copy to TRNIDINI and PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN.
3. Re-entry: RECEIVE map; EVALUATE EIBAID: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL to CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM (or 'COMEN01C' if blank); PF4 -> CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN (blank all fields, send); PF5 -> XCTL 'COTRN00C'; other -> message CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY, send.
4. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: blank id -> 'Tran ID can NOT be empty...' + send. Else blank output fields, TRAN-ID = TRNIDINI, READ-TRANSACT-FILE: `EXEC CICS READ DATASET('TRANSACT') INTO(TRAN-RECORD) RIDFLD(TRAN-ID) KEYLENGTH(16) UPDATE`. NORMAL -> move TRAN-ID, CARD-NUM, TYPE-CD, CAT-CD, SOURCE, AMT (edited +99999999.99), DESC, ORIG-TS, PROC-TS, MERCHANT ID/NAME/CITY/ZIP to the map, send. NOTFND -> 'Transaction ID NOT found...'. OTHER -> DISPLAY RESP/REAS, 'Unable to lookup Transaction...'.
5. RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN: default TO-PROGRAM 'COSGN00C' if blank; FROM-TRANID='CT01', FROM-PROGRAM='COTRN01C', PGM-CONTEXT=0; XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA).
6. SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO (titles from COTTL01Y, tran/pgm names, date MM/DD/YY and time HH:MM:SS from FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE), ERRMSG, `SEND MAP('COTRN1A') MAPSET('COTRN01') FROM(COTRN1AO) ERASE CURSOR`.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S[CT01 COTRN01C MAIN-PARA] --> A{EIBCALEN = 0}
  A -->|yes| X0[XCTL COSGN00C]
  A -->|no| B{CDEMO-PGM-REENTER}
  B -->|no| C[preload CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY] --> SND[SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN]
  B -->|yes| R[RECEIVE-TRNVIEW-SCREEN] --> K{EIBAID}
  K -->|ENTER| P[PROCESS-ENTER-KEY READ TRANSACT UPDATE] --> SND
  K -->|PF3| X3[XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C]
  K -->|PF4| CL[CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN] --> SND
  K -->|PF5| X5[XCTL COTRN00C]
  K -->|other| SND
  SND --> RET[RETURN TRANSID CT01 COMMAREA]
```

##### Data
CICS file TRANSACT -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS, key TRAN-ID X(16), CVTRA05Y 350-byte TRAN-RECORD (see layout: ID X16, TYPE X2, CAT 9(4), SOURCE X10, DESC X100, AMT S9(9)V99, MERCHANT-ID 9(9), NAME X50, CITY X50, ZIP X10, CARD-NUM X16, ORIG-TS X26, PROC-TS X26, FILLER X20). Read only (no REWRITE).

##### Outputs & side effects
BMS map COTRN1A sent; COMMAREA returned to CT01. The READ ... UPDATE obtains a record lock held until task end (RETURN), although no update is done.

##### External calls
CICS XCTL to COSGN00C / COMEN01C / COTRN00C / CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (FROM fields set to CT01/COTRN01C, context 0). No LINK/CALL.

##### Migration notes
- View-only screen but uses READ UPDATE (unnecessary lock) - re-implement as plain read.
- Only first EIBCALEN bytes of COMMAREA are copied; a caller passing a shorter COMMAREA leaves CT01 extension fields with their WORKING-STORAGE initial values.
- PROCESS-ENTER-KEY can SEND twice? No: on error it sends inside the EVALUATE and then skips, on success sends once; on READ error the read paragraph sends and the success block is skipped by ERR-FLG.
- Amount displayed with explicit sign edit +99999999.99 (drops 9th integer digit? TRAN-AMT S9(9)V99 into 8 integer positions -> high-order digit truncated).
- PF5 always goes to COTRN00C; PF3 goes back to caller.
recommendation: Fully documented.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/COTRN01C.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-0d0ebf802cd74af38c27b64b81404134.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- `WS-TRAN-AMT PIC +99999999.99` shows only 8 integer digits of an `S9(9)V99` amount: the leading digit is silently truncated for amounts ≥ 100,000,000.


End-to-end: XCTLed by COMEN01C via the COMEN02Y option table (main menu). Also XCTLed from COTRN00C on row selection. Upstream findings: sfind-6417f0efb3484b28b9b140c6d330e02d, sfind-9c73dddc77ed4e55904ad2813f757eb6.

title: CCUP / COCRDUPC credit card update screen
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CCUP` -> program `COCRDUPC` (CSD DEFINE TRANSACTION(CCUP) PROGRAM(COCRDUPC)); entered from card list COCRDLIC (CCLI, selection 'U') or main menu COMEN01C (CM00). Paragraph 0000-MAIN with `EXEC CICS HANDLE ABEND` -> ABEND-ROUTINE. Pseudo-conversational COMMON-RETURN: `EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CCUP') COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)` where WS-COMMAREA = CARDDEMO-COMMAREA followed by WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA.

##### Inputs
- COMMAREA: CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (COCOM01Y; uses CDEMO-ACCT-ID 9(11), CDEMO-CARD-NUM 9(16), FROM-PROGRAM/TRANID, LAST-MAPSET) + program area: CCUP-CHANGE-ACTION flag (' '/LOW = details not fetched, 'S' show details, 'E' changes not ok, 'N' ok not confirmed, 'C' okayed & done, 'L' lock error, 'F' update failed), CCUP-OLD-DETAILS (acct id, card id, CVV, name, exp year/mon/day, status) and CCUP-NEW-DETAILS (same).
- Map CCRDUPA / mapset COCRDUP: account id (11), card number (16), embossed name, status Y/N, expiry month, expiry year (day is protected/carried). PF keys mapped via YYYY-STORE-PFKEY (copybook CSSTRPFY).

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 or (from COMEN01C and not re-enter) -> INITIALIZE commareas, PGM-ENTER, details-not-fetched. Else copy both commarea parts.
2. Valid keys: ENTER, PF3, PF5 only when 'N' (ok-not-confirmed), PF12 only when details fetched; any other key treated as ENTER.
3. EVALUATE: (a) PF3, or done/failed and came from list mapset COCRDLI -> TO-TRANID/PROGRAM = FROM values or CM00/COMEN01C; if from list zero acct/card in COMMAREA; set user type 'U', PGM-ENTER, LAST-MAPSET/MAP; `SYNCPOINT`; `XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)`. (b) PGM-ENTER from COCRDLIC, or PF12 from COCRDLIC -> filters valid, 9000-READ-DATA with COMMAREA acct/card, 'S', send. (c) not fetched & enter, or fresh from menu -> send blank search screen. (d) done or failed -> reset commarea keys, send fresh search screen. (e) OTHER -> 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS (1100-RECEIVE-MAP, 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS), 2000-DECIDE-ACTION, 3000-SEND-MAP.
4. Edits: 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT (blank/zero -> prompt; not numeric -> 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER'); 1220-EDIT-CARD (same, 16 digits); when details are shown: 1230-EDIT-NAME (non-blank, letters and spaces only - INSPECT CONVERTING alphabet to spaces then TRIM length = 0); 1240-EDIT-CARDSTATUS (must be 'Y' or 'N'); 1250-EDIT-EXPIRY-MON (VALID-MONTH 1-12); 1260-EDIT-EXPIRY-YEAR (VALID-YEAR range from 88 on CARD-YEAR-CHECK); first error message only (WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF guard); no-change detection compares new vs old (uppercase).
5. 2000-DECIDE-ACTION: not fetched / PF12 -> if filters valid 9000-READ-DATA and 'S'; 'S' -> if errors or no changes stay, else 'N' (ask PF5 confirm); 'E' -> stay; 'N' + PF5 -> 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING then 'L' (could not lock), 'F' (rewrite failed), 'S' (record changed by someone else - old values refreshed), else 'C'; 'N' without PF5 -> stay; 'C' -> 'S' and if no FROM-TRANID zero COMMAREA keys; OTHER -> ABEND-ROUTINE code '0001' 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO'.
6. 9000-READ-DATA -> 9100-GETCARD-BYACCTCARD: `EXEC CICS READ FILE('CARDDAT ') RIDFLD(WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) KEYLENGTH(16) INTO(CARD-RECORD)`; NORMAL -> FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT, copy CVV, name uppercased, expiry YYYY/MM/DD from CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE(1:4),(6:2),(9:2), status into OLD details; NOTFND / other -> error message with file name 'CARDDAT', RESP, RESP2.
7. 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING: `READ FILE('CARDDAT ') UPDATE RIDFLD(card num)`; not NORMAL -> COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE. 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC compares current record (name uppercased) to OLD; difference -> DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE (refresh OLD, no write). Else build CARD-UPDATE-RECORD: NUM=new card id, ACCT-ID=CC-ACCT-ID-N, CVV=new CVV (via X->N redefinition), EMBOSSED-NAME=new name, EXPIRAION-DATE = year '-' month '-' day, ACTIVE-STATUS=new status; `REWRITE FILE('CARDDAT ') FROM(CARD-UPDATE-RECORD)`; failure -> LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED.
8. ABEND-ROUTINE: SEND ABEND-DATA (culprit, code, reason, msg) ERASE NOHANDLE, HANDLE ABEND CANCEL, `EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999')`.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S[CCUP COCRDUPC 0000-MAIN] --> K{EVALUATE}
  K -->|PF3 or done/failed from COCRDLI| X[SYNCPOINT; XCTL FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C]
  K -->|entered from COCRDLIC / PF12| R[9000-READ-DATA 9100-GETCARD-BYACCTCARD READ CARDDAT] --> SND
  K -->|fresh| SND[3000-SEND-MAP CCRDUPA]
  K -->|other| P[1100-RECEIVE-MAP; 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS] --> D[2000-DECIDE-ACTION]
  D -->|N + PF5| W[9200-WRITE-PROCESSING READ UPDATE; 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC; REWRITE CARDDAT]
  D -->|other states| SND
  W --> SND
  D -->|unexpected| AB[ABEND-ROUTINE ABEND 9999]
  SND --> RET[COMMON-RETURN RETURN TRANSID CCUP]
```

##### Data
CICS file CARDDAT -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS (key card number X16). CVACT02Y CARD-RECORD 150 bytes: CARD-NUM X16, CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11), CARD-CVV-CD 9(3), CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME X50, CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X10 (YYYY-MM-DD), CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS X1, FILLER X59. CARD-UPDATE-RECORD is the same layout (local). CARDAIX ('CARDAIX ') literal declared but not used for reads in this program.

##### Outputs & side effects
Card record rewritten (name, status, expiry month/year; card number/account/CVV re-written from carried values). SYNCPOINT before leaving. Screen messages incl. confirmation prompt and success.

##### External calls
CICS XCTL to COMEN01C or calling program (COCRDLIC) with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; HANDLE ABEND / ABEND '9999'. Copybook-inlined paragraph YYYY-STORE-PFKEY (CSSTRPFY) maps EIBAID to CCARD-AID-* flags (not separately read here).

##### Migration notes
- Optimistic concurrency: values shown are re-compared at save time (name compared uppercased); mismatch silently refreshes and re-shows instead of saving.
- Embossed name is uppercased on read; saved as typed (could be lower case) - next read uppercases again.
- Expiry day is never editable; it is carried from the read record.
- Read uses only card number as key although account id is also entered; account id mismatch with the card is not checked in the read (WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID is populated but RIDFLD is card number only); the rewrite writes the entered account id into CARD-ACCT-ID.
- PF keys other than allowed are coerced to ENTER.
- Edit paragraphs 1250/1260 rely on 88-level ranges VALID-MONTH / VALID-YEAR in WORKING-STORAGE (year range not captured in this document - medium confidence).
recommendation: VALID-MONTH/VALID-YEAR 88-level ranges and CSSTRPFY PF-key mapping not captured.
note:
Consolidated document for app/cbl/COCRDUPC.cbl; merged duplicates: sfind-dbacece5fd5f43128fde94a8ed866a83, sfind-0fb90f34b41d4a5bb4a3d67f46df6ead.

Additional migration notes folded from duplicates:
- The expiry day is never edited on screen; it is carried over from the old record (CCUP-NEW-EXPDAY).
- Confirmation uses PF5, not a Y/N field (unlike COBIL00C and COTRN02C).
- Embossed name is stored as entered (case preserved) but compared uppercased.
- Expiry day is not editable; CVV is carried through unchanged.

End-to-end: XCTLed by COMEN01C via the COMEN02Y option table (main menu). Also XCTLed from COCRDLIC on selection 'U'. Upstream findings: sfind-6417f0efb3484b28b9b140c6d330e02d, sfind-8518f237530e474290d2db29136a9ff4.

title: CBEXPORT multi-file branch export to 500-byte EXPORT-RECORD
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `CBEXPORT` (app/jcl/CBEXPORT.jcl): STEP01 IDCAMS delete/define AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.EXPORT.DATA (INDEXED, KEYS(4 28), RECORDSIZE(500 500)); STEP02 `EXEC PGM=CBEXPORT` (app/cbl/CBEXPORT.cbl, paragraph 0000-MAIN-PROCESSING). Not in the signal list as program-entry but it is the export half of the branch-migration pipeline consumed by CBIMPORT.

##### Inputs
All INDEXED, SEQUENTIAL, read in key order: CUSTFILE (CVCUS01Y 500), ACCTFILE (CVACT01Y 300), XREFFILE (CVACT03Y 50), TRANSACT (CVTRA05Y 350), CARDFILE (CVACT02Y 150: CARD-NUM X16, CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11), CARD-CVV-CD 9(3), CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME X50, CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X10, CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS X1, FILLER X59).

##### Processing flow
1. 1050-GENERATE-TIMESTAMP: ACCEPT DATE YYYYMMDD / TIME; WS-FORMATTED-TIMESTAMP = 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.00'.
2. 1100-OPEN-FILES: 5 inputs + EXPFILE OUTPUT; any non-'00' -> 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM.
3. Sequential phases, each read-until-EOF ('10'), error on other non-'00': 2000 customers (type 'C'), 3000 accounts ('A'), 4000 xrefs ('X'), 5000 transactions ('T'), 5500 cards ('D'). For each record: INITIALIZE EXPORT-RECORD; REC-TYPE; TIMESTAMP; ADD 1 to WS-SEQUENCE-COUNTER -> EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM; BRANCH-ID '0001'; REGION-CODE 'NORTH'; move every source field to EXP-* fields; WRITE (non-'00' -> abend); bump per-type and total counters.
4. 6000-FINALIZE: close all, DISPLAY counts.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J[CBEXPORT STEP01 IDCAMS define EXPORT.DATA] --> P[STEP02 CBEXPORT 0000-MAIN-PROCESSING]
  P --> I[1000-INITIALIZE timestamp + open]
  I --> C[2000-EXPORT-CUSTOMERS C] --> A[3000-EXPORT-ACCOUNTS A] --> X[4000-EXPORT-XREFS X] --> T[5000-EXPORT-TRANSACTIONS T] --> D[5500-EXPORT-CARDS D] --> F[6000-FINALIZE]
  I -->|error| AB[9999-ABEND-PROGRAM CEE3ABD]
```

##### Data
Output EXPFILE (KSDS key EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM) 500-byte CVEXPORT EXPORT-RECORD: REC-TYPE X1 (off 0), TIMESTAMP X26 (off 1), SEQUENCE-NUM 9(9) COMP (4 bytes binary, off 27), BRANCH-ID X4 (off 31), REGION-CODE X5 (off 35), RECORD-DATA X460 (off 40) redefined as:
- C: EXP-CUST-ID 9(9) COMP, first/middle/last X25, 3 addr X50, state X2, country X3, zip X10, 2 phones X15, SSN 9(9), govt id X20, DOB X10, EFT X10, pri-holder X1, FICO 9(3) COMP-3, filler.
- A: ACCT-ID 9(11), status X1, CURR-BAL S9(10)V99 COMP-3, CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99 display, CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT COMP-3, open/exp/reissue dates X10, CYC-CREDIT display, CYC-DEBIT S9(10)V99 COMP (binary), zip X10, group X10.
- T: TRAN-ID X16, type X2, cat 9(4), source X10, desc X100, AMT S9(9)V99 COMP-3, MERCHANT-ID 9(9) COMP, name/city X50, zip X10, card X16, orig/proc ts X26.
- X: CARD-NUM X16, CUST-ID 9(9), ACCT-ID 9(11) COMP.
- D: CARD-NUM X16, ACCT-ID 9(11) COMP, CVV 9(3) COMP, embossed name X50, exp date X10, status X1.

##### Outputs & side effects
Single multi-record export file; SYSOUT statistics. No source updates.

##### External calls
`CEE3ABD` with no parameters on any error.

##### Migration notes
- Mixed encodings inside one record (zoned, COMP-3, binary COMP) - a cross-platform reader must decode per type; EBCDIC for text.
- KSDS defined KEYS(4 28) (offset 28) but EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM is at offset 27 (1+26); the defined key overlaps byte 3 of the seq number and the first byte of BRANCH-ID. Writes still succeed because the low-order 3 bytes + constant '0' ascend - but key definition is off by one.
- Branch '0001' / region 'NORTH' hardcoded. Sequence numbers are continuous across types in fixed order C,A,X,T,D.
- Sensitive data (SSN, CVV) exported in clear.
- No transaction-level filtering; whole files exported.
recommendation: Fully documented. Confirm KSDS KEYS(4 28) vs sequence-number offset 27.
note: Duplicate of sfind-f06fac9d5d98466b878ffde08f4dc3fc (CBEXPORT multi-record master-file export); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CR00 / CORPT00C report request screen submitting TRNRPT00 via TDQ JOBS
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CR00` -> program `CORPT00C` (CSD DEFINE TRANSACTION(CR00) PROGRAM(CORPT00C)); reached from main menu COMEN01C via XCTL. Pseudo-conversational RETURN TRANSID('CR00') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA). Its business effect is submitting batch job TRNRPT00 (proc TRANREPT -> CBTRN03C) through the internal reader.

##### Inputs
- COMMAREA COCOM01Y CARDDEMO-COMMAREA.
- Map CORPT0A / mapset CORPT00: MONTHLYI, YEARLYI, CUSTOMI (report-type selectors; first non-blank wins in that order), SDTMMI/SDTDDI/SDTYYYYI (start), EDTMMI/EDTDDI/EDTYYYYI (end), CONFIRMI (Y/N).

##### Processing flow
1. EIBCALEN=0 -> XCTL COSGN00C. First entry -> send blank screen. Re-entry: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; PF3 -> XCTL COMEN01C; other -> invalid-key message.
2. Monthly: start = current YYYY-MM-01; end = last day of current month (day=1, month+1 with year roll, then DATE-OF-INTEGER(INTEGER-OF-DATE - 1)). Yearly: YYYY-01-01 .. YYYY-12-31. Custom: each of 6 date parts must be non-blank (messages 'Start Date - Month can NOT be empty...' etc.); each part converted with NUMVAL-C into PIC 99 / 9999 and moved back; month > '12', day > '31', non-numeric -> 'Not a valid Month/Day/Year...'; then full dates validated by `CALL 'CSUTLDTC' USING CSUTLDTC-DATE X(10), CSUTLDTC-DATE-FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD', CSUTLDTC-RESULT (SEV-CD X4, MSG-NUM X4, MSG X61)`: SEV-CD '0000' ok; otherwise error unless MSG-NUM = '2513'. None selected -> 'Select a report type to print report...'.
3. SUBMIT-JOB-TO-INTRDR (Monthly/Yearly always; Custom only if no error): blank CONFIRM -> 'Please confirm to print the <name> report...'; 'N'/'n' -> clear fields, stop; other than Y/y -> '"x" is not a valid value to confirm...'. On Y: loop WS-IDX 1..1000 over JOB-LINES (80-byte lines of JOB-DATA) writing each to TDQ until a line equal to '/*EOF' or spaces/low-values (that terminating line is also written): `EXEC CICS WRITEQ TD QUEUE('JOBS') FROM(JCL-RECORD) LENGTH(80)`; failure -> 'Unable to Write TDQ (JOBS)...'.
4. Success -> clear fields, green '<Monthly|Yearly|Custom> report submitted for printing ...'.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S[CR00 CORPT00C MAIN-PARA] --> A{EIBCALEN=0}
  A -->|yes| X0[XCTL COSGN00C]
  A -->|no| K{EIBAID}
  K -->|PF3| X3[XCTL COMEN01C]
  K -->|ENTER| T{MONTHLYI / YEARLYI / CUSTOMI}
  T -->|Monthly| M[compute 1st..last day of month]
  T -->|Yearly| Y[YYYY-01-01..YYYY-12-31]
  T -->|Custom| C[validate parts; CALL CSUTLDTC x2]
  T -->|none| ERR[message]
  M & Y & C --> J[SUBMIT-JOB-TO-INTRDR confirm Y/N]
  J -->|Y| Q[WRITEQ TD JOBS per JCL line until /*EOF]
  Q --> OK[report submitted message]
  ERR & OK --> SND[SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN] --> RET[RETURN TRANSID CR00]
```

##### Data
No VSAM access (WS-TRANSACT-FILE 'TRANSACT' and CVTRA05Y are declared but unused). Generated JCL lines (80 bytes each): `//TRNRPT00 JOB 'TRAN REPORT',CLASS=A,MSGCLASS=0,`, `// NOTIFY=&SYSUID`, `//JOBLIB JCLLIB ORDER=('AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PROC')`, `//STEP10 EXEC PROC=TRANREPT`, `//STEP05R.SYMNAMES DD *` with `TRAN-CARD-NUM,263,16,ZD`, `TRAN-PROC-DT,305,10,CH`, `PARM-START-DATE,C'<start>'`, `PARM-END-DATE,C'<end>'`, `/*`, `//STEP10R.DATEPARM DD *` with line `<start> <end>` (PARM-START-DATE-2 X10, space, PARM-END-DATE-2 X10), `/*`, `/*EOF`.

##### Outputs & side effects
JCL written to extrapartition TDQ `JOBS` (CSD DEFINE TDQUEUE(JOBS) 'SUBMIT JOBS FROM CICS', routed to the internal reader) -> runs TRANREPT proc: unload/sort transactions filtered by the date range, then CBTRN03C report (see TRANREPT flow). Screen message.

##### External calls
- `CSUTLDTC` (static CALL; date validation utility, not in this batch, wraps LE CEEDAYS) - passed date/format, returns severity and message number.
- CICS WRITEQ TD JOBS; XCTL COSGN00C / COMEN01C with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA.

##### Migration notes
- Custom date validation keeps checking after the first error, issuing several SENDs in one task; last message wins.
- CSUTLDTC message 2513 is treated as valid (bypass) - preserve or document.
- Range check compares alphanumerics ('12','31'), not calendar-aware except via CSUTLDTC; start > end is not checked.
- Monthly end date relies on WS-CURDATE-N (numeric YYYYMMDD redefinition in CSDAT01Y) INTEGER-OF-DATE arithmetic.
- Monthly/Yearly paths call SUBMIT even when confirm is blank (it only prompts). The '/*EOF' sentinel line itself is written to the queue.
- Job submission via TDQ to internal reader is environment-specific; replace with a scheduler/API job trigger passing start/end dates.
recommendation: CSUTLDTC source not traced (outside batch).
note: Duplicate of sfind-47410982987d4cc78d6efd7d871e30aa (CR00 / CORPT00C); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: CCLI / COCRDLIC credit card list screen (partially traced)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction `CCLI` -> program `COCRDLIC` (CSD DEFINE TRANSACTION(CCLI) PROGRAM(COCRDLIC)), from main menu COMEN01C (CM00). Pseudo-conversational `EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CCLI') COMMAREA(...)` (line 615).

##### Inputs
COMMAREA COCOM01Y (CDEMO-ACCT-ID, CDEMO-CARD-NUM, USER-TYPE, FROM/TO program, LAST-MAPSET) plus program paging area (first/last card keys, page number, next-page flag - names not captured). Map CCRDSLA in mapset COCRDLI (LIT-THISMAPSET 'COCRDLI'): account filter, card filter, per-row selection codes. RECEIVE MAP at line 963.

##### Processing flow
1. Determine entry vs re-entry from EIBCALEN / COMMAREA; PF3 -> `XCTL` to COMEN01C (CM00) (line 402).
2. Receive & edit filters (account 11 digits, card 16 digits, optional) and row selections.
3. Row selection 'S' -> XCTL COCRDSLC (CCDL card detail, line 538); 'U' -> XCTL COCRDUPC (CCUP card update, line 566), passing CARDDEMO-COMMAREA with CDEMO-ACCT-ID / CDEMO-CARD-NUM of the selected row and LAST-MAPSET 'COCRDLI'.
4. Paging: forward = `STARTBR DATASET(LIT-CARD-FILE) RIDFLD(WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM)` + READNEXT loop (lines 1129-1258), filling up to a page of rows and one look-ahead READNEXT to set next-page; backward = STARTBR + READPREV loop (1273-1376); ENDBR. Records failing the account/card filter are skipped.
5. SEND MAP CCRDSLA (line 939); RETURN TRANSID CCLI. Unexpected-state paths SEND TEXT a message and RETURN (lines 1423-1449).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S[CCLI COCRDLIC] --> K{AID / state}
  K -->|PF3| XM[XCTL COMEN01C]
  K -->|row S| XD[XCTL COCRDSLC]
  K -->|row U| XU[XCTL COCRDUPC]
  K -->|ENTER/PF8| F[STARTBR CARDDAT; READNEXT page; ENDBR]
  K -->|PF7| B[STARTBR; READPREV page; ENDBR]
  F & B --> SND[SEND MAP CCRDSLA] --> RET[RETURN TRANSID CCLI]
  K -->|error| TXT[SEND TEXT; RETURN]
```

##### Data
CICS file CARDDAT (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS) browsed by card number (CVACT02Y 150-byte card record). CARDAIX literal declared ('CARDAIX ').

##### Outputs & side effects
Card list screen; read-only (no writes).

##### External calls
XCTL COMEN01C, COCRDSLC, COCRDUPC with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA.

##### Migration notes
- MEDIUM/LOW confidence: only the CICS command skeleton, literals and targets (lines cited) were read; the exact filter edit messages, page size, selection validation (multiple selections, invalid codes), admin-vs-user filtering, and the program-specific COMMAREA layout were NOT fully traced and must be read from COCRDLIC.cbl before re-implementation.
- Filtering is applied while browsing the full card file by primary key (not via the account AIX), so a filtered page may scan many records.
recommendation: Needs full trace: filters, page size, selection validation, COMMAREA layout.
note: Duplicate of sfind-8518f237530e474290d2db29136a9ff4 (CCLI / COCRDLIC); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: READCARD / CBACT02C and READCUST / CBCUS01C VSAM dump utilities
description:
##### Entry point
Two near-identical batch diagnostic dumps: job `READCARD` (app/jcl/READCARD.jcl) `EXEC PGM=CBACT02C` and job `READCUST` (app/jcl/READCUST.jcl) `EXEC PGM=CBCUS01C`. Both `PROCEDURE DIVISION.` with no linkage.

##### Inputs
- CBACT02C: `CARDFILE` DD -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS, INDEXED SEQUENTIAL, key FD-CARD-NUM X(16); INTO CVACT02Y CARD-RECORD (150: CARD-NUM X16, CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11), CARD-CVV-CD 9(3), CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME X50, CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X10, CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS X1, FILLER X59).
- CBCUS01C: `CUSTFILE` DD -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CUSTDATA.VSAM.KSDS, INDEXED SEQUENTIAL, key FD-CUST-ID 9(9); INTO CVCUS01Y CUSTOMER-RECORD (500: CUST-ID 9(9), FIRST/MIDDLE/LAST-NAME X25 each, ADDR-LINE-1..3 X50, STATE-CD X2, COUNTRY-CD X3, ZIP X10, PHONE-NUM-1/2 X15, SSN 9(9), GOVT-ISSUED-ID X20, DOB-YYYY-MM-DD X10, EFT-ACCOUNT-ID X10, PRI-CARD-HOLDER-IND X1, FICO-CREDIT-SCORE 9(3), FILLER X168).

##### Processing flow
1. Open file INPUT (status != '00' -> display, abend).
2. Loop until END-OF-FILE='Y': GET-NEXT READ; '00' -> APPL-RESULT 0; '10' -> 16 (EOF -> END-OF-FILE='Y'); else 12 -> display 'ERROR READING ...', display status, abend. Main loop DISPLAYs the record when not EOF.
3. Close (abend on error); GOBACK.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J[READCARD: CBACT02C / READCUST: CBCUS01C] --> O[0000-*-OPEN]
  O --> R[1000-*-GET-NEXT READ]
  R -->|00| D[DISPLAY record] --> R
  R -->|10| C[9000-*-CLOSE GOBACK]
  R -->|other| X[9999-ABEND-PROGRAM / Z-ABEND-PROGRAM CEE3ABD]
```

##### Data
Read-only sequential scan of card or customer KSDS. No writes.

##### Outputs & side effects
SYSOUT only: each record displayed as raw fixed-width text. CBCUS01C displays every customer record TWICE (once inside 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT on status '00', once in mainline); CBACT02C has the inner DISPLAY commented out, so once.

##### External calls
`CEE3ABD` USING ABCODE=999, TIMING=0 (CBACT02C paragraph 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM; CBCUS01C Z-ABEND-PROGRAM, status display via Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS).

##### Migration notes
- Pure diagnostic utilities; replace with a query/export. Output contains CVV and SSN in clear text.
- Non-numeric status bytes are displayed via TWO-BYTES-BINARY redefinition (status '9x' VSAM codes displayed as 4-digit number).
- Duplicate display in CBCUS01C is real behaviour, not a doc artifact.
recommendation: Fully documented; diagnostic only.

Consolidated document for app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl, app/jcl/READCARD.jcl, app/jcl/READCUST.jcl; merged duplicates: sfind-c93e198b3e1a4a3fba93b3cfd2f16088, sfind-7958d356860540a58d89a5cda3cf40a4.

Utility/diagnostic; near-identical to CBACT03C/CBCUS01C (see READXREF/READCUST) except CBACT02C displays each record once.
- 
Job card has `NOTIFY=&SYUID` (typo; not &SYSUID) - symbol is unresolved/ineffective. Paragraph names Z-* instead of 99xx. Otherwise same as CBACT03C.

title: TRANREPT / CBTRN03C daily transaction report
description:
##### Entry point
Batch job `TRANREPT` (app/jcl/TRANREPT.jcl; same steps in proc/TRANREPT.prc): STEP05R REPROC unload of TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS -> TRANSACT.BKUP(+1); STEP05R SORT (INCLUDE TRAN-PROC-DT pos 305 len 10 between C'2022-01-01' and C'2022-07-06', SORT by TRAN-CARD-NUM pos 263 len 16 ascending) -> TRANSACT.DALY(+1); STEP10R `EXEC PGM=CBTRN03C`. Online CORPT00C submits this job via TDQ (separate flow).

##### Inputs
- `TRANFILE` -> TRANSACT.DALY(+1), sequential, 350-byte CVTRA05Y TRAN-RECORD (FD splits FD-TRANS-DATA X(304), FD-TRAN-PROC-TS X(26), FILLER X(20)).
- `CARDXREF` -> CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS random by card num (CVACT03Y).
- `TRANTYPE` -> TRANTYPE.VSAM.KSDS random key X(2); CVTRA03Y: TRAN-TYPE X(2), TRAN-TYPE-DESC X(50), FILLER X(8).
- `TRANCATG` -> TRANCATG.VSAM.KSDS random key type X(2)+cat 9(4); CVTRA04Y: TRAN-TYPE-CD, TRAN-CAT-CD, TRAN-CAT-TYPE-DESC X(50), FILLER X(4).
- `DATEPARM` -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DATEPARM, 80-byte record read into WS-DATEPARM-RECORD: WS-START-DATE X(10), FILLER X(1), WS-END-DATE X(10).

##### Processing flow
1. Open TRANFILE, REPORT (OUTPUT), CARDXREF, TRANTYPE, TRANCATG, DATEPARM (abend on non-'00').
2. 0550-DATEPARM-READ: '00' -> display range; '10' -> sets END-OF-FILE='Y' (no report body); other -> abend. NOTE: paragraph ends with `.` and no END-IF.
3. Loop: 1000-TRANFILE-GET-NEXT. Date filter `IF TRAN-PROC-TS(1:10) >= WS-START-DATE AND <= WS-END-DATE CONTINUE ELSE NEXT SENTENCE` - NEXT SENTENCE jumps past the end of the whole PERFORM sentence, i.e. out-of-range records skip processing (loop re-iterates).
4. If not EOF: DISPLAY record; on card change (WS-CURR-CARD-NUM != TRAN-CARD-NUM): if not first, 1120-WRITE-ACCOUNT-TOTALS; save card; 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF (INVALID KEY -> abend with status 23). Lookup type (1500-B) and category (1500-C) the same way (abend if missing). 1100-WRITE-TRANSACTION-REPORT.
5. 1100: first time -> put dates into header, 1120-WRITE-HEADERS. If MOD(WS-LINE-COUNTER, 20)=0 -> 1110-WRITE-PAGE-TOTALS + headers. Add TRAN-AMT to page & account totals; 1120-WRITE-DETAIL.
6. At EOF (ELSE branch): DISPLAY amounts, ADD TRAN-AMT (of the last record, still in buffer) to page/account totals again, 1110-WRITE-PAGE-TOTALS, 1110-WRITE-GRAND-TOTALS.
7. Close files.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J[TRANREPT: REPROC unload -> SORT filter/sort by card -> CBTRN03C] --> O[open 6 files]
  O --> P[0550-DATEPARM-READ]
  P --> L[1000-TRANFILE-GET-NEXT]
  L -->|out of date range| L
  L -->|EOF| E[add last TRAN-AMT again; 1110-WRITE-PAGE-TOTALS; 1110-WRITE-GRAND-TOTALS; close]
  L -->|in range| C{card changed}
  C -->|yes| AT[1120-WRITE-ACCOUNT-TOTALS if not first; 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF]
  C -->|no| T
  AT --> T[1500-B-LOOKUP-TRANTYPE; 1500-C-LOOKUP-TRANCATG]
  T --> W[1100-WRITE-TRANSACTION-REPORT headers/page break every 20 lines; 1120-WRITE-DETAIL]
  W --> L
  T -->|INVALID KEY| X[9999-ABEND-PROGRAM]
```

##### Data
Read-only: TRANFILE, CARDXREF, TRANTYPE, TRANCATG, DATEPARM. Written: `TRANREPT` -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANREPT(+1) FB 133. Report lines (CVTRA07Y): REPORT-NAME-HEADER ('DALYREPT' X38, 'Daily Transaction Report' X41, 'Date Range: ' X12, start X10, ' to ', end X10); TRANSACTION-HEADER-1 column titles; TRANSACTION-HEADER-2 133 dashes; TRANSACTION-DETAIL-REPORT: TRANS-ID X16, sp, ACCOUNT-ID X11, sp, TYPE-CD X2, '-', TYPE-DESC X15 (truncated from 50), sp, CAT-CD 9(4), '-', CAT-DESC X29 (truncated), sp, SOURCE X10, 4sp, AMT `-ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.ZZ`, 2sp; REPORT-PAGE-TOTALS 'Page Total'+86 dots+`+ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.ZZ`; REPORT-ACCOUNT-TOTALS 'Account Total'+84 dots; REPORT-GRAND-TOTALS 'Grand Total'+86 dots. WS totals are S9(9)V99; WS-LINE-COUNTER 9(9) COMP-3, WS-PAGE-SIZE 9(3) COMP-3 =20.

##### Outputs & side effects
133-byte report file; SYSOUT displays of each record. No master updates.

##### External calls
`CEE3ABD` USING ABCODE 999, TIMING 0 on errors / missing lookups. JCL uses REPROC proc (IDCAMS REPRO, not in this batch) and DFSORT.

##### Migration notes
- Bug-compatible behaviours: (a) last transaction's amount is added twice to page/account totals at EOF (then grand total includes it twice); (b) the final account's ACCOUNT TOTAL line is never written (only page + grand totals at EOF); (c) grand total only accumulates at page-total time; (d) page break test happens BEFORE the detail line and header lines also increment the counter, so pages are not exactly 20 details.
- Control break is by card number, but the report labels it 'Account Total' and prints XREF-ACCT-ID.
- Date filtering exists twice: SORT INCLUDE (hardcoded dates in JCL SYMNAMES) and program DATEPARM compare (string compare on YYYY-MM-DD). They can disagree.
- If DATEPARM is empty, END-OF-FILE='Y' and no report lines at all are written (not even headers).
- Descriptions are truncated to 15/29 chars; account id moves 9(11) -> X(11).
recommendation: Fully documented; confirm whether double-counting of last transaction and missing final account total are to be preserved.
note: Duplicate of sfind-14d5b15e18b04d8c913cae17e3df6dce (TRANREPT batch job); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: Pending authorization data definitions - CIPAUDTY, AUTHFRDS, PSBPAUTB, DLIGSAMP
description:
##### Entry point
Data definitions only (no executable entry): copybook CIPAUDTY, DDL AUTHFRDS, PSBs PSBPAUTB and DLIGSAMP. Consumed by flows CBPAUP0C, COPAUA0C, DBUNLDGS, PAUDBLOD (documented separately) and by COPAUS2C (AUTHFRDS insert; outside this batch).

##### Inputs
- **CIPAUDTY** (PAUTDTL1, 200 bytes): see CBPAUP0C finding for full layout; key PA-AUTH-DATE-9C S9(5) COMP-3 + PA-AUTH-TIME-9C S9(9) COMP-3 (8 bytes, 9's complement of YYDDD and HHMMSSmmm).
- **AUTHFRDS** DB2 table CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS: CARD_NUM CHAR(16), AUTH_TS TIMESTAMP (PK CARD_NUM+AUTH_TS), AUTH_TYPE CHAR4, CARD_EXPIRY_DATE CHAR4, MESSAGE_TYPE CHAR6, MESSAGE_SOURCE CHAR6, AUTH_ID_CODE CHAR6, AUTH_RESP_CODE CHAR2, AUTH_RESP_REASON CHAR4, PROCESSING_CODE CHAR6, TRANSACTION_AMT/APPROVED_AMT DECIMAL(12,2), MERCHANT_CATAGORY_CODE CHAR4, ACQR_COUNTRY_CODE CHAR3, POS_ENTRY_MODE SMALLINT, MERCHANT_ID CHAR15, MERCHANT_NAME VARCHAR22, MERCHANT_CITY CHAR13, MERCHANT_STATE CHAR2, MERCHANT_ZIP CHAR9, TRANSACTION_ID CHAR15, MATCH_STATUS CHAR1, AUTH_FRAUD CHAR1, FRAUD_RPT_DATE DATE, ACCT_ID DECIMAL(11), CUST_ID DECIMAL(9).
- **PSBPAUTB**: PCB PAUTBPCB DBD DBPAUTP0 PROCOPT=AP KEYLEN=14, SENSEG PAUTSUM0 / PAUTDTL1; LANG=COBOL CMPAT=YES (I/O PCB present -> DB PCB is PCB #2 for BMP CBPAUP0C; COPAUA0C under CICS uses PCB(1)).
- **DLIGSAMP**: same DB PCB with PROCOPT=GOTP plus GSAM PCBs PASFLDBD and PADFLDBD (PROCOPT=LS), CMPAT=NO (no I/O PCB - matches DBUNLDGS USING 3 PCBs).

##### Processing flow
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  DBD[DBPAUTP0 HIDAM PAUTSUM0 100B key ACCNTID packed6] --> CH[PAUTDTL1 200B key PAUT9CTS 8B]
  PSB1[PSBPAUTB AP] --> DBD
  PSB2[DLIGSAMP GOTP + GSAM PASFLDBD PADFLDBD] --> DBD
  CH -. layout .-> CPY[CIPAUDTY]
  T[AUTHFRDS DB2] -. mirrors .-> CPY
```

##### Data
As above. DBD DBPAUTP0: ACCESS=(HIDAM,VSAM), dataset DDPAUTP0, index DBPAUTX0 (PAUTINDX).

##### Outputs & side effects
None.

##### External calls
None.

##### Migration notes
- PROCOPT AP permits all DL/I functions; GOTP is read-only. CMPAT difference changes PCB numbering.
- AUTHFRDS column types differ from the IMS copybook: PROCESSING_CODE CHAR vs 9(6); POS_ENTRY_MODE SMALLINT vs 9(2); FRAUD_RPT_DATE DATE vs X(8); amounts DECIMAL(12,2) vs S9(10)V99 COMP-3 (compatible); AUTH_TS timestamp must be rebuilt from complemented key.
recommendation: Reference layouts for flows above.

title: COTRTUPC (CICS CTTU) - transaction type add/update/delete detail screen (DB2)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CTTU** -> program **COTRTUPC** (online, pseudo-conversational). Entered by XCTL from COTRTLIC (PF2) or the admin menu COADM01C, or directly. `EXEC CICS HANDLE ABEND` routes abends to ABEND-ROUTINE. Ends each interaction with `EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CTTU') COMMAREA`.

##### Inputs
- COMMAREA: CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (COCOM01Y) + program area with TTUP-CHANGE-ACTION X(1) state machine: LOW/space=DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, 'K' INVALID-SEARCH-KEYS, 'X' DETAILS-NOT-FOUND, 'S' SHOW-DETAILS, 'R' CREATE-NEW-RECORD, 'V' REVIEW-NEW-RECORD, '9' CONFIRM-DELETE, '8' START-DELETE, '7' DELETE-DONE, '6' DELETE-FAILED, 'E' CHANGES-NOT-OK, 'N' CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED, 'L' LOCK-ERROR, 'F' OKAYED-BUT-FAILED, 'C' OKAYED-AND-DONE, 'B' BACKED-OUT; plus old/new type code X2 and description X50.
- Map CTRTUPA / mapset COTRTUP (symbolic COTRTUP.cpy): TRTYPCD (type code), TRTYDSC (description), INFOMSG, ERRMSG, F-key labels. '*' in a field = LOW-VALUES.
- Keys: ENTER, PF3 exit, PF4 delete (then PF4 again to confirm), PF5 save/create, PF12 cancel.

##### Processing flow
1. Fresh entry (EIBCALEN=0 or from COADM01C/COTRTLIC not re-entering) -> reset, send map prompting for search key.
2. `0001-CHECK-PFKEYS` validates key against state; invalid -> 'invalid key' message.
3. EVALUATE: PF3 -> SYNCPOINT, XCTL to caller (default COADM01C/CA00). PF4 with CONFIRM-DELETE -> `9800-DELETE-PROCESSING`; PF4 when showing -> CONFIRM-DELETE; PF5 when not found -> CREATE-NEW-RECORD; PF5 with confirmed changes -> `9600-WRITE-PROCESSING`; PF12 -> re-read and show original / cancel delete or update; OTHER -> `1000-PROCESS-INPUTS` (RECEIVE MAP, store, `1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS`: type code required numeric 2 digits via TEST-NUMVAL/NUMVAL, must be non-zero; description required, letters/digits/spaces only; case-insensitive compare old vs new -> no change detected) then `2000-DECIDE-ACTION` (not fetched -> `9000-READ-TRANTYPE`: `SELECT TR_TYPE, TR_DESCRIPTION FROM CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE WHERE TR_TYPE=:DCL-TR-TYPE`; 0 found -> SHOW-DETAILS, +100 -> DETAILS-NOT-FOUND (prompt to create with PF5), <0 -> message), edited ok -> CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED (prompt PF5 to save)).
4. `9600-WRITE-PROCESSING`: `UPDATE CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE SET TR_DESCRIPTION=... WHERE TR_TYPE=:DCL-TR-TYPE`; 0 -> SYNCPOINT, OKAYED-AND-DONE; **+100 -> `9700-INSERT-RECORD` (`INSERT ... VALUES(:DCL-TR-TYPE, :DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION)`, 0 -> SYNCPOINT, else TABLE-UPDATE-FAILED)** - i.e. create is an upsert; -911 -> lock error 'L'; <0 -> failed 'F'.
5. `9800-DELETE-PROCESSING`: `DELETE FROM CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE WHERE TR_TYPE=:DCL-TR-TYPE`; 0 -> DELETE-DONE + SYNCPOINT; -532 (child rows exist in TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY) -> delete failed with SQLCODE message; other -> DELETE-FAILED.
6. `3000-SEND-MAP`: screen init, values (initial / original / updated per state), info message per state, protect/unprotect fields per state, PF-key label attributes, SEND MAP.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CTTU COTRTUPC] --> K{AID / state}
  K -->|PF3| X[SYNCPOINT XCTL caller or COADM01C]
  K -->|ENTER| P[1000-PROCESS-INPUTS RECEIVE + edits] --> D[2000-DECIDE-ACTION]
  D -->|not fetched| RD[9000-READ-TRANTYPE SELECT]
  RD -->|+100| NF[state X: prompt PF5 create]
  RD -->|0| SH[state S show]
  D -->|valid change| CF[state N confirm with PF5]
  K -->|PF5 confirm| W[9600 UPDATE] -->|+100| INS[9700 INSERT]
  W -->|0| SP[SYNCPOINT state C]
  K -->|PF4| CD[state 9 confirm] -->|PF4 again| DEL[9800 DELETE]
  K -->|PF12| CAN[cancel / re-read]
  NF & SH & CF & SP & INS & DEL & CAN --> S[3000-SEND-MAP CTRTUPA] --> RT[RETURN TRANSID CTTU]
```

##### Data
DB2 CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE (DCLTRTYP); DCLTRCAT (TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY) included. SELECT / UPDATE / INSERT / DELETE single row by TR_TYPE.

##### Outputs & side effects
Map CTRTUPA; committed (SYNCPOINT) DB2 changes; XCTL to caller.

##### External calls
CICS RECEIVE/SEND MAP, XCTL, SYNCPOINT, RETURN, HANDLE ABEND; DB2 SQL.

##### Migration notes
- Save on a non-existent key inserts (upsert semantics); no optimistic-lock re-read before update even though DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE state exists (not observed being set in the update path).
- Delete requires two PF4 presses; -532 RI handling.
- Validation identical in spirit to COTRTLIC (alphanumeric+spaces only); type code must be numeric and non-zero.
- Traced at paragraph level; detailed 3xxx attribute settings summarized (protect/unprotect/colour).
recommendation: State machine and SQL fully traced; screen attribute paragraphs summarized. Confirm upsert-on-save behavior.
note: Duplicate of sfind-63f866033e6444b7bf2136d8f7c5ec6e (CTTU / COTRTUPC); unique migration notes folded into that finding.

title: COTRTLIC (CICS CTLI) - transaction type list / filter / inline update-delete screen (DB2)
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CTLI** -> program **COTRTLIC** (pseudo-conversational, online). Reached by XCTL from the admin menu (COADM01C/CA00) with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, from COTRTUPC (CTTU), or directly (EIBCALEN=0). Re-entered via `EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CTLI') COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA) LENGTH(2000)`.

##### Inputs
- COMMAREA (2000 bytes) = CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (COCOM01Y: CDEMO-FROM-TRANID/PROGRAM, TO-TRANID/PROGRAM, user id/type, PGM-CONTEXT enter/reenter, LAST-MAP/MAPSET, ...) followed by WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA: WS-CA-TYPE-CD X2, WS-CA-TYPE-DESC X50, WS-CA-ALL-ROWS-OUT 7 x (code X2 + desc X50) = 364, WS-CA-ROW-SELECTED S9(4) COMP, WS-CA-LAST-TR-CODE X2, WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE X2, WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM 9(1), WS-CA-LAST-PAGE-DISPLAYED 9(1) (0 shown/9 not shown), WS-CA-NEXT-PAGE-IND X ('Y'), WS-CA-DELETE-FLAG X, WS-CA-UPDATE-FLAG X.
- Map **CTRTLIA** in mapset **COTRTLI** (`app/app-transaction-type-db2/bms/COTRTLI.bms`, symbolic COTRTLI.cpy): TRTYPE (6,44) L2 unprot - type-code filter; TRDESC (8,25) L50 unprot - description filter; 7 rows (lines 12-18): TRTSELn (col 6) L1 select, TRTTYPn (col 17) L2, TRTYPDn (col 25) L50; an 8th row TRTSELA/TRTTYPA/TRTDSCA (line 19) exists in the BMS but is not mapped by the program's REDEFINES (only 7 rows used); INFOMSG (21,19) L45; ERRMSG (23,1) L78; PAGENO (4,76) L3; header TRNNAME/TITLE01/TITLE02/CURDATE/CURTIME/PGMNAME; F-key labels BUTNF02/03/07/08/10.
- AID keys: ENTER, PF2 (add), PF3 (exit), PF7 (page back), PF8 (page forward), PF10 (confirm, only valid when a delete/update is pending). Any other key is treated as ENTER.

##### Processing flow
1. `0000-MAIN`: initialize; EIBCALEN=0 -> fresh commarea, admin user, first page. Else split commarea. `YYYY-STORE-PFKEY` (CSSTRPFY) maps EIBAID to CCARD-AID-*. Entry from another program or PF3 coming from CTTU -> reset program commarea, treat as ENTER on first page.
2. If re-entered from itself -> `1000-RECEIVE-MAP`: `1100-RECEIVE-SCREEN` (RECEIVE MAP into CTRTLIAI; row descriptions '*' or spaces become LOW-VALUES, else trimmed) and `1200-EDIT-INPUTS`:
   - `1210-EDIT-ARRAY`: if a filter changed, clear selections; else count blanks/'D'/'U'. Actions requested = 7 - blanks. Loop rows 7..1: 'D'/'U' -> remember row; if >1 action flag row error; 'U' -> `1211-EDIT-ARRAY-DESC` (case-insensitive trimmed compare with stored description: equal -> 'No change detected with respect to database values.'; else `1240-EDIT-ALPHANUM-REQD` on 50 chars: blank -> 'Transaction Desc must be supplied.'; any char other than A-Z a-z 0-9 (spaces allowed) -> 'Transaction Desc can have numbers or alphabets only.'). Other values -> 'Action code selected is invalid'. Row selection change tracked vs WS-CA-ROW-SELECTED. >1 action -> 'Please select only 1 action'.
   - `1230-EDIT-DESC`: non-blank filter -> WS-TYPE-DESC-FILTER = '%' || TRIM(desc) || '%'.
   - `1220-EDIT-TYPECD`: blank/spaces/zeros -> no filter; non-numeric -> 'TYPE CODE FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 2 DIGIT NUMBER' and protect rows.
   - `1290-CROSS-EDITS`: if any filter valid -> `9100-CHECK-FILTERS` (SELECT COUNT(1) with same predicates); 0 -> 'No Records found for these filter conditions', mark filters bad, protect rows.
3. PF-key validation; PF3 -> SYNCPOINT, XCTL to CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM (default COADM01C) with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA. PF2 (from self) -> XCTL to **COTRTUPC** (map COTRTUP/CTRTUPA). PF10 without pending action, or with changed filter/selection -> ENTER.
4. `9998-PRIMING-QUERY` (`SELECT 1 FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1`): failure -> SEND-LONG-TEXT (SEND TEXT + RETURN) .
5. EVALUATE: INPUT-ERROR -> re-read forward from first code (unless filters bad) and send map; PF7 on first page -> forward from first code; PF3 / re-entry from other program -> reset, forward; PF8 with next page -> start key = last code, page+1, forward; PF7 not first page -> page-1, `8100-READ-BACKWARDS`; ENTER with delete pending -> redisplay with row highlighted + 'Delete HIGHLIGHTED row ? Press F10 to confirm'; PF10 with delete -> `9300-DELETE-RECORD`, send, on success reset to first page; ENTER with update -> highlight + 'Update HIGHLIGHTED row. Press F10 to save'; PF10 with update -> `9200-UPDATE-RECORD`, re-read forward, send; OTHER -> read forward and send.
6. `8000-READ-FORWARD`: OPEN C-TR-TYPE-FORWARD (`SELECT TR_TYPE, TR_DESCRIPTION FROM CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE WHERE TR_TYPE >= :WS-START-KEY AND (type filter) AND (desc LIKE TRIM(filter)) ORDER BY TR_TYPE`); FETCH up to 7 rows into commarea rows; row 1 -> first code; at row 7 fetch one more to determine next page exists; +100 -> no next page, 'No more pages for these search conditions' (or 'No records found for this search condition.' on page 1); error -> WS-DB2-ERROR + DSNTIAC message. CLOSE cursor.
7. `8100-READ-BACKWARDS`: C-TR-TYPE-BACKWARD (`TR_TYPE < :WS-START-KEY ... ORDER BY TR_TYPE DESC`), fill rows from 7 down to 1.
8. `9200-UPDATE-RECORD`: `UPDATE CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE SET TR_DESCRIPTION = :DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION (varchar, len = LENGTH of untrimmed 50-char field) WHERE TR_TYPE = :DCL-TR-TYPE`; 0 -> success 'HIGHLIGHTED row was updated'; +100 / -911 (deadlock) / <0 -> keep request pending + DB2 message (-911 also INPUT-ERROR). No explicit COMMIT (commit at task end / RETURN).
9. `9300-DELETE-RECORD`: `DELETE FROM CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE WHERE TR_TYPE = :DCL-TR-TYPE`; 0 -> 'HIGHLIGHTED row deleted.Hit Enter to continue'; -532 (RI restrict - child rows in TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY) -> keep pending + message; other -> message.
10. `2000-SEND-MAP`: header init (titles COTTL01Y, date/time), row attributes (protect empty rows, red/highlight error rows and selected rows, desc unprotected only for update row), info message centered in 45 chars, `EXEC CICS SEND MAP('CTRTLIA') MAPSET('COTRTLI') ERASE FREEKB CURSOR`.
11. `9999-FORMAT-DB2-MESSAGE` (CSDB2RPY): CALL 'DSNTIAC' USING DFHEIBLK, DFHCOMMAREA, SQLCA, formatted area (10x72), LRECL 72 -> message 'action SQLCODE:nnnnn text'.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[CTLI COTRTLIC 0000-MAIN] --> B{EIBCALEN=0 / from other pgm?}
  B -->|re-entry| RM[1000-RECEIVE-MAP 1100 RECEIVE + 1200-EDIT-INPUTS]
  B -->|first| K
  RM --> K{AID key}
  K -->|PF3| X3[SYNCPOINT, XCTL COADM01C or caller]
  K -->|PF2| X2[XCTL COTRTUPC]
  K --> PQ[9998-PRIMING-QUERY SYSDUMMY1]
  PQ -->|error| LT[SEND-LONG-TEXT + RETURN]
  PQ --> EV{EVALUATE}
  EV -->|PF8 next page| F[8000-READ-FORWARD cursor C-TR-TYPE-FORWARD]
  EV -->|PF7| BK[8100-READ-BACKWARDS cursor C-TR-TYPE-BACKWARD]
  EV -->|ENTER + D/U| HL[highlight + confirm message]
  EV -->|PF10 + D| DEL[9300 DELETE TRANSACTION_TYPE]
  EV -->|PF10 + U| UPD[9200 UPDATE TRANSACTION_TYPE] --> F
  EV -->|other / error| F
  F --> S[2000-SEND-MAP CTRTLIA]
  BK --> S
  HL --> S
  DEL --> S
  S --> RT[COMMON-RETURN RETURN TRANSID CTLI COMMAREA]
```

##### Data
DB2 CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE (TR_TYPE CHAR(2) PK, TR_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(50)) via DCLGEN DCLTRTYP (DCL-TR-TYPE X2, DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION LEN S9(4) COMP + TEXT X50). Reads SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1. Delete is subject to RI from CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY (DDL TRNTYCAT.ddl) - -532 handled.

##### Outputs & side effects
3270 map CTRTLIA; DB2 UPDATE/DELETE of one row per confirmed action; XCTL to COADM01C / caller / COTRTUPC.

##### External calls
CICS RECEIVE/SEND MAP, SEND TEXT, XCTL, RETURN, SYNCPOINT; DB2 SQL; CALL 'DSNTIAC' (IBM DB2 message formatter, external).

##### Migration notes
- Page size 7; paging is key-based (first/last TR_TYPE); backward paging re-reads from first key; page counter is 9(1) (wraps after 9).
- Selection loop runs from row 7 down to 1, so with multiple selections I-SELECTED ends as the topmost row.
- Description filter is a contains-LIKE with user text inserted unescaped ('%' or '_' in input act as wildcards); type filter exact match.
- 'No change' comparison is case-insensitive; description validation allows only letters, digits and spaces.
- Update sets VARCHAR length = 50 (FUNCTION LENGTH of untrimmed field) - stores trailing spaces.
- PF3 entry from CTTU resets state; PF2 marks user as regular user (CDEMO-USRTYP-USER) before XCTL - asymmetric with other paths that set ADMIN.
- Unmapped 8th row (TRTSELA/TRTTYPA/TRTDSCA) in BMS.
recommendation: Traced through all paragraphs; screen attribute details in 2200/2400 summarised (color/protect only). DSNTIAC is IBM-supplied.

title: COPAUA0C (CICS CP00) - MQ-triggered card authorization decision, reply and IMS posting
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CP00** -> program **COPAUA0C** (CSD `CRDDEMO2.csd`). Started by an IBM MQ trigger monitor: `EXEC CICS RETRIEVE INTO(MQTM)` obtains the trigger message; MQTM-QNAME becomes the request queue name and MQTM-TRIGGERDATA is saved (unused). DFHCOMMAREA (X(4096)) declared but not used. It is a message-driven authorization engine: reads card authorization requests from MQ, decides approve/decline, replies on MQ and records the authorization in IMS.

##### Inputs
- Request queue = MQTM-QNAME (if RETRIEVE fails, name stays uninitialized and MQOPEN fails -> M001 critical).
- Request message (MQGET, max 500 bytes, MQGMO-CONVERT, 5000 ms wait, no syncpoint): comma-delimited text UNSTRINGed into PENDING-AUTH-REQUEST (CCPAURQY) in this order: PA-RQ-AUTH-DATE X6, PA-RQ-AUTH-TIME X6, PA-RQ-CARD-NUM X16, PA-RQ-AUTH-TYPE X4, PA-RQ-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE X4, PA-RQ-MESSAGE-TYPE X6, PA-RQ-MESSAGE-SOURCE X6, PA-RQ-PROCESSING-CODE 9(6), transaction amount (into WS-TRANSACTION-AMT-AN X13 then `FUNCTION NUMVAL` -> PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-AMT PIC +9(10).99 and WS-TRANSACTION-AMT S9(10)V99), PA-RQ-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE X4, PA-RQ-ACQR-COUNTRY-CODE X3, PA-RQ-POS-ENTRY-MODE 9(2), PA-RQ-MERCHANT-ID X15, PA-RQ-MERCHANT-NAME X22, PA-RQ-MERCHANT-CITY X13, PA-RQ-MERCHANT-STATE X2, PA-RQ-MERCHANT-ZIP X9, PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-ID X15. MQMD CorrelId and ReplyToQ are saved.
- VSAM via CICS READ: CCXREF (CARD-XREF-RECORD CVACT03Y: XREF-CARD-NUM X16 key, XREF-CUST-ID 9(9), XREF-ACCT-ID 9(11), filler 14); ACCTDAT keyed by 11-char account id (ACCOUNT-RECORD CVACT01Y: ACCT-ID 9(11), ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS X, ACCT-CURR-BAL / ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT / ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99, dates X10, cycle credit/debit, zip, group id); CUSTDAT keyed by 9-char cust id (CUSTOMER-RECORD CVCUS01Y).
- IMS PSB PSBPAUTB, PCB number 1 (DB PCB), DB DBPAUTP0 segments PAUTSUM0/PAUTDTL1 (layouts CIPAUSMY/CIPAUDTY, see CBPAUP0C flow).

##### Processing flow
1. `1000-INITIALIZE`: RETRIEVE MQTM; wait interval 5000; `1100-OPEN-REQUEST-QUEUE` (MQOPEN MQOO-INPUT-SHARED, HCONN 0 = CICS default connection; failure M001 critical); `3100-READ-REQUEST-MQ` first GET.
2. `3100-READ-REQUEST-MQ`: OK -> save CorrelId & ReplyToQ; MQRC-NO-MSG-AVAILABLE -> NO-MORE-MSG-AVAILABLE; other -> M003 critical (subsystem flagged CICS).
3. `2000-MAIN-PROCESS` loop until no message or WS-LOOP-END: `2100-EXTRACT-REQUEST-MSG`, `5000-PROCESS-AUTH`, WS-MSG-PROCESSED+1, `EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT`, mark PSB not scheduled; stop when WS-MSG-PROCESSED > 500 (so up to 501 messages per task) else read next.
4. `5000-PROCESS-AUTH`: set APPROVE-AUTH, CARD-FOUND-XREF, FOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR; `1200-SCHEDULE-PSB` (DLI SCHD PSBPAUTB NODHABEND; if 'TC' TERM and re-SCHD; not OK -> I001 critical); `5100-READ-XREF-RECORD` (NOTFND -> CARD-NFOUND-XREF + NFOUND-ACCT, warning A001 'CARD NOT FOUND IN XREF'; other -> C001 critical). If card found: `5200-READ-ACCT-RECORD` (NOTFND -> NFOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR, A002 warning; other C002 critical), `5300-READ-CUST-RECORD` (NOTFND -> NFOUND-CUST-IN-MSTR, A003; other C003), `5500-READ-AUTH-SUMMRY` (DLI GU PAUTSUM0 WHERE ACCNTID = XREF-ACCT-ID; OK -> FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG; GE -> NFOUND; other I002 critical), `5600-READ-PROFILE-DATA` (CONTINUE - stub). Then `6000-MAKE-DECISION`, `7100-SEND-RESPONSE`, and if card found `8000-WRITE-AUTH-TO-DB`.
5. `6000-MAKE-DECISION`: reply card num / transaction id copied; **PA-RL-AUTH-ID-CODE = PA-RQ-AUTH-TIME**. If summary found: available = PA-CREDIT-LIMIT - PA-CREDIT-BALANCE; decline (INSUFFICIENT-FUND) if amount > available. Else if account found: available = ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT - ACCT-CURR-BAL, same test. Else decline. Declined -> resp code '05', approved amt 0; approved -> '00', approved amt = request amount. Reason '0000' unless declined: xref/acct/cust not found -> '3100'; INSUFFICIENT-FUND '4100'; CARD-NOT-ACTIVE '4200'; ACCOUNT-CLOSED '4300'; CARD-FRAUD '5100'; MERCHANT-FRAUD '5200'; other '9000'. Reply buffer built: `STRING card ',' txn-id ',' auth-id ',' resp-code ',' reason ',' WS-APPROVED-AMT-DIS(-zzzzzzzzz9.99) ',' INTO W02-PUT-BUFFER WITH POINTER WS-RESP-LENGTH`.
6. `7100-SEND-RESPONSE`: MQPUT1 to saved ReplyToQ; MsgType REPLY, CorrelId = request CorrelId, MsgId none, non-persistent, expiry 50 (1/10 s = 5 s), format MQSTR, NO-SYNCPOINT; length = WS-RESP-LENGTH. Failure M004 critical.
7. `8400-UPDATE-SUMMARY`: if no summary, INITIALIZE numerics to zero and set PA-ACCT-ID/PA-CUST-ID from xref. Always refresh PA-CREDIT-LIMIT/PA-CASH-LIMIT from account. Approved: approved cnt+1, approved amt += WS-APPROVED-AMT, PA-CREDIT-BALANCE += WS-APPROVED-AMT, PA-CASH-BALANCE = 0. Declined: declined cnt+1, declined amt += PA-TRANSACTION-AMT. REPL if summary existed else ISRT; not OK -> I003 critical.
8. `8500-INSERT-AUTH`: ASKTIME/FORMATTIME YYDDD, TIME, MILLISECONDS; PA-AUTH-DATE-9C = 99999 - YYDDD; PA-AUTH-TIME-9C = 999999999 - (HHMMSS*1000 + ms). Copy request fields to detail; auth id/resp code/reason/approved amt from reply; PA-MATCH-STATUS 'P' if approved else 'D'; fraud fields blank. `DLI ISRT PAUTSUM0 WHERE(ACCNTID=PA-ACCT-ID) PAUTDTL1 FROM(PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)`; not OK -> I004 critical.
9. `9000-TERMINATE`: DLI TERM if scheduled; `9100-CLOSE-REQUEST-QUEUE` (MQCLOSE; failure M005 warning). CICS RETURN.
10. `9500-LOG-ERROR`: fill ERROR-LOG-RECORD (CCPAUERY: ERR-DATE X6 YYMMDD, ERR-TIME X6, ERR-APPLICATION X8='CP00', ERR-PROGRAM X8='COPAUA0C', ERR-LOCATION X4, ERR-LEVEL X (L/I/W/C), ERR-SUBSYSTEM X (A/C/I/D/M/F), ERR-CODE-1 X9, ERR-CODE-2 X9, ERR-MESSAGE X50, ERR-EVENT-KEY X20), `WRITEQ TD QUEUE('CSSL')`; if ERR-CRITICAL -> `9990-END-ROUTINE` (9000-TERMINATE + CICS RETURN, ending the task immediately).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  T[MQ trigger -> CICS CP00 COPAUA0C] --> R[1000-INITIALIZE RETRIEVE MQTM]
  R --> O[1100-OPEN-REQUEST-QUEUE MQOPEN] --> G[3100-READ-REQUEST-MQ MQGET wait 5s]
  G -->|no msg| TERM[9000-TERMINATE DLI TERM + MQCLOSE -> CICS RETURN]
  G -->|msg| X[2100-EXTRACT-REQUEST-MSG UNSTRING CSV]
  X --> P[5000-PROCESS-AUTH 1200-SCHEDULE-PSB]
  P --> XR[5100 READ CCXREF]
  XR -->|found| AC[5200 READ ACCTDAT] --> CU[5300 READ CUSTDAT] --> SU[5500 DLI GU PAUTSUM0] --> DEC
  XR -->|NOTFND| DEC[6000-MAKE-DECISION available credit test]
  DEC --> SND[7100-SEND-RESPONSE MQPUT1 reply]
  SND -->|card found| W[8400 REPL/ISRT PAUTSUM0 + 8500 ISRT PAUTDTL1]
  SND -->|card not found| SP
  W --> SP[CICS SYNCPOINT]
  SP -->|processed > 500| TERM
  SP --> G
  ERR[9500-LOG-ERROR WRITEQ TD CSSL] -->|critical| END[9990-END-ROUTINE]
```

##### Data
- Reads CCXREF, ACCTDAT, CUSTDAT (CICS file READ, no update). IMS DBPAUTP0: GU PAUTSUM0; REPL or ISRT PAUTSUM0; ISRT PAUTDTL1.
- Reply message layout (CCPAURLY fields, comma-separated text): card(16),txn-id(15),auth-id(6),resp-code(2),reason(4),amount(-zzzzzzzzz9.99, 14),.

##### Outputs & side effects
- MQ reply per request (non-persistent, 5 s expiry, outside syncpoint - sent even if later IMS update fails/rolls back).
- IMS summary updated/created and detail inserted (only when card exists in xref), committed by CICS SYNCPOINT per message.
- Error records to TD queue CSSL.

##### External calls
- IBM MQ: MQOPEN, MQGET, MQPUT1, MQCLOSE (CMQODV, CMQMDV, CMQV, CMQTML, CMQPMOV, CMQGMOV copybooks).
- CICS: RETRIEVE, READ, ASKTIME, FORMATTIME, WRITEQ TD, SYNCPOINT, RETURN. IMS DBCTL: EXEC DLI SCHD/GU/REPL/ISRT/TERM.

##### Migration notes
- **WS-RESP-LENGTH (STRING pointer, VALUE 1) is never reset** between messages: the 2nd reply is appended after the 1st and both are sent (BUFFLEN = pointer); by the 4th message the 200-byte buffer overflows (STRING stops). Also BUFFLEN = pointer = data length + 1, so one extra (uninitialized) byte is sent even on the first message.
- Flags not reset per message: WS-PAUT-SMRY-SEG-FLG, WS-CUST-MASTER-READ-FLG, WS-DECLINE-REASON-FLG (no VALUE clauses). If a card is not in xref, 6000 still tests a stale FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG from a previous message and can approve using the previous account's limits; stale INSUFFICIENT-FUND can mislabel reasons.
- Reason flags CARD-NOT-ACTIVE, ACCOUNT-CLOSED, CARD-FRAUD, MERCHANT-FRAUD are never set (dead reason codes 4200/4300/5100/5200); 5600-READ-PROFILE-DATA is a stub; customer-not-found does not cause decline when account exists.
- Declined path adds PA-TRANSACTION-AMT (detail segment field, populated only later in 8500) to PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT - uses the previous message's value (or uninitialized storage on first message).
- Approved path sets PA-CASH-BALANCE to 0 every time; credit limits refreshed from ACCTDAT on every auth.
- Auth ID code is just the request time. Detail key uses 9's-complement date/time so GN returns newest first; ms resolution only - two auths for the same account in the same ms collide (ISRT 'II' -> critical).
- Critical errors end the task via CICS RETURN, which commits prior work; the reply may already have been sent.
- Message limit test is `> 500` (501 messages). RETRIEVE failure is silently ignored.
recommendation: Fully traced within source; MQ copybooks (CMQ*) are IBM-supplied and not in repo. Confirm intended behavior for the non-reset reply pointer, stale flags, and declined-amount source before re-implementing.

title: CBPAUP0C / CBPAUP0J - batch purge of expired pending authorizations (IMS DBPAUTP0)
description:
##### Entry point
Batch IMS BMP job **CBPAUP0J** (`app/app-authorization-ims-db2-mq/jcl/CBPAUP0J.jcl`) step STEP01 runs `DFSRRC00` with `PARM='BMP,CBPAUP0C,PSBPAUTB'`. Program **CBPAUP0C** (batch, CB*) is entered at `PROCEDURE DIVISION USING IO-PCB-MASK PGM-PCB-MASK` (both declared `PIC X`; not referenced - DL/I calls use `EXEC DLI ... PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)` with PAUT-PCB-NUM = +2, i.e. the first DB PCB after the I/O PCB). Purpose as coded: delete expired pending-authorization detail segments and, conditionally, their summary root.

##### Inputs
- **SYSIN** (`ACCEPT PRM-INFO FROM SYSIN`), layout PRM-INFO (20 bytes):
  | Pos | Field | PIC | Default if invalid |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | 1-2 | P-EXPIRY-DAYS | 9(02) | 5 if NOT NUMERIC |
  | 3 | filler | X | |
  | 4-8 | P-CHKP-FREQ | X(05) | '5' (MOVE 5 to alphanumeric -> '5    ') if SPACES/0/LOW-VALUES |
  | 9 | filler | X | |
  | 10-14 | P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ | X(05) | '10' if SPACES/0/LOW-VALUES |
  | 15 | filler | X | |
  | 16 | P-DEBUG-FLAG | X | forced to 'N' unless 'Y' |
  JCL supplies `00,00001,00001,Y` (expiry 0 days, checkpoint every '00001', debug on).
- `ACCEPT CURRENT-DATE FROM DATE` (YYMMDD) and `ACCEPT CURRENT-YYDDD FROM DAY` (YYDDD Julian).
- IMS HIDAM DB **DBPAUTP0** via PSB **PSBPAUTB** (PCB PAUTBPCB, PROCOPT=AP, KEYLEN=14; SENSEG PAUTSUM0 root, PAUTDTL1 child).

##### Processing flow
1. `1000-INITIALIZE`: read dates and SYSIN, DISPLAY parm & date, apply defaults above.
2. `2000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-SUMMARY`: `EXEC DLI GN SEGMENT(PAUTSUM0) INTO(PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY)` (unqualified GN - walks roots in key sequence). DIBSTAT '  ' -> count read (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ, WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT +1), save PA-ACCT-ID to WS-CURR-APP-ID; 'GB' -> END-OF-AUTHDB; other -> DISPLAY + `9999-ABEND`.
3. Outer loop until ERR-FLG-ON (never set - dead) or END-OF-AUTHDB:
   a. `3000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-DTL`: `EXEC DLI GNP SEGMENT(PAUTDTL1)` under current root. '  ' -> MORE-AUTHS, WS-NO-DTL-READ+1; 'GE'/'GB' -> NO-MORE-AUTHS; other -> abend.
   b. Inner loop until NO-MORE-AUTHS: `4000-CHECK-IF-EXPIRED`: WS-AUTH-DATE = 99999 - PA-AUTH-DATE-9C (un-complements the stored YYDDD); WS-DAY-DIFF = CURRENT-YYDDD - WS-AUTH-DATE. If WS-DAY-DIFF >= WS-EXPIRY-DAYS -> QUALIFIED-FOR-DELETE and adjust in-memory summary: if PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE = '00' (approved) subtract 1 from PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT and PA-APPROVED-AMT from PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT, else subtract 1 from PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT and PA-TRANSACTION-AMT from PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT. Otherwise NOT-QUALIFIED.
   c. If qualified -> `5000-DELETE-AUTH-DTL`: `EXEC DLI DLET SEGMENT(PAUTDTL1) FROM(PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)`; success -> WS-NO-DTL-DELETED+1, else abend. Then read next detail (3000).
   d. After details: `IF PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT <= 0 AND PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT <= 0` -> `6000-DELETE-AUTH-SUMMARY` (`DLET PAUTSUM0`; success -> WS-NO-SUMRY-DELETED+1; else abend).
   e. If WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT > P-CHKP-FREQ -> `9000-TAKE-CHECKPOINT` and reset counter.
   f. Read next summary (2000).
4. Final `9000-TAKE-CHECKPOINT`, DISPLAY totals (summary read/deleted, details read/deleted), GOBACK.
- `9000-TAKE-CHECKPOINT`: `EXEC DLI CHKP ID(WK-CHKPT-ID)` (ID = 'RMAD' + WK-CHKPT-ID-CTR, ctr never incremented -> always 'RMAD0000'). OK -> WS-NO-CHKP+1; when >= P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ display progress and reset; failure -> abend.
- `9999-ABEND`: DISPLAY 'CBPAUP0C ABENDING ...', RETURN-CODE=16, GOBACK (no ROLB - work since last checkpoint is backed out by IMS only on abnormal end; GOBACK with RC 16 is a normal termination, so IMS commits uncommitted updates).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J[CBPAUP0J STEP01 DFSRRC00 BMP,CBPAUP0C,PSBPAUTB] --> I[1000-INITIALIZE SYSIN PRM-INFO defaults]
  I --> S[2000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-SUMMARY DLI GN PAUTSUM0]
  S -->|GB| CK[9000-TAKE-CHECKPOINT final] --> T[DISPLAY totals / GOBACK]
  S -->|other| AB[9999-ABEND RC=16]
  S -->|OK| D[3000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-DTL DLI GNP PAUTDTL1]
  D -->|GE/GB| SM{PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT <= 0 ?}
  D -->|other| AB
  D -->|OK| E[4000-CHECK-IF-EXPIRED day diff >= expiry]
  E -->|yes| X[adjust summary counters in memory] --> DL[5000-DELETE-AUTH-DTL DLET PAUTDTL1] --> D
  E -->|no| D
  SM -->|yes| DS[6000-DELETE-AUTH-SUMMARY DLET PAUTSUM0] --> C{proc cnt > P-CHKP-FREQ}
  SM -->|no| C
  C -->|yes| CP[9000-TAKE-CHECKPOINT CHKP RMAD0000] --> S
  C -->|no| S
```

##### Data
- **PAUTSUM0** root (DBD DBPAUTP0, 100 bytes, key ACCNTID = bytes 1-6 packed, unique) - copybook CIPAUSMY: PA-ACCT-ID S9(11) COMP-3 (6B); PA-CUST-ID 9(09); PA-AUTH-STATUS X; PA-ACCOUNT-STATUS X(02) OCCURS 5; PA-CREDIT-LIMIT, PA-CASH-LIMIT, PA-CREDIT-BALANCE, PA-CASH-BALANCE S9(09)V99 COMP-3 (6B each); PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT, PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT S9(04) COMP; PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT, PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT S9(09)V99 COMP-3; FILLER X(34).
- **PAUTDTL1** child (200 bytes, key PAUT9CTS = bytes 1-8, unique) - copybook CIPAUDTY: PA-AUTH-DATE-9C S9(05) COMP-3 (3B, 99999-YYDDD) + PA-AUTH-TIME-9C S9(09) COMP-3 (5B, 999999999-HHMMSSmmm) form the key so newest sorts first; then PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE X6, PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME X6, PA-CARD-NUM X16, PA-AUTH-TYPE X4, PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE X4, PA-MESSAGE-TYPE X6, PA-MESSAGE-SOURCE X6, PA-AUTH-ID-CODE X6, PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE X2 ('00'=approved), PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON X4, PA-PROCESSING-CODE 9(6), PA-TRANSACTION-AMT S9(10)V99 COMP-3, PA-APPROVED-AMT S9(10)V99 COMP-3, PA-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE X4, PA-ACQR-COUNTRY-CODE X3, PA-POS-ENTRY-MODE 9(2), PA-MERCHANT-ID X15, PA-MERCHANT-NAME X22, PA-MERCHANT-CITY X13, PA-MERCHANT-STATE X2, PA-MERCHANT-ZIP X9, PA-TRANSACTION-ID X15, PA-MATCH-STATUS X (P/D/E/M), PA-AUTH-FRAUD X (F/R), PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE X8, FILLER X17.
- Read: GN/GNP. Written: DLET of PAUTDTL1 and PAUTSUM0 only. No REPL.

##### Outputs & side effects
- Deleted expired detail segments; deleted summary roots whose approved count <= 0 after adjustment.
- IMS checkpoints (commit points) with ID 'RMAD0000'.
- SYSOUT DISPLAY lines: parm echo, date, debug traces, CHKP progress, totals, error lines. RETURN-CODE 16 on any DL/I error.

##### External calls
- IMS DL/I via EXEC DLI (GN, GNP, DLET, CHKP) through DFSRRC00 BMP region. No program CALLs.

##### Migration notes
- **Summary delete condition tests PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT twice** (`<= 0 AND <= 0`); PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT is never checked, so a summary with only declined auths left - or with remaining non-expired declined details - is deleted when approved count is 0. Deleting a root in IMS also deletes all its remaining children, so non-expired declined details can be lost.
- Counter/amount adjustments in 4000 are made to the in-memory summary only; there is **no REPL**, so surviving summaries keep their old counts/amounts in the DB.
- P-CHKP-FREQ / P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ are PIC X(05) compared with numeric DISPLAY counters (9(8)); COBOL compares as alphanumeric (numeric operand treated as its 8-digit character form, shorter operand space-padded), so `00000002 > '00001   '` is false - checkpoint frequency does not behave as an integer threshold. Defaults are moved as '5'/'10' left-justified. Re-implement deliberately (likely intended integers).
- Expiry uses Julian YYDDD subtraction; across a year boundary (e.g. 25001-24365=636) the difference is not a day count; Y2K-style 2-digit year. With JCL value '00', every detail qualifies (diff >= 0).
- WS-ERR-FLG never set (dead loop condition); WK-CHKPT-ID-CTR never incremented; no XRST/restart logic despite checkpoints.
- IO-PCB-MASK/PGM-PCB-MASK linkage unused; PCB selection by number (2).
recommendation: Fully traced. Confirm with business whether the duplicated PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT test (summary delete) and the missing REPL of adjusted summary totals are intended, and whether checkpoint frequency should be numeric.

title: DBUNLDGS / UNLDGSAM - unload pending-authorization IMS DB to GSAM files
description:
##### Entry point
JCL **UNLDGSAM** (`app/app-authorization-ims-db2-mq/jcl/UNLDGSAM.JCL`) STEP01 `EXEC PGM=DFSRRC00,PARM='DLI,DBUNLDGS,DLIGSAMP,,,,,,,,,,,N'` (IMS DLI batch region). Program **DBUNLDGS** (batch) entered via `PROCEDURE DIVISION USING PAUTBPCB PASFLPCB PADFLPCB` and `ENTRY 'DLITCBL'` with the same three PCB masks (PAUTBPCB DB PCB; PASFLPCB, PADFLPCB GSAM PCBs).

##### Inputs
- PSB **DLIGSAMP**: PCB PAUTBPCB DBD DBPAUTP0 PROCOPT=GOTP KEYLEN=14 (SENSEG PAUTSUM0, PAUTDTL1); GSAM PCB DBD PASFLDBD PROCOPT=LS; GSAM PCB DBD PADFLDBD PROCOPT=LS.
- IMS HIDAM DB DBPAUTP0 (root PAUTSUM0 100 bytes = CIPAUSMY, child PAUTDTL1 200 bytes = CIPAUDTY; see CBPAUP0C flow for field layouts).
- No SYSIN read (PRM-INFO declared but unused).

##### Processing flow
1. `1000-INITIALIZE`: ACCEPT DATE/DAY, DISPLAY start banner. (No OPEN - GSAM files are opened by IMS.)
2. Loop `2000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-SUMMARY` until WS-END-OF-ROOT-SEG='Y': `CALL 'CBLTDLI' USING FUNC-GN PAUTBPCB PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY ROOT-UNQUAL-SSA ('PAUTSUM0 ')`.
   - status spaces: count, copy summary to OPFIL1-REC, ROOT-SEG-KEY = PA-ACCT-ID; **only if PA-ACCT-ID IS NUMERIC**: `3100-INSERT-PARENT-SEG-GSAM` (ISRT PASFLPCB PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY; non-space status -> abend), reset WS-END-OF-CHILD-SEG, loop `3000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-DTL` until 'Y'.
   - 'GB' -> end of roots. Any other non-space status -> 9999-ABEND.
3. `3000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-DTL`: `CBLTDLI GNP PAUTBPCB PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS CHILD-UNQUAL-SSA ('PAUTDTL1 ')`; spaces -> copy to CHILD-SEG-REC, `3200-INSERT-CHILD-SEG-GSAM` (ISRT PADFLPCB PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS; non-space -> abend); 'GE' -> end of children; other -> abend.
4. `4000-FILE-CLOSE`: DISPLAY only (CLOSE statements are commented out). GOBACK.
5. `9999-ABEND`: DISPLAY, RETURN-CODE 16, GOBACK.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  J[UNLDGSAM STEP01 DFSRRC00 DLI,DBUNLDGS,DLIGSAMP] --> I[1000-INITIALIZE]
  I --> R[2000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-SUMMARY CBLTDLI GN PAUTSUM0]
  R -->|GB| C[4000-FILE-CLOSE / GOBACK]
  R -->|other err| AB[9999-ABEND RC16]
  R -->|OK & PA-ACCT-ID numeric| P[3100 ISRT PASFLPCB root GSAM]
  R -->|OK not numeric| R
  P --> D[3000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-DTL CBLTDLI GNP PAUTDTL1]
  D -->|OK| W[3200 ISRT PADFLPCB child GSAM] --> D
  D -->|GE| R
  D -->|other| AB
  W -->|err| AB
```

##### Data
- Read: DBPAUTP0 roots/children in hierarchical sequence.
- Written: GSAM PASFLDBD (DD PASFILOP, DSN AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PAUTDB.ROOT.GSAM, DISP=(OLD,KEEP,KEEP)) - 100-byte summary images; GSAM PADFLDBD (DD PADFILOP, DSN AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PAUTDB.CHILD.GSAM) - 200-byte detail images. Also DDPAUTP0/DDPAUTX0 IMS DB datasets in JCL.

##### Outputs & side effects
Two GSAM sequential files; SYSOUT counters/diagnostics; RC 16 on error. Database unchanged (read-only GOTP).

##### External calls
IMS `CBLTDLI` (GN, GNP, ISRT on GSAM). No other programs.

##### Migration notes
- Child GSAM records are the raw 200-byte detail **without the parent key** (ROOT-SEG-KEY/CHILD-SEG-REC are filled in OPFIL2-REC but the ISRT passes PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS), so parent linkage is implicit only by file order; contrast with PAUDBLOD which expects key+detail (206 bytes) in INFILE2 - the outputs of this unload are not directly the input format of PAUDBLOD.
- Roots whose packed PA-ACCT-ID is not numeric are silently skipped together with all their children.
- Detail-read counter increments WS-NO-SUMRY-READ (copy/paste); WS-NO-DTL-READ unused. FD/SELECTs for OPFILE1/OPFILE2 commented out; WS-PGMNAME literal is 'IMSUNLOD'.
- 'GE' on root GN or 'GB' on GNP are treated as errors (abend).
recommendation: Fully traced. Align unload output and loader input formats in the target design.

title: CODATE01 (CICS CDRD) - MQ request/reply system date service
description:
##### Entry point
CICS transaction **CDRD** -> program **CODATE01** (CSD `app/app-vsam-mq/csd/CRDDEMOM.csd`), started by an MQ trigger monitor (EXEC CICS RETRIEVE of MQTM). Online MQ request/reply service returning the CICS system date/time.

##### Inputs
- Trigger message MQTM: MQTM-QNAME -> INPUT-QUEUE-NAME.
- Request message (MQGET up to 1000 bytes into REQUEST-MESSAGE; layout REQUEST-MSG-COPY: WS-FUNC X(4), WS-KEY 9(11), filler X(985)) - **content is not inspected**; any message triggers a date reply.
- MQMD MsgId/CorrelId/ReplyToQ saved (ReplyToQ saved but not used).

##### Processing flow
1. `2100-OPEN-ERROR-QUEUE`: MQOPEN 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR' (MQOO-OUTPUT + PASS-ALL-CONTEXT + FAIL-IF-QUIESCING); failure -> 8000-TERMINATION (no error message).
2. `EXEC CICS RETRIEVE INTO(MQTM)`: NORMAL -> input queue = MQTM-QNAME, reply queue = 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.DATE'; else build 'CICS RETRIEVE' error text, 9000-ERROR, 8000-TERMINATION.
3. `2300-OPEN-INPUT-QUEUE` (MQOO-INPUT-SHARED + SAVE-ALL-CONTEXT + FAIL-IF-QUIESCING; error 'INP MQOPEN ERR'), `2400-OPEN-OUTPUT-QUEUE` (reply queue, MQOO-OUTPUT + PASS-ALL-CONTEXT; error 'OUT MQOPEN ERR'). Errors -> 9000-ERROR + 8000-TERMINATION.
4. `3000-GET-REQUEST`: MQGET with MQGMO-SYNCPOINT + FAIL-IF-QUIESCING + CONVERT + WAIT 5000 ms. OK -> save ids, `4000-PROCESS-REQUEST-REPLY`. MQRC-NO-MSG-AVAILABLE -> NO-MORE-MSGS. Other -> 'INP MQGET ERR:' 9000-ERROR + 8000-TERMINATION.
5. `4000-MAIN-PROCESS` repeated until NO-MORE-MSGS: `EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT` then 3000-GET-REQUEST.
6. `4000-PROCESS-REQUEST-REPLY`: ASKTIME; FORMATTIME MMDDYYYY with DATESEP('-'), TIME with TIMESEP; STRING 'SYSTEM DATE : ' mm-dd-yyyy 'SYSTEM TIME : ' hh:mm:ss INTO REPLY-MESSAGE; `4100-PUT-REPLY`: MQPUT to reply-queue handle, buffer length 1000, MsgId = saved request MsgId, CorrelId = saved request CorrelId, MQFMT-STRING, CCSID = queue manager, MQPMO-SYNCPOINT + DEFAULT-CONTEXT; failure 'MQPUT ERR' -> 9000-ERROR + 8000.
7. `9000-ERROR`: MQ-ERR-DISPLAY (para name, cond/reason codes, queue name, message) -> ERROR-MESSAGE -> MQPUT to CARD.DEMO.ERROR (syncpoint, length 1000); failure -> 8000.
8. `8000-TERMINATION`: close input queue if REPLY-QUEUE-OPEN (flag actually set by input-queue open), close reply queue if RESP-QUEUE-OPEN, close error queue if ERR-QUEUE-OPEN; `EXEC CICS RETURN` (commits syncpoint work).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  T[MQ trigger -> CICS CDRD CODATE01] --> E[2100-OPEN-ERROR-QUEUE CARD.DEMO.ERROR]
  E --> R[EXEC CICS RETRIEVE MQTM]
  R -->|fail| ER[9000-ERROR MQPUT error queue] --> TM
  R --> O[2300 open input / 2400 open CARD.DEMO.REPLY.DATE]
  O --> G[3000-GET-REQUEST MQGET wait 5s syncpoint]
  G -->|msg| P[4000-PROCESS-REQUEST-REPLY ASKTIME FORMATTIME] --> PUT[4100-PUT-REPLY MQPUT] --> SP[4000-MAIN-PROCESS CICS SYNCPOINT] --> G
  G -->|no msg| TM[8000-TERMINATION MQCLOSE x3, CICS RETURN]
  G -->|error| ER
  PUT -->|error| ER
```

##### Data
No files/DB. Queues: input (trigger-named), CARD.DEMO.REPLY.DATE, CARD.DEMO.ERROR. LIT-ACCTFILENAME declared, unused.

##### Outputs & side effects
One reply per request message, 1000-byte space-padded text `SYSTEM DATE : MM-DD-YYYYSYSTEM TIME : HH:MM:SS`; error messages to CARD.DEMO.ERROR.

##### External calls
IBM MQ MQOPEN/MQGET/MQPUT/MQCLOSE (IBM copybooks CMQ*, not in repo); CICS RETRIEVE, ASKTIME, FORMATTIME, SYNCPOINT, RETURN.

##### Migration notes
- Reply goes to the fixed queue CARD.DEMO.REPLY.DATE, ignoring the request's ReplyToQ; reply reuses the request MsgId and CorrelId.
- MQGET and MQPUT are under syncpoint; the first GET happens before the loop and SYNCPOINT occurs before each subsequent GET, so get+put commit together.
- `MOVE WS-CICS-RESP2-CD TO WS-CICS-RESP2-CD` (self-move) - RESP2 display field never populated.
- Error-queue open failure and error-queue put failure terminate without logging; close errors call 8000-TERMINATION recursively (potential repeated close attempts).
- Fixed 1000-byte reply length (no trimming).
recommendation: Fully traced; MQ structures from IBM copybooks not in repo.

- Correlation: reply MSGID and CORRELID copied from request.
- MQ-MSG-COUNT has no VALUE (uninitialised display numeric) and is never output.
- Close failures recursively call 8000-TERMINATION (and 5200 calls 9000-ERROR on the queue being closed) - potential loop.
